passages.text: This shall be remembered as one of the darkest days in the history of our world. But hope remains. Elune's light has strengthened our resolve.

passages.title: The Demon's Trail
passages.text:
Malfurion is nearby. I can sense him.

Search the summit of Andu'talah while I continue to scour the forest.

Be swift, <name>. Time is of the essence!

passages.title: The Demon's Trail
passages.text:
My husband, Malfurion, what has become of him?!

Answer me!

passages.title: Turn the Keys
passages.text:
My roots wither... my branches die...

The Bonespeakers, they seek to silence the Runewood. The runestones are the key...

Turn the stones... release my bonds...

passages.title: Turn the Keys
passages.text: My shackles remain...

passages.title: Turn the Keys
passages.text:
So it was your footsteps I felt upon my woods as the runestones released their grip? 

You have my thanks, outsider.

passages.title: Bjornharta
passages.text:
The afterlife leaves the dead hungry for the delicacies of their former lives. For the vrykul kings, none such offering is prized more than Bjornharta - a celebratory feast of an engorged bear heart. 

The bears of the Runewood eat well, and have long been prized for their tender meat. Hunt them and find a suitable heart of offer to the ancient rulers. They will not be able to resist such an offering.

passages.title: Bjornharta
passages.text: How went the hunt, outsider?

passages.title: Bjornharta
passages.text:
These hearts are fat and bloody. 

The slumbering rulers will not refuse an offering of Bjornharta.

passages.title: The Dreaming Fungus
passages.text:
So an outsider would seek to be judged by the ancient rulers of the vrykul? Curious, this. Know that they will not take to your presence kindly, stranger.

If you are so hasty to meet judgment, you can call them forth with a ritual of wakening. To complete this ritual, you will require an aromatic to burn and an offering to present.

A plant grows in the Runewood that will make a suitable incense. Gather it, and I will instruct you further.

passages.title: The Dreaming Fungus
passages.text: What do you bring?

passages.title: The Dreaming Fungus
passages.text:
Yes, these Soulcaps should be adequate for your ritual. 

Speak with me once you are ready to proceed and I will guide you further.

passages.title: Judgment Day
passages.text:
You have proven resourceful thus far, stranger. As promised, I will instruct you on the ritual of wakening.

First, you must place the offering directly atop the grave of the ruler you wish to awaken. Burn the incense so that its aroma wafts over the grave. If your offering is adequate, the ruler will rise, and you may ask your judgment.

Take care, outsider. The dead vrykul kings will not enjoy being awakened from their slumber.

passages.title: Judgment Day
passages.text:
Ashildir's grave has been disturbed, outsider. 

Do you know something of this?

passages.title: Waking the Shieldmaiden
passages.text:
With the rituals disrupted and her bones returned, we may be able to wrest Ashildir from the grasp of these Bonespeakers.

Deeper within Haustvald, the mystics possess a special altar that can reunite the body and spirit of a fallen warrior. With this, we may be able to return Ashildir's spirit into her bones, and out of the grasp of these foul mystics.

Go outsider, I will rally her guard.

passages.title: Waking the Shieldmaiden
passages.text:
Where... where am I now? 

I... know you...

passages.title: Breaking the Bonespeakers
passages.text:
The crimes of these ritualists must not go unpunished, but we cannot be their executioners. The rune magic they practice grants them untold power over the dead.

You, however, are not dead, and I can sense great power from you. Take the fight to these heretics, and show Ashildir that you are truly worthy of her judgment!

passages.title: Breaking the Bonespeakers
passages.text: Your glorious battle honors the Valkyra queen.

passages.title: Regal Remains
passages.text:
So you seek the judgment of the queen of the Valkyra? This must be your fault!

The Bonespeakers of Haustvald have committed an atrocity and stolen Ashildir's bones. They must have done this to keep an outsider from completing the trials. You must not let this stand!

Enter Haustvald and retrieve her remains. I hope, for your sake, that Ashildir is in a forgiving mood.

passages.title: Regal Remains
passages.text: Were you able to recover her remains?

passages.title: Regal Remains
passages.text:
The treachery of the Bonespeakers knows no limit. 

Their rituals seek to sunder the very essence of our queen, but we will use their own magic to return her to us!

passages.title: The Final Judgment
passages.text:
In my fragmented state, I captured glimpses of a hero meting out justice to the corrupted mystics of Haustvald. I see now, this hero was you, <class>. 

I know you seek my judgment, but my spirit is still fragmented. As we speak, Runeseer Faljar is calling upon dark, forbidden magics in an attempt to banish my spirit to Helheim. If he succeeds, your trial will be lost.

My connection here is fading. Go, there is little time!

passages.title: The Final Judgment
passages.text:
I cannot believe this fate... 

I am sorry, outsider, for I had underestimated Faljar's power.

That he could banish us here... is unthinkable.

passages.title: Into the Fray
passages.text:
The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.

Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.

passages.title: Into the Fray
passages.text:
The two of you are a welcome sight. We pushed the demons out of these ruins, but they are stronger than any we have encountered before.

Your help is appreciated. If we do not crush this Legion invasion now, they will overrun Azsuna and then the rest of the Broken Isles.

passages.title: Clear the Deck!
passages.text:
Our mission in Skold-Ashil will have to wait, <class> - for now, we have more pressing matters to attend to.

I had just recently arrived with reinforcements for our assault when Greymane's ship sailed in and began barraging our walls. We deployed our siege weapons, but their ground forces quickly overwhelmed us.

If you can get to those catapults and take out the dogs manning the cannons, it may give us the window we need to push the attack!

passages.title: Clear the Deck!
passages.text: Hah! Greymane will find his cannons aren't so useful when the blight takes his crew!

passages.title: Shielded Secrets
passages.text:
Our goal lies within that vault, <class>. I don't have time to explain in detail - just know that it is vital to the Forsaken that we succeed.

The shieldmaidens have proven tenacious in their defense, but I believe there may be another way in. A chosen few of their order are allowed entrance, and I need you to find out how.

In the town I have seen intricately engraved shields which I believe are passed down from these champions. The scenes they depict may be the key to passing into the vault.

passages.title: Shielded Secrets
passages.text:
I would hope that you bring me some good news, <class>. 

For both of our sake.

passages.title: A New Life for Undeath
passages.text:
It seems that you are full of surprises, <name>. With the blessing of the Valkyra queen, you have opened a path that will shape the destiny of Azeroth.

I invite you to bear witness, for today a new day dawns on the Forsaken!

passages.title: A New Life for Undeath
passages.text:
It looks like we underestimated Greymane's tenacity - a mistake that cost the Forsaken dearly. 

This Eyir cannot hide for long, however. If I must I will hunt her through the Halls of Valor! 

Go now, <class>. I will call upon you when you are needed.

passages.title: Keepers of the Hammer
passages.text:
The Highmountain Tribes had intended to pledge our allegiance to your forces. We know war has come with the Burning Legion.

However, we have been betrayed from within and must now ask for your aid.

A great relic, the Hammer of Khaz'goroth, was stolen from our people by the vile drogbar.

We need your help in recovering it.

passages.title: Keepers of the Hammer
passages.text: We must be swift. I was overlong in finding you.

passages.title: Keepers of the Hammer
passages.text: I know you seek the Pillar of Creation but I am sad to say it was one of many things we lost today.

passages.title: Get to High Ground
passages.text:
It is no accident that Dargrul attacked the Rivermane in force. It is their farms and their pastures that supply food for the region.

Please, get Jale to Thunder Totem. With luck, Mayla will have reinforcements to send to the area.

We will rally the survivors here and follow as quickly as we can.

passages.title: Get to High Ground
passages.text: Have you had any luck with the Rivermane?

passages.title: Get to High Ground
passages.text:
Riverbend was... destroyed? That disgusting beast Dargrul! I will not stop until I see him dead.

But we cannot do that with the army we have.

We need help from the other tribes.

passages.title: Rocs vs Eagles
passages.text:
High Crawliac has taught her witches how to curse our beloved eagles into the vile rocs you see assaulting the valley.

There is no way to break this curse once it has taken hold.

We will take to the skies and do battle with the rocs, but we need your help on the ground.

Head north through Darkfeather Valley and release any eagles that you find.

Every eagle you save is one less roc we must kill later.

passages.title: Rocs vs Eagles
passages.text:
Your bravery has returned to us some of our fine feathered friends. Well done.

Now how do you feel about a frontal assault?

passages.title: The Rivermane Tribe
passages.text:
What has happened here requires more time than I have to explain. In short, our tribes have scattered in the wake of the attack that left the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in the hands of the barbaric drogbar.

Even now the drogbar are raiding the Rivermane tribe, and I have too few braves left to send to their aid. 

We need a hero. Please, go to Earthmother's Bounty and lend what aid you can.

passages.title: The Rivermane Tribe
passages.text:
Mayla was still able to send help? I could hug that child.

Welcome, outsider. I am Jale Rivermane, Chieftain of the Rivermane tribe. And we could really use your help.

passages.title: The Bloodtotem Tribe
passages.text:
The Bloodtotem are led by Torok, a volatile but useful tauren chieftain. He is wary of outsiders, but I believe you have already met an emissary to their tribe--Oakin Ironbull--whom you rescued at Riverbend.

Use that small thread and you may be able to bring the Bloodtotem back into the fold. Highmountain needs them if we are to defeat the drogbar and reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. Be on your guard, <name>.

passages.title: The Bloodtotem Tribe
passages.text: Outsider, you are one of few from beyond Highmountain who has made it into these woods alive. With me vouching for you, the Bloodtotem have been given a no-kill order by Torok.

passages.title: The Skyhorn Tribe
passages.text:
The Skyhorn people are some of the greatest pathfinders and hunters this world has ever known.

They are a proud people, but should be willing to listen to reason.

If the roads feel unsafe, you may ask any flight master in Highmountain to fly you there.

Please, adventurer, go to their leader Lasan and remind him that only together, we are Highmountain.

passages.title: The Skyhorn Tribe
passages.text: Ha ha! And what are you, tiny creature? Have you come to battle us or join us in battle?

passages.title: Battle of Snowblind Mesa
passages.text:
Your timing is fortunate. Our forces at Snowblind Mesa report seeing the Underking above ground.

What is more, he is lightly guarded, and has the hammer with him. Thanks to your efforts, we can meet them in battle.

Meet us at Snowblind Mesa and let us take the fight to Dargrul together.

passages.title: Battle of Snowblind Mesa
passages.text: That... is a lot of drogbar.

passages.title: Littlefur
passages.text:
Stranger, I beseech you! My once peaceful brethren are now cursed with insatiable wrath.

My nephew and I tried to leave against the Chieftain's wishes. The clan wrested him from me, and would have torn me apart if I did not flee.

He is trapped in the village, and I fear the worst.

Great <class>, please save him. I am too old and too weak to do it myself.

passages.title: Littlefur
passages.text: Uncle?

passages.title: Logistical Matters
passages.text:
I think we are ready to... reintroduce ourselves to the Legion on the Broken Isles.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker has volunteered to help coordinate our forces on the ground. You should speak with him immediately, Highlord.

passages.title: Logistical Matters
passages.text: Now is the time to strike back against the Legion.

passages.title: Grasp of the Underking
passages.text:
If we have one good fortune in this it is that Dargrul has no knowledge of how to use the hammer.

He keeps thinking of the hammer as a weapon instead of a tool of creation.

Even so, he has imprisoned our tribesman in fists of stone summoned from the earth. Our weapons have proven useless against this magic.

You might have power enough to break these fists. Can you help?

passages.title: Grasp of the Underking
passages.text: How are the captives? Did you find them alive?

passages.title: Grasp of the Underking
passages.text:
It has been an age or more since the drogbar last walked the surface in such numbers.

They became the dark stories we tell children.

passages.title: The Drogbar
passages.text:
It wasn't enough for Dargrul to just destroy this village. He has also sent his Stoneraiders to take what is left.

Please champion, prove to my people that you are the hero I foresaw.

Slay enough of these Stoneraiders that it breaks their resolve.

passages.title: The Drogbar
passages.text: The drogbar were supposed to be our allies against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: The Drogbar
passages.text: Your battle skills are impressive.

passages.title: Dargrul and the Hammer
passages.text:
We are about to follow a drogbar into a cave, something we warn our children never to do.

Even so, several of our warbraves have already followed Dargrul inside.

Come, join us in battle and let us reclaim the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

passages.title: Dargrul and the Hammer
passages.text: This is a hard day.

passages.title: Dargrul and the Hammer
passages.text:
Oro and the others? Did they make it out as well?

Such destruction. So many good warbraves have fallen today.

It is clear now, we will need the full might of the Highmountain tribes if we are to recover the hammer.

passages.title: Bitestone Enclave
passages.text:
This is an old drogbar enclave that we used to trade with. Now it is a base of operations for their raids.

I need more time to gather what is left of our warbraves. Go, enter the enclave, and slay any you find in there.

Buy us the time we need to gather our strength.

passages.title: Bitestone Enclave
passages.text: Highmountain stands!

passages.title: Bitestone Enclave
passages.text: Thank you for clearing us a path. We should have a straight shot at Dargrul now.

passages.title: Call of the Illidari
passages.text:
<name>, Altruis requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.

<Kor'vas leans in close, her voice an urgent whisper.>

You must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

passages.title: Call of the Illidari
passages.text: We need to move quickly. With every moment we sit here, the Legion's hold strengthens.

passages.title: To Catch a Banshee
passages.text:
The strange-talking vrykul said I might be able to meet you here. I have orders from Greymane. It seems he may have a lead on Sylvanas' location.

He's set up a camp near the base of the mountain. We've run into some troubles, though. It looks like the Horde may have homed in on our position.

We could use your help. You can take my gryphon. Just speak to me when you're ready to leave.

passages.title: To Catch a Banshee
passages.text: It is good you arrived when you did, <name>.

passages.title: Combustible Contagion
passages.text:
It is true that we may have a lead on Sylvanas. Though I want nothing more than to get my hands on the Banshee Queen, the situation here at Greywatch requires immediate attention.

Yesterday, a regiment of guards returned with word of Forsaken forces in the woods. Several of them bore signs of a blight, similar to the one we endured in Gilneas. It would appear these Forsaken seek to unleash this blight upon Greywatch.

Seek out their caches and destroy them, before the blight overtakes us!

passages.title: Combustible Contagion
passages.text: Have the caches been taken care of?

passages.title: Combustible Contagion
passages.text:
The deed is done. 

You have done a great service to the worgen of Greywatch, <name>.

passages.title: To Skold-Ashil
passages.text:
We have her now! According to these reports, Sylvanas' forces are after something in Skold-Ashil - a vrykul town not far from here. We must make our way there and track her down.

I had previously dispatched Commander Lorna Crowley and a detachment of Gilneas Brigade to scout the position. Meet up with her there and find out what Sylvanas is after.

Meanwhile, I will muster the fleet to assault their outpost. We will have justice if I have to reduce their camp to rubble!

passages.title: To Skold-Ashil
passages.text:
So the cavalry has arrived? 

Good, we must make haste if we wish to uncover Sylvanas' plot before it comes to bear.

passages.title: Shielded Secrets
passages.text:
It's obvious at this point that the Horde wants something in Skold-Ashil. Unfortunately we still don't know what they're after.

We think the secret lies with the shieldmaidens here, so we need to find out more about them. Some early scouting revealed that they have a method of carving their shields to tell their stories. 

Go into the city and find as many of these shields as you can. With luck, we will find what Sylvanas seeks.

passages.title: Shielded Secrets
passages.text:
Val'kyr, you say? This is worse that I had imagined. If Sylvanas is able to create more Val'kyr, there will be no limit to her armies!

It seems the vault is her goal. We must stop her!

passages.title: Shriek No More
passages.text:
Papa loved this village. He'd never hear of leaving, even in these dread times.

Before he died, he told me what attacked him: a monstrous falcon we call Rotbeak.

You're fighting these undead, aren't you? Will you avenge my father? If so, you can find the beast northwest of here, patrolling our western route to the sea.

passages.title: Shriek No More
passages.text:
Papa always said the only way he'd leave here would be feet-first.

I wish he'd been wrong.

passages.title: Shriek No More
passages.text:
Thank you. Grisly, eh? I think I'll mount it over the door.

I want you to have this, too. Fresh-caught mossgill was Papa's favorite.

passages.title: Ending the New Beginning
passages.text:
The Banshee Queen is here! I'd recognize those tainted arrows anywhere.

This is the moment we have been fighting for. Sylvanas will answer for her crimes against Varian Wrynn and the Alliance!

To arms!

passages.title: Ending the New Beginning
passages.text:
You're awake! We nearly lost you there... 

It's a good thing we managed to get you and Greymane out of there in time, otherwise we wouldn't have been able to reverse Sylvanas's poison. It's a shame she got away, but her plans in Skold-Ashil failed and we have you to thank for it. 

I'm sure Greymane will order a commendation for you once he is fully recovered. You did a great thing here, <name>. 

Gilneas is in your debt.

passages.title: Testing a Theory
passages.text:
Now that the Bloodstone has fed, I hope to use its power to bend the will of demons that would otherwise not be so easily controlled.

Of course, this is all theory. I have never witnessed the direct effect of the Bloodstone's power on a demon. This is where you come in.

I have procured a few imps that should make suitable test subjects. Use the Bloodstone on them and report back to me with your findings.

passages.title: Testing a Theory
passages.text: Have you tested the Bloodstone yet? I have imprisoned a few imps in the cave behind me that should make suitable test subjects.

passages.title: Testing a Theory
passages.text:
The subject died during the testing process? Well that was unexpected.

Nonetheless, you've held up your end of the bargain. I suppose it's time for me to fulfill mine.

passages.title: A Village in Peril
passages.text:
Another outsider? Some bloke named Jarod just went off to our village down the road claiming he might be able to help us with our problem.

If you're here to help as well, then you best speak to the Mayor.

Just know this is a bad time, and he's got an itchy trigger finger.

passages.title: A Village in Peril
passages.text: We don't need any help, and we don't like strangers wanderin' around on our land.

passages.title: Bloodstone Bandit
passages.text:
Something of personal value has been taken from me, and my work here cannot continue until I get it back.

To most it would appear to be an ordinary stone, but it is so much more than a simple rock - it lives and breathes!

The nearby naga have been snatching anything with any sort of magical significance, my stone included. Fortunately, they do not know how to access its power.

Return my stone to me, and I will consider your request for help.

passages.title: Bloodstone Bandit
passages.text: Have you recovered my Bloodstone yet?

passages.title: Bloodstone Bandit
passages.text: You're quite resourceful. I can see why Ritssyn likes to send you on errands.

passages.title: Legacy of the Icebreaker
passages.text:
The greatest warrior should wield the greatest weapons. Long ago a great king, Magnar Icebreaker, wielded weapons crafted from a scale of the mightiest dragon in the land. He should be here, but he is not. Instead he languishes in his tomb.

His son, Hruthnir, is here. He will lead you to the tomb. If Magnar can be saved, do so. Either way, return with his weapons.

passages.title: Legacy of the Icebreaker
passages.text: You have done well. You will bring many victories to these Halls.

passages.title: Legacy of the Icebreaker
passages.text: A great deed was done today. I have gained a mighty <class>, and you a powerful artifact.

passages.title: The Eye of Odyn
passages.text:
It is time to begin the war in Azeroth. We have prepared a tool for you to direct your warriors and your own operations from here. It is called the Eye of Odyn. 

If you will follow me, I will take you to it, and someone that will help you use it.

passages.title: The Eye of Odyn
passages.text: It has been a while since I've talked to the living. I hope you don't mind if I assist you. Being slain in combat has given me a calmer outlook in this emergency than other warriors.

passages.title: Call of the Illidari
passages.text:
<name>, Kayn requests that you meet him at Krasus' Landing at once.

<Kor'vas leans in close, her voice an urgent whisper.>

You must hurry. The Legion has eyes everywhere.

passages.title: Call of the Illidari
passages.text: We have much to do, and precious little time to do it.

passages.title: Poisoned Crops
passages.text:
After driving us from the farmland and infesting our crops with insects, the drogbar placed wicked totems that further poison our harvest.

I can only hope that if you destroy them, we'll be able to heal the land using Jale's water magic.

Thank you for coming to help us, <name>. We are but simple farmers and fishermen, and have little prowess in combat.

passages.title: Poisoned Crops
passages.text: The crops must be rid of this poison!

passages.title: Poisoned Crops
passages.text: Thank you, <race>. Some of the crops still live. I believe with hard work and some of Jale's magical waters, we will not lose the entire harvest.

passages.title: Spray and Prey
passages.text:
The Bug Sprayer you recovered from Ormgul the Pestilent seems like it could give us an advantage against the drogbar and their insects.

Spray the Drogbar with their own alchemy and watch their insects turn against them.

passages.title: Spray and Prey
passages.text: For this group of drogbar to turn against us after so many years of peace...

passages.title: Spray and Prey
passages.text: That worked quite well. I will hold on to this Bug Sprayer; it might be useful in the battles to come.

passages.title: Trapped Tauren
passages.text:
The drogbar just rounded up those of us that they could and led them to a cave near here.

If you act quickly, I think they can still be saved. I know not what purpose they have for capturing our people.

I shudder to think of it... in the deep places, the darkness rules.

passages.title: Trapped Tauren
passages.text: They slew many of my brothers and sisters, but at least some managed to escape. Others, however, we captured.

passages.title: Trapped Tauren
passages.text: They have returned relatively unharmed. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Three
passages.text:
When High Crawliac seized control of the harpies she placed 3 powerful and deadly witches in charge of the covens under her command.

These witches must die. Feel up for the challenge?

Head into the Haglands behind me and find these three evil creatures.

We will cover you from the air and give your prey no sky to retreat.

Look for us higher up the mountain, should you survive.

passages.title: The Three
passages.text: Many Skyhorn have fallen to the witchcraft of these hags.

passages.title: The Three
passages.text: Well done. Now to cut the head off the snake, as it were.

passages.title: The Witchqueen
passages.text:
The time has come to assault High Crawliac, the Witchqueen.

You should know that one does not become queen of the harpies through kindness.

This creature has killed, betrayed, and tormented countless tauren, harpies, kobolds, and anything else she had to in order to secure her position as queen.

Come, friend, let us finish this.

passages.title: The Witchqueen
passages.text: Without a queen, it will take the harpies many years before they can organize in such numbers again.

passages.title: The Witchqueen
passages.text: You have our respect and honor, <name>. I name you Skyfriend, and grant you free passage through our lands at your discretion.

passages.title: Witch of the Wood
passages.text:
You saved me at Riverbend not long ago. It is the reason I vouched for you as emissary to this tribe, and the only reason you're alive here now. I consider my debt to you paid.

You must prove yourself to the Bloodtotem chieftain before he will speak with you.

Within the forest is the Witch of the Wood, a harpy mother who recently descended into this territory. If you are able to defeat her and show her carcass to the Bloodtotem, they might allow you an audience with Torok.

passages.title: Witch of the Wood
passages.text: The Bloodtotem don't often allow outsiders into their midst. Even asking them to give you an audience is a danger.

passages.title: An Audience with Torok
passages.text:
I should warn you that Torok is easily displeased and is hateful of outsiders. Be on your guard.

We will seek an audience with him at his tent at the Cliff's Edge. As the Rivermane Emissary here, I am afforded some protection against aggression, but they have made no such promises about you.

passages.title: An Audience with Torok
passages.text: I just hope the Bloodtotem don't cut us down for demanding their chieftain's time.

passages.title: An Audience with Torok
passages.text: Strange that he would be in the cavern at this time... perhaps this is a good sign?

passages.title: Rock Troll in a Hard Place
passages.text:
We should leave this place while we have a chance. The Bloodtotem are amassing at their village to the north, and I believe they intend to kill my people.

Let me know when you are ready to go, and I can take us to a safe place quickly.

passages.title: Rock Troll in a Hard Place
passages.text: You have little reason to trust me, but we have a common enemy in the Bloodtotem and I could use your help.

passages.title: Dishonored
passages.text:
Xandris the Dishonored was among the first to betray his brethren and accept the curse of Xavius.

During the great war, it was he who led the slaughter of many of my dearest friends.

The last time I met him on the battlefield he fled. Help me to finally dispense justice on this foul being.

passages.title: Dishonored
passages.text: Xandris has finally paid for his crimes, but his blood will not bring back the innocents he has slain.

passages.title: The Corruptor
passages.text:
Xandris has been slain, but there are others that must be dealt with if my grove is to be saved.

During the great war, Kagraxxis took great pleasure in corrupting the lands he once called home.

Were it not for the foolish mercy of my fellow druids, I would have slain him myself.

Find the demon and bring justice upon him.

I must entrust this task to you alone, for I sense an even darker presence here... one that requires my personal attention.

passages.title: The Corruptor
passages.text: Kagraxxis must be slain.

passages.title: The Corruptor
passages.text:
You have my thanks, <class>.

If not for your arrival I would have surely perished here.

passages.title: The Skies of Highmountain
passages.text:
When you are ready, join me at the base of Thunder Totem.

I would be honored to have you at my side as my tribe once again swears its allegiance to the young Mayla.

Together, we are Highmountain!

passages.title: The Skies of Highmountain
passages.text: Have you had any luck with Lasan?

passages.title: The Skies of Highmountain
passages.text: The Skyhorn are with us? This day just got much better.

passages.title: It Hungers for Blood
passages.text:
Bloodstones contain a great deal of power that can only be awakened once they are fed. 

Yet this stone does not feast on fish and cakes. It hungers for blood; the more powerful, the better.

There's an infestation of demons just east of here. I need you to nourish my stone with their blood, so that I may unlock its power.

passages.title: It Hungers for Blood
passages.text: Has the Bloodstone been sated yet?

passages.title: It Hungers for Blood
passages.text: The Bloodstone looks sated. Well done! Now it's time for a test...

passages.title: Pet Rocks
passages.text:
I raise creatures born of the earth to help defend myself and my people. When I was captured, I ordered them to stay behind at our home, but they are often disobedient and likely tried to follow me.

If they did, I fear the Bloodtotem may have captured them, or worse. In my current state, I can't muster the strength to find them. If you find them, it would be much appreciated.

passages.title: Pet Rocks
passages.text: These beasts are not terribly bright, but they are loyal in their way.

passages.title: Pet Rocks
passages.text: Frag has fallen? The youngest of my pets was perhaps my most dear... curse the Bloodtotem and their cruelty!

passages.title: Stonedark Crystal
passages.text:
Without my crystalline focus, my powers are weak. Those who captured me took it, and I know not where it is now.

I'm sure one of the Feltotem has it. If you find it, please return it to me.

passages.title: Stonedark Crystal
passages.text: I have power over the earth without my crystal, but my power is much greater with it than without.

passages.title: Stonedark Crystal
passages.text: This will help me repair my broken body.

passages.title: Blood Debt
passages.text:
You have proven a much greater ally than the Bloodtotem ever were. With my focus crystal, my wounds are healed. I fear Frag was too far gone to revive.

Torok and his Bloodtotem will suffer for what they have done to us. Let's pay them a visit before they can mount an attack against the cave of my people.

passages.title: Blood Debt
passages.text: Drogbar are not violent by nature, despite our size. But the Bloodtotem crossed us, and they pay the debt in blood.

passages.title: Blood Debt
passages.text: You have earned my trust. The Stonedark are not yet safe from our brothers led by Dargrul the Underking. We would willingly join Mayla Highmountain and her tauren against them.

passages.title: Unexpected Allies
passages.text:
You have gained my trust. Not all drogbar are as violent as the savages led by Dargrul the Underking, nor are all tauren as bloodthirsty as the Bloodtotem.

You may tell Mayla Highmountain that she has our support. The cavern we call home is yours to explore freely as well, <name>.

passages.title: Unexpected Allies
passages.text: Has Torok agreed to join us?

passages.title: Unexpected Allies
passages.text:
Torok is dead? By... your hand? He must have truly given in to his thirst for blood if that came to pass.

The Stonedark on our side, though... That is an advantage I had not expected. Navarrogg has always been much more agreeable than Dargrul and his brood. Thank you for striking this rare alliance, <name>.

passages.title: Crystal Fury
passages.text:
A drogbar stonecaster known as Gelmogg entered our sacred water caverns and aims to draw its power into himself.

We must destroy him before he gets too powerful.

He is in the upper caverns.

passages.title: Crystal Fury
passages.text: The drogbar used to control only earthen magic, but it seems they've found a way to draw power from other sources.

passages.title: Crystal Fury
passages.text: I have never seen a drogbar transform like that. The Hammer of Khaz'goroth is indeed powerful.

passages.title: Balance of Elements
passages.text:
The drogbar place their foul crystals in our cave to absorb the magic within, and then they collect them when they are saturated with power.

We must recover the crystals so the magic might dissipate and be suffused back into the waters, or else the drogbar will find ways to corrupt the magic to their own purposes.

passages.title: Balance of Elements
passages.text: I believe the drogbar are learning stronger magic now that they have possession of the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

passages.title: Balance of Elements
passages.text: With the magic now spreading back into the cave, the balance of elements will be restored and the drogbar will not last long here.

passages.title: Invading Spelunkers
passages.text:
The drogbar and their earthen furies have overrun the cavern. They're perverting the magic within and destroying the elementals that have forever dwelled in this place.

Let's work together to remove them from this sacred cave.

passages.title: Invading Spelunkers
passages.text: We must cleanse the cavern of the drogbar.

passages.title: Invading Spelunkers
passages.text: The cave is nearly restored...

passages.title: Ormgul the Pestilent
passages.text:
We've lived at peace with the drogbar for years--our tribe even more than the others. But we were betrayed in our last trade with them at Riverbend.

They usually supply us with potent alchemy to prevent insects from infesting our fields. This time, led by Ormgul, they have attacked the crops that sustain us all.

Ormgul the Pestilent is the one who brought the infection to our farmland. Destroy him, and bring me whatever he uses to attract the bugs to our land.

passages.title: Ormgul the Pestilent
passages.text:
The Rivermane are a peaceful tribe. We provide the others with food and healing in exchange for protection and equipment.

When pressed, however, I am willing to put my magic to more violent use.

passages.title: Ormgul the Pestilent
passages.text: Now we have what they used to spray our fields. I wonder what use we could put this to...

passages.title: High Water
passages.text:
Riverbend! Is that what the Underking said?

That is my home and the place where we store our winter supplies. We must make it there at all speed and warn them.

Meet me there.

passages.title: High Water
passages.text: It would seem we beat the Underking here.

passages.title: The Path of Huln
passages.text:
Armies are vital to the success of a war. But so are symbols.

For our people, few things make for a better symbol than the blessings of our most eldest ancestors.

Mayla must walk the Path of Huln.

The path is dangerous, and she may only bring two people with her: a spiritwalker to guide her and a champion to protect her.

Will you be the champion?

passages.title: The Path of Huln
passages.text: Quite a drop. Mind yourself in here, this is not a safe place.

passages.title: An Ancient Secret
passages.text:
Before Mayla may be pronounced High Chieftain, there is one more vision she must see. I wish to show you as well.

It is an ancient secret, handed down along the Highmountain bloodline. I ask for your discretion in keeping it that way.

passages.title: An Ancient Secret
passages.text:
That day, the hammer freed me of the corruption of the Black Dragonflight.

In gratitude, I have faithfully served the Highmountain family since Huln rescued me from this pit.

It has been my honor and my pleasure to watch each of his descendants earn the title of High Chieftain.

passages.title: Titanic Showdown
passages.text:
The tale of Huln did not end with him acquiring the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

No. For that part, we must venture deeper into this cavern. A final brazier awaits us ahead.

Come, let us see what happened next.

passages.title: Titanic Showdown
passages.text:
And so Huln cast out Deathwing into the land of Deepholm and claimed the Hammer of Khaz'goroth as his charge.

But there was one last bit of business for him to attend to...

passages.title: The Backdoor
passages.text:
This will take Mayla some time to adjust to.

That being said, we should return to Thunder Totem.

Just south of here is a tunnel that should take us through the old drogbar slave enclave and then to an opening beyond.

We keep a small Skyhorn outpost there to watch and ensure nothing enters or leaves this vault without us knowing about it. They should be able to fly us back.

passages.title: The Backdoor
passages.text: I always thought it odd that Ebonhorn never seemed to age. Or at least, he always looked old, but he never got older.

passages.title: The High Chieftain
passages.text:
I understand what Ebonhorn has been trying to tell me for a while now.

Our people do not need a hammer, we need a leader. One willing to stand against any threat, even if they are terrified to do so.

And between you and me, I am definitely terrified, but resolved.

Let us return to Thunder Totem and prepare ourselves for war.

passages.title: The High Chieftain
passages.text: Even without the hammer, I know what to do next. When our forces are rallied, we can take the fight to the Underking.

passages.title: They Will Pay With Blood
passages.text:
The tauren go too far. I did not escape their outpost for fear that they would attack the cave and slaughter my people.

It looks like they planned to do it all along. Slay some of the Feltotem. Thin the herd.

passages.title: They Will Pay With Blood
passages.text: These tauren have always been bloodthirsty. The Highmountain chieftain has barely been able to stop them killing all of us.

passages.title: They Will Pay With Blood
passages.text: Their numbers are fewer, but still they threaten our safety.

passages.title: The Shattered Watcher
passages.text:
When your adversary - the one called Skovald- completed his first trial, he used his ill-begotten powers to sunder my physical body.

I cannot allow a contender to pass through the vault while I remain unwhole. 

His forces have no doubt scattered my pieces through the plateau which they currently desecrate. Bring them back to me, so that I may properly guide your trial.

passages.title: The Shattered Watcher
passages.text: Have you managed to find them all?

passages.title: The Shattered Watcher
passages.text:
Wonderful! 

It is good to be whole again!

passages.title: A Trial of Might
passages.text:
I owe you my gratitude for helping make me whole again, outsider. It is clear that you are worthy to take on the trials. 

Go now into the vault. There you will find the archive for the first trial you must undertake.

I will meet you inside.

passages.title: A Trial of Might
passages.text:
The trial is done, and you emerge victorious! 

It is a great feat you have done here, but you are not through yet. Many great challenges await you on your path to the Aegis.

passages.title: The Blessing of the Watchers
passages.text:
As is your due for passing the Trial of Might, I will grant you the blessing of the watchers. 

Furthermore, to aid you in your trials to come, I will bestow upon your artifact the power of the vault's keeper. May it serve you well in your time of need.

Speak to me when you are ready to receive this gift.

passages.title: The Blessing of the Watchers
passages.text:
The trial is done and you yet live. This land is full of wonders, yes?

But it looks like the God-King intends to give you trials on top of trials. Still you must hurry, for even now, the next awaits!

passages.title: Fish Out of Water
passages.text:
The drogbar are on a rampage! They're smashing everything they can find and are throwing fish to the shore.

Worst of all, it is the wrong time to harvest fish. They must be returned to the waters so they can breed.

passages.title: Fish Out of Water
passages.text: We used to supply the drogbar with most of their food between our fish and crops. What will the fools eat now?

passages.title: Fish Out of Water
passages.text: Thank you. You saved enough fish that they can breed a new population.

passages.title: Where Dragons Rule
passages.text:
Thanks to your help, Thrymjaris was able to escape the clutches of that vile demon. She bid me wait for you, so that I could take you to her once you had finished dispatching your foes.

She has gathered our brood at the top of Thorim's Peak to prepare for a counterattack. 

Would you join us?

passages.title: Where Dragons Rule
passages.text:
You are truly a hero to my brood.  

You have gained a powerful ally today, outsider. The God-King has reason to fear you.

passages.title: Odyn and the Valarjar
passages.text:
Fear not, mortal, you are not dead. I was directed to collect you before your demise by Odyn himself.

I will take you to Odyn now, follow me.

passages.title: Odyn and the Valarjar
passages.text: Now all here know who you are. It is time for armaments befitting my champion.

passages.title: Lifespring Cavern
passages.text:
The drogbar have taken over my cavern. It is where we Rivermane practice our water magic and get much of the purest healing water in Highmountain.

Meet me there and we will cleanse that sacred place of these dark-dwellers.

passages.title: Lifespring Cavern
passages.text: Are you ready? We are about to enter a cave... and the drogbar are at home in such dark places.

passages.title: Making the Rounds
passages.text:
As you can see, we have spared no expense in showing our support of your great quest.

Final preparations are being made - come, walk with me.

passages.title: Making the Rounds
passages.text: As soon as preparations are complete, we set out for Stormheim.

passages.title: Making the Rounds
passages.text: Do you understand the gravity of our task? If we do not fight for our future, we will not have one.

passages.title: Paradise Lost
passages.text: Archmage Khadgar was planning an expedition to Azsuna - you should seek him out at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran immediately.

passages.title: Paradise Lost
passages.text: Perfect. Up for a little trip down to Azsuna?

passages.title: Into Our Ranks
passages.text:
I feel that we should quickly welcome Akama into our ranks. It's important that the others see him treated as one of us, rather than as an outsider.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn has proven herself invaluable, time and time again. Her skills in combat are unquestioned and unparalleled. You will find no champion better suited to destroying our enemies.

It is time to officially raise them up as champions.

passages.title: Into Our Ranks
passages.text:
Up until now, the Illidari have been a fairly exclusive club. Demon hunters only. But, as you have so clearly demonstrated, my dear, if we are to move forward trusting one-another, then bringing Akama in is an important step.

It gives one hope.

And, of course, making Kor'vas one of your champions is the obvious choice. No one fights as well as she does.

What's that?

passages.title: A Sound Plan
passages.text:
The Legion still believes us crippled from the Broken Shore. They think we are unable to fight back.

Let's prove them wrong.

We've been hard at work mapping out the Broken Isles, learning everything we can about each region for our imminent assault.

Once you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should leave for Dalaran at once and charge into the maw of the beast.

We will end this madness for good. Light help us all.

passages.title: A Sound Plan
passages.text: Good luck out there! We're all in this together.

passages.title: Battle Worms
passages.text:
Snowmane Village behind us was caught completely off guard by the scale of this attack. I will hold the drogbar line here so the civilians have time to prepare their evacuation.

The drogbar are using worms to burrow their way to the surface and deploy their troops.

I am giving you command of our forces. Use them to slay these worms and cut off enemy reinforcements.

passages.title: Battle Worms
passages.text: Worms. Why did it have to be worms? I hate worms.

passages.title: Battle Worms
passages.text: That should slow these invaders down.

passages.title: Buy Us Time
passages.text:
We need time to evacuate Snowmane Village. Can you take the fight to these Mightstone drogbar and cull their numbers?

I will direct my healers to get everyone that is unable to fight to safety.

passages.title: Buy Us Time
passages.text: We need all the time you can buy us.

passages.title: Buy Us Time
passages.text:
Excellent. Thank you, Champion.

We have managed to get the children and the wounded to safety thanks to your efforts.

passages.title: The Underking
passages.text:
Mayla already chased the Underking into his cave. That is something we tell our children never to do.

Reckless child, but hey, who wants to live forever? Let us join her in battle.

passages.title: The Underking
passages.text: Dargrul is just postponing the inevitable.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Death to the Underking
passages.text:
I will direct my people to clear a path through this rubble and assault Dargrul's forces directly.

It will be a ruse.

Navarrogg proposed a plan that I believe has merit. He knows of a side entrance that might lead directly to Dargrul.

Muster what allies of yours you can and strike at them through this side passage. Recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth before that villain brings the mountain down on top of us.

We will provide the distraction you need to get a shot.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Death to the Underking
passages.text: The war continues.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Death to the Underking
passages.text:
It was a hard fight, but necessary. <name>, on behalf of the Rivermane, the Skyhorn, the Stonedark, I thank you for your efforts.

But where one battle ends, another begins. When you stand against the coming of the Burning Legion, know that the tribes of Highmountain stand with you.

passages.title: The Runewood's Revenge
passages.text:
The Bonespeakers...they are corrupt... hungry for power.

Cut them from my woods...

passages.title: The Runewood's Revenge
passages.text: Has the corruption been removed?

passages.title: The Runewood's Revenge
passages.text:
The Runewood will know peace once more with these Bonespeakers removed from the land. 

It is a good beginning.

passages.title: To Haustvald
passages.text:
Your next steps are clear, your feet know the way. Follow them to Haustvald and meet your fate!

It is the tree you seek, the heart of the mystic Runewood. He will offer guidance, and probably leaves.

passages.title: To Haustvald
passages.text:
Bound... twisted... 

The Bonespeakers...

passages.title: Our Next Move
passages.text:
Have you seen the fog that surrounds us? The chill winds of Acherus have provided us with a perfect concealment from the prying eyes of the Legion!

Under cover of this fog we've been able to send out scouting teams who've put together a fairly comprehensive map of the Broken Isles.

Choose where we shall begin our assault. You, of course, shall have the honor of spearheading our efforts, but the rest of the Ebon Blade will follow your lead.

passages.title: Our Next Move
passages.text: A fine choice, Deathlord.

passages.title: The Trials Continue
passages.text:
<Havi's voice continues in your head as the raven stares on>

If valor you seek, then to the bones you must speak! 

But first you must prepare!

passages.title: The Trials Continue
passages.text:
Ah, the hero of the hour! We must waste no time! 

Our business at hand is most important if you wish to succeed in your trials!

passages.title: Speaking of Bones
passages.text:
The Trial of Valor will be your next test, and test you it will!

But only a fool fights on an empty stomach. Are you a fool, outsider?

No? Then lend these old bones a hand and butcher the moose for our meal. I will spin you a tale of rocks, trees and spirits.

passages.title: Speaking of Bones
passages.text:
A fine cut, I must say. 

Yes, you will do well against the Bonespeakers, I think.

passages.title: Champion: Thassarian
passages.text:
Deathlord, I've found our wayward knight. He wishes to return to the Ebon Blade, in particular he wishes to speak with you himself.

<Mograine turns and nods to a nearby guard.>

He should be here momentarily.

passages.title: Champion: Thassarian
passages.text:
You and I have been through much together, <name>. Now, you stand before me as Deathlord and leader of our order. I could not be more proud!

The battle against the Burning Legion will be hard fought and filled with peril. You should not embark on this alone, my friend.

I will go wherever you command and I will kill whoever you wish me to kill.

passages.title: Champion: Nazgrim
passages.text:
Deathlord, I've found our wayward knight. He wishes to return to the Ebon Blade, in particular he wishes to speak with you himself.

<Mograine turns and nods to a nearby guard.>

He should be here momentarily.

passages.title: Champion: Nazgrim
passages.text:
These foolish class trainers speak to me as if I have never held an axe before!

They have nothing to teach that I do not already know. The dark power of undeath flows through my veins and it seeks blood and battle!

Let's waste no more time in this dusty necropolis! Send me to the front so that I may spill the blood of our enemies!

passages.title: Plans and Preparations
passages.text:
Your weapon is stronger than ever, but it will need many more souls in order to reach its true potential.

Siouxsie has been collecting reports from the scouts, she will direct you to our enemies and their screaming souls will empower your weapon further.

passages.title: Plans and Preparations
passages.text:
Deathlord, I've prepared a brief report on all we've discovered about this new land.

You should find it quite interesting.

passages.title: A Desperate Bargain
passages.text:
It looks like your friend didn't make it. A pity, but we must move on.

You'll want to plead our case to Helya. She is the ruler here. I would accompany you, but I'm afraid I wouldn't help your case.

Meet me when you are finished. I will see if I can find the whereabouts of my shieldmaidens.

passages.title: A Desperate Bargain
passages.text: <The air hangs silent as you approach.>

passages.title: A Desperate Bargain
passages.text:
<Helya's voice fills the air as you stand>

Nobody leaves Helheim without my approval! Entertain me, and I may let you pass.

passages.title: To Light the Way
passages.text:
Helya must think her challenge unwinnable. We will show her different.

I am unsure what she did, but Helya has weakened you somehow. I have seen similar effects on my shieldmaidens, and now they are trapped by Helya's minions.

I may know a way, however. The Kvaldir ships carry special lanterns bound to this place to navigate through the fog. It is said that the light of these lanterns can release bonds of the spirit.

There is a kvaldir ship nearby. See if you can find one there.

passages.title: To Light the Way
passages.text: Were you able to secure the lantern?

passages.title: To Light the Way
passages.text:
This appears to be what we need. 

Now, we can prepare for the battle ahead.

passages.title: Allies in Death
passages.text:
Our power alone may not be enough to fight the behemoth, Geir. Fortunately, Faljar was kind enough to send our allies into Helheim with us.

Earlier, I had discovered several of them being tortured by the elemental forces of Helheim. You may think the dead can't drown, but with Helya's power, this is not the case. 

I could not release them then, but now that you possess the waylight, you may be able to.

Seek them out and free them from an eternity of suffering!

passages.title: Allies in Death
passages.text: Once unbound, my Valkyra will throttle these wretched minions.

passages.title: Allies in Death
passages.text:
It is good to have my shieldmaidens returned to my side. 

You have gained allies today, but know you have also gained my gratitude.

passages.title: Victory is Eternal
passages.text:
There is no more cause for hesitation. Now is the time to strike.

We will defeat this foul behemoth and meet Helya's bargain. The path out of Helheim awaits, outsider. 

Prepare yourself.

passages.title: Victory is Eternal
passages.text: Together, we can defeat this foe!

passages.title: Victory is Eternal
passages.text:
The day is won. Now, we must collect our reward. 

Let us hope that Helya keeps her side of the bargain.

passages.title: Paid in Lifeblood
passages.text:
We have fulfilled Helya's bargain. Now, we see if she will keep to her word.

When you are ready, we should proceed to the throne. If you have any other business here, I would suggest finishing it now.

I will follow your lead, outsider.

passages.title: Paid in Lifeblood
passages.text:
So the dead return from Helheim and back? An impressive feat. 

Your worth has been judged and the trial passed. 

Now, to your destiny. To the Halls of Valor!

passages.title: The Eternal Nemesis
passages.text:
<Helya's voice echoes in the sky above the altar>

You say that you do not belong here among the unworthy, outsider, but your spirit fragments so easily. How am I to know you speak the truth? 

I cannot, so you must show me.

Bring yourself to the eternal battlefield and face my champion. If you manage to defeat him, then I may grant you a pardon.

passages.title: The Eternal Nemesis
passages.text:
You do not look good. 

I take it Helya did not prove lenient?

passages.title: Rite of Blood
passages.text:
Oakin Ironbull vouches for you. He's capable, for a Rivermane. You also brought with you proof of your own strength, albeit rather inconclusive proof.

Before we allow you to move freely within our territory, you must complete the Rite of Blood, which you have already begun. If you succeed--and I doubt you will--talk to me.

Enter the depths of the cave. Defeat whatever foe appears and return to me.

passages.title: Rite of Blood
passages.text: Are you afraid of the dark?

passages.title: Rite of Blood
passages.text: Thank you for saving me. I hope now we can trust each other. We must if we are to defeat these Feltotem.

passages.title: The Siegebrul
passages.text:
Worms do not like battle or the surface. They only go where their master tells them.

So, when in war, kill the master.

Siegebrul Olgrul is the master of worms for the Mightstone drogbar who attack us from the north.

Slay him.

passages.title: The Siegebrul
passages.text: Siegbrul Olgrul torments all who serve him. There are evil drogbar, and then there is this foul monster.

passages.title: The Siegebrul
passages.text:
"Siegebrul." Bah!

Before this war we had no need for such titles.

Olgrul was always just a brute who takes pleasure in the pain of others.

passages.title: I Have a Bad Feeling About This
passages.text:
You have no reason to trust me. My cousins led by Dargrul have gone mad with power.

But I ask you to investigate something. I have a feeling something terrible is about to befall Highmountain, and that Torok and his Bloodtotem are going to be responsible.

If you don't believe me, look for yourself at the northern side of Cliff's Edge.

passages.title: I Have a Bad Feeling About This
passages.text: <The cage is empty. Navarrogg is gone.>

passages.title: Khadgar's Discovery
passages.text:
Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.

I have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

passages.title: Khadgar's Discovery
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>.

passages.title: Magic Message
passages.text:
For the last 10,000 years, the elven city of Suramar has been sealed in an arcane barrier, much like Dalaran once was.

That barrier has come down.

Since then, waves of magical energy have been emanating from the city like ripples in a pond. It was in these waves that I sensed a pattern.

A spell, encrypted among the chaos.

I have recreated the spell here. It's not dangerous, but beyond that... I have no idea what it does!

passages.title: Magic Message
passages.text: Go ahead and take a look.

passages.title: Magic Message
passages.text: A magical message in a bottle, slipped right beneath the Legion's nose... Clever.

passages.title: Huln's War - Stormrage
passages.text: <Eche'ro nuzzles your hand and turns around. It looks back, beckoning you to the south.>

passages.title: Huln's War - Stormrage
passages.text: You bring with you Eche'ro, and... what is this? The blessing of Cenarius?!

passages.title: Huln's War - Reinforcements
passages.text:
Cenarius himself has risked much in coming here, if only briefly, to bestow a blessing upon you. He has seen what you are capable of, and has chosen you as champion in this battle. I would speak with you on this later. It is a rare gift indeed.

But now, I ask for your help, Huln Highmountain. I must finish my incantations to allow dryads from beyond the veil to enter this place and lend us their aid.

passages.title: Huln's War - Reinforcements
passages.text: This shouldn't take long. Please do not allow them to interrupt my spell.

passages.title: Huln's War - Reinforcements
passages.text: The ritual is complete. Reinforcements will be able to push through the portal and assist against the demonic horde.

passages.title: Huln's War - The Nathrezim
passages.text:
I am fully occupied here organizing my troops and planning for the battle to come.

While I would like to slay the Dreadlord Tichondrius myself, I will allow that honor to be yours, Huln Highmountain.

passages.title: Huln's War - The Nathrezim
passages.text: You see now, that Huln was mighty? He united the tribes and defeated terribly powerful foes.

passages.title: Knocking on Valor's Door
passages.text:
The Halls of Valor is your destiny to claim, but it is already in the claiming. The God-King befouls its steps with demons and wickedness.

Your dragon allies have come to Halls' defense, but they need your aid. The vrykul have taken the leader of the storm dragons, the one you call Vethir.

Free your dragon friend, champion, and wash the Felskorn from the Gates of Valor!

passages.title: Knocking on Valor's Door
passages.text:
What is this... I see? 

A friendly face... in a sea of foes?

passages.title: A Familiar Fate
passages.text:
We had come to defend the Halls of Valor... I was taken from the sky...

I cannot break free of my bindings. Find the jailer who made this cell...

Set me free, friend...

passages.title: A Familiar Fate
passages.text: The jailer has... the key...

passages.title: A Familiar Fate
passages.text:
You still manage to surprise me, outsider. Your trials are complete, and yet you still have challenges to face. 

The God-King's forces are many, but in your weapon you possess the powers of Stormheim herself! Approach the gates, and these powers will lay low the enemies of this land!

Now, let us take the fight to the God-King, and cleanse the Gates of Valor of his fel taint!

passages.title: Break the Spine
passages.text:
To lead his tainted forces, the God-King has enlisted demons of great power to act as his lieutenants. If we wish to end his assault, we will need to take their leaders.

These demons are too powerful for most mortals to face, but with the power of Stormheim at your disposal, they will prove no match for you. 

Take them down, and shatter the spine of Skovald's offensive!

passages.title: Break the Spine
passages.text: Are the leaders slain?

passages.title: Break the Spine
passages.text:
With their fel leaders slain, the God-King's forces will scatter. 

Still, we are not finished here. So long as the demons continue to assault the gates, Stormheim will not be safe.

passages.title: Stormheim's Salvation
passages.text:
It would seem that the portals we destroyed down here were not the only ones. Demons still pour in from the top of the Gates of Valor's edifice, summoned by the God-King himself!

I cannot face Skovald alone. Come, champion, let us take the battle to him and end this threat!

For Stormheim!

passages.title: Stormheim's Salvation
passages.text:
It's unfortunate that the God-King escaped, but his defeat has stemmed the flow of the Legion into Stormheim.

Now, the Halls of Valor await you.

passages.title: The Only Way Out is Through
passages.text:
I have much to tell you, but it is not safe to speak here. I cannot hold this barrier forever.

<Thalyssra lifts a delicate flask to her lips. Her eyes shimmer as she takes a sip.>

If we push through, we may find shelter up ahead.

passages.title: The Only Way Out is Through
passages.text: There is no turning back.

passages.title: The Only Way Out is Through
passages.text:
You fight well.

Perhaps it is time for a proper introduction.

passages.title: Tapping the Leylines
passages.text:
The arcways were built to tap into the magical leylines beneath Suramar. As we learned to subsist on the Nightwell, the old facilities fell out of use.

This chamber is clearly receiving power from elsewhere.

There is only a trickle now, but if you can direct more leyline energy here it will help to sustain us.

The closest source is to the north, near Anora Hollow.

passages.title: Tapping the Leylines
passages.text: And just who might you be?

passages.title: Oculeth's Workshop
passages.text:
We need to make contact with Chief Telemancer Oculeth, the man who developed Suramar's teleportation network. 

Oculeth had a workshop in old Suramar, from the age before the Sundering. He may be taking refuge there.

<Thalyssra presses a small coin into your palm.>

If you find him, show him this. Hopefully you see him before he sees you...

passages.title: Oculeth's Workshop
passages.text: If we are to put up any resistance against the combined forces of the Legion and the Grand Magistrix, we must secure a means of traversing the region quickly.

passages.title: Oculeth's Workshop
passages.text: You may deliver me to Thalyssra once my work here is complete.

passages.title: An Old Ally
passages.text:
I was on my way to Ambervale in hopes of finding an old colleague.

Arcanist Kel'danath was fascinated by the withered. He studied them for years hoping to calm their feral nature or even cure them.

When one of his subjects escaped and ran amok in the royal gardens, Kel'danath was ordered to cease his research and kill all withered in his possession. He refused, and was exiled.

If Kel'danath lives, he is near withered. And withered are drawn to old settlements like Ambervale.

passages.title: An Old Ally
passages.text: <Somebody has been living here recently. This scroll bears strange lettering that glows warmly, beckoning your hand.>

passages.title: The Hunter of Heroes
passages.text:
Helya has made a mockery of my order by creating her own "helarjar", powerful undead tasked with hunting down heroic warriors and taking their souls before my val'kyr can claim them. Among them is her personal champion, Vigfus Bladewind, who wields stolen blades I forged myself long ago.

He has returned to Tideskorn Harbor with a full cargo of stolen souls to take to Helheim. Go there, kill him and his helarjar, and make the swords yours.

passages.title: The Hunter of Heroes
passages.text: Ah, you have returned...

passages.title: The Hunter of Heroes
passages.text: Curse Helya, she's corrupted the blades! Still, her champion defeated, her helarjar skulking back to Helheim, and my weapons in the hands of my chosen champion! She even made them more powerful than before. Wield them well, <name>, smite the enemies of this world!

passages.title: Huln's War - Malorne's Favored
passages.text:
[In broken Common] Shan'do ask for you. Sent Eche'ro beast with message on rack.

Unng Ak hear Eche'ro sound fighting. You find beast? Give help, maybe feathered night elf be relieve.

passages.title: Huln's War - Malorne's Favored
passages.text: <Eche'ro looks up briefly, then lowers its head before you. This creature is thankful for your aid.>

passages.title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
passages.text:
Ahh, Val'sharah.

It has been an age since I have set foot in these sacred woods. Too long...

Our work here is simple, <class>. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. With them, you will be one step closer to sealing Sargeras' Tomb and thwarting the Legion.

You have many treacherous tasks in front of you. Consider your visit here a brief respite.

Come, this will not take long.

passages.title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
passages.text: Cenarius!

passages.title: Cenarius, Keeper of the Grove
passages.text:
This corruption - I've never seen it before.

And yet, it seems somehow familiar...

passages.title: The Nightborne Pact
passages.text:
<Thalyssra winces and holds her abdomen.>

Ngh... I can ignore this wound no longer.

Help me patch this up. I will explain everything.

passages.title: The Nightborne Pact
passages.text: We must find a way to reclaim Suramar City.

passages.title: Branch of the Arcan'dor
passages.text:
You have used the spellstone of Kel'danath to soothe countless withered. Yet it contains merely a shade of the arcan'dor's power, drawn from its slumbering seed. 

<Thalyssra holds aloft a gleaming white branch.>

This fell from the tree. Though it is severed, it is not dead - invisible threads of magic bind all pieces of the arcan'dor together.

I have enchanted this branch with a new iteration of Kel'danath's charm spell. With it, you can mend the arcane essence of even more withered. Use it well.

passages.title: Branch of the Arcan'dor
passages.text: I never imagined I would spend my time in exile studying withered. Through them, I have learned a great deal about my own people, and the nature of our relationship with the Nightwell.

passages.title: Debt Repaid
passages.text:
I have a few urgent matters to take care of, but soon after I will make my way to Dreadscar Rift and aid you with your summoning.

You should warn Ritssyn to keep his distance. I'll be there to repay my debt to you, not to speak to the hypocrite who chose the council over his friends.

passages.title: Debt Repaid
passages.text:
It appears Kira travels faster than your word. She arrived moments ago, though her eyes purposely avoided mine.

In gaining her trust, you accomplished something I could not. With her help, we should be able to summon the gateway.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text:
It was in this place, ages ago, that Huln Highmountain challenged the great Deathwing.

Today we shall re-live moments of that day through the eyes of our ancestors.

For this next part of the spirit journey, we must seek out the three braziers set down many ages ago so that those who would follow in the footsteps of Huln might witness his deeds.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text: You are learning parts of our history few outsiders have ever known.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text: And so it was that Huln Highmountain came to this mountain, freeing the drogbar slaves of Deathwing, and came into possession of the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

passages.title: Step into the Dark
passages.text:
With the threat to my people quelled, I believe it is time to introduce you to my kin.

Meet me at Stonedark Grotto, and you will see where we live.

passages.title: Step into the Dark
passages.text: Welcome to our humble home. You are free to move about here from now on.

passages.title: A Grim Equation
passages.text:
They were waiting for us when we crashed. It was all we could do to establish our small outpost.

Even now they drain the souls of our fallen to fuel their attacks.

Destroy their soul coffers. Free our comrades and let them join the Light.

When you have finished, find Y'mera in the field. She has been sorely missed, but she will not have fallen. Of this I am certain.

passages.title: A Grim Equation
passages.text: Good work. They will return in time, but we can use this advantage.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
We aren't going to get our forces anywhere near the Broken Shore without getting knocked out of the sky.

I think it best if you handle this matter yourself - there are none among us more capable on the field of battle.

Save Allari and her men if you can, but the Aldrachi Warblades will do far more for this war than warm bodies.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
What of the others? Did they...?

I see. They gave their lives for a worthy cause - the Warblades will change the tide of this war, mark my words.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text:
All of Kel'danath's experiments to connect with the withered failed, and some even made them more dangerous.

Until he found Theryn.

His arcane essence - the very soul of the shal'dorei - had been touched by something special. But what? 

By weaving my arcane essence together with Theryn's, I can create an empathic bond. This communion will bare his soul to us all - or what's left of it. 

We need only to feed him mana, and lots of it, in order to begin.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text: Feed Theryn as much as he will take.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text: Good. Let us see what we can learn.

passages.title: Scenes from a Memory
passages.text:
Theryn is at the mercy of his own mind. Whatever we find in there, it may be difficult to control.

I will need your help to sort through the visions, so be ready for anything.

With any luck, we will discover what makes Theryn special. And... whether there is anything left of who he used to be.

passages.title: Scenes from a Memory
passages.text:
The withered... Not only do they suffer a burning thirst for the Nightwell, but their own memories torture them as well.

Truly a fate worse than death...

passages.title: Scattered Memories
passages.text:
<As your fingers trace the elegant symbols on the page, a voice dictates the words in your mind.

It seems the nightborne have elevated even simple note-taking to a sorcerous art.

Arcanist Kel'danath was definitely working in this area. There must be more of his notes scattered around.>

passages.title: Scattered Memories
passages.text: <A bag containing countless pages of technical notes. Flipping through them, you find Kel'danath's last journal entry.>

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text:
Wavespeaker Adelee tracked Sharas'dal to the Throne of Tides within the Abyssal Maw, then disappeared. <name>, if we go after her, we are almost certainly walking into a trap.

But the elements are with us, my friend. The naga will not expect a shaman of your caliber!

Swim to the Throne of Tides to the Northwest, within the Abyssal Depths. I will join you once you are inside. Let's find our missing shaman and get that artifact!

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text: What news from the deeps, <class>?

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text:
So the legends of the Scepter of Tides were true, <name>!

It lifts our spirits to have such a powerful artifact in the hands of the Earthen Ring.

passages.title: Needs of the Hunters
passages.text:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:

 To: <name>

The time has come to strike back at the Legion.

Meet me at Hunter's Reach in Dalaran as soon as you can.

 -Emmarel Shadewarden

passages.title: Needs of the Hunters
passages.text:
Your reputation precedes you, <name>.

It is important that we speak.

passages.title: The Spear in the Shadow
passages.text:
Many years ago, a corrupted nightsaber hunted my people. Our chieftain, Dorro Highmountain, took Talonclaw and pursued the beast, but never returned.

I have heard tales of a fearsome nightsaber that now stalks the mists of Stormheim. My brother and I believe this to be our ancient foe.

The weapon must be there too! If we kill the beast and reclaim the spear, it will be of great use against the Legion.

passages.title: The Spear in the Shadow
passages.text:
So the Bane of the Highmountain is dead and Talonclaw is recovered! Well done, <name>!

I mourn the loss of Apata and Wuho. They will be greatly missed in the conflict to come.

passages.title: Huln's War - Shadowsong
passages.text:
Someone with whom I believe you are familiar commands in the battlefield below.

Jarod Shadowsong speaks highly of you, and has requested that you join him in battle.

He has plans to put an end to this fight.

passages.title: Huln's War - Shadowsong
passages.text: I am happy to see you, great ally.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text:
I am glad you are here, <name>.

This... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.

He wishes to meet us at the entrance to the city as soon as possible.

Will you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text: Hello again, champion. I see we are all here now.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
You have long been a trusted hero of the Alliance, <name>. And like the rest of us, you have endured many hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask even more of you. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
As you well know, I have opposed the Horde at many turns. The orcs have taken... so much from me. From my family.

Yet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, <name>. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
It is no small matter for me to seek the aid of a blood elf. Your leaders have turned their backs on the sacrifices made by my family and so many others.

Yet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, <name>. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Our gathering has identified several weapons of immense power. In the right hands, these holy artifacts give us a fighting chance against the Legion.

We cannot pursue all of them at once. We risk too much if we spread ourselves that thin. We must agree on where our efforts are best focused.

That is why I asked you here, <name>. As one of our greatest champions, you must be our voice of reason and decide our next move.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: Excellent choice! There's no time to waste.

passages.title: Rescue Mission
passages.text:
The demon has told us how to open a portal to the world where he says Alleria is being held. You and I can go through and see if there is any truth to his claims.

In case it's a trap, Magus Solgaze has given me a portal stone to get us back to Dalaran.

This demonic magic is anathema to the mage, so we must move quickly. I'm ready when you are, <name>.

passages.title: Rescue Mission
passages.text:
We didn't recover Alleria, but at least we have proof she was there. She will be found... I know it!

Thas'dorah has long been symbolic of the Windrunner family, but until Alleria's return, it belongs in your hands.

Use it to rally the greatest hunters of Azeroth and drive the Burning Legion back to the abyss!

passages.title: A Walk With the Spirits
passages.text:
The spiritwalker you saved from Riverbend has been insufferable since his arrival. He is insisting on showing you the ways of our people so that you better understand what is to come.

He is a strange one, even by spiritwalker standards.

Even so, only a fool would discard his insight. Please, go to speak with him when you get a moment.

passages.title: A Walk With the Spirits
passages.text: You made Mayla smile. That is the first time I have seen her smile in... ever?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text:
We could not save Ysera, but we did prevent her from destroying the temple.

Now I can finally turn my attention to my husband.

I do not know what fate he suffers now. I only know that if we stand any chance of saving him, you must go now.

Follow Xavius into the Nightmare and find Malfurion.

Please, save my husband if you can.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text: Is he alive? Will my husband return to me?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text:
Praise Elune and all that her light touches... Malfurion is alive.

I thought I would spend the rest of my days alone, dreaming of the choices I did not make.

Thank you. Thank you for returning my love to me.

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text:
The Felskorn who ravage my brood were once Drekirjar - a tribe with whom we shared an ancient pact. Now, under the influence of the God-King, they forsake their oaths and strike at the forebears of their coveted drakes.

They should answer for this slight.

Awaken your fury, <class>, and take the battle to them!

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text: Are we rid of the Felskorn threat?

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text:
The Felskorn have witnessed true strength today. 

They will think twice before raising their blades to you again.

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text:
Nothing! There is next to nothing in our records about this weapon!

I've checked and re-checked, and can find barely a shred of a tale. This can only mean that the story comes from a land outside Pandaria.
