Li Li Stormstout is young, but she is the most traveled on the entire isle except for you. If anyone might know of this weapon, it is she.

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text: What's up?

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text: Do you think that the story is true? I bet you could control the power of those blades!

passages.title: Into The Heavens
passages.text:
This stone is saturated with elemental power, possibly the remnant of the magic used against Irmaat!

If you went outside and held the stone aloft, it should unleash the stone's essence as a mighty whirlwind. So potent a windstorm could carry you and your companion all the way to Skywall!

If the hand blades of Irmaat, the Fists of the Heavens, are as powerful as the old tales say, they would certainly be found there.

passages.title: Into The Heavens
passages.text:
That was a fantastic trip, <name>! We really should do this kind of thing more often!

Now that you have those blades I bet there's going to be a bunch of adventures ahead!

Maybe I should just stick around here a while.

passages.title: The Nightmare Lord
passages.text:
You arrived just in time, friend.

Kagraxxis was moments away from sacrificing me to his master... I was certain I would perish.

I am grateful, but we are not out of danger yet... Xavius has returned.

The Nightmare Lord is here in Val'sharah, personally orchestrating the corruption of this land. My captor revealed as much to me before I was to be sacrificed.

We must find Thaon Moonclaw and inform him before it is too late!

passages.title: The Nightmare Lord
passages.text:
Thaon Moonclaw was a great druid and a true protector of this land.

How can we hope to defeat the Nightmare Lord without him fighting beside us?

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
As the greatest warrior in these halls, you require a great weapon to do both your will and mine. I have looked down on Azeroth and found artifacts worthy of your hands.

I leave it to you to choose which artifact you wish to seek out and wield against the Legion. We will recover the others in time.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: Choose wisely, <name>.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: I knew you would pick that one. Let us be about it.

passages.title: Thus Begins the War
passages.text:
The Legion thinks you are dead. It will be quite the surprise when you punish them for that assumption!

This allows us to see all across the Broken Isles and assign warriors to various tasks.

Once you've taken a look, you should choose your first area of operation. I've already picked out the best spots!

passages.title: Thus Begins the War
passages.text: An excellent choice, <name>. As more opportunities arise, I will bring them to your attention. Good luck in battle!

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text:
Kill now, grieve later!

Here, champion, take flight with one of my war eagles. Use the powers bestowed upon you by our united tribes and help us rain destruction down on these drogbar.

Let us clog that new doorway to their lair with the bodies of their own!

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text: The drogbar sure do love those rocks.

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text: Well done. We will make a Skyhorn out of you yet.

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text:
Though the journal devolves into dark ramblings written in hurried scribbles, one entry stands out:

"Ulthalesh. The name rings in my head. I can hear it calling, but where?

"The spirits... the very land here is tied to it. It is no wonder we would so often get lost in this place. The forces pull my compass point in every direction...

"Perhaps if it had a stronger pull, the compass could show the way..."

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text: Is that the one?

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text:
There is definitely something wrong with this compass. 

It seems to be trying to point in all directions at once.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Three weapons... three worthy paths.

Acquiring one such artifact will be the first step in battling the Legion. The weapon will grow in power as you wield it, so you must choose the one which will be the focus of your efforts, <name>.

After a time, you will be able to pursue the other weapons. But you must decide which to seek first.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Now you must begin your pursuit of the artifact. It will not be easy to obtain, but a weapon this powerful seldom is.

After you succeed, return here to me and we shall speak at greater length. There is much for us to do!

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text:
I am glad you are here, <name>.

This... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.

He wishes to meet us by the entrance to the city as soon as possible.

Will you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text: Hello again, champion. I see we are all here now.

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text:
Oh I'd love to go see if that story is true! But Pops is too busy stuffing his gut and being a grouch to let me go do any real exploring. He even told me that I can't leave the village unless I have a guardian!

Is Pops for real? I can protect myself just fine!

Say, would you be my guardian? Please, get me away from this boredom and you will totally be my hero!

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text: Do you see this place? This is so neat!

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text:
Hey there, <name>. What took you so long?

While you were traveling the long way I've been doing some research of my own. King Phaoris offered to help us as long as we can take care of a problem for him.

I'm sure you'll be able to handle whatever it is.

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text:
I know the tale of Irmaat well. It is said that his home was the ancient city of Ahmtul, long buried under the desert sands.

Recently a strange storm has appeared over the ruins. What's more, I am told that an elemental called Nader has attacked my people in nearby lands.

These events must be related.

Find this Nader and put an end to him. Make sure to search his body for clues as to what is behind this.

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text: Have you found anything, <name>?

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text:
So, you found this stone upon his body?

Interesting... Let me take a closer look.

passages.title: Prepare To Strike
passages.text:
The Burning Legion took us by surprise at the Peak of Serenity. We will not allow them to do so again!

We have trained hard, but we need weapons capable of destroying this great evil if we are to have any chance of success.

Our scrolls speak of several weapons that should prove suitable, but we are unable to decide which one to pursue first.

The choice, Grand Master, is yours.

passages.title: Prepare To Strike
passages.text: As you wish, Grand Master.

passages.title: A Summons From Moonglade
passages.text:
<name>, Your presence is requested at Moonglade at once.

We are preparing for a ritual of great importance and will require your assistance.

I will meet you there, so please come with haste.

passages.title: A Summons From Moonglade
passages.text:
<name>, I'm pleased you came on such short notice.

We have a great undertaking here in the Moonglade that is about to begin, one in which you will play a key role.

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text:
The preparations for the ritual are now complete.

Come with me, <name>, I will guide you to the ceremony.

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text: Are you ready to begin the ritual?

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text:
Well done, <name>!

Now that the path is open we can begin our journey to Val'sharah.

passages.title: To The Dreamgrove
passages.text:
The portal to the Dreamway is open and it is here where our paths must part. The Moonglade remains vulnerable to the attacks of the Burning Legion and I must ensure it is well defended.

I'm entrusting you with the mission to Val'sharah, <name>. Archdruid Greathoof is the leader of the druids there. He is wise in the old ways and will provide us invaluable assistance.

The Dream can be dangerous so I will send Keeper Remulos to guide you. Meet with him upon the other side.

passages.title: To The Dreamgrove
passages.text:
You did well to navigate through the Emerald Dream to get to this place. Still, there are times when you might wish to return here a bit more quickly. This spell will guide you.

Traveling the Dreamway is no small feat in itself, but it pales to the tasks ahead.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
I agree with Keeper Remulos. To confront and defeat the Legion, we will need weapons of legendary power.

Among the history of our kind, there have been four weapons of renown.

Tell me, which weapon would you pursue first?

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Excellent choice, <name>!

With the power of that weapon in your hands we will be able to bring balance back to Azeroth.

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text:
Now that we have Ursol's blessing, we can safely pass the magical wards and reach the claws' resting place!

Now, we must pass into the Dream. Lay down before the Shrine of Ursol and drink of the moonwater you brought earlier and your spirit will drift off into the dream.

Be careful, the Dream can be a dangerous place.

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text: Have you retrieved the Claws of Ursoc?

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text:
I owe you my life, <name>. If it wasn't for your actions I'd be dead or worse.

That traitor, Xavius, may have taken Ursoc but at least we were able to recover the claws. Hope is not lost to us yet.

passages.title: Meet with Mylune
passages.text:
It would seem we are fortuitous that you seek G'Hanir this day, <name> - the dryad Mylune arrived not long ago from the sacred shrine where the staff has been guarded for many centuries.

Few are privy to its hidden location within the roots of Shaladrassil, but you have certainly earned that right.

Speak to Mylune when you are ready to depart - I saw her last just east of here up the hill.

passages.title: Meet with Mylune
passages.text:
<Mylune's eyes are watery with dew, her usual smile an unsightly frown.>

Y-yes?

passages.title: Word on the Winds
passages.text:
It is time that we turn our attention to matters in the Broken Isles.

Skylord Omnuron has gathered information on events from all over the Isles. If we are presented with any opportunity to strike against the Legion he will know of it.

Go and see if he has anything available.

passages.title: Word on the Winds
passages.text:
Greetings, Archdruid.

The threats we face are numerous. We must act quickly.

passages.title: Making Trails
passages.text:
The Burning Legion threatens the life of Azeroth, but the nightmare threatens its very soul. We must remove both threats if our world is to survive.

This map will allow us to track the developments all across the Broken Isles and respond to threats as they arise. Our forces are limited for now, so we should focus our efforts where they will be the most effective.

Once you've taken a look, you should choose where we shall begin.

passages.title: Making Trails
passages.text:
Yes, I agree. That is a good place to focus our initial efforts.

As new threats arise, I will bring them to your attention. Elune guide your path, Archdruid.

passages.title: Druids of the Claw
passages.text:
A new ally has joined our ranks. His name is Yaris Darkclaw, a skilled trainer among the Druids of the Claw.

Go speak to him now.

passages.title: Druids of the Claw
passages.text: Excellent. Soon enough, the Druids of the Claw will bolster our ranks.

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text:
The book you carry is the key to your friends' salvation, and to your absolute power! It holds within information about many relics too dangerous to the Legion to leave unchecked.

Read, friend. And decide which of these artifacts you will use to strike Jagganoth down!

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text: Have you made your choice?

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text: Yes, friend chose very wisely!

passages.title: Priestly Matters
passages.text:
<Master/Mistress> <name>, I come at the behest of one who seeks to organize a stronger resistance to the Legion threat.

If you would meet him at Faol's Rest in Tirisfal Glades, he will guarantee both your safety and an opportunity to play a pivotal role in the conflict.

passages.title: Priestly Matters
passages.text:
Can I take that as a yes?

If you are ready, I'd like to get started immediately.

I know you are immensely capable, but let's not leave anything to chance!

passages.title: A Legend You Can Hold
passages.text:
To face the trials ahead, you require a weapon that can enhance your considerable abilities. I have learned of a few possibilities that you might consider.

You must decide which weapon to pursue first. I have the utmost confidence in your decision.

passages.title: A Legend You Can Hold
passages.text: A wise choice. My brethren and I stand ready to assist you on your next move, <name>.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
I was wrong about you, warlock. Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Perhaps I should not be so quick to judge.

Nevertheless, you have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners. As for Ulthalesh, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, warlock.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Friend has the weapon? 

Yes, Calydus can feel its power!

passages.title: The Call To War
passages.text:
<A chilling thought brushes your mind.>

Hear me, <name>.

The Legion has returned. They hope to control us, to bend us to their will. Fools - they only walk back within reach of our blades.

Your brethren within Dalaran have begun to gather at Krasus' Landing. Go, meet with Duke Lankral and all will be explained.

passages.title: The Call To War
passages.text:
I'm sure you have many questions, but they're just going to have to wait. We're at war now!

We have to move quickly, but I'll try to explain what I can.

passages.title: A Pact of Necessity
passages.text:
We have an unexpected ally in this war, <name>, and we're going to need every advantage we can get to defeat the Burning Legion.

The Ebon Blade will serve as the Lich King's arm as long as the Scourge is confined to Northrend. In return for our assistance, our ally has offered to assist in obtaining powerful weapons for the strongest of our knights. Weapons powerful enough to end the Legion once and for all!

You are one of our best, <name>. I want you to decide which weapon you would like to seek out.

passages.title: A Pact of Necessity
passages.text: Excellent choice.

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text:
I've noticed some wandering eyes, lately.

I am more than happy to continue delivering the goods to Vanthir, but it is getting increasingly dangerous to do so. 

The Duskwatch that walk the bazaar are by far the most observant.

Find and slay the Orbitists so that I may deliver the goods safely.

I will follow behind with the shipment.

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text: What of Deline?

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text: Deline was able to deliver the goods safely, thanks to you.

passages.title: One of the People
passages.text:
It is time for you to enter the city proper, <name>.

I am sending you to my loyal friend Vanthir. I do hope you remember him- I can guarantee that he remembers you.

I will not be able to accompany you, but I must stress that the disguise I have granted you is not impervious. Tread carefully, and avoid those who stare too long.

Farewell for now.

passages.title: One of the People
passages.text: Glad you could make it. Your help is sorely needed here.

passages.title: Network Security
passages.text:
We must lock down the facility. Otherwise my esteemed colleagues from the palace could uncover my secrets, which puts any teleporters I build for you and Thalyssra at risk.

<The inactive attunement device near Oculeth hums to life.>

This will take us to my secret test chamber beneath the mountain. From there we can begin the lockdown sequence and make our escape!

passages.title: Network Security
passages.text: Did we... make it?

passages.title: Whispers from Oronaar
passages.text:
Ethereals, the Void, a Dark Naaru... I feel they are all connected.

I explored the ruins below while you and Velen were seeking the Crown. There are survivors, <name>.

Broken wander the cluster of buildings to our west- I cannot understand much of what they say but I suspect that their minds are not their own.

If the Void is to blame, we will need to start our investigation there.

I will conduct my own search in the meantime.

passages.title: Whispers from Oronaar
passages.text: Something is very wrong here.

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text:
I have received word that Tyrande herself has authorized the release of a great artifact, the Scythe of Elune, to aid our cause. Valorn Stillbough has agreed to give up the weapon, which he has kept as part of an investigation into the cursed worgen of Duskwood.

I believe that you, champion, will be our best hope at wielding its power without succumbing to the animal rage that ebbs within. You must go to Duskwood, and take up the scythe against our foes!

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text: The champion arrives. I hope you are prepared for this burden.

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text:
Well met, champion. 

Are you ready for the burden you must bear?

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text:
Though it goes against my better judgment, it is Tyrande's wish that the Scythe of Elune be brandished once more against the new Legion threat. It is a small comfort to see it wielded by a keeper of the balance, such as yourself.

Know that the last time the scythe was wielded, it resulted in great calamity. You must be vigilant to contain the bestial wrath that ebbs within. 

With those words in your heart, take the scythe and bring its fury against our foes. May the light of Elune protect you.

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text: The scythe is yours, <class>.

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text:
Valorn...

That was.. a Dark Rider!

But how did they reach us here, under the protection of the grove?

passages.title: A Matter of Planning
passages.text:
Your weapon is stronger than ever, now is the perfect time to put it to use and take our fight to the Legion.

Master Hsu has set up a command table by the training grounds, and has collected reports from our friends and allies around all of Azeroth.

When you are ready, Grandmaster, he should have an update prepared for you.

passages.title: A Matter of Planning
passages.text:
Grandmaster, I've prepared a brief report on all that I've heard about the Broken Isles.

You may find it quite interesting.

passages.title: The Fight Begins
passages.text:
The Burning Legion has left a trail of ruin all across the face of Azeroth. We must strike at their bases within the Broken Isles if we are to have any hope of ending this war.

I've put together a map of the isles and a list of tasks that we will need to have done there.

Once you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should choose where we will begin our assault.

passages.title: The Fight Begins
passages.text: An excellent choice, Grandmaster.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text:
We have long relied on Lord Illidan to vanquish the Legion's strongest warriors - many have expressed concern over our efforts without him.

Thankfully, their concerns may not matter much longer.

We know of two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Lord Illidan's that are not yet out of reach.

If we act quickly we should be able to hunt down one without forsaking our watch over the Legion's movements.

I must defer judgment on which is most worthy of our time to you, <name>.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text: Well chosen. There isn't a moment to spare.

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Oh, <name>, it's you. Good, we've got a little problem here .

Altruis didn't think that Cyana and I could handle this on our own? He might have been right this time.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text:
Illidan and I may have disagreed, but he was unarguably powerful. He was pivotal in vanquishing some of the Legion's most powerful soldiers.

However, that may not matter much longer.

There are two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Illidan's that may still be within reach.

Regrettably, our numbers are too few to hunt both while maintaining our vigil over the Legion. I fear our window of opportunity is waning quickly.

As the ranking Illidari, that decision falls to you.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text: You must move quickly - our time is short.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text:
Do you recall Varedis, <name>? He was once our lead trainer, but fell with the Black Temple years ago.

...or so we thought.

Kor'vas spotted the traitor alongside the Legion... wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.

The Kirin Tor have an eredar lord locked away in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' stronghold lies. The prison warden has agreed to consider granting us access to the fiend.

Time to do some convincing.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text: I hold little love for these mages and their ilk, but they are necessary allies.

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text:
It seems that friend has caught the attention of Mephistroth. This is very bad news, as the dreadlord will surely wish to seek revenge for losing his general.

Friend will need more than the Dreadscar to stand against him, you will need powerful warlocks such as those who were captured.

Calydus thinks the orc still lies in the pit where you were chained. Friend must revive him, and rebuild the council!

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text: I will not rest until the council has been rebuilt.

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text:
I can hardly believe my eyes. For one <class> to control an entire army of demons is beyond what I thought the council was capable of. 

I only hope such power is enough to turn the tide of this war.

passages.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
passages.text:
It would seem that where the council has failed, you have found untold success. These Dreadscar should prove powerful allies, but they may not be enough.

For now, we must look to rebuild. I will send agents out to locate the whereabouts of the captured council members, as well as any other warlocks who may be able to aid the cause.

Meet me at the scrying pool, and we will plan our action from there.

passages.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
passages.text: The plan is set, and the wheels are in motion.

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text:
<Oculeth's eyes have dulled. His voice trembles.>

Are we... are we close?

So hungry...

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text: Where is Oculeth?

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text: Thank you for recovering Oculeth. He will be an invaluable asset to our cause.

passages.title: Call of The Uncrowned
passages.text:
My masters gave me strict instructions to deliver this letter to you as quickly as possible.

Its contents are for you and you alone.

Good luck.

passages.title: Call of The Uncrowned
passages.text:
Your reputation precedes you, <name>.

Apologies for the secrecy. We simply could not risk the wrong person finding us here.

passages.title: The Deadwind Hunt
passages.text:
The Nightbane! If they are in Deadwind Pass, then they may be seeking the scythe as well.

Let's split up and try to track them down. We'll see where their trail leads...

passages.title: The Deadwind Hunt
passages.text:
The worgen appear to be drawn to the catacombs beneath Karazhan.

Could it be...

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
This sewer grate leads to the catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it seems to be where the Nightbane are being drawn to.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: It is done.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Today was a great blow against the Dark Riders, and a victory for the people of Duskwood. 

They are in your debt, as am I.

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text:
You walk in the halls of the Uncrowned. We are the slayers of kings, the downfall of empires, the unseen blades that write the true history of this world.

Seated before you are the Shadows, the council which aims the blades of the Uncrowned wherever our will demands.

We have brought you here today with an offer. Take your seat as the final Shadow and help us lead the Uncrowned.

What do you say?

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text: It's up to you, <name>.

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text: Welcome to the Uncrowned, Shadow <name>.

passages.title: A Worthy Blade
passages.text:
For quite some time, we've been looking for someone who can operate outside these halls.

<name>, you are the answer to that search. You will be the blade in the dark that vanquishes our foes.

In order to do so, you require weapons capable of striking down the Legion's best.

Greymane, Tethys, and Valeera each have devised plans to obtain weapons worthy of the tasks to come. I suggest you hear each out before proceeding.

passages.title: A Worthy Blade
passages.text: Well chosen.

passages.title: A Friendly Accord
passages.text:
I'd like to offer ya an accord.

The Dread Admiral Eliza wields a pair of cursed blades that have made her the scourge of the south seas. She also stole one of me best ships - the Horizon's Edge - and has it anchored off the shore of Azsuna as we speak. 

If you help me take back me ship, then her cursed blades are yours.

Now, assuming that sounds agreeable, meet me aboard the Crimson Veil. We have her docked right in Booty Bay - not a cheap arrangement.

passages.title: A Friendly Accord
passages.text: Aha! I knew you'd come!

passages.title: The Dreadblades
passages.text:
I can promise ya a safe journey to Eliza's position, but once we're there... well, we both know there be no guarantees.

The plan is simple. We'll take the Crimson Veil as close as we can get her without being seen and disembark from there.

Once we're ashore, we'll board the Horizon's Edge, bribe her mutinous crew to hand it over, and hunt down Eliza and her legendary blades wherever she may be.

Just say the word when yer ready.

passages.title: The Dreadblades
passages.text: You did fine work today, lad.

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text:
Alonsus Faol has been a valuable ally, and his instincts about you have proven true. I believe you are uniquely suited to assist in a matter that will bring a great force of good into this world.

I must take you somewhere far from Azeroth to finish a task my people began long ago. Will you aid us?

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text: We have important work to do, <name>.

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text: Welcome back, Cardinal. I think you'll find we've done quite a job getting this place prepared for you. We should get started immediately.

passages.title: The Unseen Path
passages.text:
For a thousand years, the Unseen Path has watched and waited. We remained few in number, quietly acting behind the scenes when Azeroth needed us. Only a select few even knew our group existed.

But the time for lingering in the shadows is over.

Before we begin our work, you should hear more about the Unseen Path.

passages.title: The Unseen Path
passages.text:
The Legion has returned, and the Unseen Path needs new blood... new leadership.

The weapon you hold is proof there is no one better suited to this task.

Will you take up the mantle? Will you fulfill the oath my order took so long ago?

passages.title: Survey Says...
passages.text:
It is time to establish the first secure connection in our teleportation network.

Take this beacon to the Ruins of Elune'eth above us and survey the area to find a suitable location.

Once your survey is complete, place the beacon and I will anchor a connection to it from here.

passages.title: Survey Says...
passages.text: <This seems like a good location for the teleporter.>

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
If I might impart some advice to aid you on the trials and tribulations ahead: do not hesitate to use the many resources of the Uncrowned to aid your efforts.

There is a communal board in the tavern beyond this chamber where we organize the efforts of our underlings.

Seek out Nikki by the board - she can show you the ropes.

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
I don't know nothin' about nobody.

Oh, who I am I kiddin'? I know everything about everybody! How's it goin', Shadow <name>?

passages.title: Lethal Efficiency
passages.text:
Word is you're headin' down to the Broken Isles. That true?

Soon as news got out about the place, we combed through every book, tome, and paper we could get our hands on. We put together quite the report! You should take a look.

While you're here, this board is where the magic of the Uncrowned happens. You can put a bounty on a king's head, offer a reward for felsilk cloth... just jot down your latest whim and your agents will take care of it.

passages.title: Lethal Efficiency
passages.text: Great choice! We have tons of intel on that place.

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text:
I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.

I can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.

Fight well, <name>. May Talonclaw serve you well.

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text:
The gateway is fully functional, <name>. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!

Do let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.

You will be joining us aboard, won't you?

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text: This place is built for war - it's exactly what we need to level the playing field.

passages.title: Felstorm's Plea
passages.text:
You may not know me, but I need your help, <name>.

Meet me in the Violet Gate and I'll explain everything. 

Make haste. I fear we have little time.

passages.title: Felstorm's Plea
passages.text:
I was a fool. I thought that I could banish Kathra'natir once and for all, but instead the dreadlord broke free.

In the years he spent trapped within my body, he must have been privy to my secrets... such as those of the Council of Tirisfal.

The damage he could do with this knowledge is unthinkable. He must be stopped.

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.

Thankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: The Fel Hammer is fully operational.

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text:
The Storm Brew is created by a legendary vrykul brewmaster named Melba. Here is the location of her meadery along the northern Stormheim coast.

If we can convince her to share her secret recipe with us, we will gain a significant advantage over the enemy.

Grandmaster, how are your skills of persuasion?

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text: What do you seek?

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text:
My master was loved by many, and she passed her knowledge to me.

However, the recipe for Storm Brew, her most fiercely guarded secret, was stolen before she could teach it to me.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Brewmaster
passages.text:
I've made a new breakthrough with Melba's Storm Brew recipe.

We need the use of a special cauldron, one owned by Odyn himself.

This cauldron is located in none other than the Halls of Valor.

There is only one way to enter this exalted place, and that is through the storm god's favor.

You must find a way to enter the hall of warriors. You may require allies for this endeavor, <name>.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Brewmaster
passages.text:
Hello, champion.

I have been watching you from afar.

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text:
<name>, Saurfang has not been the same since our loss at the Broken Shore. Though he led well and slew many, he has taken our defeat hard.

I fear he is determined to return to the Broken Shore. Will you speak to him?

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text: Will you help?

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text:
Very well, let us see what awaits us on that ill-fated shore.

At the very least, a lot of dead demons! Hah!

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text:
Malfurion, my love...

In vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.

<race>, I know we have little reason to trust one another, but I will not turn away your help.

If you value the sanctity of this world, you will come with me.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text: Pray my husband makes it through this alive, <race>.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text:
Malfurion, my love...

In vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.

He is strong, but the horrors that have befallen this land are all-consuming.

I must find him, and you must help me!

Gather your wits, <race>, and follow me.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text: I pray it is not too late, friend.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text:
Your actions in Stormheim were courageous. I thank you for avenging me, and for helping my apprentice, Aegira. I can think of none better to inherit my knowledge.

With you, I will share the secret to my Storm Brew. The true strength of the brew comes from Odyn's Cauldron, which can be found in the great hall just ahead.

You have my blessing to borrow it. Good luck in your journey ahead, <name>.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text: Did you pass the trials?

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text: Tell me, were the Halls of Valor as amazing as the stories say? Regardless, you got the cauldron. Now we can begin brewing.

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.

Thankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
The Fel Hammer is ours at last.

Nicely done.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text:
The Fel Hammer will be a fine home for our kind, but it is what we found within its depths that is the true prize of our conquest.

Battlelord Gaardoun and his Ashtongue have it closely guarded - you should have him show you.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text: It is my honor to serve, <name>.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.

Kayn has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
<Kayn sighs.>

I know that look. I, too, gazed into the crucible and saw the horrors of the tomb.

We must act quickly.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text:
We must seal the Tomb of Sargeras at all costs or the flow of demons will never cease.

Until then, we must do what we can on the ground to alleviate their foothold before it grows further.

This citadel was created to spearhead Legion invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our assault.

I think you would agree that none would be better suited to lead our charge than you.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text: Agreed. You are as skilled a tactician as myself.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text:
In conquering this citadel we obtained something that I think would be of great use to you.

Gaardoun's men have it well-guarded just below - I suggest you have him show you.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text: It is my honor to serve, <name>.

passages.title: A Peaceful World
passages.text:
Word has reached us that the Legion is advancing on the Broken Isles.

They beset us from all sides, and if we do not stand strong, they will spill over into the rest of Azeroth.

<name>, we need your help more than ever. Lend your strength to those defending at the front. We cannot fail here.

passages.title: A Peaceful World
passages.text: Astounding, Grandmaster! Reports are flying in about your success. Without your help, many of our outposts around the Broken Isles would have fallen.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.

Altruis has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
<Altruis nods knowingly.>

I saw it too.

We must consider our next move carefully.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text:
The Tomb of Sargeras is the Legion's primary entrance into our world - it must be destroyed.

No easy task, but until we have the means to do so we must do what we can to stop their invasion.

The Legion used this citadel to spearhead invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our own assault against them.

You, of course, must take the honor of first breaking ground on their territory, but we will soon follow.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text: Well-chosen. The Legion will soon fear the very sight of the Illidari on the battlefield.

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text:
The first king of the humans, Thoradin, performed many acts of heroism and valor. While on a personal quest near the end of his reign, he stumbled upon the tomb of my brother Tyr... and the grave-prison of the monstrosity he died fighting. Thoradin unintentionally awoke the beast and gave his life to keep it from escaping.

It is Thoradin's sword, Strom'kar, that has kept the monster at bay. Retrieve it and finish what Tyr and Thoradin started. Kill Zakajz the Corrupted.

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text: Ah, you have returned...

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text: A mighty blade! Forged by the son of vrykul, enchanted by elven sorcery, and quenched in the blood of a C'thraxxi. It will serve you well, <name>. With it, you will put an end to our enemies!

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text:
Do you remember Varedis? He was once our lead trainer at the Black Temple, but fell early in the siege.

...or so we thought.

Kor'vas spotted the traitor amongst the Legion wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.

The Kirin Tor have an eredar lord interred in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' base of operations is. The hold's warden has agreed to consider granting us access to him.

<Altruis smirks.>

Time to play the friendly diplomat.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text: Let's get this done with. These bureaucrats already test my patience.

passages.title: The Tirisgarde Reborn
passages.text:
The Tirisgarde is reformed. It is time we begin our mission in earnest.

The order will need leaders, and though I may be an experienced mage, I am no strategist. You have proven yourself capable, in both your past exploits and present. 

Will you take on this challenge, <name>?

passages.title: The Tirisgarde Reborn
passages.text:
So you're a Conjuror now, huh? Fan-cy!

We've got a good start with this Tirisgarde thing here, but I think we should keep up the recruiting if we actually plan on invading demon-town.

Fortunately for you, nobody negotiates contracts like a goblin!

passages.title: A Conjuror's Duty
passages.text:
I don't know about you but I'm ready to get this show on the road. This place is nice and all, but it's a bit stuffy.

I'll see what I can do to get some more mages in this group of yours. You go ahead and check the map over there. It'll help you plan your first moves.

passages.title: A Conjuror's Duty
passages.text:
Alright, then! I can get started recruiting, and you can get to taking the fight to the demons!

Yeah, I know I'm letting you take the easy job, but hey, what are friends for?

passages.title: A Re-Warding Effort
passages.text:
<This small device of elegant nightborne design crackles gently with arcane power.

Kel'danath's notes mention wards that keep the withered at bay. It seems he found some form of spellcasting that does not tempt their ravenous appetite for magic.

These may prove useful in your search for the missing arcanist.>

passages.title: A Re-Warding Effort
passages.text: <The ward snaps to life, giving you a slight pinch. Kel'danath must have put great care into developing a spell that would scare the withered away without harming them.>

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Our goals have been met, warlock, and it is time we part ways. I think I will be glad to see the last of you.

Go on, return to your dark masters. We are done here.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Friend has the weapon? 

Yes, Calydus can feel its power!

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text:
<name>, we must find a way to reseal the Tomb of Sargeras.

I have uncovered information concerning an ancient relic, which might be the key to stopping the Legion.

Our search begins on the ancient elven island of Azsuna. Long ago, it was where the Highborne elves of Suramar perfected their mightiest of magics. Now it is a cursed ruin.

The Illidari demon hunters have established a camp on the island. As they are the only people we know in the area, that is where we will begin.

Ready to take wing?

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text: It would seem that we have arrived at the crucial moment.

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text:
As I suspected, the Illidari are holding the line against the Burning Legion, but just barely.

We must come to their aid, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text:
The gateway is fully functional, <name>. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!

Do let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.

You will be joining us aboard, won't you?

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text: This citadel was one of the Legion's most valuable assets - it will serve us well.

passages.title: Sowing The Seed
passages.text:
Your weapon is ancient and powerful but it holds the potential to be so much more.

Take this seed, it is all that remains of a forest that grew tall when the world was young. Plant it within the grove to the west and allow it to take root.

With its power both it and your weapon will be far more than they are alone.

passages.title: Sowing The Seed
passages.text: Excellent. There's no time to waste.

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text:
Nobundo is right. Conventional tactics will not work against the Legion - the Broken Shore taught us that. We must scour the world for weapons to use against the Legion!

The Doomhammer is missing and must be recovered. Rehgar and Erunak have some other ideas, as well. Whatever our course, we must act immediately.

Speak with me to go over your options, but the final decision is yours!

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text: Have you made your decision yet?

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text: A good choice. There is no time to lose - let us begin!

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text:
I realize we have never met, but you will learn of my order soon enough. For now, pleasantries must wait.

The Legion has returned to Azeroth stronger than ever, and we need new weapons to fight them.

I have met three individuals here in Dalaran who have leads on ancient artifacts which could prove vital in the battle to come. Acquiring these weapons demands the skills of a master hunter.

Speak to each of them and decide whom you will aid first.

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text: Have you chosen a lead to pursue first?

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text:
Any of the three weapons you learned of would be a huge boon in the war against the Legion.

But your crusade must start with one of them, so you must choose.

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text:
This bed will be yours for the deep slumber that will usher you into the Dream.

Once you are comfortable, drink of the moonwater you brought. I will guide you from there.

Quickly, now - with every passing moment G'Hanir slips further into darkness.

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text: Were you able to retrieve G'Hanir?

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text: Delving into the Dream with such darkness encroaching is no simple task, one few druids dare attempt, but I'm afraid your journey is far from over.

passages.title: Join the Dreamer
passages.text:
I'm afraid I can't really help you actually enter the Emerald Dream - we dryads merely shift our bodies between the planes.

That's ok, though - Naralex has offered to help!

Go to the very bottom of the Tel'Andu Barrow Den. Naralex is already there setting things up for you.

passages.title: Join the Dreamer
passages.text: My preparations are complete. Are you prepared to enter the Dream?

passages.title: Mistress of the Claw
passages.text:
The great forest guardian, Ursoc, gave his life for this world ten thousand years ago. After the guardian's death his claws were hidden away, safe from any who would use their power for evil.

Lea Stonepaw and her Druids of the Claw consider Ursoc their paragon and dedicate their lives to following in his example. If anyone would know where the claws reside, it would be Lea.

She and her Druids of the Claw reside in the Tel'Andu Barrow Den just to the north.

passages.title: Mistress of the Claw
passages.text:
The Claws of Ursoc?

I thought I'd go the rest of my days without hearing of them again. Is our situation truly so dire? They were sealed away for good reason!

passages.title: Azeroth Needs You
passages.text:
We shaman under your command will aid your efforts against the Legion. You may direct our actions from here.

Seek out Advisor Sevel just to the south and locate the scouting map from which you can direct your followers. We will also indicate on the scouting map various hot-spots around the Broken Isles that require your attention.

Azeroth needs you, Farseer! Visit the scouting map and choose our first point of attack.

passages.title: Azeroth Needs You
passages.text:
A sound decision, Farseer. Behind me I have opened up an astral portal to Dalaran to help our people move quickly between our base of operations and the Broken Isles. Step through to return to Dalaran. You may always use the portal to travel back here whenever you need to augment your artifact or command your followers.

May the elements guide you, Farseer.

passages.title: Rendezvous with the Courier
passages.text:
Thas'dorah is a mighty bow indeed! The weapon was carved from a limb of Thas'alah, the mother tree of Eversong, and infused with the magic of the Sunwell. I fought alongside its first wielder, Talanas Windrunner, during an Amani troll incursion.

Ah, but such tales can wait for another time.

Courier Larkspear was making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: Rendezvous with the Courier
passages.text:
I don't know the full details, but a demon prisoner has given us the first solid lead on Alleria Windrunner's whereabouts in a very long time.

The ranger-general has joined with members of the Farstriders on the Broken Shore. She's putting a team together, and your presence is crucial to its success.

passages.title: A Beastly Expedition
passages.text:
I know the power of Titanstrike well. The Unseen Path battled the vrykul warlord Volund as he campaigned to conquer the Broken Isles. We sought to wrest the rifle from him, but he took it to his grave.

If Volund's tomb can at last be opened, the artifact would be a great boon to our cause.

I believe Grif Wildheart is making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: A Beastly Expedition
passages.text:
There you are! I knew you'd be bitin' to find Titanstrike.

Don't mind ol' Huey here. The city of mages is no place for a gryphon.

passages.title: Preparation for the Hunt
passages.text:
Talonclaw is a mighty spear indeed! I first set eyes upon it when the Highmountain tauren led the members of my order up to Talon Peak to found the Trueshot Lodge.

But such tales must wait for another time.

Apata has been in Dalaran gathering supplies for her expedition. I imagine she's ready to depart by now.

Seek her out at Krasus' Landing. I know she will be eager to begin.

passages.title: Preparation for the Hunt
passages.text:
My brother Wuho and I will be honored to have you on this quest, <name>. Talonclaw is a sacred artifact to my people, and I know with your help we will recover it.

We just have to do one thing before we head out, speak with the Eagle Spirit.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text:
We must learn much about our long-lost kin if we are to fight them.

We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and gather intelligence. The Sentinels sent their own scout as well, hopefully she is smart enough to not get herself killed before reporting in.

They have not returned in some time, and we must suspect the worst.

Find them and we shall see what we are up against.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text: They are alive? That is good news. Their knowledge of the defenses will be invaluable.

passages.title: The Light's Wrath
passages.text:
Light's Wrath... a bold choice. Though if you believe you can control its energies, it could prove vital to our cause.

Retrieving it won't be easy. It was last held by the Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

passages.title: The Light's Wrath
passages.text:
So you seek Light's Wrath? A dangerous weapon, to be sure.

Long ago the Kirin Tor entrusted its safekeeping to the blue dragonflight. It was locked away in the only place that could contain its rampant power  - the Nexus Vault.

I have not been there in some time, however. After the blue dragonflight was dissolved, the Nexus was abandoned. There is no knowing whether the Nexus Vault is still intact - or what may be waiting in the Nexus itself.

passages.title: A Forgotten Enemy
passages.text:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

passages.title: Eyes of the Dragon
passages.text:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, <name>. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

passages.title: Unleashing Judgment
passages.text:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Light's Wrath into these points of focused void, and the reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum likely won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Light's Wrath, I would ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, <name>.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
You have my gratitude for saving Azuregos, <name>. I can rest easy knowing that the Nexus is under his care.

As for you, I can see you're full of surprises. Never in my time have I seen a <class> who can control the chaotic energies of Light's Wrath. 

You are truly the hero we need to face the Legion.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text:
You have done a great thing for the blue dragons today, <name>, as well as for my own peace of mind.

Now, armed with Light's Wrath, I only ask that you fulfill your original goal, and take the fight to the Legion.

I believe Alonsus Faol awaits your return. Safe travels, friend.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text: So the dragons proved helpful? This is good, we may need their assistance in the war to come.

passages.title: Reconvene
passages.text:
You found Lyessa in the Dream, didn't you, Shan'do <name>? I heard you mutter her name in your slumber.

Thank Elune she is well.

You must seek her out - I can sense her presence even now at the Circle of Spirits above.

If ever there were one who could help us cleanse G'Hanir, it is Lyessa.

passages.title: Reconvene
passages.text: I don't know how much longer I would have lasted had you not arrived - thank you.

passages.title: Subject 16
passages.text: <It seems Theryn is still under the arcanist's spell. In the absence of Kel'danath himself, a live subject could be useful in helping Thalyssra unravel his research.>

passages.title: Subject 16
passages.text:
So, Kel'danath turned in the end...

He deserved better. Thank you for giving him peace.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
Xavius led Ysera past here, but their destination is unclear. This twisted wickedness smothers my mind!

These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins of their home. If it somehow resisted this corruption...

I will beg of Elune a vision to give me direction. With her light, I may find my husband yet.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen.

passages.title: Heart of the Nightmare
passages.text:
I know only that my husband is somewhere deeper in this twisted forest. He is still alive, but it remains to be seen if he is whole.

<Tyrande's expression hardens into a scowl.>

Elune herself cannot protect Xavius if he is not.

passages.title: Heart of the Nightmare
passages.text: No one is safe from this corruption.

passages.title: Slowing the Spread
passages.text:
Reinforcements. Just what we needed! Grandmaster, the monastery is under attack.

The Legion is using a foul device known as a Fel Spreader to scorch the very earth we walk on with disgusting fel energy.

Destroy those machines, and we can slow their efforts.

passages.title: Slowing the Spread
passages.text: You did well, little wicket. Stay strong together, that's the ticket! The enemies have tried to spread their taint, but we stopped them with a little restraint!

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text:
Good, your timing couldn't have been better, <name>.

These foul Legion creatures have invaded our sanctuary. They have no place here on our world.

Kill every demon you see, <brother/sister>.

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text: This is an invasion like none I have ever seen before.

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text: Good wicket, strong wicket, thanks for helping! You've sent the demons off, groaning and yelping!

passages.title: The Hand of Keletress
passages.text:
The demons' leader is up ahead, taking prisoners it is said!

This dire storm, we will weather... if we fight her together!

passages.title: The Hand of Keletress
passages.text: Tian Monastery is safe again, thanks to you.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text:
A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.

As with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.

Please, <name>, bring him peace.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

passages.title: An Unlikely Ally
passages.text:
Channeling the demonic gateway will require the assistance of someone with intimate knowledge of the Burning Legion.

I know of such a warlock, though I imagine her blood still boils upon hearing my name. It might be best if you are the one to request her help.

passages.title: An Unlikely Ally
passages.text:
Ritssyn sent you, did he? I see my old mentor still refuses to do his own dirty work.

But of course, someone in his position can't be seen consorting with a purported member of the Argus Wake! What would the others think?

As much as I relish the idea of Ritssyn needing my help, I don't barter in kindness and favors, <name>.

My currency is power and knowledge. If you have either, then it's possible we can come to an arrangement.

passages.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
passages.text:
Elisande's decision to welcome the Legion into Suramar earned her plenty of enemies, though only some of us were bold enough to openly defy her.

We have allies in the city - we just don't know how many.

I need you to make contact with a spell-fencer by the name of Silgryn. He is loyal to our cause, and has been lying in wait since our failed coup.

He patrols the western edge of the city. Address him by name and tell him our cause is not lost!

passages.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
passages.text: We should be safe to speak here for a moment.

passages.title: Close Enough to Touch
passages.text:
He is near, <race>, I can feel it.

We must search Shala'nir for Malfurion. If we do not find him soon, I fear he will be lost to me forever.

I was unsure of your worth when first we met. I know now that you will not fail me.

I am... grateful.

passages.title: Close Enough to Touch
passages.text: This cannot be!

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text:
If we have any hope of curing this curse, we need to know what kind of magic we're dealing with.

I know of an alchemist who earned himself quite the reputation for his unconventional methods. Shunned from Gilneas long ago, I believe Mad Ernie has taken up residence in these lands.

His knowledge may be the first step to breaking this curse.

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text: Have you come to lend a hand? We all must do our part.

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text:
That's a name I thought I'd never hear again.

We may have worked together in the past, but Ritssyn needs to know I'm not the man I was before.

My priorities are Marl and this farm.

passages.title: The Skies Above
passages.text:
There has been no Windlord to lead the air elementals since the death of Al'Akir.

The realm of Skywall has been thrown into turmoil. The throne of Al'Akir is Thunderaan's by right, but what remains of the prince's essence within Thunderfury is diminishing. If we do not move quickly, Thunderaan may be lost forever.

Take the damaged Thunderfury to Vortex Pinnacle and speak with Celestos.

Celestos was a loyal servant of Al'Akir and he will share our desire to see Thunderaan reborn.

passages.title: The Skies Above
passages.text: Farseer Nobundo has told me of your plan to save Azeroth. I fear I may be the only zephyr to share your desire.

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text:
You have recovered the Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, and with it you hold all that is left of the soul of Prince Thunderaan.

Thunderfury can be restored, but it will require a rare essence known as the Heart of Skywall.

Vortos, the Duke of the East Winds, possesses the heart... but he will not give it willingly.

Vortos must be defeated, and the Heart of Skywall must be combined with the blade.

Only then can Thunderaan return and claim the Throne of Four Winds.

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text: Have you retrieved the Heart of Skywall?

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text: At long last, the Windseeker shall return to to his rightful place as heir to the Throne of Four Winds. This is a glorious day for Skywall!

passages.title: Ascendant of Flames
passages.text:
As we speak, an endless war rages for control of the Firelands. Of the two aspiring Firelords, Lord Smolderon hates mortals less.

If we help him defeat his rival and ascend to Firelord, he may unite with us in return.

The champions of the Earthen Ring have already made their way to the Firelands. Go and meet with Rehgar Earthfury and find a way to turn an old enemy into a new ally.

If anyone can succeed at this impossible task, I have faith that it is you, Farseer.

May the elements be with you.

passages.title: Ascendant of Flames
passages.text:
At last you have arrived, Farseer <name>.

It seems our presence in the Firelands has not gone unnoticed.

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text:
Greetings, mortal. I am Scaldius, emissary of Lord Smolderon.

I have just met with others from your order. They tell me that you will bring an end to those who oppose my master. This pleases Lord Smolderon.

Pyroth and his minions defy my master's rule and so an example must be made of them. You will slay Pyroth and his champions!

Nothing is more humiliating than death at the hands of a mortal. Do this and Lord Smolderon will grant you audience.

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text: I will devour the heart of Pyroth with great pleasure!

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text:
The son of Rhyolith slain by mere mortals? What an ignominious death!

You have done well, <class>. This pleases me greatly.

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text:
In order to unite the four Elemental Lords of Azeroth, you will need to seek out Therazane and convince her to join the cause of Azeroth.

However, the Stonemother currently has her hands full battling a Twilight's Hammer resurgence in Deepholm.

If we lend Therazane our aid she may agree to unite with the Earthen Ring against the Burning Legion.

Journey to Therazane's Throne in the heart of Deepholm. Aid her in defeating the Twilight's Hammer and convince her to join the defense of Azeroth!

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text: What would you have with the Stonemother, <class>?

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text: The Earthen Ring has come to offer help? This is unexpected... but welcome, nonetheless.

passages.title: Return of the Windlord
passages.text:
With Thunderfury recharged, Prince Thunderaan can now return to the physical realm.

In a moment, I will release my master's spirit from the blessed blade.

When the ritual is complete, Skywall will once again have its Windlord.

passages.title: Return of the Windlord
passages.text: At long last, I have returned to Skywall thanks to the help of mortal hands. I owe you a great debt, Farseer.

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text:
We are all that stands between the Twilight's Hammer and their conquest of Deepholm.

Azeroth cannot hope to fight the full strength of the Twilight's Hammer and the Burning Legion at the same time. It is up to us to put an end to their cult before they are able to fully rebuild.

Accompany me into their stronghold and we shall cut through their ranks together!

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text: How many have you slain? I've lost count.

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text: The Twilight's Hammer will not soon recover from the damage we've dealt to their numbers this day. It is an honor to battle at your side, Farseer <name>.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text:
Doom curses are serious business, so much so that many warlocks didn't deal in them for some time. 

The magic grows stronger as time goes on, eventually leading to death. Only the caster of the curse can remove it.

I can craft an elixir that will slow its progression, but you'll need to collect an assortment of ingredients first.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text: Have you found those ingredients yet? Time really isn't on your side, you know.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text: This looks like everything I need. Just give me a moment to mix it all together.

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text:
In case you haven't noticed, things are a bit hectic around here.

Marl's doing a good job protecting the corn fields, but the commotion gave our goats quite the scare. They dashed out of their pen as soon as the fighting started, and are now running amuck!

Round them up for me and I'll do my best to figure out how to handle the curse you're dealing with.

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text: Have you found my goats yet?

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text:
I can see all my goats have been accounted for.

Now, let's see if we can do something about that curse.

passages.title: Finding Fizzlebang
passages.text:
I have reason to believe that Wilfred Fizzlebang's sister has made her way to Stormheim.

If she has half his power, but at least twice his intelligence, then we just might succeed in summoning the eredar twins.

passages.title: Finding Fizzlebang
passages.text:
You're the council's new leader, aren't you? I could tell by your weapon. I bet you have an amazing story to tell about how you got it.

My name's Lulubelle, or Lulu for short. But, uh... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention to anyone that you saw me, ok?

passages.title: Someone Else's Mess
passages.text:
A confession alone won't be enough to clear my name. As long as those demons run amuck, people will blame their presence on me. 

Someone needs to clean up the mess that warlock made. I'd do it myself, but I can't be placed at the scene of the crime.

You could banish them though. That would do the trick. Use this orb on newly summoned demons to send them right back where they came from - permanently!

passages.title: Someone Else's Mess
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>.

Your willingness to help an outcast will not be forgotten.

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
The Legion...

<the glow of Ursol's eyes begin to shine intensely>

Yes... I remember clearly that day long ago when my brother fell. Countless demons fell beneath his claws until, through the overwhelming numbers of the enemy, he was overtaken. My brother was the true spirit of the bear!

You must prove to me that the spirit of the bear resides within you as well.

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text: You are powerful indeed, but strength alone will not impress me.

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
Ursoc never backed down from a battle, even when faced with overwhelming odds. If you would take up his claws you will show me that you possess the same courage.

Your next trial will place you against an onslaught of my followers. Defeat all of the spirits and prove that you possess the courage of the bear!

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. You handled yourself with honor!

You've done well so far, yet a single trial remains before I will give you my blessing.

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
You've proven to me your strength and your courage, but do you possess the ability to apply yourself when it matters most?

This final trial will reveal all.

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
You have passed every trial I've placed before you and emerged victorious. You are worthy indeed of my brother's legacy, and have earned my blessing!

Go, seek out the claws and claim them as your own.

passages.title: Lulubelle on Loan
passages.text:
What you plan to do is pretty risky, you know? Summoning one sister would be difficult enough, but both of them at once? That's just asking for trouble.

Luckily, I'm up for the challenge. I'll help you and the rest of the council summon those demons, and hopefully restore pride to the Fizzlebang name.

passages.title: Lulubelle on Loan
passages.text: With Lulubelle's assistance, we should be able to complete the summoning.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text:
As her name suggests, Imp Mother Dyala is adept at summoning imps.

While the council controls Dreadscar Rift, her services will be ours to use as we see fit.

Speak to her if you wish to train a pack of imps.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text:
As First of the council, you have acolytes devoted to helping any way they can. Recruiter Jared is in charge of screening candidates, only selecting those that possess the skills we desire.

Speak to him now.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text: I'm here to help build you an army, <name>.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text:
A Legion communicator? Hmmmm.

<Khadgar pauses to think for a moment.>

You know what, I think I have something in my lockbox upstairs that is just the ticket.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text: I'm always happy to help a friend.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text: No need to thank me, just promise you won't accidentally blow anything up in the city; our repair bills are already astronomical.

passages.title: Return to Jace
passages.text:
That crystallized soul should power your communicator long enough to reach your allies.

I must urge you to be cautious, <name>. If that device is of Legion origin, then you never know who among its creators might overhear your message.

I'm sure your allies eagerly await your return.

passages.title: Return to Jace
passages.text: Did the Archmage have anything of use?

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text:
I got bad news fer ya - we don't have time to wait for reinforcements. They're sacrificin' prisoners now! Every minute we wait here jabberin' is another life on the line!

First things first, my friend Sylara is being held captive in the camp just across the road.

We need ta free her - she'll be a valuable ally.

We've got ta move move move!

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text: Something need punching?

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text: Good, ye did it. Sylara is worth ten well-trained monks.

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text:
Most of the prisoners are being held in the main camp at the Gates of Valor.

Our people have been beaten and tortured, and worse still awaits for them if we don't save them.

Find the cages within the main camp and free as many monks as you can find.

I'll be right beside you, knocking heads and taking names!

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text: Did we free them all?

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text:
Good work, Grandmaster!

That should be all of them.

passages.title: Zero to Hiro
passages.text:
I have a favor to ask of you, <name>. My good friend Hiro is still somewhere inside the main camp.

Only problem is, the Gates of Valor are swarming with the biggest, baddest, nastiest Legion creatures I've ever seen. If we walk in there, we'll just get slaughtered.

But I've seen these vrykul chugging some kind of special brew called Storm Brew. It's some kind of combat tonic that makes them bigger and stronger.

Let's steal some of that drink, then storm in to save Hiro!

passages.title: Zero to Hiro
passages.text: Ahhh, tanks be to ya for freein' me. I thot I was demon-food for sure.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
Caria lies in the very heart of Legion territory - they'll see our forces immediately if we try to launch an all-out attack.

Failure is not an option.

However, if you go alone you might be able to slip by unnoticed long enough to avoid the brunt of the Legion army.

Remember, <name> - this is not a rescue mission. The power of the Aldrachi Warblades could tip the scales of this war in our favor; Allari and her men are expendable if need be.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
What of the others? Did they...?

I see. They gave their lives for a worthy cause - the Warblades will change the tide of this war, mark my words.

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text:
Our friend Ly'leth contacted me. She requested that you meet her atop the Grand Promenade as it overlooks the city.

Have your disguise ready just in case, <name>.

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text: Hm?

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text: I hope you have prepared yourself to enter the City. It is time.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text:
I need your help.

The wine you so graciously distributed to the needy was the last of my reserves. Without more, these people here will risk succumbing to their thirst, and eventually becoming withered.

I am dedicated to preventing this for as long as possible.

There is a woman by the name of Deline who owns and operates a small delivery service out of her gondola.

Find her, identify yourself as my messenger, and offer your aid in acquiring the next shipment.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text: Unless you want a ride, you should keep moving.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text: Let's get started, shall we?

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
Xavius has been this way, but his destination is unclear. The Nightmare smothers my mind!

These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins ahead.

If it is uncorrupted, it will give me the focus I need. By Elune's light, we will find my husband yet.

Meet me at the Moonwell at once, <class>.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen. For your sake, let us pray that he is unharmed.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text:
A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.

As with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.

Please, <name>, bring him peace.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: Is it done, then?

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text:
The purpose of the Twilight's Hammer has always been the same. They seek to bring about the end of the world. Their schemes may change, but their wicked purpose remains constant.

Defeating the Twilight's Hammer is not simply a matter of defeating them in battle. If we are to be successful, we will need to uncover their scheme and put an end to whatever terrible plans they have created.

Let us start by searching the encampment for clues as to their true purpose here.

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text: What vile scheme have the Twilight's Hammer plotted against the world this time?

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text:
If The Master is not stopped, the Twilight's Hammer will have all the power they need to conquer Deepholm and enslave the elements!

We must not allow that to happen.

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text:
According to The Master's journal, the Twilight's Hammer has discovered a method of harnessing the void to subjugate even the most powerful of elementals.

The journal specifically mentioned the children of Therazane as test subjects. Whether The Master was speaking literally or figuratively in this regard, I do not know. Regardless, we need to free these elementals and stop these dark rituals from continuing.

It appears that our journey here is going to take us deeper into the depths of darkness...

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text: Dark rituals such as these must not be allowed to continue.

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text: The servants of Therazane are free and the dark rituals of subjugation have been halted... for now.

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text:
There are prisoners here, Farseer <name>, that are enslaved by the Twilight's Hammer.

The cultists work them to death in the depths of the mine.

I cannot abide such cruel mistreatment! Let us clear a path through the mine and rescue any Twilight's Hammer prisoners we find, so that they may return to their homes and families.

The Twilight's Hammer will pay for their crimes!

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text: Have the slaves been rescued?

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text: The captives have been set free, but there is still much more to be done if we are to dismantle the Twilight's Hammer cult...

passages.title: Appropriations
passages.text:
I have come to lend my help to the Order of the Broken Temple.

My job is to create a solid base of operations around here. Right now, we have wounded to tend and bellies to feed. After this, we can worry about building our defenses.

Lao Shu is in charge of our supply inventory. Go and speak with him now in the inn.

passages.title: Appropriations
passages.text: Ah, yes yes yes! High Elder Cloudfall was right to send you to me.

passages.title: Tracking the Tideskorn
