passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text:
Spiritwalkers maintain balance between the world of the living and the spirit realm. We can travel into the memories of the dead to glean clues about the past.

The wards Ebonhorn maintained were placed long ago by heroes who fought the darkness. By walking in their footsteps, we may locate the wards and restore them.

Igrul, the drogbar known as the Scalebane, was a true friend to Huln Highmountain. Use the Water of Vision to enter his memories and find where he placed the first ward.

passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text: As a spiritwalker, I am able to see the memories of the dead.

passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text:
I am pleased you were able to place the first ward. We are one step closer to saving Ebonhorn.

But this mention of the Darkness is unsettling. It is a monster spoken of in our myths and folklore, tales told around campfires to spook the young.

Could these stories be based in truth?

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text:
Oenia Skyhorn was a legendary chieftain of her tribe. Though she crossed over to the spirit realm long ago, her presence is still felt all around us.

Ebonhorn told me that Oenia placed a ward here to protect the people she cared for so deeply... perhaps from the specter of the Darkness.

Use the Water of Vision to journey into her echoes. Worry not that this ritual might disturb her rest. A hero like Oenia would relish a chance to aid us in the present.

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text: The spirits speak of the Darkness. A great danger rises, <name>.

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text:
These shadows of the spirit realm grow stronger. I fear they may soon pierce the veil into our reality.

I pray restoring the wards will set things right.

passages.title: Servants of the Darkness
passages.text:
The heroes of Highmountain's past placed wards to protect our land from the insidious Old Gods. The deeds of these noble champions kept us safe for thousands of years.

We must not fail their memory.

Huln Highmountain himself placed the ward here at Snowblind Mesa. It must be reactivated for us to have any hope of saving Ebonhorn.

Enter the echo of Huln's spirit, and let his courage lead you to the location of this ward.

passages.title: Servants of the Darkness
passages.text:
Huln battled the Necrodark?

There are so many tall tales attributed to Huln that I assumed those drogbar to be just another story. But it is clear they served the Darkness.

A troubling discovery... but there is no time to dwell on it now.

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text:
Ye'd not normally know it, but the terraced entrance to the vrykul's Halls o' Valor is a fine place for findin' ancient artifacts. Problem is, the place is just a big mess with demons at the time.

Well, ye've not got much choice. If the disc isn't elsewhere in Stormheim, it most likely lies at the Gates of Valor. Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text: Ye're back in one piece. What's the news?

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text:
Alright, let's see what ye brought me.

<Brann examines the disc pieces.>

Well look at this? There's a piece o' somethin' fel here. I betcha that's what was causin' all those imps ta show up 'round here.

I'll give it to ya to dispose of, or do whatever it is ye do with things like that.

passages.title: Curse of the Necrodark
passages.text:
It is clear that the Old Gods have long sought to control Highmountain. Their covetous desire speaks to the power of this land, and the strength of the spirits that echo through its peaks and valleys.

They will not take our sacred mountain, <name>. Not while I draw breath.

With the Highmountain tribes united, and with Baine Bloodhoof at our side, we will defeat the Darkness... once and for all.

Come. Let us take back the summit from the forces that would corrupt it.

passages.title: Curse of the Necrodark
passages.text:
Mayla charged ahead with Ebonhorn. Now they're cut off from the rest of us.

This is bad, <name>.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text:
The Necrodark are readying their ritual to give physical form to the Darkness. They've sealed themselves inside and barred our way.

The shards you brought me should provide the means to bring down the barrier. Once it is done, we have to act quickly. We must restore the final ward before the Darkness can manifest.

Do not hesitate. The fate of Highmountain itself hangs in the balance.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text: This is the hardest challenge I have ever had to face.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text:
We failed! The ward is shattered.

I sense the Darkness rising...

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text: The vyrkul meadery overlooks the coast in northern Stormheim. Meet me there when you are ready, <name>.

passages.title: Den of Shadows
Whispers of the Darkness
passages.text:
Before our arrival, many of our own came to neutralize the threat here. They did not know what they were walking into.

Our people are now suffering from the whispers. The Old Gods seek to corrupt them and turn them against their own.

Wake them from their stupor. Free them from the whispers any way you can.

passages.title: Whispers of the Darkness
passages.text: Well done, <name>. If left unchecked, the whispers can turn even the best of friends against one another.

passages.title: Dark Tales
passages.text:
Spiritwalker Ebonhorn is stable... for now.

He once told me of the wards he maintains against the Old Gods. He placed them at key locations around this mountain, but kept them hidden from mortal eyes--even my own.

Incapacitated like this, his wards cannot hold back the evil ones. No doubt this is the reason for their attack.

To find the wards, we must enter the echoes of Ebonhorn's past and commune with the spirits we find there.

Meet me in Riverbend, <name>. It is there our search begins.

passages.title: Dark Tales
passages.text:
The spirits hold many truths, <name>.

Walking in their footsteps may reveal the locations of Ebonhorn's wards.

passages.title: Tainted Growth
passages.text:
The blood red petals of the Nightmare Flower seethe with chaotic energy. The plant twitches every now and then, releasing puffs of pollen into the air. 

The nearby satyrs and keepers can be seen harvesting similar plants for little crimson seeds.

These seeds must be destroyed.

passages.title: Gathering the Pieces
passages.text:
Grand Master, the Mission Table is now at your disposal.

There are several strategic areas where we can focus our Order's efforts.

First, we should check on the status of the other monk temples. It seems the Legion has a special focus on destroying us.

Second, we need to scour the seas near the Broken Shore. There are still many missing from the battle.

Finally, there is the continued appearance of demonic forces at numerous points across the Broken Isles. They must be kept at bay.

passages.title: Combat Training
Black Rook Holdings
passages.text:
Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest.

The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

passages.title: Kept Secret, Kept Safe
passages.text:
With the scrolls in hand, now you must set to the task of finding the staff.

When Aegwynn relinquished it many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text:
You have done a great thing for the blue dragons today, <name>, as well as for my own peace of mind.

Now, armed with Aluneth, I only ask that you fulfill your original goal, and take the fight to the Legion.

I believe your comrades await your back in the Hall of the Guardian. Safe travels, friend.

passages.title: Rise, Champions [NYI]
passages.text: [Tutorial quest flow not yet implemented. Skip forward.]

passages.title: Building Our Troops [NYI]
passages.text: [Tutorial quest flow not yet implemented. Skip forward.]

passages.title: The Shade of Xavius
passages.text:
Brightwing loves nice things - rainbows, unicorns, and flowers! But enemies, Brightwing does not forget. Brightwing remembers for a long, long time those that hurt the grove.

Now, we must destroy our enemies... so that the grove can be nice and happy forever!

Friend, go to Darkheart Thicket beneath the roots of Shaladrassil.

There, find the one named Xavius... the one who started it all. Kill him, and bring me his head.

passages.title: In With the New
passages.text:
Well, here's your new conduit. Try not to break this one, I really don't feel like making another.

Oh, and tell your boss, Deucus, that he owes me big time for this.

passages.title: In With the New
passages.text:
You're finished? Let's see it!

<Deucus takes the conduit from you and places it against the wall.>

Now that is a good looking decoction conduit. I'm glad I upgraded its strength from that old hunk of junk I had before.

You might even say Svena did me a favor by destroying that old one.

passages.title: The Dreamweavers
passages.text: Assist the Druids of Val'sharah by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Dreamweavers
passages.text: The Dreamweavers thank you.

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text:
While you're focused on murlocs...

Many murlocs are known to wear jewelry to attract a mate. I'm willing to bet that we can use some of the same jewels they use.

Collect some of their jewelry and bring it back to me. The wetter, the better!

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text: I could see how jewelry on a murloc might make it seem more attractive...

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text: Oh yes! There are some fine looking jewels here. Let's just scratch the goop off, and...

passages.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
passages.text:
If you are heading east, there is something I would ask of you.

While we struck camp some of our caravan left to scout around the city. Lilryia Dawnwind has been gone too long.

I would be most grateful if you would go check on her safety. She said she was going to scout out the ruins of Dawncleft.

passages.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
passages.text: You could not have arrived at a better time, <race>.

passages.title: The Valarjar
passages.text: Assist the Vry'kul of Stormheim by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Valarjar
passages.text: The valarjar thank you.

passages.title: Missing Demon
passages.text:
I seem to have misplaced my imp, Daglop.

If you see him, tell him to check in.

Normally I would just resummon him but I'm worried blind Marius here will kill him first and ask questions later.

No vision, that one.

passages.title: Missing Demon
passages.text: Yeah yeah, the new master sent you. I get it. I have to deal with my former master first.

passages.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
passages.text:
I have had it with these small fry, assistant. Time to go straight to the top.

The tome is the key! The key to unlocking the potential within our people.

Do not worry, young one. I have enough power to complete the task at hand. Let us harness fel magic and change the future.

Follow me and witness the redemption of the shal'dorei!

passages.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
passages.text: Kyrtos, you old fool! You should have known the risks...

passages.title: Quantity Over Quality
passages.text:
The demons of Felblaze Ingress are amassing at an exponential rate.

We must cull these invaders before they have enough demons to flank our forces at Illidari Stand.

Will you join us in battle?

passages.title: Quantity Over Quality
passages.text: That should stall these demons for a time. We may need to return in the future to ensure they have not regrouped.

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text:
These demon portals are terrible and sloppy. No skill or finesse in it.

This physically hurts me and I haven't felt real pain in decades.

I "fixed" some of the Legion's precious Portal Stabilizer crystals.

I want you to take them and "modify" their main portal in the Ingress and watch the "hilarity" ensue.

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text: Did you see the look on those demons' faces? Priceless!

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text: If you think the explosion was big on our side of the portal, you should see what the other side looks like. Ha!

passages.title: Felblaze Ingress
passages.text:
It is my mission to cover the rear guard of Illidari Stand. I have employed this warlock... thing, to assist me.

However, the two of us are insufficient for a task that needs doing.

To the east is a mass of demons at Felblaze Ingress. These creatures have begun to open portals to summon in countless reinforcements.

Meet us at Felblaze Ingress and together we can crush this fel insurgency.

passages.title: Felblaze Ingress
passages.text: Keep your voice down unless you feel like being felbat food.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text:
There is being blind, and then there is being stupid.

This eyeless wonder next to me wants to barrel into Felblaze Ingress without preparation.

Bah! I say we scout it first.

Here, I will provide you with an extra eye I picked up from a place better left unmentioned.

Enter Felblaze Ingress, investigate the area, and try not to get poked in the eye.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text: Don't ask where I got the eye. Worst case is I tell you and then it gets all awkward between us.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text: Why? Why would demons, of all things, be this bad at summoning their own kind?

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text:
Mrglrg! Mrlglr mrgllrg.

<Phin gesticulates wildly>

Mrlgrlg glrglmglr mrlglrg. Rglrgmrg mrglr glr. Glr! Gmrlgrmlg mrglmrgm...

<Phin looks at you expectantly.>

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text: Mrlgr?

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text:
<Phin grabs your shoulders and hops happily.>

Mlrglr! Grlrlrglrmg.

passages.title: Court of Farondis
passages.text: Assist the Court of Farondis in Azsuna by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Court of Farondis
passages.text: The Court of Farondis thanks you.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: Assist the Nightfallen of Suramar by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: Assist us, and we will reward you.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: The nightfallen thank you.

passages.title: The Wardens
passages.text: Assist the Wardens by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Wardens
passages.text: The wardens thank you.

passages.title: Plight of the Blackfeather
passages.text:
<The ravenbear frantically gestures and points down the path. 

It seems he wants you to follow him.>

passages.title: Plight of the Blackfeather
passages.text:
Caw?

<The ravenbear chieftain seems preoccupied with the gathering of reagents for some sort of ritual. Perhaps you could help him?>

passages.title: Singed Feathers
passages.text:
Ca-caw! Caw caw!

<The chieftain flaps his wings and points outside where the storm dragons attack the ravenbears of his tribe. 

It's plain to see that he's seeking your help to save his flock.>

passages.title: Singed Feathers
passages.text:
The Blackfeather chieftain bows respectfully to you. 

You have helped ensure the survival of his tribe.

passages.title: Dances With Ravenbears
passages.text:
<The chieftain beckons for the ravenbears to gather the tribute and gestures toward the ritual circle outside.>

Caw! Caw ca-caw!

<It looks like he wants you to follow.>

passages.title: Dances With Ravenbears
passages.text:
It seems that Nithogg wasn't interested in the ravenbears' tribute.

It's probably a good idea to get out of here before he comes back...

passages.title: Unholy Destiny
passages.text:
The greatest heroes on Azeroth have gathered together to face the Burning Legion. But heroes alone cannot save this world.

The salvation of Azeroth will come at a price the living cannot pay. Only upon the shoulders of the dead and damned, will the world of the living be spared.

You shall be their pariah, <name>. Find the Grimoire of Damnation and do what must be done.

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text:
Deep beneath Suramar is a defunct set of tunnels known as the Arcway. They were abandoned when a disaster disrupted the mana collectors operating there. 

I know not what awaits you down there, but I do know one thing.

We are not the only ones interested in this place. Make enough noise and one of the advisors with whom I served under Elisande is sure to appear.

His name is Vandros. Slay him, if you can.

His death will be our victory, as we deprive Elisande of one more weapon in her arsenal.

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text: Thank you. It is one thing I no longer need to think about.

passages.title: PH: Withered Scenario
A Blaze of Starlight
passages.text: I will deliver the good news of my recently-rediscovered vitality to my brood. You, on the other hand, have a Tidestone to deliver.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Friend is getting stronger, and so is friend's weapon! Come back to Dreadscar. I have more to show you.

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text:
I received word that a coven of harpies and their rocs plan to attack in force.

They'll be coming from the mountains to the north.

Use one of the bolas launchers and I'll man the other.

Quick!

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text: Let's show those harpies why they shouldn't even think about attacking Thunder Totem!

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text: That was some nice work you did there, <name>. Thanks for the assist.

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text:
This crate is filled with relics from the nearby ruins. The pirates have discarded them, likely thinking they're of little value.

The Explorers' League would probably appreciate if you retrieved these relics for them to study.

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text:
Well that was most noble of you to save these ancient relics from a water-logged fate.

I will be sure that the Explorer's League puts these to good use!

passages.title: What the Bonespeakers Buried
passages.text:
Most Fascinating! It would appear that we're dealing with our very own vrykul vampyr!

All we have encountered have been of blood elven descent, but it has long been theorized that the vrykul have suffered the curse as well. It's too bad he's awake - I would dearly like a subject to study.

Oh well, guess there's nothing for it. Take this stake and put it through the old chap's heart. I'm pretty sure that should do the trick.

passages.title: What the Bonespeakers Buried
passages.text:
Oh, the stake didn't work you say?  My apologies, I must've had my immortal evil undead mixed up.

You're all in one piece though, and the evil has seen its end. Hopefully, at least.

Vampyr can die, can't they?

passages.title: Spilling Bad Blood
passages.text:
Ending the evil of the Blood Prince will be a boon to this land, but we can't just allow these crazed corsairs to run amok. I'm afraid there is no choice but to put them to the sword.

Carry out this noble deed, my good fellow, and we will celebrate with a nice warm lager.

passages.title: Spilling Bad Blood
passages.text:
Good riddance to bad rubbish, I say. 

Those louts were ne'er-do-wells before they went crazy. Just imagine what they would do if we let them run rampant!

Cheers to your bravery, sir.

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text:
Mrmlgr! Mrglr rlmgrg mlrgr! Mrlgmr...

<Phin shows you a flaw on the side of the pearl.>

Mmlrgmlr rlmgr grlmrmlg mglrmglr. Mlrgmrl rmglr? Mlgrmglr!

Gmmlrgmrl mlrgmlr lrglrmgrl lrlgllrlm mglrlr grlm-grlm.

<Phin makes a pinching motion with his hand.>

Mrlgmlgr mgrlmlgr? Mlrgmlr gmrlmglr Mrgrlilgrl.

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text: Mrglmrlg? Mrgmlr. Rmlgrmlrg!

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text: Mlrgmlr! Rgmrlmg, grmlmglr lmrglmrg mrlgmlglr! Mlrgmlrg grmlgrl.

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text:
Hi! <name>, right? The archmages in Dalaran said we might see you down here.

My brother and I are here on a reconnaissance mission. We're looking for our parents.

We've lived our entire lives thinking that our family was killed in Azsuna several thousand years ago, but look around! Most of the elves here are ghosts.

Olothil's been searching through books for clues as to why, but we could use some help.

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text: We've hit a dead end here. Any luck out there?

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text:
This Prince Farondis opposed Queen Azshara, so she got mad and blew everything up? That's awesome!

Hey Olothil, listen to this!

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text:
In order to find the spirits of our family, I will need materials to scry their location.

The naga carry magical trinkets imbued with ley energy that is better-attuned to this land than anything we have in Dalaran. If I had a few of those, I could do some real scrying.

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text: I would have brought my own spell foci if SOMEONE hadn't been rushing me...

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text: Perfect. Let's get this ritual started, shall we?

passages.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
passages.text:
Mrglm, rmgrlg mrlgmrl.

Grmrglmrl mlrmglrgr mlrmlgr! Rglrmgl rmglrgmlr mlmlglr mglgrgrlm - grlgmr, mlgr - lrgmlrgr rmgrmlg mlrg! Mlrgr?

Mrlgmrlgmrl rmglrmglr!

<Pearlhunter Phin makes a stabbing motion.>

passages.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
passages.text: Mrrgml... mlrgmlrg. Mlrmglrg gmrlr!

passages.title: Emerald Sisters
passages.text:
The owlbeasts here are disconnected from Elune.

A contingent of dryads went into their territory to find out what went wrong, but none of them have returned.

I fear the worst, and I believe they are in need of rescue.

While I try to learn if the owlkin can be saved, I would appreciate your help in freeing any Sisters you find in the grotto.

passages.title: Emerald Sisters
passages.text: The owlbeasts are... melting the dryads down and using their bones to create minions?! How... how could this even be?

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text:
I cannot hold on for much longer...

I brought a dreamcatcher with me. I was to use it to steal the magic from owlbeast totems.

It is the only way to break the barrier where they hold Keeper Remulos.

Please help where I have failed.

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text: Leirana? Oh no...

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text: I knew Leirana... she was one of Remulos' favored, and kindhearted soul. If he has been captured as she believes, we have no time to mourn her passing.

passages.title: Moon Reaver
passages.text:
We must not delay! If Keeper Remulos is in danger, he must be protected.

With the dreamcatcher, we should be able to enter the lair of the owlbeast Boneflux.

It must be defeated so Keeper Remulos can break free!

passages.title: Moon Reaver
passages.text:
My wounds are great, and my magic has been severely drained. I must recover from this enervation and return to the Dreamgrove.

The owlkin here are beyond saving by mortal hands, but perhaps Elune will one day shine her light upon them again.

Thank you, <name>. May your path be blessed.

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text:
Sharks. They be the biggest threat to us pirates. Well... after scurvy, ninjas, and the judicial system. Luckily, we only have to deal wit' sharks today.

Go pull some teeth out of their ugly faces 'n bring 'em back to me. I needs a new necklace!

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text: I require thirty-three Razor-Sharp Shark Teeth. Do not try to short me, lad.

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text: Blimey! This one still has blood on it! Looks like he got a good bite on ye good, lad!

passages.title: Grotesque Remains
passages.text:
These grotesque remains are an amalgamation of jelly-like ooze and what appear to be dryad bones.

Guviena Bladesong would be interested in seeing these.

passages.title: Grotesque Remains
passages.text: These remains... this is horrible! They are turning dryads into mindless piles of ooze!

passages.title: The Banner of the Ebon Blade
passages.text:
Although the Scarlet Crusade are murderous zealots, the monastery is still blessed by the Light. This places us at a disadvantage.

The battle for the Scarlet Cathedral will be hard fought, Deathlord.

With you fighting alongside our brothers and sisters of the Ebon Blade, they will surely be inspired to victory.

Take up the banner of our order and place it near our troops to empower them.

Not even the Light will stop us from our goal!

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text:
These fruit appear to be food to grell.

Old Grizzleback might appreciate it if they were removed from the village.

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text: You have found a fruit that might be of interest to me?

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text: Ah yes, this is the grell food supply. Perhaps I can use this to lure them away. Thank you.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text:
The ringleader of the grell must be sent to his final rest.

You will know him by the white of his skin and the bite of his tongue.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text: I miss the days when grell kept to themselves and played tricks on the night elves.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text: I don't know if grell have mothers, but I hope that one never kissed his mother with his mouth.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text:
The grell are in a frenzy, attacking my brethren and destroying our village!

Please, stranger, help us send these wicked miscreants to the soil.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text: The grell can sometimes be a terrible nuisance.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. You are welcome in our village anytime.

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text:
How did you end up out here? Ah well, that's neither here nor there at this point. What matters is that I need your help!

I see you have some experience fishing. Think you could put that skill to use for me?

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text: Any bites out there?

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text: That's it! This will do nicely. Please bring me as many of these as you can!

passages.title: Tracking Down Uthalesh
passages.text: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

passages.title: Tracking Down the Skull
passages.text: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text:
<name>,

My father lived by the sword, as you do. He taught me that if we truly want peace for our kingdom then we must be willing to fight to preserve it, as you have fought.

You have demonstrated valor of the highest order - bravery unsurpassed in the ranks of the Alliance. Valor that must be recognized.

Please join me in Stormwind Keep at once so that you can be properly rewarded for your service.

- King Anduin Wrynn

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text: It's an honor, <name>.

passages.title: Pure Water
passages.text:
I may have discovered the key to restoring the pillar's magical energy.

First, we will require a great deal of Pure Water. It is not easy to find, however I have heard that the naga in the Eye of Azshara are known to carry large quantities of this concentrated essence.

It will be not be easy, but if you can collect enough of the essence, we may be able to restore the pillar.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
It takes a true hero to put their life on the line day after day in defense of their home so that others do not have to.

You have dutifully safeguarded the people and interests of the Alliance, never faltering in your courage or devotion.

As a small token of our appreciation for your valiance, please turn to the gathered heroes before you, raise your weapon high, and be recognized.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Thank you for everything.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: Well-earned, <name>.

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text:
<name>,

Those who do not stand with the Horde stand against it. You, champion, have cut down such enemies in droves.

I admire your dedication. It is through you that we will rise up, more powerful than ever, and put the Alliance in their place once and for all.

Join me in the Undercity at once. Your victories must be met with due reward.

- Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text: The pleasure is mine, <name>.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
We will never be dominated so long as you stand at the front of our lines. Together we will slaughter anyone who stands in our way.

You have sacrificed as much as any in the name of the Horde. I will not let your dedication go unnoticed.

Face your fellow champions, <name>. Face them, and be recognized.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: You have pleased me this day.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
You have impressed me, <name>. No simple feat.

Be sure you continue to do so.

passages.title: Beware of the Crooked Tree
passages.text: <race>, you must be warned. There is great evil in Val'sharah. I've seen it, and I wish I hadn't. If you take my advice, you will stay far away from the crooked tree in Bradensbrook.

passages.title: Beware of the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
So you've come to the crooked tree,

To name a foe you ask of me,

But listen first to my tragic tale,

Then you will hear my sister's wail...

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
The bond between you and your weapon has grown stronger, Deathlord. The time has come for you to direct the flow of power within your artifact.

Return to Acherus and speak with me when you have made your choice.

passages.title: reuse me
passages.text: [PH]

passages.title: By Invitation Only
A Time to Reflect
passages.text: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: Let us speak, then, of events that have already come to pass.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: A moment to reminisce on how far we have come. A day to look to the future and where we might go. A year of reflection on what it means to grow and a lifetime of memories made by those brave enough to seize it.

passages.title: The Aegis of Aggramar
passages.text:
Now that it's out of the hands of the Legion, the Aegis should be brought back to Dalaran for safekeeping while the hunt continues for the rest of the Pillars of Creation.

It should be safe in the central portal chamber until the time comes when it is needed.

passages.title: The Aegis of Aggramar
passages.text:
The Aegis of Aggramar is secure within the well-defended city of Dalaran.

Your quest to drive back the Legion is one step closer to fruition.

passages.title: Pixie Dust
passages.text:
Friend, you have done so much for Brightwing, but there is still so much more to do.

I've been working so hard to restore the grove, but my magic is drained.

<Brightwing's stomach grumbles loudly.>

Without magic, my work cannot continue. The enchanters of your people use a magical dust that can revitalize me quickly.

If you bring me some, I can work much faster!

passages.title: A Gathering for the Grand Master
passages.text:
<name>, err... <class>t,

Your presence is requested for a matter of the greatest importance at the Temple of Five Dawns.

Master Ponshu and the rest of the Broken Temple are waiting for you!

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: Let us speak, then, of events that have already come to pass.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: A moment to reminisce on how far we have come. A day to look to the future and where we might go. A year of reflection on what it means to grow and a lifetime of memories made by those brave enough to seize it.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
Filmaff believes with a little assistance we can give you more.

There are a few tomes I could point out - not easy to get, mind you - that would... <Cough>... that would push forward our research a bit.

Here, I'll give you a list.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, each year I visit Stormwind to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, you're here. You must have received my letter.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, each year I visit Orgrimmar to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, you're here. You must have received my letter.

passages.title: Silver Hand Knights
passages.text:
Good news, Highlord! We have recruited a paladin trainer named Commander Born.

He is a hard teacher, but has trained some of the greatest paladin knights in recent times. We are lucky to have his services.

Go speak to him, and train a squad of Silver Hand Knights.

passages.title: Silver Hand Knights
passages.text: Wonderful! These knights will serve the order well.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, <name>. Do you have a moment?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Do you have a moment, Conjurer?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away deep within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text:
The Heart's magic is attuned to Azshara's elite through powerful warding spells. If we tried to tap into its power now we would be met only with our own demise.

However, there may be a way we can bypass the wards.

Prince Farondis and his court were once a part of Azshara's empire, and still hold on to keepsakes of their sordid past. Among these is sure to be a Vainglorious Draught, said to further bind the queen's followers to her will.

See if you can convince the court to part with a bottle.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text: It may take some effort to convince Farondis' people to part with the draught; some among them still cling desperately to their past lives.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text: Well done. We can use this to disable the magic protecting the Heart.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text:
I do not doubt Senegos' plan, but I do have some concerns about the Heart's volatility, especially when combined with nightmare energy.

Despite its name, Blood of Sargeras is often used as a tempering agent by master craftsmen. I believe it would work for our ritual as well.

You should keep an eye out for it during your travels - we'll need a substantial amount to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text: It can be difficult to extract properly, but I do not wish to leave anything to chance.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text: Fantastic! This will do quite nicely.

passages.title: Repaid Debt
passages.text:
The Moon Guard fought against the Legion many years ago, during the War of the Ancients. Their intimate knowledge of our enemies would be invaluable to our cause.

They have remained in Shal'Aran since you saved Thalrenus and his kin. Shall we pay them a visit and see what they can do?

passages.title: Repaid Debt
passages.text: Let us speak with Thalrenus and discuss our plan of action.

passages.title: Planning the Assault
passages.text:
Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion. The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.

We just need a way inside.

I am working fervently with the rest of the Council of Six to secure an entrance. Once we have, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills.

passages.title: Planning the Assault
passages.text:
We've found a back entrance into the Nighthold that should provide some relief from the armies at the main gate.

'Some' being key.

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text:
With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.

Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text: Yes, <race>?

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text: And so you return with the bindings in hand. The Firelord shall be very displeased to have lost these.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED]
passages.text: You bring the cursed bindings of Ragnaros to this place. Speak your intent, <race>.

passages.title: Audience with the Windlord
passages.text:
I have kept my promise. Thunderaan the Windlord awaits.

Know that if betrayal is in your heart, the Windlord will not be deceived. Be silent, and perhaps your audience shall be a fortunate one.

passages.title: Audience with the Windlord
passages.text:
The bindings now belong to me. When the time comes, the Firelord shall be imprisoned as I once was. But that time is not now.

Your reward is this, a small fragment of my power. Unleash it upon your blades, <race>, and you shall have what you seek.

passages.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
passages.text:
Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>

This place stinks! But you can help!

These feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

passages.title: The Wisdom of Patience
passages.text:
The horrors you braved in the thicket are only the beginning. Within the Emerald Nightmare you will face the very heart of the corruption that threatens the stability of all life on Azeroth.

But not just yet.

We have not yet managed to permeate the magic protecting Xavius' sinister realm. Once we have, however, you should return here; there is still much to be done.

passages.title: The Wisdom of Patience
passages.text:
Your next steps will be difficult, young one, and more dangerous than any threat you've faced, but they must be taken.

For the good of Azeroth.

passages.title: Shalassic Park
passages.text:
We have a Devilsaur.

I think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands.

She looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

passages.title: Shalassic Park
passages.text:
That was quite the spectacle, <name>.

Su'esh will be a valuable ally in the days to come. I will keep an eye on her for the time being.

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text:
<This feed appears to draw power from the leyline in order to become fully operational.

You should be able to imbue it with mana, but it will take a few minutes to draw enough leyline energy to accept the infusion.

Beware, for creatures may notice the surge of arcane energy...>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
<Sir/Mam>, my head would be in a book whether I was supported by the Tirisgarde or not... but my means are limited. Learning more about this weapon of yours is critical to the fight against the Legion, I know it.

If you want more researchers on the job to turn out results faster, we'll need to supply the resources to keep them going.

I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: There's such a wealth of knowledge in these books.  I wish there were more of me to pour through them all at once.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You are lovely. Just lovely. I'll get to work right away.

Keep us in mind with any resources the Tirisgarde can spare. If you can keep the researchers busy, we should unfold everything there is to know about your weapon in no time.

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
Any death knight worth their salt knows the weapon they wield as if they were born with it. But you now carry a weapon older than any in this hall.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
A demon hunter is nothing without blades with which to cut flesh. Yet those you wield are older than even you... and have power we don't understand yet.

If you truly want to unlock all of their potential, we need to learn more about them. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That's where I come in. It's my specialty.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I am quite good at such things.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a mighty weapon with a long history, one we barely understand. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can get workin' on that for ya.

Still, it'll take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can do this for you.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
Your weapons are undeniably powerful, but we know near nothing about'm.

If we want to unlock all of their potential, we need to dig up some dirt on how they work, what they've done... get to know them, ya know? That's where I come in. I dig up dirt all the time. I mean, not literally, but... you know what I mean.

It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: I like books.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: On it, boss. Will get back to you soon!

passages.title: Speaking to the Wind
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. We know stories of it, but little about its origins.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. The winds can help us with this, but we need to know what to ask.

It will take more shaman than just myself to learn everything there is to know about this artifact of yours. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Speaking to the Wind
passages.text: Thank you. I'll get back to you with what I've learned soon.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That is a thing that I can do for you.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Very good. I'll get back to you with the results soon.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Any resources that you can prioritize towards this research will be well worth it.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: I will have results for you soon.

passages.title: Preparing to Move
passages.text:
Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion.

The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.

Before we move on the hold, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills, and I would wager that they have unfinished business with their former brothers and sisters.

passages.title: Preparing to Move
passages.text:
We've found a back entrance into the Nighthold that should provide some relief from the armies at the main gate.

'Some' being key.

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
Warriors of da Horde! Break out ya axes and sharpen ya spears. Da Burning Legion has returned ta our world!

We be shipping outta Bladefist Bay right away. With da full fury of da Horde, we gonna smash der line so hard dat Sargeras is gonna feel it in da Nether!

Get to da ships. We got demons ta slay!

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
The ships are leaving from the dock in Bladefist Bay.

Before you leave, prepare yourself. I have the feeling that this fight won't be an easy one.

passages.title: Seeking Refuge
passages.text:
The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.

If you can convince the Nightfallen to aid us, they may be able to offer the Moon Guard and us both refuge right under the Legion's nose.

passages.title: Timeworn Artifact
passages.text:
<You've found a strange looking naga artifact on the fallen corpse.
You saw King Mrgl Mrgl as you were walking around Timeworn Strand. Maybe he knows what to do with it?>

passages.title: Timeworn Artifact
passages.text: Just what I've been looking for! <King Mrgl Mrgl studies the artifact> Ah! Yes. But there must be more of these Timeworn Artifacts still on the shore. Any more you can bring back would be greatly appreciated!

passages.title: Recruiting Shieldmaidens
passages.text:
The powerful val'kyr Savyn Valorborn has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She ushers some of the most valorous vrykul shieldmaidens into the Halls of Valor.

Speak to her and recruit powerful troops to add to our roster.

passages.title: Recruiting Shieldmaidens
passages.text: I will rally the worthy in Odyn's name.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text:
<class>t <name>, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.

The Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.

Will you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Show me what you've found.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Most curious indeed! This is no object of the Legion's making. Let me have a closer look.

passages.title: Wasted Potential
passages.text:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

passages.title: Wasted Potential
passages.text:
I heard rumors that you intend to leave the City... that there is another place for the Nightborne where we are not beholden to Elisande's insanity.

I wish to go with you.

I can offer my harp and my hands, as they are not wanted here.

Say the word and I will go with you through the teleporter and share my music with whomever awaits me on the other side.

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text:
The invitation appears to be for an exclusive fox hunt. They plan to hunt Volpin, a rare, elusive fox somewhere in the Broken Isles. Perhaps we can take advantage of this?

We need to gather more information about this hunt, but we should do so without alerting the Nightborne to your plans. Your champions can act in your stead and further investigate where the hunt will be.

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text: Have your champions discovered anything about the fox hunt?

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text:
Yes, its all here, the location of the hunt for Volpin. 

I'm sure there are better uses for a wonderful creature such as he than a pelt on some Noble's shoulders, don't you agree?

passages.title: Volpin the Elusive
passages.text:
According to the map, the fox hunt will start at the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in Suramar. If the Nightborne succeed, they will kill Volpin, a fox that is the last of his kind in the Broken Isles.

Travel to the Hunting Grounds, and interrupt the hunt.

passages.title: Ga'nar's Vengeance
passages.text:
My brother's head is as thick as his axe and he is as stubborn as a gronn.

When Ga'nar left he took with him some of the finest warriors in the clan and headed north to the Daggermaw Ravine. If they are still out there, you must find them. Ga'nar will not listen to me.

Help him see his vengeance through if you must but please bring him back to us.

passages.title: Ga'nar's Vengeance
passages.text: So my brother would not dare come himself?

passages.title: On the Trail of Blood
passages.text:
This orc appears to have made a last stand, dying while defending his fallen wolf. His clothes are that of the Frostwolf Clan.

From the tracks and other signs it would appear there were six other wolves during the battle that got away, one bleeding. A trail of fresh blood leads off into the desert northward.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin!
passages.text:
I have no time for my brother's whimpering. We hunt for vengeance or death.

The Thunderlord chieftain slew my father and left me for dead, so I shall take his three sons, the first of which is this runt in my hand.

This filth has revealed the number and positions of the Thunderlords in the ravine beyond.

Join us, if you dare, and you will witness how real warriors of the Frostwolf clan fight. Get in my way, and I will end you.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin!
passages.text:
The Thunderlord think their numbers will save them.

We will show them that their numbers count for nothing when hunted by a pack of Frostwolves.

passages.title: Wrath of Gronn
passages.text:
The Thunderlord are capturing gronn for the Iron Horde. Show these fools why gronn are NOT pets. 

Follow us into Grulloc's Grotto and sunder the chains of the captive gronn. Let the beasts seek to gain their own vengeance against the Thunderlord.

Meet us at Grulloc's Lair beneath the grotto when you are done.

passages.title: Wrath of Gronn
passages.text: For many years I hunted all sorts of prey alongside my father. This hunt shall honor his memory as well as avenge his death at the hands of these traitorous, honorless Thunderlords.

passages.title: The Eldest
passages.text:
There is Hatock, last and eldest son of the Iron Wolf. One of the greatest hunters the Thunderlord have ever fielded.

He was there when his father murdered my father and left me for dead.

When I am done with him he will regret not finishing the job.

passages.title: The Eldest
passages.text: Today is a good day.

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text:
Even when on a mission of vengeance we must remember to uphold the honor that is required of a member of the Frostwolves.

In the grotto below are the fallen corpses of many good Frostwolf orcs. They must be remembered.

While you carry out Ga'nar's task, look for articles of our fallen brethren. Bring these articles to me so that I might pass them to a shaman for final burial as is our tradition.

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text: Have you found the articles?

passages.title: Articles of the Fallen
passages.text: You have shown honor to our clan. This act shall be remembered.

passages.title: They Rely on Numbers
passages.text:
Thunderlord spend their days training to hunt as a team, but as individuals they are weak. Their only strength is in numbers.

So... to win, we must cull their numbers.

As we move up through the Daggermaw Ravine, slay any Thunderlord who stand in your way, and their clan will be made the weaker for it.

passages.title: They Rely on Numbers
passages.text: My axe bears the blood of a dozen Thunderlord. How many have you slain this day?

passages.title: They Rely on Numbers
passages.text: A fine headcount, commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
passages.text:
Draka and Drek'Thar are travelling to Farseer's Rock. It is a sacred place, not a safe one. But Draka insists that Drek'Thar must rebuild his connection to the elements.

I can feel the spirits of this land are becoming restless. Something is about to happen, and I suspect these two will need all the help they can get.

Please, adventurer, go to them and lend what aid you can. I care for these two a great deal.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Farseer's Rock
passages.text: You again? Not eaten by ogres or killed by Thunderlords yet? Ha!

passages.title: Eaters of the Elements
passages.text:
Drek'Thar has already begun his ritual, and it is powerful enough to draw the attention of the local goren. Those beasts are drawn to elemental magic like flies to a corpse.

I will have my hands full soon enough. Help us if you like but Drek'Thar must be allowed to finish his ritual.

passages.title: Eaters of the Elements
passages.text:
I came seeking aid from the elements. I see now that we are the ones who must aid them.

Come, <name>, witness what I have witnessed.

passages.title: Scavengers of Flame
passages.text:
I sense another child of the fury being consumed by the vile goren in a nearby nest.

Search the caves east of here for any signs of a goren nest. I suspect there will be quite alot of steam given the cold.

I will try to locate the next child of the fury in your absence.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text:
The goren and the magnaron are ravaging the element spirits and smelting their essence as one would smelt steel.

Commander, take my totem, travel east to Magnarok. Please, find them, and free them.

Draka and I will make our way to the Ascent of Frostfire. Meet us there if you are successful.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text: The ritual was more draining than I could have anticipated.

passages.title: In the Shadow of Giants
passages.text:
You have done well, <class>.

We will need the aid of these children when the time comes to rescue Exurotus.

passages.title: The Ascent
passages.text:
I can feel the voice of the Fury at the top of the ascent. Come, let us climb these stairs together.

Be on your guard. The goren of this area are likely to be drawn by the smell of a shaman.

If we get separated, fall back to the base of the stairs and regroup.

passages.title: The Ascent
passages.text: This is ancient magic, from a time before the orcs. It will not be easy to undo.

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text:
The moment I begin the ritual to free Exurotus you can expect Kron to be drawn to us. 

It would normally take an army of seasoned warriors to defeat a magnaron. We have only the three of us.

Look for my fire totem upon the battlefield. I will try to gain what boons I can from Exurotus. Step near the totems and become one with the Fury.

With these boons, slay Kron! Lok'tar ogar!

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text: The... Fury... is nearly free!

passages.title: Fury of Frostfire
passages.text:
With Kron defeated I can finish breaching the magic that holds Exurotus, but I may be too late. So much of the fury has already been expended and drained by the magnaron and goren.

I fear we may have only bought this spirit a peaceful death.

passages.title: Securing the South
passages.text:
We have an outpost to the southeast that was boxed in by Thunderlord forces as they marched through the canyons to Wor'gol.

I have sent reinforcements to secure the outpost and press east to Grom'gar. We will push the Thunderlords out of our lands completely, and pursue them all the way back to that reeking corpse they call home.

Draka's sister, Lokra, was among the orcs who volunteered to clean up Stonefang Outpost.

passages.title: Securing the South
passages.text: <name>! They told me you'd be heading this way. You are late to the party! We are just cleaning up now.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text:
The siege has been broken - they underestimated the resilience of Stonefang, and our reinforcement wave from Bladespire caught them completely off-guard.

Once we finish cleaning up here, we rally anyone who can still fight and prepare to march for Grom'gar.

The outpost captain, Karg Bloodfury, should have come out to meet us by now. Can you get him out here?

Tell him Lokra is waiting. He knows how much I hate to be kept waiting.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text: You go ahead - Asha and I will hold here for now.

passages.title: They Who Held Fast
passages.text: You're back! But where is Karg?

passages.title: Into the Boneslag
passages.text:
The Thunderlords took prisoners into the Boneslag?

Well what are we waiting for?! We have to go after them!

You look for the missing villagers - Asha and I will track Karg.

passages.title: Into the Boneslag
passages.text: Thank you for finding the others. Karg and his captor are one step ahead of us, but they're limping.

passages.title: Moving Target
passages.text:
Karg's captors are moving east - probably retreating to Grom'gar with their tails between their legs!

They think they outrun me, but Asha here is the fastest thing on four legs. We'll run them down in the Icewind Drifts.

passages.title: Moving Target
passages.text:
<Lokra's gaze remains fixed on her dying frost wolf.>

We had them... We had them, Asha. You were so fast. So beautiful.

I failed you, Asha. I am sorry.

passages.title: The Strength of Our Bonds
passages.text:
Asha has passed, but we share a bond that cannot be severed by death. Even now, her spirit urges me onward to Grom'gar.

The Iron Wolf claims our attachments make us weak... that love makes us vulnerable.

He is wrong.

Karg is my strength, and I his. I will free him from his chains, and together we will show the Thunderlord clan the strength of our bonds.

passages.title: The Strength of Our Bonds
passages.text: Help me out of these chains. We have work to do.

passages.title: To Karabor!
passages.text:
Draenor will not be a friendly place for someone like you. There are far too many orcs here, and I know your kind has a history with the orcs.

No, if you're looking for a friendly face here on Draenor, you'll need to find the draenei.

Hop on my back. I will take you to the draenei temple of Karabor.

passages.title: Collect Karabor Axes
passages.text:
Some of our bravest champions have fallen today.

To make matters worse the Iron Horde has started using our own weapons against us. 

The idea of my people being slain with the weapons forged by our ancestors makes me sick.

<name>, could you please retrieve these weapons and bring them back to me?

passages.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
passages.text:
Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.

He has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

passages.title: Catching His Eye
passages.text:
For what must be done, I need someone I can trust. You're one of those few.

The woods and the orc village, Gul'var, are protected from my scrying magic. We need to pierce that veil. I think I know a way.

There's a fel presence within the woods. A demonic watcher is there, hidden in a cave from which it casts its all-seeing gaze.

I would like for you and the warden to capture it.

passages.title: Catching His Eye
passages.text:
As soon as we have enough blessed water from the priestess's moonwell, we'll break the demon's will and use it as a proxy to see into Gul'var.

That way, they won't know it's us scrying upon them.

But first, we need to weaken their shrouding magic.

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text:
It's good to know what Teron'gor and Cho'gall are up to. It's more important that we stop Gul'dan.

Some of his disciples can summon minor demons. To do this, these lesser warlocks must use a soul shard. The foul crystal creates a connection to the Twisting Nether, pulling a demon through against its will.

Gul'dan's as much demon as he is orc. If we can gather some of the more potent shards, we can combine them into something that just might capture him.

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text: Do you have the shards, <name>?

passages.title: Soul Shards of Summoning
passages.text:
Now all that's left to do is to fashion them together into something strong enough to ensnare Gul'dan.

Luckily, we can do that right here.

passages.title: Task: Warsong Riot
passages.text: The Warsong Ragemongers are attacking the temple!

passages.title: Think of the Children!
passages.text:
When the Shadowmoon attacked Arbor Glen, everything was thrown into chaos.

Many of us escaped, but there are still three children missing.

I believe they are still back in the village.

Please save them!

passages.title: Think of the Children!
passages.text: I am glad to hear that the children are safe. They will remember your heroic deeds for their entire lives.

passages.title: Into Twilight
passages.text:
The safety of my people is of the utmost priority.

It is likely that Ner'zhul has taken the prisoners to Shaz'gul, his stronghold to the southwest.

I do not wish to use aggression against him, but he may force my hand.

Meet me at Twilight Glade, <name>. Then, we shall try our best to recover the prisoners.

passages.title: Into Twilight
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>. There is much to be done.

passages.title: The Memory of Fire
passages.text:
<The obsidian chip is hot to the touch, but strangely, can be held with no fear of being burned.>

On its surface is etched a picture - a rectangular stone with a hole cut through the middle, surrounded by a ring of flames.

There is just such a stone in the fields to the north.

passages.title: A Hero's Welcome
passages.text:
Prophet Velen has asked me to show you around Shadowmoon Valley.

We will go first to Embaari Village, where my sister Samaara is waiting for us. I have not seen her since the Iron Horde took me to Tanaan.

The village is just one of many trading villages between the Temple of Karabor and Shattrath.

Follow the road east and make your way to Embaari Village. I will accompany you, my friend.

passages.title: A Hero's Welcome
passages.text:
Thank you, stranger! The Prophet spoke of new allies arriving on our shores.

I hear it is thanks to you that my sister is safe.

I owe you a great debt, friend.

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text:
Oh my, such a vigorous young <lad/lass>! Such a spring in your step, and such a sparkle in your eye!

When you get to my age, it's all aches and pains.

Luckily, I have a recipe for an unguent that would soothe my joints. I just need the ooze from the skin of belly toads in the swamp.

Would you be a dear and help an old woman out?

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text: It's all downhill from here, dearie.

passages.title: A Grandmother's Remedy
passages.text:
Oh thank you child, thank you, thank you.

The nights in the swamp are cold. It means a lot to this old woman to have some comfort from her aching bones.

passages.title: Escape From Shaz'gul
passages.text:
I've failed, <name>...

My squadron was caught by a wandering patrol. We fought fiercely, but the alarm had been raised. The rangari forced me into hiding before surrendering themselves to the enemy.

They were under MY command, and they gave their lives... for what? I... I'm not sure what to do, <name>.

We need to get out of here, but how?

passages.title: Escape From Shaz'gul
passages.text:
I could never have done it without you, <name>. Your words unlocked something within me which I have not felt before.

Call it what you wish - resolve, conviction, faith. I will not soon forget this, <class>.

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text:
Ey commander, fancy runnin' inta ya out here!

Tha garrison's got plenty a hungry mouths ta feed, with more folks comin' by every day.

We're really gonna need a big haul o' meat ta keep everyone happy.

Wouldya care ta lend us a hand? It'll be faster work with an extra pair a hands.

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text: Have ya seen tha size a these beasts?

passages.title: The Big Haul
passages.text:
Brilliant, just brilliant! Ay've never seen such a haul in my entire life!

Get tha wagons ready. We're eatin' well tonight!

passages.title: Fallen From the Stars
passages.text:
The final ingredient is a rare flower that grows only in the heart of the Nightmarsh.

This flower feeds only on starlight, and dies when it falls under shadow.

If you can find such a flower, bring it to me. Only its essence will help me gain the clarity I need.

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text:
The ancients of the Cursed Woods have been corrupted by demonic magic. Since they need to be destroyed, we might as well make use of their resources. Waste not, want not.

Beware: these woodland behemoths are no easy targets. Gather trusted friends before you engage these twisted ancients.

-- Baros Alexston

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text: Have you read the bounty I posted concerning the twisted ancients in the Cursed Woods?

passages.title: Bounty: Twisted Ancient
passages.text:
Unfortunate that the ancient guardians of the woods fell to such corruption.

At least now, its long nightmare has ended. Not to mention its sacrifice is our gain.

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text:
The archmage has asked me to prepare this moonwell. Once it is completed, I'll be able to sanctify its water for use against the demon.

Only one thing remains.

A piece of one of Draenor's moons has fallen into a nearby pool on the far side of the woods. Such a thing is perfect for use in the dedication of the moonwell to Elune.

Will you bring it back for me, <name>?

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text: With that chunk of fallen rock, I'll be able to complete the dedication of the moonwell.

passages.title: Shadowmoonwell
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. The White Lady will be pleased.

Now, I shall go about the business of preparing the moonwell water for use in the archmage's plan.

But first, I wonder if you'd be willing to help me again. The warden brought back very disturbing stories about the creatures in the woods.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text:
The fiery heart of Krosnis is in the forge. We have the soul shards.

Now all that is left to do is to stoke the fires and combine all of these foul components into a trap for Gul'dan.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text: With the soul shards combined, we will trap Gul'dan and put an end to the Shadow Council on Draenor.

passages.title: Forging the Soul Trap
passages.text:
You've forged the soul trap. There's no time to waste, <name>.

We must capture Gul'dan.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text:
Long ago, the shaman of the Shadowmoon clan erected three stones in the woods. There, they performed their sacred rituals, blessing the beasts and the trees.

Now, someone has placed a fel magic upon those stones. This corruption is what shrouds the village of Gul'var.

Before we can use the captured demon to safely peer into the Shadow Council's village, we must bring down those stones.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text: Once the shrouding stones are destroyed, we'll turn our attention to breaking this demon's will.

passages.title: Shrouding Stones
passages.text:
Now that the veil has been lifted from the woods, we can make use of the demon.

We will convince it to turn its eye upon Gul'var and show us what the Shadow Council is planning.

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text:
We have their citadel, but they still have some of my people enslaved at the Sootstained Mines.

We have no one to spare, but you seem more than capable of handling a few ogres on your own.

I ask that you release any enslaved Frostwolves you find there, and keep an eye out for Mulverick.

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text: Free my people and then we can talk!

passages.title: Slavery and Strife
passages.text: Who are you, outsider? I saw you freeing some of my kin...

passages.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
passages.text:
Cordana tells me that the creatures of the woods are cursed by the same fel energies keeping Khadgar from scrying into the orc village.

This will not do.

If we were on Azeroth, I could find a cure in a reasonable timeframe. However, we are not, nor do we have the luxury of time.

Better to put a swift end to their suffering rather than allow these poor creatures to linger with demonic energy.

passages.title: A Curse Upon the Woods
passages.text:
Grim business. I wish that it could have gone differently.

Thank you for your dedication, <name>. Be comforted in the fact that Elune understands.

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text:
The ogres outnumbered us, *cough* but we made them pay for their deeds in blood.

Even so, I was forced to abandon my fallen brothers and sisters on the battlefield. They deserve better than to have their corpses despoiled by the ogre filth.

Here, take this torch *cough* and do what I could not: burn the corpses of my fallen brothers and sisters to the west.

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text: Did you give the others a proper burial?

passages.title: A Proper Parting
passages.text: You bring honor to the clan by giving my family a proper burial, <name>.

passages.title: Task: Clear Out Grimfrost Hill.
passages.text: Kill Grimfrost Ogres

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Task: Poisionous bunnies
passages.text:
A large number the bunnies in the area have been infected with a toxic poison.

It might seem cruel but burning the bodies of the bunnies is the only way to ensure the infection will not spread.

passages.title: Put down Poisonfiend.
passages.text:
Zugunk Poisonfiend is to blame for this madness.

He has contaminated this temple and it is time for his reign of terror to end.

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text:
Snowpaw was able to help me to here so that I might strike against their leader, Guttra, but I have lost too much blood. My time is near.

Do you have the strength to help me avenge my fallen brothers and sisters and kill Guttra Wolfchew?

The monster resides in the tallest tower of Grimfrost.

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text: Did you kill Guttra Wolfchew?

passages.title: Gut Guttra
passages.text: Wolfchew is defeated? *cough* Glorious.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
passages.text:
Just because we need to focus on Gul'dan doesn't mean we're not going to take down the Shadow Council in the process.

This village is filthy with Shadow Council villains. Let's do something about them.

passages.title: Cleaning Up Gul'var
