It's an SI:7 bounty for one Overlord Blackhammer, who just happens to operate out of this very facility. You help me take him out, I pay you. Then I take his head to the Alliance and collect on the bounty. Everyone wins!

Well, everyone except for Blackhammer.

passages.title: WANTED: Overlord Blackhammer
passages.text: You aren't getting cold feet on me now, are ya?

passages.title: WANTED: Overlord Blackhammer
passages.text:
<Gazlowe fishes around in his pouch before producing a single gold piece.>

Err... looks like I'm a little short. Personal bodyguard fees really add up!

I'll give you a proper cut when we get back to your garrison. Come on, you know I'm good for it!

passages.title: Maker's Mark
passages.text:
I don't get it - most of the Iron Horde junk is about as advanced as strapping cannons to a gronn. Even the drill itself is nothing special. But that induction system was a work of art...

This don't add up at all!

Despite my better judgment, I gotta find out who made this. I wanna look at more of what they got in the Iron Siegeworks, see if anything's been signed.

<Gazlowe pats the sack of coins on his belt.>

Whaddaya say? Wanna be my bodyguard?

passages.title: Maker's Mark
passages.text: You get paid when we get out of this place alive.

passages.title: Maker's Mark
passages.text:
That's Darkanvil's signature! I knew I'd seen that work somewhere before.

Thaelin Darkanvil is a Dark Iron dwarf who came to Draenor with the Alliance forces, and a damn brilliant engineer. We have what you might call a friendly rivalry.

But why's Thaelin making weapons for the Iron Horde?

passages.title: Four Finger Discount
passages.text:
I gotta admit, establishing a supply chain to a primal world on the wrong side of time is tough, even for me. Gotta make due with, uh... "locally sourced" goods.

Say what you want about the Iron Horde, but when it comes to raw materials, they got connections!

Keep an eye out for some of the more valuable goods in the Iron Siegeworks. I packed a few rocket chickens we can use to send the good stuff back to your garrison.

passages.title: Four Finger Discount
passages.text: Not a bad haul. Here's yer cut!

passages.title: A Fellow Gearhead
passages.text:
There's no way Thaelin sold out. NO way! They gotta be holdin' him here somewhere.

Come on, adventurer. I know he's with the Alliance, and I know they aren't your favorite people, but we do NOT want the Iron Horde having access to his work - trust me!

passages.title: A Fellow Gearhead
passages.text:
You gotta respect your fellow gearheads!

Plus, I made a TON of money copying those walking bombs he designed.

Er... you didn't hear that last part.

passages.title: A Fellow Gearhead
passages.text:
Don't worry, Thaelin can handle himself. That was my good deed for the year - don't tell nobody!

Hey... you think I can write off that fuel as a business expense?

passages.title: Darkest Night
passages.text:
This keystone will grant its bearer entry into Anguish Fortress.

Take it and meet Prophet Velen outside the Shadowmoon fortress.

He intends to face Ner'zhul head-on.

passages.title: Darkest Night
passages.text: Good, you've arrived. Rulkan's message said that you would not be long.

passages.title: "Mole Machine, Go Home"
passages.text:
My patented "Come to Papa" voice command was only the first step.

I also programmed all of my mole machines with a "Go Home" command that'll send 'em auto-diggin' to a pre-determined location - my workshop in Gorgrond!

Let's send the mole machines home before the orcs stink 'em all up with their stupid breath and their sweaty... leather... thongs.

<You hear Thaelin gagging a little from inside The Suit.>

Blech!

passages.title: "Mole Machine, Go Home"
passages.text:
If the voice command fails, you can always try the manual override.

Ye simply hold down the control pedal, shift into reverse, and pull the escape lever at the same time.

passages.title: "Mole Machine, Go Home"
passages.text:
There, my beauties are safely out of the hands of the Iron Horde. No more orcs poppin' out of the ground!

There's just one more thing I need to do before I can leave with a clear conscience.

passages.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
<Prophet Velen's voice continues.>

Yrel and I have located Warlord Ner'zhul. He is meeting with Grommash Hellscream atop the highest altar overlooking Anguish Fortress.

Meet us there. We must stop him.

passages.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text: Ner'zhul will pay for what he has done.

passages.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
We saved everyone we could, <name>. We were too late for the others... including my sister.

Prophet Velen is right. When it is asked of us, we ALL must fight. I promise this: I will never again let my loved ones suffer.

Ner'zhul is close to calling down the Dark Star. We are the only ones who can stop him.

passages.title: Enemies Above
passages.text:
We have dealt a crushing blow to the Thunderlords with the death of the Iron Wolf <name>, but we can not rest yet.

The Thunderlord generals will be fighting like caged wolves to maintain their place in the Iron Horde and that means bad news for us.

I sent Scout Ruk'gan to keep an eye on their movements but he hasn't reported back for some time now. If you would help us then seek out Ruk'gan. 

 Lok'tar <name>!

passages.title: The Search For Drogguk
passages.text:
Drogguk has taken it upon himself to watch the Iron Horde's movement to ensure they do not find our village.

It has been two days and he has not yet returned. If you are willing, I would ask that you seek him out and bring him home. His family worries.

He tends to make his post roughly southeast of here.

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text:
This coil of rope has been woven thick, the better for the Thunderlord Wranglers to handle the dangerous beasts they tame.

Scout Ruk'gan might have a use for this and a few more like it.

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text:
Rope? Do you expect me to tie a noose and ask the Thunderlords to go hang themselves?

Wait... that gives me an idea. Yea, I think I can make this work with the right materials.

Good Job.

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text:
The Thunderlord Spear is extremely light and strong.

Scout Ruk'gan might be able to use this and a few more like it.

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text: What is it <class>? Have you got something for me?

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text:
Hrm, yes these spears look pretty good.

Not bad! I know just what to use these for!

passages.title: At the End of Your Rope
passages.text:
With the spears and rope you gathered the Thunderlord Sky Riders will no longer be out of our reach. Even they will feel our wrath!

I've tied the rope to the spears you brought me to fashion a harpoon. Hunt the Sky Riders that are flying all over the valley. Take the Harpoon and throw it at them as they circle by. If your aim is true the barbs should allow the spear a firm hold allowing you to yank the rider right towards you!

If your aim is bad... well... try not to miss.

passages.title: At the End of Your Rope
passages.text: Well done <name>! The removal of the Sky Riders takes the heat off us for a bit. Keep your weapon in hand though, we're not done with them yet.

passages.title: Tar Get of Opportunity
passages.text:
General Vul'gath leads this band of Thunderlord. He is a coward and hides in his hut, yelling orders at his warriors through the walls.

We will need to show him that his flimsy defenses can not stand against the Frostwolves!

I'll need some tar to carry this out. There are a couple of tar pits to the south, go gather a few globs from the oozes that reside there and bring them to me.

passages.title: Tar Get of Opportunity
passages.text: We need that tar soon <name>! Get to it!

passages.title: Tar Get of Opportunity
passages.text:
Ugh, those smell awful! No, I don't need to see them. I'll take you at your word that you have them all.

Let's get a move on before another Thunderlord patrol stumbles upon me.

passages.title: Burn Them Down
passages.text:
Now, we begin our assault, <name>!

Get down to Agurak's Fall and use these tarbombs to destroy their rylak egg incubators.

While you are busy I will sneak down into their camp and prepare for the next phase of our attack. Meet me there once you have burned everything.

passages.title: Burn Them Down
passages.text:
Good job <name>, I was able to use the commotion from your work to sneak into the camp.

Now we have only one thing left to do.

passages.title: Trouble to the South
passages.text:
A group of Alliance soldiers headed south from here not long ago. They said they were searching for some sort of special flower.

To be frank, I'm concerned for their safety. This area is still crawling with Iron Horde.

They could surely use your help if you're able. Follow the road south and you should find their position.

passages.title: Payment Due for Services Rendered
passages.text:
I'm ready to get outta here, and I ain't hoofin' it back through all those orcs.

Fortunately, I kept a few extra rocket chickens to get us back to your garrison in style! Let's get up to the roof and find a decent place to take off.

passages.title: Payment Due for Services Rendered
passages.text: Told you I was good for it!

passages.title: Mission Successful
passages.text:
The Thunderlords are finished <name> and our job is complete. I'll stay here and watch over the area.

You should head back to Sergeant Gil'nath. I'm certain he will have another task for you.

passages.title: Return To Sender
passages.text:
This tiny tracking device is used to collect biological data. It appears to have been fastened to a dart and fired from long range.

After closely examining the device, you are able to trace the signal to a receiver nearby. The information contained within could be important; it's probably a good idea to find the owner and return it.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Keeping Calm
passages.text:
<These beads must belong to Kaduz, the shaman you rescued. They are engraved with the name "Dulga".>

<He said to meet him in nearby Palemoon Village. You will surely find both Kaduz and Dulga there.>

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text:
An ally of yours, Thaelin, is helping us counter the Iron Horde.

He claims this device can be used to spy on the enemy, even so far as hearing what they are saying at great distance.

I do not trust such devices. Use it and let me know what you see.

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text: Take a look through Thaelin's Observicopter. I don't trust that machine.

passages.title: Through the Looking Glass
passages.text: Orgrim leads the Iron Horde in Talador... Now we know the face of our enemy.

passages.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
passages.text:
We must slay the Iron Horde troops who infest our lands.

Find those who would sully our great forest and show them the hand of justice.

passages.title: Too Many Irons in the Fire
passages.text: The Iron Horde has no consideration for the wonders of the forest. In death, they will know respect.

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text:
The Iron Horde has explosive devices stored throughout the heart of their logging camp.

We must recover them so they are not used against us.

I will keep an eye on Maraad... I worry for him in his anger.

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text: Have you found the Iron Horde Explosives yet?

passages.title: In Short Supply
passages.text: I believe we can use these explosives against the Iron Horde.

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text:
Those Thunderlords circling above us are a problem <name>.

They fly their pathetic Rylaks leisurely across the valley, thinking they are safe to rain spears down on our heads. We need to show them they are not safe from Frostwolf Vengeance!

I have a plan but we will need to gather some material. Go hunt across the valley for any of their spears that survived intact. I think five should be enough.

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text: What is it <name>? Have you got something for me?

passages.title: Getting the Points
passages.text: Hrm, yes these spears look pretty good. Outstanding <name>! I know just what to use these for!

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text:
That shredder had a manual jammed in the cockpit, but it's missing a lot o' pages. If we can find those manual pages, I'd bet my third toe I can get the prototype shredder working again.

I coulda swore I saw a few of those pages floatin' about in Archenon Siegeyard. Maybe the orcs there carry them.

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text: Have you found those pages? These manuals are ridiculous.

passages.title: Vol. X Pages ?
passages.text: I wondered why the manual was so big... they write with really big letters!

passages.title: Iron Them Out
passages.text:
The orcs themselves are not the only threat. They still have siege weapons of significant power.

They've already been used against Tuurem, and we must not allow for their continued operation.

Sabotage siege weapons using the explosives you collected from the logging camp.

passages.title: Iron Them Out
passages.text: They will be unable to use those weapons against us when we attack Tuurem.

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text:
I'll get the prototype shredder working right now!

Take a look through my Observicopter. You'll see what you're about to head into...

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text: Take a look!

passages.title: An Eye for a Spy
passages.text: That's a lot of orcs, eh? Glad I'm here tinkerin' away instead of in the thick of it.

passages.title: Born to Shred
passages.text:
I've got this prototype shredder operating on most cylinders.

Boy, will they be surprised when you stomp them with their own machine!

Can't wait to watch you from the safety of the Observicopter.

passages.title: Born to Shred
passages.text: -- ENEMIES ELIMINATED --

passages.title: Engineering Her Demise
passages.text: -- THE MOTHER HAS BEEN DETECTED. WARNING! WARNING! --

passages.title: Engineering Her Demise
passages.text: The screams of our enemies washed over me. The people of Tuurem are avenged.

passages.title: The Battle for Shattrath
passages.text:
To stop the Iron Horde, we must overcome prejudice and work together, if only for this purpose.

Horde, Alliance, past, present... all meaningless in the face of this enemy.

We will retake Shattrath together... or die trying.

passages.title: The Battle for Shattrath
passages.text: Maraad is dead... but we must carry on. I will not let his sacrifice be for nothing.

passages.title: Ogre Diplomacy
passages.text:
They may be spirits, but the Ango'rosh are still ogres. Even with their books in hand, they won't respect you until you prove yourself, and there's only one way to earn that.

By killing them.

You should take out as many of the Ango'rosh spirits and their pets as you can while in the ruins.

passages.title: Ogre Diplomacy
passages.text: How goes your diplomatic mission?

passages.title: Ogre Diplomacy
passages.text:
<Liadrin smiles.>

I knew they'd see it our way.

passages.title: To Thunder Pass
passages.text:
There is no time to mourn our fallen or lick our wounds. Your scouts have already reported sighting a massive Iron Horde army making its way through Thunder Pass.

I advise you let your garrison forces secure this area while you and I make for the pass east of here with the rest of the Frostwolves.

It is time to show this Iron Horde what a united Frostwolf clan can do.

passages.title: To Thunder Pass
passages.text:
I am glad to see you. Our clan has faced many challenges, but the sheer size of the army coming toward us is beyond anything we have attempted to face.

We need your experience.

passages.title: The Battle of Thunder Pass
passages.text:
The Iron Horde has an army tenfold our number marching down the Thunder Pass as we speak.

Durotan is amassing our forces at the mouth of the pass. He is doing what he can to mount a defense but war on this scale is not what we Frostwolves are masters of.

He will need your expertise.

Please, go to him.

passages.title: The Battle of Thunder Pass
passages.text:
This was a costly victory, and a very painful lesson. We chose to refuse the Iron Horde and live as we always have, but I see now they will never respect such neutrality.

I am not about to wait for the Iron Horde to marshal their forces. We will fight with you, and bring the Iron Horde to its knees.

Commander, the Frostwolves stand ready!

passages.title: Retribution for the Light
passages.text:
There are agents of darkness everywhere, fighting tooth and nail to envelop the world. The Light relies on us to balance the scale.

You have the power needed to destroy Teron'gor's demonic minions once and for all. Send them to the Twisting Nether in pieces!

passages.title: Retribution for the Light
passages.text: Already I can feel the Light triumphing over darkness. We've done it!

passages.title: Destination: Unknown
passages.text:
Teron'gor and Gul'dan were just leaving through the portal as I arrived... and I... I know I won't be able to defeat them.

I'll hold open the portal as long as I can. It will be up to you to strike the killing blow.

Our fate is in your hands, <name>.

passages.title: Destination: Unknown
passages.text:
Teron'gor and Gul'dan... they slaughtered everyone...

...and then they just... disappeared... into the shadows...

How did they know where to go?

passages.title: Into the Heart of Madness
passages.text:
<name>, Nyami ran off to 'take down Teron'gor herself.'

You need to find her. She has no chance against him on her own.

I must remain here and organize our ranks should another attack fall upon us. I'm counting on you.

passages.title: Into the Heart of Madness
passages.text: You have to hurry... Teron'gor just left!

passages.title: Hiding in the Shadows
passages.text:
<The voice of Teron'gor enters your mind.>

Our final move must remain concealed from the Auchenai, my minions. Use the shadow orbs Gul'dan provided for us to veil Gul'rok in darkness.

Prepare our forces, we march on Auchindoun on my order. We will feast on the souls of the draenei and usher our demonic allies into this world!

<Destroying these shadow orbs would help the defenders at Auchindoun greatly.>

passages.title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
passages.text:
The abandoned mine shaft has been overrun with goren! They seem to be responding to commands from a big one farther down in the mine. If you can take him out, the rest will probably retreat.

Once you have those goren cleared out, we can get that mine up and working!

passages.title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
passages.text: Were you able to take out the leader?

passages.title: Things Are Not Goren Our Way
passages.text: Nice job, <name>! Let's get this mining operation started!

passages.title: Clearing the Garden
passages.text:
This cave is the perfect climate to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem. All these damn nibblers!

I need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.

passages.title: Clearing the Garden
passages.text: Did you get em?

passages.title: Clearing the Garden
passages.text: Great work, <name>! We will get started planting the garden right away.

passages.title: Looking For Help
passages.text: We have an accessible fishing spot here, but no bait seems to work! We need to find a local fisherman with some knowledge of the area to help us out. Head northwest and see if you can find anyone on the shoreline.

passages.title: Looking For Help
passages.text: Find anyone?

passages.title: Looking For Help
passages.text: Time to see what you can do.

passages.title: Vouchsafe Our Arrival
passages.text:
A matter of great importance has arisen. While you were away, Archmage Khadgar contacted me.

He is investigating demonic influences to the north.

Being a human, the Frostwolves will not accept Khadgar without you there to vouch for him, nor will they accept a night elf such as myself.

I will wait for you outside Throm'var in the Frostwind Crag.

passages.title: Vouchsafe Our Arrival
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>. The archmage and I are in need of your assistance.

passages.title: They Have My Son
passages.text:
Please, adventurer! Can you help me. I received a ransom note from a very corrupt and uncouth orc within the ranks of the Iron Horde.

He has my son!

He made sure to include a number of graphic words to describe what would happen if the ransom is not paid. Clearly he thinks my people conjure gold from the nether. And if I try to rescue him myself, both of us will be killed in the process.

Can you go to Gron'mar for me and rescue my son?

His name is Corki.

passages.title: Safe Passage
passages.text:
Being a human and a night elf, the archmage and I aren't likely to be well-received by the orcs of the Frostwolf clan.

We need you to make an introduction for us with the Throm'var farseer.

There is much to discuss. Shall I bring you up to speed on the way to the village?

passages.title: Safe Passage
passages.text: You honor us with your presence.

passages.title: Safe Passage
passages.text:
Wolf-brother, already word has traveled to us of your actions at Wor'gol. You have the eternal respect of the Frostwolf.

Now, who are these strangers that you have brought to us and what is this urgent matter?

passages.title: Smash Blon'sky!
passages.text:
Grulk not choose to be mutated. Grulk not monster like Blon'sky! Blon'sky evil... chose mutation for power!

You go to Grommar? Smash Blon'sky before he hurt innocents, make Grulk happy!

passages.title: A Clew of Worms
passages.text:
While I was scouting, I noticed that most of Frostwind Crag is crawling with an odd species of worm.

The worst thing about them is that these things burrow under the ground and then spring on you from out of nowhere.

I saw the worms attacking the frost wolves and other wildlife in the wastes. I'm certain the orcs would appreciate you helping out.

passages.title: A Clew of Worms
passages.text: Watch your back out there. Those worms will attack when you're not looking.

passages.title: A Clew of Worms
passages.text:
We haven't seen these creatures here in a generation.

Their sudden appearance and the shaking of the ground are most definitely connected.

passages.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
passages.text:
Something has awakened the great Shui Halad. She is causing the ground to quake.

<The farseer makes a sign of warding in the air, and then continues.>

Perhaps those who have disturbed the great worm are the same ones your friends are tracking down?

Either way, Shui Halad must be put to eternal rest before her thrashing collapses all of the north into the ocean.

passages.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
passages.text: The ground yet rumbles, my friend. Do you need aid?

passages.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened
passages.text:
I've heard of these strange Pale orcs you saw. They sound like the Warsingers of Nagrand. But no, that cannot be....

As for the ogre, his name is Cho'gall. You should kill him if you get the chance. He brings nothing but destruction in his wake.

passages.title: Eye Need That
passages.text:
The Mother of Wolves was infected with demon magic. The Shadow Council must have hoped to spread the corruption to the other frost wolves and then to Throm'var.

The hunters are reporting they've seen glowing green eyes down in the Icescar Boneyard to the west. We both know what that means.

I have an idea... we're going to use the Shadow Council's "eyes" against them to reveal their base. All we need is the lead warlock's All-Seeing Ring.

passages.title: Eye Need That
passages.text: The All-Seeing Ring. Do you have it?

passages.title: Eye Need That
passages.text: Yes, this will do nicely. Let's use the Shadow Council's magic against them.

passages.title: Payback
passages.text:
We thought we were safe behind Leafshadow's cloaking veil.

<Vindicator Kaluud wipes the blood from his face.>

Someone told the Shadow Council's forces how to disable it. We were able to hold them off at first...

Most of the town was slaughtered in the attack. Please, you must avenge our fallen. Rout these invaders out from Telmor forever!

passages.title: Payback
passages.text: Excellent. The shards are at last together!

passages.title: Scheduled Pickup
passages.text:
You've proven yourself more than capable in battle, <name>. As you know, there may be Shadow Council forces anywhere around Auchindoun, including near Telmor.

Tuulani's powers as a soulpriest have not yet fully manifested; she isn't capable of protecting the shard alone. I need you to join her at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it to Auchindoun safely.

passages.title: Scheduled Pickup
passages.text: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!

passages.title: Scheduled Pickup
passages.text:
You've proven yourself more than capable in battle, <name>. There may be Shadow Council forces all around Auchindoun, including near Telmor.

I want you to join Soulbinder Tuulani at Telmor to make sure the crystal makes it safely to Auchindoun. I know I can trust you to get it done.

passages.title: Scheduled Pickup
passages.text: It's not safe here. The Shadow Council has already taken the city!

passages.title: They Took My Father
passages.text:
adventurer! I have a lead on what happened to my father. There have been reports that he was seen in the presence of Shadow Council orcs in ____.

My father was a powerful Anchorite with a vast amount of ancient knowledge. I dread to think what those within the Shadow Council would do to him to get that knowledge. 

Can you go to ___? Hunt down their officers and see what they know?

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text:
None of the Thunderlord can escape my wrath! We need something to pull them out of the skies so that they can greet our blades.

Their wranglers should carry rope with them for handling their beasts. Slay them, if they have any coils in good condition bring them to me.

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text: I'm growing tired of waiting, do you have anything to help our assault or not?

passages.title: A Collection of Coils
passages.text:
Rope? Do you expect me to tie a noose and ask the Thunderlords to go hang themselves?

Wait... that gives me an idea. Yea, I think I can make this work with the right materials.

Good Job.

passages.title: The Fate of Gordawg
passages.text:
Looming monstrously between us and the inner chamber is the great fury we have sought to return to the Throne of Elements.

Gordawg stands before us enthralled; a slave to the pale and their mysterious master. My heart is heavy with grief to see such a great creature mindless and enslaved by evil.

There is no going back, in order to push forward you must go through Gordawg.

It pains me, but Gordawg must be slain.

When the deed is done, we will return the fury's heart to the Throne of Elements.

passages.title: The Fate of Gordawg
passages.text: What of Gordawg? Has the great fury been brought to rest?

passages.title: The Fate of Gordawg
passages.text:
Gordawg was a mighty ally. The elements will mourn the loss of the fury, but death was the only answer. Gordawg would not have wished to stay a slave to evil.

Though Gordawg is no more, the heart of a fury is eternal and unbreakable. In time, this brightly glowing heart will take shape into a new earthen fury.

Such is the cycle of life upon the Elemental Plateau.

passages.title: Stop the Flow
passages.text:
The Shadow Council down in the boneyard are going to have magic circles. It's not enough to simply kill them; we also have to eliminate their infernal devices.

If you destroy the circles, you'll stop the flow of demons they're summoning to inhabit the bones of the dead.

passages.title: Stop the Flow
passages.text: Were you able to destroy the Shadow Council's summoning circles?

passages.title: Stop the Flow
passages.text: We should have killed them all at the Dark Portal in the beginning and damn the consequences.

passages.title: All is Revealed
passages.text:
Tell me when you're ready.

We'll invoke the power of the ring to summon one of their 'eyes.' Through it, we'll discover where the Shadow Council is located and what they're really up to.

passages.title: All is Revealed
passages.text: Gul'dan is there! We must move quickly to capture him.

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text:
They roughed me up real good an' I have a splitting headache but I'll survive. I need to get out of this bit o' chain here though.

Could ye get the key to it for me? A big ogre called Nub has it, he's over on the far side of the terrace.

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text: Dun ye worry about me. I'll sit here an' nurse me wounds.

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text: With that ball o' stone gone I be feelin' better already!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Owynn Graddock
passages.text:
Commander, I have bad news to report.

Agent Graddock was out on assignment to keep an eye on the Bloodmaul and he missed his deadline to check back in.

Something's not right, <name>.

If Owynn was captured they may have locked him away with their slaves.

Head over to Stonefury Cliffs and see if you can locate him.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Owynn Graddock
passages.text: Well I be a son of a gnome! Am I glad to see you! I was hoping fer a rescue but didn't expect da boss tae be here himself!

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text:
When I was captured they took my gear and left me in rags. My mace is being used to crack stones and they're even using me best dagger as a dinner fork! I'd hate to know what happened to me armor but I hope its still usable.

I'll need a wee bit to recover from me wounds and without my stuff I'm no help in a fight. Could ye go find my gear for me?

Last I saw my armors in a chest next to that big tower south of here, my dagger was to the south west, and my mace over near that lava field to the west.

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text: Just need a bit of a refresher, being beat up by ogres makes ye a little sore. Who knew?

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text: Thank ye, looks like everything's still in good shape. Just give me a moment to put this on.

passages.title: Seeking the Truth
passages.text:
Okay, now down to business.

The Bloodmaul have unearthed some monstrous artifact I've heard them call the Soulgrinder. It's a nasty bit o' sorcery that their chief uses to give himself incredible magical power, but it comes at the cost of needing to feed upon souls to maintain it. Every day, more and more corpses pile up from the slaves killed to maintain it.

We need to go find Borgal and get rid of this Soulgrinder!

passages.title: Seeking the Truth
passages.text:
Secluded cave across the lava, check.

Creepy piles o' bones, check.

Okay, this looks like the place. We're gonna have to watch ourselves, I'll bet Borgal isn't here alone.

passages.title: Cleansing the Souls
passages.text:
Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.

End their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

passages.title: Cleansing the Souls
passages.text: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text:
Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.

If we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!

Go find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.

passages.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
passages.text:
It is time for Borgal to die.

We must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.

Your job will be the difficult one, kill him!

passages.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
passages.text:
That was one hell of a battle! Bloody fine job there la... um commander. 

Orlana really helped us out there. I'll ask around, maybe a priest can think of something we can do for her. 

At any rate, we still have this artifact to deal with. I think you better hold onto it for safe keeping before any power crazed lunatics comes looking for it.

passages.title: Have a Heart
passages.text:
Did you notice the magical barrier protecting the cave's entrance? It's being powered by demon crystals.

The Burning Legion has a habit of making demon parts serve as the keys to such devices.

Travel west to the Ruins of Ata'gar. Look for a powerful demon therein and bring me its heart.

I'll project an image of myself into the ruins. You won't have to come back here until we're done.

passages.title: Have a Heart
passages.text: Do you have the demon key?

passages.title: Have a Heart
passages.text:
A heart? How touching.

Quickly. We must use it to destroy the fel crystals and get to Gul'dan.

passages.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
passages.text:
Those ruins are going to be full of Shadow Council flunkies. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once you've dealt with Gul'dan.

No, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

passages.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
passages.text: Necessary business. We don't dare risk letting them grow more powerful.

passages.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
passages.text:
These ruins are full of Shadow Council adherents. We can't afford to let them scatter all over Draenor once Gul'dan has been dealt with.

No, we need to eliminate every one of them down to the last orc.

passages.title: Eliminate the Shadow Council
passages.text: Necessary business. We don't dare risk letting them grow more powerful.

passages.title: The Fel Crystals
passages.text:
You have the key. Now use it to destroy the fel crystals.

Once they are eliminated, the magical barrier blocking the entrance to the Gloomspire will come down.

And once the barrier is down, you'll go inside to confront Gul'dan.

passages.title: The Fel Crystals
passages.text: Is there a problem?

passages.title: The Fel Crystals
passages.text: The barrier is down. Now it's time to capture Gul'dan.

passages.title: To Capture Gul'dan
passages.text:
Gul'dan is in the cave further into the Gloomspire.

We know that he's about to leave for Talador and Shadowmoon Valley. You must capture him by any means necessary, <name>.

I'll see you back at Throm'var. Good luck.

passages.title: To Capture Gul'dan
passages.text:
Unfortunate, but not surprising. At least we were able to defeat one of the inner council members.

All is not lost, <name>. We know what the Shadow Council is up to and where they're heading.

We'll regroup in Talador. Together, we'll put an end to Teron'gor and his plans for Auchindoun.

Did you hear that?...

passages.title: A Threat We Can't Ignore
passages.text:
Ishnu-alah, <name>. I trust that Khadgar and Mathias have adequately briefed you on this situation here in Grommar. Time is of the essence, so I will be brief.

The Iron Horde presence here represents an immediate threat to the safety of Shadowmoon Valley. Grommar has been receiving supplies and reinforcements via the harbor for some time now.

The most concerning of these reinforcements are the battleships docked in the harbor. Place these explosives on the nearest battleship undetected and report back.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja
passages.text:
It be a long time since we hear from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja, commander. 

Last we know she be on assignment keeping an eye on dem Bloodmaul ogres up in Frostfire.

Dem ogres just be a bunch a slavers so something really big must be happening ta keep her from reporting in.

Go over ta de Stonefury Cliffs an' find her.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Search for Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja
passages.text: Oi dere mon! Glad to see a friendly face but I not expect da commander ta come out here for me himself!

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text:
Lissen mon, dem ogres, got da jump on me wid an artifact wid powerful mojo. Next t'ing I know I wake here wid broken bones an' dis chain on me leg. I called to da spirits ta break it, but da spirits here no answer.

Gotta go wid da old methods ta get out. Dere be a big ogre in da cave here called Rugrum who has da key to me shackle. Could ye go put a blade in his belly and get me dat key?

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text: You no worry about me, mon. I be going nowhere.

passages.title: Out of the Chains
passages.text: Ah now, dat be feeling much better!

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text:
Dem ogres whipped me real good. My arm be broke, a few ribs snapped, t'ink even me spleen be hurtin' from dat beatin'. Nothin' a troll can't handle though but I be needin' a moment ta recover.

What I really be needin' is me gear dem ogres took from me. Dey got me garb in a chest near a hut to da south, me glave in a chest next to da tower wid da Bonecrushers, dey even got me mask, it over near da lava! Could ye go find dem while I take a breather?

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text: Ah, hear dat? T'ink anudda rib just popped back inta place.

passages.title: Gearing Up
passages.text: Ah dat be me stuff! Give me a moment ta put me stuff on mon. Then, I gonna take me an ogre ear for every bone I had ta pop back in place.

passages.title: Seeking the Truth
passages.text:
Lissen mon, a few nights ago dem ogres found a bit o' old and powerful mojo.

I was snooping around da cave across de lava flows when dere was a huge scream from da spirit world. I went in and saw Borgal, de ogre chief, he be draining da spirits from de slaves wid some big stone wheel dat I heard dem call de Soulgrinder. I tried ta take 'em out but a single shot from dat thing took all de strength from me.

Dat mojo too much of a threat in de hands of dem ogres.

passages.title: Seeking the Truth
passages.text: This be da place. We gonna need ta be careful, Borgal an' da artifact be in there.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text:
Before Borgal began to use the Soulgrinder, he used totems to bind spirits to his service.

If we can get a few of those totems I may be able to use the spiritual connection he's forged with them to force a link. He'll be compelled to appear before us!

Go find me a few of those totems and I might be able to pull this off, I think five should do it.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text: Do you have those totems I asked for? He left them around the buildings nearby.

passages.title: The Totems That Bind
passages.text: Very good, I can feel that the magic in these is strong.

passages.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
passages.text:
It is time for Borgal to die.

We must travel to a location of power where I have room for the ritual. There is a ruined tower to the northwest that will be perfect for this. Meet us there and place the totems in the areas of power you will find there. Once they are placed I will do the ritual that will summon Borgal to us.

Your job will be the difficult one, kill him!

passages.title: Soulgrinder Survivor
passages.text:
Dat was a battle for da ages mon! Bwu'ja be glad ye are here commanda, else I'd likely be back in da spirit world permanently.

Dat Soulgrinda be a nasty piece o' mojo. Ye be the best one to hold onto it.

Dat spirit, she helped us out a lot mon. I hope she find da peace she be seeking now.

passages.title: Changing the Tide
passages.text:
It is time to retaliate against this foe. Meet me at Retribution Point and we will take this fight to the Shadow Council.

Teron'gor shall not feast on another soul so long as we stand in his way! His reign of terror ends today.

passages.title: Changing the Tide
passages.text: Our enemy has been pushed back and Auchindoun's defenses restored thanks to your help, but we are not yet done here.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
passages.text:
Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand.

We've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond.

We have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert.

I'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike, and we could use a capable <class> like yourself. I'd like you to be part of that team.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>. You're the commander that Choluna mentioned?

Good.

passages.title: Ambushing the Enemy
passages.text:
See that Iron Horde camp to the south, across the water? We've been watching their movements for days.

We've seen a lot of correspondence between their lieutenant and the Iron Horde command in Nagrand.

We need to disrupt their operation.

Gather their supplies, and bring me their leader's head.

passages.title: Ambushing the Enemy
passages.text: Those orcs were working on someone else's orders.

passages.title: Ambushing the Enemy
passages.text: I knew you were the right person for this job, <name>. I just love results.

passages.title: The Giant Cauldron
passages.text:
A high value artifact at Cragplume Canyon, hmmm?

Let's see if we can't beat the Iron Horde to it.

Let's move fast. Speak to Choluna, and we'll be on our way.

passages.title: The Giant Cauldron
passages.text: So this is it, huh? Let's see what's hiding in these depths.

passages.title: The Descent
passages.text:
Whatever lies at the bottom of this cauldron is of great use to the Iron Horde, and therefore, of great interest to us.

I need you to investigate the bottom of this crater.

You go ahead. I'll be right behind you.

passages.title: The Descent
passages.text: <Thisalee looks at you coolly.>

passages.title: The Descent
passages.text: That was close, <name>. Good work.

passages.title: A Goren's Feast
passages.text:
Goren. This caldera is full of them. I can even smell their stench from here.

I suspect that these goren are more than just primitive beasts, but in order to prove my theories, I need more data.

During your mission, if you should slay a goren or two, would you examine their stomachs for me? I'd like to know what these curious creatures eat.

passages.title: A Goren's Feast
passages.text: Oh my, what an interesting variety! It appears that the goren will eat... anything!

passages.title: Heating Up
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I have been conducting research on the steam geysers of Gorgrond for some time now.

Cragplume Cauldron is one of the largest caldera in this region, but we have been unable to do a geographical survey due to the dangerous creatures in this area.

Since you are venturing into the depths, could you take a temperature reading for me?

It would add greatly to our understanding of these natural caverns.

passages.title: Heating Up
passages.text: Oh, my! Amazing! This caldera is hotter than hot! Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Beating Heart
passages.text:
One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde.

We had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.

passages.title: The Beating Heart
passages.text: Good. We will keep the artifact safe here, in your garrison.

passages.title: Lurkers
passages.text:
Dis be a dangerous place, boss-mon.

Filled with big monsters and savage giants.

Well, like my family loa say, 'If ya can't beat it, poison it.'

We gonna be needin' some venom from the lurkers out there on the Cracking Plains. Dem lurkers be mighty sneaky, and mighty creepy. Be watchin the ground for rumbles and shakes.

I'll be stayin' here to make a cure in case you accidentally get too poisoned.

passages.title: Lurkers
passages.text: Dem lurkers scare ya off?

passages.title: Lurkers
passages.text: Dem centipedes creep you out boss-mon? Touchin' ya with their teeny tiny legs? I ain't thought of a thing that makes me skin crawl more, except maybe mah sister's voice. Hee hee.

passages.title: Poulticide
passages.text:
We be huntin' something so big, so savage, we gonna need anotha poison. We gonna need a big ol' poultice of poison!

So... boss-mon? Ya think ya up for a little flower pickin'? We gonna need the leaves of them frostbloom plants that be growing along the shadows of rocks and ledges along the sides of the Cracking Plains.

Be careful when pickin' them, boss-mon! They not always be by themselves...

passages.title: Poulticide
passages.text: I'd pick de flowers myself, but I got allergies. Ha ha!

passages.title: Poulticide
passages.text: Haha! Ya brought 'em! I hope ya not offended I asked such a lowly task of ya. We needed the leaves, and I needed to settle a bet.

passages.title: Frosted Fury
passages.text:
The furies of Draenor are different than the elementals of Azeroth. But don't be fooled. Some be wicked, boss-mon. Wicked.

The trap we are making be needing some proper frostshards. You can get them, if ya willing, from the ice furies.

Dey be wandering the Cracking Plains, freezin' all dat dey touch, an' bein' wicked.

Bring us some o' these frostshards, boss-mon, an' we gonna whip ya up one deadly trap.

passages.title: Frosted Fury
passages.text: A shadow huntah knows much of da spirits. We be talkin'. We be tradin'. But these ice furies, dey be wicked,  boss-mon.

passages.title: Frosted Fury
passages.text: Ah, now these be some fine trap making props. Ya know how to make a shadow huntah proud.

passages.title: Bladefury's Orders
passages.text:
Lieutenant O'rok:

Send an elite strike team to Cragplume Cauldron.

Retrieve a high-value artifact from the crater and deliver it to my command post in northern Talador.

With your remaining forces, go to Gorgorek's Fall. Protect and prepare the ancient magnaron specimen for retrieval.

Immediate action is required.

- Bladefury

passages.title: Bladefury's Orders
passages.text:
These orders come straight from the leader of the Burning Blade!

I've heard of her... the fierce orc with the blade that thirsts for death.

You've done well to bring this to me, <name>.

passages.title: The Real Prey
passages.text:
Eh boss-mon. Time for us to be huntin' the real prey now. To the north, there be a cave. In the cave, there be right mean ogron dey call "Grosh the Mighty." That ogron got a big stash of pillaged hides and leathers we gonna be needin' for the troops at the garrison.

I made a special poison from the stuff ya gathered. Dis be a magic poison, and it gonna put that ogron down to sometin' a bit more manageable. 

Take these vials to the cave and see if ya can't win us a treasure.

passages.title: The Real Prey
passages.text: Why be killin' five hundred clefthoof when ya can just kill one big ogron dat killed five hundred clefthoof?

passages.title: The Real Prey
passages.text:
Now dat be a mighty fine haul. We gonna be keepin' all the folks at the garrison warm.

It seemed like a simple task but ya tackled it like a boss-mon. If ya need a shadow hunter in your ranks, I be willin' to serve.

passages.title: Darktide Defender
passages.text: <Rexxar looks at you as you inspect the dead goblin. It's clear what he wants you to do.>

passages.title: Shredder Suppressor
passages.text:
The rylaks have no defense against the Iron Horde's technology. A true hunter would not need machines to capture their prey.

Destroy the Iron Shredders and the scum that pilot them. Spirit will join you on your quest.

passages.title: Shredder Suppressor
passages.text: You are proving to be a great hunter, <name>. But our work on this island is not yet complete.

passages.title: A Good Death
passages.text:
These fools have no honor.

They seem to enjoy torturing these poor beasts. The only humane thing we can do at this point is find injured rylaks and put them out of their misery.

Take this axe and aim for their vitals, <name>. These rylaks deserve a good death.

passages.title: A Good Death
passages.text:
You have done a good thing here today. Don't let the blood on your axe blind you.

You have given these rylaks the peace they deserve.

passages.title: Dirty Rats
passages.text:
These shredders are more of a hassle than I expected.

I've been peering through the eyes of the rats on the island. There are number of unmanned shredders west of here.

The rats have an uncontrollable appetite for this bait. Throw it onto Unmanned Shredders and let the rats destroy them from the inside.

passages.title: Dirty Rats
passages.text:
With fewer machines these weaklings will quickly lose their foothold on this island.

Excellent work, <name>.

passages.title: The Shadow Gate
passages.text:
Okay, we're gonna have to be quick. 

I've seen Borgal form magical portals before so he might try to use one to escape. If he does that our only option will be to follow after 'em. On top of that he always keeps his lieutenant Grubnor nearby so we may have a bit of a tussle in store.

<Owynn peeks into the cave.>

Keep yer head down, something's going on in there.

passages.title: The Shadow Gate
passages.text:
Blast it, he's given us the slip!

Ta make things worse the portal looks like it's closed from this side. We're gonna have to find a way to track Borgal down or we might be stuck in wherever this is.

passages.title: Releasing Rylak
passages.text:
These goblins have been conducting horrible experiments on the rylaks. This fool gave me the location for three of their prized experiments.

Set these mutated rylaks free. Maybe freedom will help these tortured souls find some peace in life.

passages.title: Releasing Rylak
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. You are proving to be a great ally.

passages.title: Tanaan 01: Front of the Portal
Back to Work
passages.text:
Alright, boss. We're gonna need some lumber if we're gonna get this garrison started off right.

If you mark some trees to be cut down, your peons will do the rest.

passages.title: Back to Work
passages.text: There aren't a lot of trees around. Go mark 'em!

passages.title: Back to Work
passages.text: That should be plenty of wood for now.

passages.title: Ore Not to Be
passages.text:
Okay, commander, here's the deal. You're gonna want spikes and all sorts of cool stuff on your garrison, right? To get started, we'll need some ore from a nearby cave.

Check out that cave to the southeast of us. Knowing what I know from being here for a no time at all, I bet there's something big and nasty inside.

Take care of it and the peons will get the ore for ya.

passages.title: The Portal Home
passages.text: [Ph] Khadgar is willing to open a portal to Azeroth, if only briefly, to get some of those we need to secure our foothold here.

passages.title: Den of Wolves
passages.text: Durotan wishes for us to join him now that you have established your foothold. I hope he will accept your help.

passages.title: Den of Wolves
passages.text: I hope you are finding your land agreeable.

passages.title: Rally the Frostwolves
passages.text:
My brother, in his haste, has already taken some of my clan with him and has begun an assault on Bladespire Citadel before we were ready.

Draka awaits by our war horn. Please let her know that it is time to rally the clan!

With the aid of you and your forces, we might actually stand a chance at victory against the ogres.

passages.title: Rally the Frostwolves
passages.text: Draka will know what to do.

passages.title: Rally the Frostwolves
passages.text: The clan is prepared. It is time for us to advance on Bladespire Citadel!

passages.title: The Shadow Gate
passages.text:
Dere be ogres in da cave, I smell de stink of 'em.

Keep ye weapon handy, we gonna have ta move quick and take down de ogres before dey start tossing da mojo.

<Bwu'ja peeks into the cave.>

Watch ye self mon, something be going down in dere.

passages.title: The Shadow Gate
passages.text:
Dat ogre, he done give us de slip!

<Bwu'ja looks around.>

Dis place, it be da spirit world! First time I ever walk here in da flesh.

Looks like our path back be blocked and our prey be gone. We gonna have ta go find dat ogre ta get outta dis place.

passages.title: Onslaught's End
passages.text:
"Guard Gul'dan and his Shadow Council with your lives! The portal cannot function without our prisoners' fel magic. Fail me and watch all that you hold dear turn to ash.

-Grommash Hellscream."

The Iron Horde appear to be holding prisoners that are crucial to keeping the portal open. Search the nearby spires!

passages.title: Onslaught's End
passages.text:
See the drifting energy from the tips of those spires? They clearly have some effect upon the portal.

With any hope, the portal falls along with them.

passages.title: Onslaught's End
passages.text:
The portal is weakened, but it remains open.

Only one option remains, <name>.

passages.title: Downsizing the Darktide
passages.text:
This pathetic excuse for life sold out all of his companions. All it took was a little squeeze of the neck.

Find the leaders of this operation and bring me their heads. Haratha will accompany you on your quest.

passages.title: Downsizing the Darktide
passages.text: The Iron Horde have no concept of honor.

passages.title: Downsizing the Darktide
passages.text: With their leaders dead this operation will surely fall apart.

passages.title: Warlords of Draenor: The Dark Portal
passages.text:
ATTENTION HEROES
 ADVENTURERS
 DEFENDERS OF AZEROTH

Archmage Khadgar, hero of the Second War, is assembling a coalition of Azeroth's strongest to bravely step through the Dark Portal and stop the Iron Horde's invasion of Azeroth.

Champions who are interested in glory can meet Khadgar at the base of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.

Safety not guaranteed.

passages.title: Warlords of Draenor: The Dark Portal
passages.text: Looks to me like we ended up in the right place.

passages.title: Trouble In The Mine
passages.text:
The Jorune Mine is in trouble!

We recently unearthed an exceedingly large and powerful arcane crystal; however, something has gone terribly wrong and the energy from the crystal is flooding the mine.

The Auchenai have already sent their Vindicators into the mine to assist us.

Speak with Vindicator Doruu inside of the mine, he'll know how you can help.

passages.title: Trouble In The Mine
passages.text: The Vindicators welcome you, <name>.

passages.title: Frenzied Manafeeders
passages.text:
There is a rare breed of moth in Talador known as the Manafeeder. These moths sustain themselves by feeding on arcane crystal dust from the mine.

Typically speaking, these moths are nothing more than an occasional nuisance. However, they are now gorging themselves upon the intense arcane energy flooding out of the mine and have become highly territorial and aggressive.

I have attuned this crystal to disperse arcane energy. Please use it on the Frenzied Manafeeders to soothe them.

passages.title: Frenzied Manafeeders
passages.text: Have you used the Arcane Dissipator on the Manafeeders yet?

passages.title: Frenzied Manafeeders
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. These moths are typically peaceful creatures and are deserving of mercy.

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text:
Kaelynara will not stop until she has drained every last drop of arcane energy from the crystal...and destroyed this entire mine in the process. The arcane shield she guards herself with cannot be penetrated by normal means, but I have a plan.

If I had a focusing crystal powerful enough to momentarily pierce her shield, Kaelynara could then be dealt with.

Fortunately, we are in the perfect place to build one. Start by bringing me arcane essence from the creatures rampaging throughout the mine.

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text: Have you retrieved the arcane essence for me?

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text: This will do nicely, <name>. All we need now is a suitable crystal...

passages.title: Of Wolves and Warriors
passages.text:
The return of many of my people is a boon to us, and I thank you for your part in their survival.

Come, ride with me. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Of Wolves and Warriors
passages.text: This land should serve our needs well. I leave it to you to decide how to best use it, commander.

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text:
Kaelynara's lust for arcane power has consumed her and she threatens the safety of all in this mine. She must be stopped.

Unfortunately, there is nothing we can do while she shields herself. We will need to find a way to penetrate her shielding spell.

Perhaps if I were to build a focusing crystal, I could use it to lower her shield...I'll need you to search the crystal mine for the necessary components.

First, I'll need arcane essence from the Crystal Ragers and Arcane Wraiths in the mine.

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text: Have you collected enough arcane essence yet?

passages.title: Arcane Essence
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. The arcane essence you've collected will do nicely. All we need now is a suitable crystal to attune...

passages.title: Crystals of Unusual Power
passages.text:
Arcane crystals of this size and power are quite rare even on Draenor. It is no coincidence that the Draenei built Shattrath and Auchindoun so close to this mine.

I am interested in learning more about these particular crystals and their arcane nature.

Return to me with any unrefined power crystals that you may find and I will make sure that you are adequately compensated for your effort.

passages.title: Crystals of Unusual Power
passages.text: Have you collected the unrefined power crystals I need for my research?

passages.title: Crystals of Unusual Power
passages.text: The crystals in this mine are most certainly unique. Thorough study of the samples you have provided should reveal why this is the case.

passages.title: Caught In The Chaos
passages.text:
Not all of the Draenei miners made it out when the chaos erupted, <name>. Many of them are injured and still trapped inside the mine.

Kaelynara's disruption has caused all hell to break loose. Arcane Wraiths are forming from the unleashed energy and attacking everything they see. The elementals that slumbered beneath the ground are emerging from the rocks frenzied and dangerous.

Please find as many injured miners as you can and ensure that they return safely.

passages.title: Caught In The Chaos
passages.text: Thank you for getting the workers our of the mine safely, <name>.

passages.title: Holding the Line
passages.text:
It is good to see you again, champion.

Demons are assaulting Auchindoun and we are barely standing our ground against them.

We need to push our front lines forward lest our losses reach critical mass.

If your blade is with us, shove it into these foul creatures' throats.

passages.title: Holding the Line
passages.text: I only hope we are enough.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
passages.text:
Our druids set up a wide network of scouts to follow up on your intel from Nagrand.

We've identified a suspicious Iron Horde excavation near some salt pools on the western coast of Gorgrond.

We have reason to believe that these orcs are pursuing a valuable artifact deep in the desert.

I'm putting together a small mission for a focused, surgical strike. I'd like you to be part of that team.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Crows In The Field
passages.text:
Greetings, <class>. You're the commander from the garrison?

Good.

passages.title: The Beating Heart
passages.text:
One thing is certain. We now possess an item of great value to the Iron Horde.

We had better secure this... "Heart of Gorgorek" at once.

passages.title: The Beating Heart
passages.text: Never in my years have I seen anything like this, <name>. You have done well today.

passages.title: Lumberstruck
passages.text:
[Test Quest - Do Not Translate]

This box is empty, begging to be filled with wood.

Protect your peasants as they gather materials from the region.

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text:
In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.

Within the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept beneath the rocky earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.

The heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart. Once I have the heart, I will have everything I need to construct the focusing crystal!

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text: Do you have the crystal giant heart?

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text: Excellent. Give me a moment and I will prepare the focusing crystal.

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text:
In order to break through Kaelynara's arcane shield, we will need a focusing crystal of rare power and quality.

Within the mine is a crystal giant known to the Draenei as An'dure. The giant has slept far beneath the earth for ages, but due to Kaelynara's recklessness it has awakened.

The heart of a crystal giant is a truly powerful artifact. Defeat An'Dure and return to me with a crystal giant heart.

When you return I will construct the focusing crystal and together we will stop Kaelynara.

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text: Do you have the crystal giant heart?

passages.title: An'dure The Giant
passages.text: It is sad to see such a mighty creature fall, but An'dure was a danger to all within the mine. The heart of the crystal giant will aid us in restoring peace to the Jorune Mine.

passages.title: Holding the Line
passages.text:
Auchindoun is under attack!

The Auchenai are valiant warriors in their own right, but they cannot hold against these endless demon hordes alone. We came here to stop the Legion from engulfing Draenor... working together is our best shot.

I need you to thin out the demons' numbers so we can regroup our forces safely and push forward into the Burning Front.

We will stop their march here and now!

passages.title: Holding the Line
passages.text: Your valor will give our men reprieve as they work to contain the threat completely. Well done.

passages.title: The Cost of War
passages.text:
They called this operation a suicide mission, but I don't plan on throwing away any lives meaninglessly.

Everybody, with me!

passages.title: The Cost of War
passages.text:
With the Dark Portal disabled, we have a new mission: stay alive.

We must keep pressing on, even if only to honor those who stayed behind to secure our retreat.

passages.title: Bled Dry
passages.text:
<The orc spits out his last words.>

They kept us in cages. They... drain our blood, for... rituals...

<The Frostwolf coughs violently.>

...many left --

 -- my... people...

<The orc dies.>

passages.title: Bled Dry
passages.text:
Well done, <name>.

Given, they are injured, half-starved, and poorly-equipped... but there is no blade so sharp as a vengeful spirit, no armor so thick as a righteous cause.

passages.title: The Chase is On
The Kargathar Proving Grounds
passages.text:
The orcs in this area look like members of the Shattered Hand clan. You can tell by looking at their hands.

Let's join up with the others. We must find a way out of here.

passages.title: The Kargathar Proving Grounds
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Kargathar Proving Grounds
passages.text:
We will hold this position for now. We must allow these freed prisoners a moment to breathe.

It is not an ideal position. We will be moving again shortly.

passages.title: Kill Your Hundred
passages.text:
I see only one way out of this trap, <name>, and it's right through the middle of that arena.

This might be the end of us.

passages.title: Kill Your Hundred
passages.text:
You're still alive? Good.

That cave-in will only hold them for so long. We have to keep moving.

passages.title: Masters of Shadow
passages.text:
The bad orcs tried to catch me, but I snuck away. I'm good at hiding.

All of the bad orcs are bad, but I've remembered the names of the meanest ones, just in case anybody came to save me.

<Luuka takes a deep breath.>

Ungra, Gurran, and... umm... oh! Ankova.

Will you protect me from them?

passages.title: Masters of Shadow
passages.text: How goes your mission?

passages.title: Masters of Shadow
passages.text:
Well done.

Be ready to move. We may have had the element of surprise within this cave, but our advantage is fleeting.

passages.title: Yrel
passages.text:
Forgive me if I'm a bit flustered - I've never killed anyone before.

My name is Yrel, and I am a student of Karabor.

You say you have an ARMY with you? The Light must truly be watching over me today.

I will follow you, then. Lead the way, <name>.

passages.title: Yrel
passages.text:
Up there - that is Keli'dan the Breaker. No doubt he's been alerted to our presence, and he's attempting to tell his warlord about our little jailbreak.

We have to take him out, <name>.

passages.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
passages.text:
One of Ner'zhul's lieutenants remains, up ahead. The exit to the cave isn't much farther past him.

I will go back and tell Khadgar that the cave is clear. We will rendezvous once you've taken care of Keli'dan!

passages.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
passages.text:
Fine job in the cave, but this is no time to rest.

We have momentum. We must stay in motion.

passages.title: The Prodigal Frostwolf
passages.text: I can get back to Drek'Thar myself... after I run this stinking shovel through a few Blackrock stomachs.

passages.title: The Prodigal Frostwolf
passages.text: You have my thanks, <name>. Durotan, our chieftain, will be happy to hear that Ga'nar lives.

passages.title: The Battle of the Forge
passages.text:
Our troops are armed - the time to strike is now!

Strike swift and true, <name>!

passages.title: The Battle of the Forge
passages.text: This dam thing is tougher than it looks.

passages.title: The Battle of the Forge
passages.text:
It's a good thing you got to high ground.

Look at the dam!

passages.title: The Fewer, the Merrier
passages.text:
We're vastly outnumbered down here, but at least we have the element of surprise.

For now.

Every Blackrock orc we slay in this quarry reduces the probability that we will be overwhelmed later. Go, and thin their ranks before they thin ours.

passages.title: Ga'nar of the Frostwolf
passages.text:
We must move on, there isn't time to waste!

One of the elders of my clan, Ga'nar, is out there somewhere. I can sense him, but I cannot find him.

Keep an eye out for Ga'nar. He is a strong-willed orc, and will languish in captivity.

passages.title: Ga'nar of the Frostwolf
passages.text:
<The orc's lips and wrists quiver with restrained fury.>

Who are you?

Wait, what's that you say? Drek'Thar is here?

passages.title: A Taste of Iron
passages.text:
The way I see it, there's two ways to keep this tank from going through the portal: break the tank, or USE the dang tank ta' BLOW UP the dang portal.

I can get 'er workin', I just need time. Hop in that turret off the starboard bow and keep 'em off my back.

passages.title: A Taste of Iron
passages.text: Almost there, <name>.

passages.title: A Taste of Iron
passages.text:
Takin' away Gul'dan was one thing, but blowin' up the whole damned portal? That's my kind of solution.

Now, I think we'd better get out of here before that army gets to us.

passages.title: The Home Stretch
passages.text:
If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank!

Let's join up with the rest and get out of here!!

passages.title: The Home Stretch
passages.text:
Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.

Our ship is waiting. Shall we depart?

passages.title: [Deprecated] Kill Thunderlord Master
passages.text: xxxxx

passages.title: Rylak Rescue
passages.text:
I managed to squeeze even more information out of our little friend here.

The Darktide Matriarch is at the top of the hill.

One of their lead engineers is attempting to tame the matriarch with his technology. We must stop him, <name>.

passages.title: Rylak Rescue
passages.text: We have accomplished great things on this island today, <name>. I look forward to the day we hunt again.

passages.title: Sunsworn Camp
passages.text:
We no longer have a need to work alongside the Auchenai, champion. I have arranged for their lead soulbinders to continue to advise us, but I believe any action is best left to us at this point.

Meet me at Sunsworn Camp, southeast of here. I can sense more demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.

passages.title: Sunsworn Camp
passages.text: There is still much to be done before we can leave Auchindoun with peace of mind, champion.

passages.title: Light's Rest
passages.text:
With the brute force of our enemy neutralized, we must turn our sights on quelling the aftermath and preparing for any future assaults. We still need Auchindoun's defenses reinvigorated.

Meet me at Light's Rest, not far south of here. We have reports coming in of demonic taint in the area, and we may be able to track down the remaining power crystal shards at its source.

passages.title: Light's Rest
passages.text: We have our work cut out for us, champion. The Legion's stench fills the air.

passages.title: Mind Controlled Rylaks
passages.text: xxxxx

passages.title: Free their Minds
passages.text:
This device is what the goblins are using to control the rylaks.

There is a button on the controller labeled do not touch.

Get within range of a Controlled Rylak and touch the button.

passages.title: Powering the Defenses
passages.text:
What few soulpriests we don't have on the front lines are working fervently to maintain Auchindoun's defenses. They aren't going to be able to keep it up much longer alone.

Soulbinder Tuulani went inside the nearby Tomb of Lights to retrieve a backup power pylon and hasn't returned. I need you to find her and get her and the pylon back here safely.

passages.title: Powering the Defenses
passages.text: You look like you can fight. We need to get out of here!

passages.title: Powering the Defenses
passages.text:
I know what the Bonechewer are after.

Auchindoun is protected by a powerful barrier, which can only be disabled using an ancient key. No being could ever hope to penetrate it.

The Auchenai, my people, split the key into three shards long ago and hid each piece outside the mausoleum walls. We guard those shards with the same zeal as Auchindoun itself.

Go into the Tomb of Souls and retrieve the key from Soulbinder X. The shards are no longer safe.

passages.title: Winds of Change
passages.text:
Commander, I have bad news. Olin Umberhide, the tauren who escaped with you from Tanaan, was ambushed when near the eastern perimeter of the Garrison.

He was seen being dragged off by the pale. These are dangerous, disturbing creatures that some believe were once orcs. Now they are husks of barely living flesh bent by dark magics.

Olin is resourceful, but outnumbered. I would advise travelling east to effect a rescue as soon as possible, before they eat him alive... slowly.

passages.title: Winds of Change
passages.text: Have you found Olin? Was he alive or dead?

passages.title: Winds of Change
passages.text:
Well done, commander. Olin spoke to me of your bravery and has already offered to serve under your command.

If I may advise you in this matter, I would suggest accepting his service. We could make use of a tauren with his skill set in a land like this.

passages.title: Mysterious Ring
passages.text:
This elegantly crafted ring is covered in ornate decorations and symbols, the most prominent of which being the letter "V" in a glowing rune. The ring seems to fade in and out of view as if passing back and forth through time.

Someone at Khadgar's Tower may have an interest in such an artifact.

passages.title: Mysterious Ring
passages.text: Time magic is a young field of research.

passages.title: Mysterious Ring
passages.text:
Ah. Now what do you have there? This ring is going to require some extra research.

It seems like someone was trying to travel through time but in a very backward fashion.

passages.title: Mysterious Boots
passages.text:
Phasing back and forward in time, these flickering ornate boots are adorned with a lavish "V" on them.

Someone at Khadgar's Tower might have insights to the nature of these strange items.

passages.title: Mysterious Boots
passages.text:
I was wondering "when" I would see you again. Ah...? Ah...? Get it?

Look, for as long as anyone was speaking the bronze dragons got to hog all of the good time jokes.

Well now the guardians of time are taking a break and there is no one left to stop me!

passages.title: Mysterious Boots
passages.text:
These boots are fantastic! You did the right thing bringing these to me.

They are actually trying to replace the space they occupy with a different timeline.

This will definitely require more study.

passages.title: Mysterious Hat
passages.text:
Energy flows from this mystical hat with an unseen strength. It hums as it drifts back and forward in time where it rests on the ground.

This is the sort of object that someone at Khadgar's Tower would find very interesting.

passages.title: Mysterious Hat
passages.text: It is so nice to finally be able to research my passion without those interfering bronze dragons showing up.

passages.title: Mysterious Hat
passages.text:
Now THAT is a hat. See how it flickers in and out of time as if someone were temporally jiggling it?

I'd try putting it on if I weren't afraid it would wipe me from the timeline.

passages.title: Mysterious Staff
passages.text:
Fluctuations in reality surround this staff so much that it is hard to identify any recognizable markings aside from a large, lavish "V" on its apex.

This might require help to identify by someone from Khadgar's Tower.

passages.title: Mysterious Staff
passages.text:
I did my time with fire and the other arcane arts. They were good. Nothing compares to hurling a giant ball of fire.

But temporal wizardry? So much fun!

Really hard to master but you always have plenty of time.

passages.title: Mysterious Staff
passages.text:
Hmm. This staff looks familiar. I wonder...

You did the right thing bringing it to me. I will investigate further!

passages.title: Cleansing the Souls
passages.text:
Not all spirits are destroyed by the Soulgrinder. Some souls manage to survive more or less intact like myself. Others have become twisted and maddened.

End their misery, take my soul shard and use it to purify them. Their rage will blind them to the effects of its energy so you must defeat them before you use it.

passages.title: Cleansing the Souls
passages.text: Thank you, I am glad that the spirits have been released from their torment.

passages.title: Temporal Juxtaposition
passages.text:
I think I figured out what those mysterious artifacts you collected were for.

It would seem someone is attempting to affect a temporal shift by sending items back into this timeline from your own timeline.

Technically that shouldn't be possible. But whoever this is found a way.

I think I may try a ritual to bring the traveler through.

passages.title: Temporal Juxtaposition
passages.text:
<name>? Is that you? Fantastic! And they said it couldn't be done.

They said traversing the worlds in this way was the domain of the bronze dragonflight. Well, guess who's temporally laughing now!

passages.title: Follow Spirit
Garrison Invasion!
passages.text: Your garrison is under attack! Use this magic device to get back there and defend it!

passages.title: Bonus Objective: Kill Grimfrost Ogres
passages.text: Free the Frostwolves being held by the Grimfrost ogres.

passages.title: Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
passages.text:
They killed Aedraa and took the crystal from her! The captain of the guard, Restalaan, tried to stop them and they took him into the cathedral!

If we can just get this crystal, we can reunite the Heart of Auchindoun and turn its defenses on fully! We can't afford to fail now.

<name>, you're the only one left that can do it. You have to find Restalaan! He'll know where they took it.

passages.title: Restalaan, Captain of the Guard
passages.text: There is no time for pleasantries. The raid's leader is just ahead.

passages.title: Into the Jaws of the Jungle
Declawing The Competition
passages.text:
These saberon freaks have cost me a lot of money, <class>.

I'm not one to forgive a debt and it's time to collect!

The saberon that have been causing us the most trouble are the ones living in Sabermaw. They keep ambushing our trade shipments along the road.

<Pyxni grins.>

It's time to declaw the competition. Bring me their claws; we'll sell the best ones as good luck charms here at the arena.

If the claw sales don't cover their debt, we'll just have to charge them an arm and a leg too!

passages.title: Declawing The Competition
passages.text: Do you have the saberon claws I asked for?

passages.title: Declawing The Competition
passages.text:
<Pyxni examines the saberon claws.>

We're gonna make a killing selling these as good luck charms to all the wannabe gladiators here at the arena!

From now on, the saberon will think twice about messing with the Steamwheedle Cartel!

passages.title: WANTED: Razorpaw!
passages.text:
Wanted for crimes against the innocent at the Ring of Trials!

Razorpaw is responsible for leading several raids and ambushes against travelers on the road near Sabermaw.

Last seen in the vicinity of the saberon den known as Sabermaw.

Exercise extreme caution!

Upon completion, this bounty will be fulfilled by Pyxni Pennypocket of the Steamwheedle Cartel.

passages.title: WANTED: Razorpaw!
passages.text:
You fought your way into Sabermaw, killed Razorpaw...and lived?

That's incredible news!

The roads will be much safer now that he's dead! That means more money for me!

As promised, here's your reward!

passages.title: They've Got The Goods!
passages.text:
The Saberon...they weren't just after prisoners...

<Cough>...they took all the merchandise too.

Kidnapping is one thing...but stealing a goblin's merchandise? That's making things personal!

<Cough>...Pyxni ain't going to be happy unless you get all of the stolen goods back. Make your way into Sabermaw and steal back all our merch.

When you're done, make your way back to Pyxni at the Ring of Trials.

She'll make it worth your while...

passages.title: They've Got The Goods!
passages.text:
Greexlex told you that the saberon stole our merchandise?

Well, what are you standing around for? Get your butt over to Sabermaw and get it back!

Time is money!

passages.title: They've Got The Goods!
passages.text:
You recovered the merchandise? Fantastic!

<Pyxni rummages through the bags.>
