However, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, and gather their medallions of service.

When we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

passages.title: Reclaiming the City
passages.text: What I ask is no easy task, for his scions are formidable. How goes the offensive?

passages.title: Reclaiming the City
passages.text: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.

passages.title: Reclaiming the City
passages.text:
The Shattrath offensive is going well, but Socrethar refuses to show himself.

And despite our best efforts, we are unable to break into the inner city, where he resides.

However, we think we can lure Socrethar out of hiding. Defeat his lieutenants and warriors, then gather their medallions of service.

When we show him proof of their demise, his pride will surely force him to face us.

passages.title: Reclaiming the City
passages.text: What I ask is no easy task, for his followers are formidable. How goes the offensive?

passages.title: Reclaiming the City
passages.text: Excellent. These insignias will surely bring Socrethar out of hiding.

passages.title: Socrethar's Demise
passages.text:
Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.

There, we will issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts our challenge, it is there that he shall meet his end.

The creature that calls himself Socrethar was once my brethren. I can only hope that there is still some Light left within him.

passages.title: Socrethar's Demise
passages.text: Finally, it is done. Othaar... my old friend... be at peace now.

passages.title: Rage and Wisdom
passages.text:
An endless war wages between the creatures of the eastern wilds and the beasts of the western wasteland.

Should one side overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would fall at the hand of the victor.

I sent Rangari Erdanii to the heart of the battle between these two forces. It is likely that she will need your help, commander.

passages.title: Rage and Wisdom
passages.text: Thank you for coming, commander.

passages.title: Rage and Wisdom
passages.text: These creatures are relentless in their assault against one another.

passages.title: Socrethar's Demise
passages.text:
Meet me down by the entrance to the Shattrath dome.

There, we shall issue our challenge to the Sargerei leader. If he accepts, it is there that he shall meet his end.

I must admit, <name>, I am looking forward to this.

passages.title: Socrethar's Demise
passages.text: What is it?

passages.title: Socrethar's Demise
passages.text: Finally, it is done. This creature of darkness shall torment us no longer. Shattrath is free of his taint.

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text:
We need allies amongst these spires, and quickly. Commander, I believe it would be wise if you sought out aid.

There is a lone arakkoa outcast southeast of here living near a ravager nest. The ravagers do not attack him - I suspect he has information on the beasts we may be able to use.

I have our last crate of cactus apple surprise ready for you. It is our best shot, <sir/madame>.

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text: Any luck, commander?

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text: I believe we can come to an arrangement, savior of Skettis. But first...

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text:
We could really use an ally to trade with, commander.

There's an arakkoa outcast living in the middle of a ravager nest northeast of here... do you think he might ally with us? He must have some sort of secret to keeping those ravagers at bay.

I have one last crate of my Northshire Port. Maybe that will help convince him that we're friendly.

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text: Welcome back! How did things go with the arakkoa?

passages.title: Peace Offering
passages.text: I believe we can come to an arrangement, savior of Skettis. But first...

passages.title: When All Is Aligned
passages.text:
The ravenspeaker acolytes have been equipped with Apexis interfaces, they just need to get close enough.

Come, let us take to the skies and secure the Terrace of Dawn.

When all is aligned, we shall turn the false suns against one another and the spires shall burn like torches!

I look forward to penning your actions into history.

passages.title: When All Is Aligned
passages.text: Percy and I want to give you something as a token of our thanks. It's not much but please, take your reward.

passages.title: Best Deals Anywhere
passages.text:
Commander, two goblin smugglers - Mixxy and Trixxy Weldblast - came through here recently and went off towards the bog to the east.

They had drilling equipment but weren't carrying any weapons, <sir/madame>.

I'd bet anything that they'll have materials we'd want, and that they could use some protection in return.

Commander, I think seeking them out would be a good idea.

passages.title: Best Deals Anywhere
passages.text: I don't know what you're doin' all the way out here, but mind helpin' a gal out since you're stopping by?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text:
We were hauling batteries to the excavation site and I crashed my freakin' car!

My sister didn't even look back. I took the turn a little fast, so what? It happens!

Point is, the batteries went flying everywhere and I'm in no condition to lift them out.

So what do you say? Wanna help me out?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text: Do you have the batteries?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text: You're a real doll. Let's get out of here.

passages.title: Tangleheart
passages.text:
Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.

The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.

I'm headin' there now.

passages.title: Tangleheart
passages.text: Hey! Looky what I found here.

passages.title: Tangleheart
passages.text:
The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.

Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.

I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?

I'll meet ya there.

passages.title: Tangleheart
passages.text: Cheers! I found a goblin skulkin' about here. Think I'll keep 'er around. Says she knows things about lumberjackin'.

passages.title: The Tinkertoss Twins
passages.text:
Commander, two gnomish smugglers passed by while you were out - Filbert and Dilbert Tinkertoss. They were headed towards the bog to the east.

They had all sorts of drilling equipment but didn't seem to have any weapons.

What do you think of offering them protection in exchange for some of their materials?

I'll jot down where they were headed in case you decide to go.

passages.title: The Tinkertoss Twins
passages.text: You're armed to the teeth! Say, would you be interested in helping a weary gnome out?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text:
A squadron of arakkoa spotted us while we were en route to the excavation site and took out our caravan. My brother made it to safety in the chaos.

Lucky son of a tinker.

I can't leave without the batteries for our drill, but they all fell into the bog and I can't even get them to budge.

Any chance you could retrieve them for me?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Sticky Situation
passages.text: You're a lifesaver! Let's get these to the excavation site.

passages.title: Back on Track
passages.text:
You're a lifesaver, I'll tell you what.

Say, how about you go on ahead to the excavation site and let my sister know I'm on my way. I'll get everything neat and tidy and go get a new cart to lug these over.

passages.title: Back on Track
passages.text: Oh, Mixxy sent you? What a relief. I'm not even armed!

passages.title: Back on Track
passages.text:
Now that the batteries are out of the bog I can radio in some more copters to take them to camp.

I'll stay here until they arrive, but you should go ahead to my brother Dilbert and let him know what happened. He must be worried sick!

passages.title: Back on Track
passages.text: Oh, thank goodness. I don't even have any weapons!

passages.title: Cauterizing Wounds
passages.text:
You have saved my most precious companion, Nisha. I owe you a great debt.

The Iron Horde lured me away to separate us. I shall not make the same mistake again.

They have inflicted grievous wounds, and I fear we must cause her even more pain before the healing process can begin.

Please use a burning log from the nearby fire to cauterize her wounds.

I will hold her down.

passages.title: Cauterizing Wounds
passages.text: Nisha must make it through this.

passages.title: Cauterizing Wounds
passages.text: Thank you. Her wounds have closed.

passages.title: Rites of the Talonpriests
passages.text:
That gavel was once known as Beakbreaker. In his final, darkest days, Terokk used it to perform grim, damnable acts of sacrifice. 

It is best not to dwell on those days.

Terokk was sealed away deep within the shadows to rest, and perhaps to heal.

Making contact with him will take a great deal of effort, so in the meantime, allow me to tell you of his more glorious exploits. Before this wretched curse took hold.

Please, place the gavel upon the effigy.

passages.title: Rites of the Talonpriests
passages.text: <As you place the gavel at the base of the effigy, Reshad speaks over your shoulder.>

passages.title: Writing in the Snow
passages.text: This is a worn page from Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Rokhan, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

passages.title: Writing in the Snow
passages.text: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, <name>.

passages.title: Writing in the Snow
passages.text: This is a worn page from Owynn Graddock's journal. It appears to be a sketch of the entrance of the Bloodmaul Slave Mines. Bodrick Grey, in your garrison, would be very interested in this.

passages.title: Writing in the Snow
passages.text: Excellent work. Your service is always appreciated, <name>.

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text:
So you have a smuggler's den, huh?

I'd love to trade with ya, toots, I really would, but my laser cannon isn't even functional right now.

I'll tell you what. See all the ancients around here? They got toasted good by the arakkoa's weapon, and they're practically walking piles of charcoal.

Bring me some charcoal to power this thing and you've got a deal.

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text: If you've got the stuff, let's talk.

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text: That ought to do it! Nice work.

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text:
Oh, you have a trading post?

Fantastic!

Let's make a deal. You help me power up my laser cannon, and I'll trade some of this... thermo... ultra... obsidiglass with you for some weapons.

The ancients all around here are practically made of charcoal after the arakkoa weapon hit, you should go get some of that!

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text: Blasted refurbished goblin tech is always malfunctioning.

passages.title: All Natural
passages.text: That's... quite a bit of charcoal. Nicely done!

passages.title: Ending Executions
passages.text:
We arrived as soon as we could... but we be too late. Da Iron Horde has taken our warriors prisoner.

No doubt they be trying ta squeeze info out of da troops.

I fear once they are done with da interrogation they gonna execute their prisoners. Time be running out.

passages.title: Ending Executions
passages.text: Da prisoners be shaken up, but they are free. We be in your debt, <name>.

passages.title: Under Siege
passages.text:
Those Iron Horde cannons are laying waste to our troops. I'm not sure how much more of this we can handle. Our forces are already spread too thin.

There has to be a way to stop those war machines.

passages.title: Under Siege
passages.text: It will take the Iron Horde quite a while to get those demolishers operational again. Throm-Ka, <name>.

passages.title: Subversive Scouts
passages.text:
We have been unable to execute a vast majority of our battleplans. We are definitely being watched.

The Iron Horde must have scouts planted throughout the Blasted Lands. Victory is slipping away from us.

passages.title: Subversive Scouts
passages.text: You killed how many scouts? No wonder we have been unable to execute our plans...

passages.title: Attack on Nethergarde
passages.text:
The Iron Horde controls Nethergarde Keep, but they are fools if they think we will let them retain such a strategic position.

My best troops are more than eager to spill the blood of those savages, but we need a champion like yourself to lead the charge.

passages.title: Attack on Nethergarde
passages.text: The Iron Horde will learn to fear us, as they should.

passages.title: Ransacking Nethergarde
passages.text:
After the Iron Horde took Nethergarde we attacked. While we killed the Iron Horde at Nethergarde they brought more forces through the portal and took Okril'lon Hold. So many souls stripped of their bodies by those savages.

We must not forget those that gave their lives at Nethergarde. If you find any mementos of the fallen, bring them back to me.

passages.title: Ransacking Nethergarde
passages.text: Did you find anything?

passages.title: Ransacking Nethergarde
passages.text: Throm-Ka, <name>. These mementos will forever remind us of our champions.

passages.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
passages.text:
The stupidity of the Dreadmaul ogres never ceases to amaze me. The Iron Horde is clearly using them to further their own nefarious agenda.

Regardless, we must show the ogres what happens when you confront the true Horde. I think it's time we send the Dreadmaul ogres a message.

passages.title: Death to the Dreadmaul
passages.text: It's important that our enemies understand what happens when you attack the true Horde. I'm glad you could be there to show them.

passages.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
passages.text:
With the intelligence you have gathered we have learned this assault is being led by a powerful Iron Horde orc named Gar'mak Bladetwist. He is hunkered down inside Okril'lon Hold.

Killing him will not win this war, but it will surely break down the Iron Horde's communication. This will buy us valuable time while we gather more forces and outline a battleplan to deal with this new threat.

passages.title: Gar'mak Bladetwist
passages.text: It was an honor fighting alongside of you, <name>.

passages.title: Okrilla's Revenge
passages.text:
The Dreadmaul ogres think they have bested us? They will all suffer. Here take this poison, place a couple drops in their rat stew.

The poison will slowly eat away at their insides. Causing a prolonged and painful death, just like they deserve.

passages.title: Okrilla's Revenge
passages.text: I wish I could be there to watch their faces as they suffer. I hope they all die a slow horrible death.

passages.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
passages.text:
I've got a strange problem and I'm hoping you might be able to help. I don't know who else could help, to be honest.

My workers keep saying they're seeing the ghost of the arakkoa that used to head up this place.

I know, I know, it's crazy but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?

If there's a ghost around here, it'll find it. If there's not, then my workers are trying to slack off on the clock.

passages.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
passages.text: Well, I'll be. Ghosts. Who knew?

passages.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
passages.text:
Say, while you're here would you mind helping me out with a major problem?

The workers keep saying that they're seeing the ghost of the head arakkoa that used to be here.

I don't believe it for a second but could you take my Ghostogrifier 12000 to her body and check?

If they're not crazy, it'll prove it.

passages.title: I See Dead Arakkoa
passages.text: You're kidding! What a world.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
passages.text:
Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
passages.text: One minute you are skirting the cauldrons avoiding the Gronn, the next a blast a steam followed by burning hot claws.  Erosian's death should make our scouts lives a lot easier!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
passages.text:
Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Erosian
passages.text: One minute you are skirting the cauldrons avoiding the Gronn, the next a blast a steam followed by burning hot claws.  Erosian's death should make our scouts lives a lot easier!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
passages.text:
Defeating Dessicus has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
passages.text:
You have defeated yet another deadly beast in Gorgrond.

Dessicus cared little on who he preyed upon, they all went into his salt pools forever. You have saved many lives <name>!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
passages.text:
Defeating Dessicus has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Dessicus
passages.text:
You have defeated yet another deadly beast in Gorgrond.

Dessicus cared little on who he preyed upon, they all went into his salt pools forever. You have saved many lives <name>!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Crater Lord Igneous
passages.text:
Defeating Crater Lord Igneous has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Crater Lord Igneous
passages.text: I thought I felt less quakes in the earth. His fury caused untold damage to this world, it is good that he has fallen to you.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Crater Lord Igneous
passages.text:
Defeating Crater Lord Igneous has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Crater Lord Igneous
passages.text: I thought I felt less quakes in the earth. His fury caused untold damage to this world, it is good that he has fallen to you.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
passages.text:
Defeating the Fungal Praetorian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
passages.text: I've heard tales of the Crimson Fen from the rangari; no one has yet returned from there. If this was the reason then we can all breathe safer now.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
passages.text:
Defeating the Fungal Praetorian has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Fungal Praetorian
passages.text: I've heard tales of the Crimson Fen from the Laughing Skull and how no one ever returns from there. If this is part of the reason, then we can all breathe safer now.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Charl Doomwing
passages.text:
Defeating Charl has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Charl Doomwing
passages.text:
Our purpose here was hard enough without a giant beast like Charl harassing our scouts and aggravating the Gronn.

Glory to you <name>!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Charl Doomwing
passages.text:
Defeating Charl has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Charl Doomwing
passages.text:
Our purpose here was hard enough without a giant beast like Charl harassing our scouts and aggravating the Gronn.

You have saved the rangari a great deal of punishment with this kill, <name>!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Roardan the Sky Terror
passages.text:
Defeating Roardan has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Maraad at Highpass.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Roardan the Sky Terror
passages.text:
The screams of that giant rylak could never be ignored.

You could never be sure if it was far away or if there would be a sudden shadow followed by your immediate death.  Well done!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Roardan the Sky Terror
passages.text:
Defeating Roardan has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Roardan the Sky Terror
passages.text:
The screams of that giant rylak could never be ignored.

You could never be sure if it was far away or if there would be a sudden shadow followed by your immediate death.  Well done!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
passages.text:
Defeating Khargax has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
passages.text: The Laughing Skull have always steered clear of that area because Khargax was very quick for such a huge beast. They will be pleased to know their eaten dead have been avenged.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
passages.text:
Defeating Khargax has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your outpost. 

Return this to Maraad to increase your glory!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Khargax the Devourer
passages.text:
You have done us all a great favor <name>.

The existence of that slippery hydra wasn't even truly known despite our losses in the area.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
passages.text:
Defeating Erosian has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your gladiatorial arena. 

Return this to <ARENA NPC NAME> to increase your glory!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Sodius
passages.text:
Defeating Sodius has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at <HORDE OUTPOST>.

passages.title: I Drew Aggro...culture
passages.text:
adventurer? Boy am I glad to see ya.

I was tryin' ta ditch that genesaur when I stumbled across this rangari camp.

Next thing I know, the ground is creepin' up and spittin' out all sorts of angry plants.

I barely made it out of me tank before that genesaur threw it like it was an empty beer mug.

I'm gonna make my way back to the road an' look fer me tank.

I'll see ya there when yer done.

passages.title: I Drew Aggro...culture
passages.text: Ah perfect. I'll get this up an' runnin' in no time.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
passages.text:
One of my top field operatives, Jeanine Amrell, is stationed deep in Iron Horde territory in northern Nagrand.

She reports that the warlords of the orcish clans are planning to convene in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost.

This may be a critical opportunity for us to gain intel on their future plans.

I need you to meet up with agent Amrell immediately. This may be our chance, <name>!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
passages.text: <Judging by the marks on her body, the agent put up an impressive fight.>

passages.title: The Warlord's Council
passages.text:
Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around her neck.

Scrawled upon it angrily are the words:

"WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"

passages.title: The Warlord's Council
passages.text:
I'm glad I found you, <name>. I've been hiding out since the Warsong orcs ambushed our camp at the Hidden Camp.

You should have seen the fight that Jeanine put up. Even after they began torturing her, she never gave up that there were two of us.

She had a will of steel, that one.

passages.title: Plans of War
passages.text:
I managed to get my hands on Jeanine's notebook. She identified several key items in the nearby buildings to investigate, but couldn't follow up before her demise.

The least we can do is follow the lead that she left us.

Search the camp for the intelligence. I'll keep the orcs distracted.

passages.title: Plans of War
passages.text:
This is remarkable, <name>. We now have direct proof of Grommash's intentions.

Perhaps now, we can stay a step ahead of the Iron Horde. Great work!

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text:
Intelligence is the name of the game, friend. The more we know about Hellscream's plans, the easier it will be to thwart them.

The Mok'gol orcs often act as Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from this place to his outposts all over Draenor.

Kill these riders, and recover any orders that you can find.

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text: Do you have something for me?

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>.

passages.title: Putting Down the Packleader
passages.text:
Operations at Mok'gol Watchpost are entrusted to a mighty warrior named Packleader Vor'gash.

If we can take out this fierce leader, we can shut down their communications temporarily.

You can find Vor'gash patrolling the compound to the northeast.

Slay him.

passages.title: Putting Down the Packleader
passages.text: I have heard many reports about Vor'gash. It is a relief to know he will trouble us no more.

passages.title: Putting Down the Packleader
passages.text:
Da one in charge a Mok'gol Watchpost be Packleader Vor'gash.

We take him out, we shut dem down.

Ya ken find 'im patrolling da compound ta da nor'east.

Kill 'im.

passages.title: Putting Down the Packleader
passages.text: I know about dis Vor'gash. It be a relief ta know he won't trouble us no more.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
passages.text:
Ya timin' be good, commanda.

I sent one a ma shadow huntas deep inta da land 'a da enemy.

He reports dat da warlords be plannin' ta meet in secret at Mok'gol Watchpost.

Dis be our chance ta learn what Hellscream be up to.

Go now, and meet wit Zasta. He will tell ya what to do next.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Deep Recon
passages.text: <Judging by the marks on his body, the shadow hunter put up an impressive fight.>

passages.title: The Warlord's Council
passages.text:
Upon closer inspection, you notice a piece of leather parchment looped around his neck.

Scrawled upon it angrily are the words:

"WITNESS THE FATE OF THOSE WHO DEFY THE IRON HORDE!"

passages.title: The Warlord's Council
passages.text:
I ben lookin' for ya, commanda. I knew you was comin', but dat nasty orc lady got ta ya afore I could give warnin'.

At least I could save ya. Poor Zasta. He never saw it comin'.

passages.title: Plans of War
passages.text:
I managed ta recover Zasta's notes. He saw dey Warsong leaders meetin' often in dey nearby buildings. Zasta tinks dere be clues about dey Iron Horde's plans nearby.

Dey least we can do is follow dey lead he left us.

Search dey camp for dey intelligence. I'll keep dey orcs distracted.

passages.title: Plans of War
passages.text:
Now we have proof a Hellscream's intentions.

Mebbe now, we ken stay a step ahead a da Iron Horde. Gud work.

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text:
Intelligence be da name a da game, commanda. Da more we know about Hellscream's plans, da easier it be ta mess dem.

Da Mok'gol orcs be Hellscream's couriers, carrying mission orders from dis place ta his outposts all over Draenor.

Kill dese riders, an' recover any orders dat you ken find.

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text: Ya have something for me?

passages.title: Intercepting the Orders
passages.text: Dis is gud, <name>. Dis be real gud.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
passages.text:
We are getting reports that Iron Horde warships are docking on a small island just south of Shadowmoon Valley.

We sent in some scouts, but we haven't heard back from them yet. It might be worth investigating.

Dungar Longdrink has a gryphon waiting for you when you are ready, commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
passages.text: These savages have no honor, it is time we deal with the Iron Horde presence on this island.

passages.title: Basilisk Butcher
passages.text:
Basilisk is one of Nisha's favorite meals. This is where she hunts, and that's likely how those Iron Horde bastards were able to capture her.

Why would they go to the trouble to subdue her this way? Perhaps together, you and I might learn the answer as we punish them for their transgressions.

For now, Nisha's going to need some food. While I tend to her, will you do her hunting for her?

passages.title: Basilisk Butcher
passages.text: <Nisha sniffs deeply.>

passages.title: Basilisk Butcher
passages.text: <Nisha downs the meat in one gulp.>

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
passages.text:
We is getting reports dat da Iron Horde warships be dockin' on a small island to da south of da Shadowmoon Valley.

We be sendin' some scouts, but we haven't heard back yet. We need ta be investigating.

Bron Skyhorn has a ryklak waitin' for ya when you be ready, commander.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Darktide Roost
passages.text: These savages have no honor, it is time we deal with the Iron Horde presence on this island.

passages.title: Safety Measures
passages.text:
As it turns out, the resonance frequency of the batteries has really upset the local wildlife. I... I think one of the boars looked at me and licked its lips just a moment ago.

I'll make it worth your time if you just... get rid of anything you come across down there. Doesn't matter what it is, just kill it, okay?

passages.title: Safety Measures
passages.text: Fantastic! This is some good old-fashioned adventuring if I've ever seen it.

passages.title: Safety Measures
passages.text:
The batteries I lost in the bog have really ticked off the wild creatures. It's going to be impossible to remove them without fighting through who knows what.

If you're up for it, why don't you 'take care' of any critters you come across? I don't want some giant beast stalking me back to the excavation site.

I'll make it worth your while.

passages.title: Safety Measures
passages.text: Now that's what I'm talking about. You're tough as nails.

passages.title: Rage and Wisdom
passages.text:
Beasts of the western wasteland fight an endless war with the creatures of the eastern wilds.

If one side were to overwhelm the other, all of Draenor would be doomed at the hand of the victor.

The Laughing Skull seek revenge for their destroyed village. I have directed them to aim their vengeance at the nearby creatures, that our outpost here might be preserved.

If you would, commander, oversee their efforts. I have not yet grown to trust the Laughing Skull.

passages.title: Rage and Wisdom
passages.text: I can see the future of my enemies in the bones. They're gonna die!

passages.title: The Interest of Bruto
passages.text:
You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.

I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.

Will you accept it?

passages.title: The Interest of Bruto
passages.text:
Now THAT is how you break out of a gladiator pit!

You are fun. Your weapons are covered in a rainbow of blood types.

I am going to follow you now.

passages.title: The Fists of Vaandaam
passages.text:
You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.

I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.

Will you accept it?

passages.title: The Fists of Vaandaam
passages.text:
For years the ogres would make me fight, kill, and salute. My soul bled with each salute.

But because of you, I will never again have to salute an ogre.

You have helped me win my freedom, so I choose to use that freedom to serve your banner.

Today, I salute you, commander.

passages.title: The Home Stretch
passages.text:
If they weren't angry before, they sure are now. We won't survive a minute up on top o' this tank!

Let's join up with the rest and get out of here!!

passages.title: The Home Stretch
passages.text:
Against all odds, here we stand. Still alive, an entire army on our heels.

Our ship is waiting. Shall we depart?

passages.title: The Missing Piece
passages.text:
Terokk's daughter Lithic was a skilled huntress, but found her true passion in goldsmithing.

She forged this bangle as a gift for her father, and he wore it for many years. Only after Lithic passed away did he remove the bangle, for her memory was too much for the old king to bear.

Place the bangle upon the effigy, and I shall tell you of Terokk's fall.

passages.title: The Missing Piece
passages.text: <You carefully hang the bangle upon the effigy's arm.>

passages.title: Attempted Murder
passages.text:
Your bartender Lunzul is dying, commander. She's been poisoned and needs an antidote immediately.

One of your scouts reported seeing a Shattered Hand orc nearby recently - that's our best bet.

There is a small arakkoa camp to the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. I suggest we start our search there.

I've already spoken to your flight master about securing us a flight; every second counts.

passages.title: Attempted Murder
passages.text: These corpses are fresh. Their killers must still be nearby.

passages.title: Attempted Murder
passages.text:
Kolrigg is dyin', commander. He's been poisoned and needs an antidote before it's too late.

One o' yer scouts reported seein' a Shattered Hand orc nearby not long ago - I wager that's our best shot.

There's a small arakkoa camp tae the east that sits near a known Shattered Hand encampment. We should start our search there, <sir/madame>.

I've already spoken to yer flight master about flyin' us out; every second counts.

passages.title: Attempted Murder
passages.text: Aye, these corpses are definitely fresh. They can't have gone far.

passages.title: Bread and Circuses
passages.text:
Hey, <mister/lady>, this crumb-bum won't let me in. Interested in some cold, hard cash?

My boss is promoting fights at the Ring of Trials. You look like you could hold your own.

You should go fight.

passages.title: Bread and Circuses
passages.text:
Hey there, bub. Lucy sent you? Good kid.

Yeah... you look like you'll do nicely.

passages.title: Bread and Circuses
passages.text:
Hey, <mister/lady>, this crumb-bum won't let me in. Interested in some cold, hard cash?

My boss is promoting fights at the Ring of Trials. You look like you could hold your own.

You should go fight.

passages.title: Bread and Circuses
passages.text:
Hey there, bub. Lucy sent you? Good kid.

Yeah... you look like you'll do nicely.

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text:
Their poison is more powerful than I thought. We need to find the orc responsible for making it.

Master assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one of their kills. It's a calling card; a claim to fame in their circles.

This was definitely the work of such an assassin.

We should split up and see if we can find some sign on one of the outcast corpses that will lead us to their creator. Rendezvous at the bottom of the hill, commander.

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text: Any luck? I couldn't find anything.

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text: What is it you found? Let me see that.

passages.title: The Gronn Strategy
passages.text:
Raz,

Your orders are to capture four additional gronn for weaponization.

Of your first group, only one survived the entire process.

One attacked our soldiers relentlessly and had to be put down. Another fell victim to a misfire while being fitted. Yet another rolled onto its cannons in its sleep. We're still cleaning up that mess.

Rest assured, your efforts are not in vain.

- Captain Brak

passages.title: The Gronn Strategy
passages.text: Weaponizing gronn? If they succeed...

passages.title: The Gronn Strategy
passages.text: This is grim news, <name>.

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text:
We need tae find the orc responsible fer makin' the poison tae make an antidote.

Master assassins always leave their mark somewhere on one o' their kills. It's a claim tae fame o' sorts. An' trust me, this was the work of a master assassin.

Let's split up and see if we can find some sign on one o' the outcast corpses that will lead us tae their killer. I'll meet ye at the bottom o' the hill, commander.

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text: Did ye find anything?

passages.title: Assassin's Mark
passages.text: What's that? Let me have a look.

passages.title: Nisha's Vengeance
passages.text:
Since I left on my last hunt, the Iron Horde have drawn nearer and reinforced their positions.

<A grin spreads across Rexxar's lips.>

They've created a target-rich environment.

I must continue nursing Nisha to health for now. You go in my stead, friend. Fill them with the fear and pain that they inflicted on her.

Make their screams fill the canyon!

passages.title: Nisha's Vengeance
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Nisha is nearly returned to health.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
passages.text:
This tooth is proof of your strength at slaying goren and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the tooth back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
passages.text: We are impressed with your ability to slay the goren. They are relentless and voracious and can overwhelm those are not prepared.

passages.title: Greblin Fastfizzle
passages.text:
I've been hanging here forever!

I was flying around, surveying the area for Nixxie when -- blamo! One of those stupid ogres throws a rock right at me!

My glider busted and here I am... and boy is this uncomfortable.

Help me down will ya? I'll make it worth your while.

passages.title: Greblin Fastfizzle
passages.text:
Ouch... my leg is still asleep, that smarts... Greblin Fastfizzle's my name, archeology's my game.

How can I help?

passages.title: Peckers the Majestic
passages.text:
You have done me a great service. This blade is as much yours as it is mine.

I offer you this blood oath: I shall serve your cause and lend my knowledge of blades and mining to your forces.

Will you accept it?

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
passages.text:
This tooth is proof of your strength at slaying goren and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the tooth back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Goren Tooth
passages.text: We are impressed with your ability to slay the goren. They are relentless and voracious and can overwhelm those are not prepared.

passages.title: Ogre Onslaught
passages.text:
Those ogres are standing in the way of a full Steamwheedle Preservation excavation.

They are brutal, violent, horrible smelling beasts. And if I'm being completely honest with myself, I'm pretty mad they broke my glider.

Do me a favor will ya? Wipe 'em off the face of Draenor.

It will make everyone's life easier, or at the very least, it will make my life easier.

passages.title: Ogre Onslaught
passages.text:
Oh, that's way better.

Maybe next time they'll think twice before they throw a rock at someone. Err... I mean if they weren't so dead and everything.

passages.title: Brokyo Beatdown
passages.text:
I'm almost done here, but I can't leave in good conscience.

I spotted an ogron named Brokyo that is wearing a priceless ring. Priceless as in crazy expensive.

I'm sure Nixxie will give me a promotion if I bring that ring back to her.

passages.title: Brokyo Beatdown
passages.text: Did you take care of Brokyo?

passages.title: Brokyo Beatdown
passages.text:
You got the ring? Nice! The Steamwheedle Preservation Society is going to make some serious moolah on this stuff.

Nixxie will be pleased.

passages.title: Assault on Darktide Roost
Assault on Darktide Roost
Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
passages.text:
Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society.

We've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area.

In fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week!

We aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
passages.text: You're looking for what now? I mean, yeah sure... whatever. Just get me down alright?

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text:
<The amorphous blob of arcane energy appears to be giving people a tour of your garrison.>

Commander <name>! I was sent here to summon you.

Archmage Khadgar has a very urgent favor to ask. He is gravely concerned about additional threats this world may hold for Azeroth, and he will need your assistance pursuing them. Please see him at his tower, east of Talador, in the Zangarra swamp.

This will not take long.

passages.title: Call of the Archmage
passages.text:
<The Archmage looks damp and uncomfortable.>

I apologize for the conditions here, <name>. I had no choice. I summoned this tower at the optimal confluence of arcane energies. My hope is to finish my work here before all my books get musty.

So then! Let's get to it.

passages.title: Core of Flame
passages.text:
Compared to Azeroth, Draenor is a young world. The primal forces that shaped and bent the land are still accessible - if you know where to look.

I need you to find for me a Core of Flame. The Bloodmaul Ogres have been known to use these to bend molten furies to their will, but you and I can find a much better use for one.

Enter the Bloodmaul Slag Mines and acquire one from Gug'rokk. He won't need it anymore after you kill him.

passages.title: Core of Flame
passages.text:
Have you been to the Slag Mines yet?

Honestly, who mines slag anyway? What do they do with it?

passages.title: Core of Flame
passages.text:
<Khadgar rolls the fiery orb back and forth between his hands.>

Do you know how to use this, <name>?

Me neither. Sometimes you just have to improvise as you go.

passages.title: Core of Iron
passages.text:
There's no point in getting a Core of Flame without any way to focus its power. Somehow, the goblins figured out how to do it - the technology is used in the "Iron Star" engines that the Iron Horde is using extensively throughout Draenor. We're gonna need the biggest engine core that we can find.

Our best bet is to derail one of their trains and crack open the engine compartment. I suggest a raid on the Grimrail Depot...

passages.title: Core of Iron
passages.text:
Did you get the engine core?

Ordinarily I wouldn't ask you to assault a fortified moving train - ah, no, that's not true. This is exactly the sort of thing I'm going to need from you. All the time.

passages.title: Core of Iron
passages.text:
Oh very good. I've been waiting to get a close look at one of these - let's open it up here.

Hmmmmm...

Well, those goblins aren't very creative but their methods have a certain brute-force charm to them. It's amazing this thing doesn't explode. Or maybe it does. At least I'm beginning to understand what they use a "samophlange" for.

This will work. Well done, <name>!

passages.title: Core of Life
passages.text:
Scrying for a living being is a very specific kind of magic, and if we want to search the whole of Draenor for Gul'dan, we're going to need a very powerful living reagent.

The answer lies with the plant life of Draenor itself. There is a creature known as a "genesaur" who is the closest we can get to the primordial creatures who shaped all life on this world.

One of our Kirin-Tor outposts has been overrun in Gorgrond, and a genesaur named "Yalnu" was spotted. Kill it, and bring its heart to me!

passages.title: Core of Life
passages.text: How fares the outpost? More importantly... where's my core of life?

passages.title: Core of Life
passages.text:
Oh - it's still alive! Can you feel that?

I must return this to the soil of Draenor when we are done with it. Perhaps in the care of the Cenarion Circle, who can ensure that it doesn't grow into another corrupted threat.

Well done, <name>. This was no easy feat.

passages.title: Tackling Teron'gor
passages.text:
I just received dark news from Exarch Maladaar that may be of use to us. Shadow Council agents have infiltrated Auchindoun! I guarantee Gul'dan's minions are behind this - likely Teron'gor, his right-hand orc.

Let's pull him from the chessboard, <name>. Kill Teron'gor!

Bring me a vial of his corrupt blood, and I can use it to track down other Shadow Council troublemakers... Including Gul'dan. Our prey will not be able to hide.

passages.title: Tackling Teron'gor
passages.text:
What news of Auchindoun? Are the spirits of the draenei safe?

Was I right about Teron'gor?

passages.title: Tackling Teron'gor
passages.text: We've done a great thing today, <name>. We've deprived Gul'dan of one of his top lieutenants and we're one step closer to finding the fiend himself.

passages.title: Eyes of the Archmage
passages.text: With the blood of Teron'gor and the crystals you collected for me, I should be able to zero in on our target. Step outside with me and I will begin my scrying spell. Speak with me to start - be ready for anything!

passages.title: Eyes of the Archmage
passages.text:
Gul'dan is countering my magic, <name>! He's hiding!

He's a crafty one, but we're craftier. I think I know a way to increase the power and range of my spell...

passages.title: Tarnished Bronze
passages.text:
That dead dragon's essence has seeped into the very fabric of this light-forsaken world. His spirit is also restless. If you and I are to claim what remains of his power, we're going to need to finish the job that Garrosh started.

I'm going to need to rely on your tactical combat expertise, commander. Would you prefer to go on the offensive, to fight defensively, or to heal us?

The decision is yours. Speak to me when you are ready, and the three of us will destroy Kairoz once and for all.

passages.title: Tarnished Bronze
passages.text:
<The archmage is out of breath.>

Give me - give me a moment. Pshew.

<name>, that was incredible! You are possibly the greatest <class> I've ever had the honor to fight alongside.

passages.title: Empire's Fall
passages.text:
The Ogre Sorcerer King, Imperator Mar'gok, has mastered magical techniques we would consider on the fringe of arcane science. His felbreakers, among others, can actively dampen or nullify magic. Even fel magic!

If we're to locate Gul'dan, we need to figure out how it's done. Acquire a felbreaker's tome from his felbreaker captain and acquire the sigil of the sorcerer king himself - I must know what he knows.

Yes, <name>, this means I expect you to storm Highmaul and defeat everyone inside. Get to it!

passages.title: Empire's Fall
passages.text: What have you found in Highmaul?

passages.title: Empire's Fall
passages.text:
The felbreaker's tome is blank? Let me see that. Did you get the Sorcerer King's sigil? Of course - see here, as you run the sigil over the page, runic lettering appears. Oh... this is really advanced.

It may take some time to fully comprehend what you've discovered, <name>, but these initial pages appear to be dedicated to the nature of fel. Exactly what I need! Great work!

passages.title: Fugitive Dragon
passages.text:
Ready to do some dragon hunting? A bronze dragon freed Garrosh Hellscream and took him to this world. His name is Kairozdormu, and he's a fugitive from Azeroth. It's time to track him down.

His essence permeates this entire timeline. If I could just get a hold of him - dead or alive! - I could re-calibrate my magic to this era of Draenor.

We'll need the help of a fellow bronze dragon. I'll find her and meet you in Nagrand. Let's rendezvous at the crossroads north of the Ring of Trials.

passages.title: Fugitive Dragon
passages.text:
<name>, Chromie here has offered to help track down our bronze fugitive.

She may look diminutive, but I assure you she is as old as a hundred of your lifetimes.

passages.title: The Scrying Game
passages.text:
We've learned everything we need from the ogres, <name>. Thanks to your efforts, I believe I can pierce the veil of secrecy that's cloaking Gul'dan.

I WILL find him, <class>.

Once my spell is finished we should be ready to leap into action. I won't begin until you let me know you're ready.

passages.title: The Scrying Game
passages.text:
Stabbed! He's been stabbed!

Why wasn't he more careful? We could've set up wards, we could've -

It doesn't matter now. We have to act fast.

passages.title: Hunter: Hunted
passages.text:
The weapon that stabbed the archmage was imbued with fel magic. He's slowly being poisoned!

<name>, we don't have any time. Khadgar will be dead in minutes. I need you to track down Garona before she gets away - find that murder weapon and maybe we can find a cure!

Follow the traces of fel energy she left behind. Track her down into the Zangarra lowlands and capture her with this Violet Hold Incarceration rune.

Hurry!

passages.title: Hunter: Hunted
passages.text: Why are you wasting time? Find Garona!

passages.title: Hunter: Hunted
passages.text: The Kirin-Tor responded quickly. Jaina was here in minutes. But if you hadn't located Garona, the Archmage would've died for certain. Thank you, <name>!

passages.title: Flamebender's Tome
passages.text:
The Iron Horde, and the Burning Blade clan in particular, have forged a unique relationship with Draenor's ancient elementals. They can work with iron and flame in ways that even I don't fully understand.

Yet.

<name>, slay the Burning Blade's highest-ranking artisan: Flamebender Ka'graz. She is down in the very heart of the Black Forge of the Blackrock Foundry, an area known as the Burning Font. If we're lucky, her secrets are codified in a Flamebender's Tome.

passages.title: Flamebender's Tome
passages.text: Do you have the Flamebender's Tome? Many legendary Burning Blade weapons owe their existence to this volume!

passages.title: Flamebender's Tome
passages.text:
Let me see what we have here... very interesting! This runic language here seems similar to the ignan kalimag dialect spoken by Azeroth's fire elementals. A full translation may take years.

But these parts written in orcish - yes, these I can probably decipher. Not just to bend steel, but to bend elemental power itself to our will.

Gul'dan may be powerful, but if we continue to unlock the mysteries of Draenor, we will be able to counter his every move...

passages.title: Reverse Piracy
passages.text:
<name>, during the attack on Karabor Iron Horde dreadnaughts looted or sank most of the draenei eastern fleet. A priceless artifact was captured: A genuine Draenic Thaumaturgical Orb.

I must have it! Those orcs don't know what they've got!

My sources indicate that the orb was aboard a ship that's being retrofitted down in the Dread Grotto beneath the Blackrock Foundry. Search the ship and the area nearby for the Sha'tari Vault that contained the orb. We've got to get it back!

passages.title: Reverse Piracy
passages.text: The orb! Tell me you've found the orb...?

passages.title: Reverse Piracy
passages.text:
You found it! I have heard stories of these orbs of power. How I craved to study them during my long exile in Outland. And now, at last, I have one. Show me...

<Reverently, Khadgar opens your pack and looks inside. His face remains motionless for a long time. Finally, he speaks:>

...I don't know what I expected.

passages.title: Blackhand's Secret
passages.text:
<name>, you've given me a lot to think about. There's a section of the Flamebender's Tome that speaks about a "sacrifice," and a more recent notation referring to "the chieftain." I think it's talking about Warlord Blackhand.

Did Blackhand sacrifice someone? Himself? A piece of himself? Is that why his hand is deformed?

Before I risk channeling these elements into a spell, I need to know. And there's only one way to find out.

Kill Warlord Blackhand. And bring me his severed arm.

passages.title: Blackhand's Secret
passages.text: Well <name>? Are you armed?

passages.title: Blackhand's Secret
passages.text:
What do we have here? The legends ARE true. Blackhand sacrificed his own arm to the elements. Now that he's dead, it's indistinguishable from stone. Or is it?

<Khadgar utters a few incantations from the Flamebinder's Tome. The severed hand slowly clenches into a fist.>

Hmmmm. Yes. <name>, I'll be perfectly honest with you: This thing is extremely creepy.

passages.title: Prisoner of the Mind
passages.text:
I'd had some time to compare the Flamebinder's tome with the elemental tablets you collected. Where it gets interesting is when I cross-reference the incantations you obtained from the ogre felbreakers... I can see I'm losing you. I will get to the point: I believe I can cast a spell that will nullify Gul'dan's mind control over his assassin Garona.

Mind-controlled or not, she may be dangerous, so I won't begin the spell until you're with me. Let me know when you're ready!

passages.title: Prisoner of the Mind
passages.text:
Gul'dan's magic is embedded deep within Garona's mind. The more time I spend with her, the more it becomes clear that we MUST free her from his control.

I am not giving up on this, <name>.

passages.title: We're Not Finished...
passages.text:
<name>, I'm going to have to hit the books and do more research to figure out how to locate Gul'dan or untangle his mind control of Garona. It's not glamorous, but the life of a mage is often spent in long hours of grueling study.

As for you, there's much to do. Ensure that your garrison is fully upgraded, locate the best possible equipment, and continue fighting the Iron Horde.

I will summon you when the next step of our journey is ready.

passages.title: We're Not Finished...
passages.text: My studies have gone well. I believe we are ready for the next step. You may not like it...

passages.title: Extrinsic Motivation
passages.text:
The Shattered Hand aren't strangers to pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign of their allegiance to Kargath.

If you're going to get them to talk, it might take more than my poison.

Slaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing to go for their beloved warlord.

passages.title: Extrinsic Motivation
passages.text: Excellent work.

passages.title: Extrinsic Motivation
passages.text:
The Shattered Hand are nae strangers tae pain. They each cut off their own hand as a sign o' their allegiance to Kargath.

If you're going tae get the information we need, it might take more than my poison.

Slaughter them all. We'll see how far they're willing tae go fer their beloved warlord.

passages.title: Extrinsic Motivation
passages.text: They got what's comin' to 'em.

passages.title: Gardul Venomshiv
passages.text:
We need to take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element of surprise on our side. We need it to craft the antidote. This may be our only opportunity.

If what you learned is true, his camp is just south of here. You take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.

Let's get moving.

passages.title: Gardul Venomshiv
passages.text: We won't let him get away.

passages.title: Gardul Venomshiv
passages.text:
We need tae take out Gardul and take his poison recipe while we still have the element o' surprise on our side. We need the recipe tae figure out the antidote. This may be our only opportunity.

If what ye learned is true, his camp is just south of here. Ye take him down, and I'll make sure none of his guards interfere.

passages.title: Gardul Venomshiv
passages.text: We won't let him get away.

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text:
We have Gardul right where we want him, commander.

You're far more equipped to face him than I am. Dispose of him, take his formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels of poison as you can.

I'll guard this ramp and make sure no reinforcements come to his aid.

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text: Do you have everything we need?

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text: Excellent. I have a ride back to your outpost ready.

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text:
We have Gardul right cornered, commander.

Ye have a much better chance against him than me. Take him out, grab the formula from his corpse, and grab as many barrels o' poison as ye can carry.

I'll stay here and make sure nae reinforcements come to Gardul's aid.

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text: I don't want to stick around here any longer than we need to.

passages.title: We Have Him Now
passages.text: Perfect work. I called in a ride for ye back to the outpost when yer ready.

passages.title: A Worthy Vessel
passages.text:
The time has come, adventurer.

Awaken the Talon King from his long slumber. Call him into this world so that he may destroy our enemies!

passages.title: A Worthy Vessel
passages.text: You fight well.

passages.title: [Deprecated] Ogron Boss
passages.text:
Alright, I'm outta here. What? Oh now you want me to help you? Sheesh, alright fine.

A goblin named Ganky came through here just a bit ago. She tried to help me down but she was too short, and in a massive hurry. She said something about stopping Azuki? Azukah? I'm pretty sure it was a name that started with "az".

Anyway, Ganky ran toward the top of the Broken Precipice. Bad timing if you ask me. The ogres and ogron are in some kind of civil war. I'd be careful if I were you.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
passages.text:
This horn is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the horn back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
passages.text: It is hard to admit that there is a creature more brutal than an ogre, but the ogron definitely fit that description. Facing a captured ogron in the arena is no mean feat. Facing one in their own lair is something even more dangerous. Hail to thee champion!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
passages.text:
This horn is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the horn back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ogron Horn
passages.text: There is a creature more brutal than an ogre. Facing a captured ogron in the arena is no mean feat. Facing one in their own lair is something even more dangerous. I like your style.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
passages.text:
This scale is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the scale back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
passages.text: A gladiator saw you tear this off the back of a gronnling, which I am sure did not part with it easily. It is more like a stone than a true scale though as these brutes are part stone it seems. Not an easy trophy to collect!

passages.title: A Hero's Welcome
passages.text: You have arrived in Frostfire Ridge. Farseer Drek'Thar can guide you from here.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
passages.text:
This scale is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the scale back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronnling Scale
passages.text: A gladiator saw you tear this off the back of a gronnling, which I am sure did not part with it easily. It is more like a stone than a true scale though as these brutes are part stone it seems. Not an easy trophy to collect!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronn Eye
passages.text:
This eye is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the eye back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronn Eye
passages.text: A gronn's eye is not something they part with alive. Your gladiator described a fight hard won and this trophy is a testament to your abilities.  Well done!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronn Eye
passages.text:
This eye is proof of your strength at slaying ogron and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the eye back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Gronn Eye
passages.text: A gronn's eye is not something they part with alive. Your gladiator described a fight hard won and this trophy is a testament to your abilities.  Well done!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Botani Bloom
passages.text:
This bloom is proof of your strength at slaying botani and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the bloom back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Botani Bloom
passages.text: The botani are nothing to be trifled with. They are incredibly cunning and their powers are strong on their home land. Taking one of their blooms is an true example of your fighting skill!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Botani Bloom
passages.text:
This bloom is proof of your strength at slaying botani and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the bloom back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Botani Bloom
passages.text: The botani are nothing to be trifled with. They are incredibly cunning and their powers are strong on their home land. Taking one of their blooms is an true example of your fighting skill!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Orc Thorn
passages.text:
This thorn is proof of your strength at slaying the infested and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the thorn back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Orc Thorn
passages.text: The infested appear to be mere husks animated by plant life. They are slow but very strong. Slaying even one is a strong demonstration of your own skill!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Orc Thorn
passages.text:
This thorn is proof of your strength at slaying the infested and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the thorn back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Orc Thorn
passages.text: Sometimes we don't get turned into mulch for the jungle.  Sometimes we get back up, filled with plants. The Infested are hard to kill. Slaying even one is a strong demonstration of your own skill!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ancient Branch
passages.text:
This branch is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the branch back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ancient Branch
passages.text: Ancients here tend to be guardians and tenders, but that does not make them any less dangerous. An enraged ancient is something to be behold. Taking a branch from one is a worthy deed!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ancient Branch
passages.text:
This branch is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the branch back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ancient Branch
passages.text: Ancients here tend to be guardians and tenders, but that does not make them any less dangerous. An enraged ancient is something to be behold. Taking a branch from one is a worthy deed!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ravager Claw
passages.text:
This claw is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the claw back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ravager Claw
passages.text: Even the insects of Gorgrond are larger and meaner than other parts of the world I have been to! Killing them, which you have obviously done, takes a great deal of strength and skill.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ravager Claw
passages.text:
This claw is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the claw back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Ravager Claw
passages.text: Even the insects of Gorgrond are larger and meaner than other parts of the world I have been to! Killing them, which you have obviously done, takes a great deal of strength and skill.

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Wasp Stinger
passages.text:
This stinger is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the stinger back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Wasp Stinger
passages.text: As you can see, the venom Gorgrond wasps have is extremely powerful. To face one is to possibly face your own death. I would refrain from harvesting more of these, one enough to prove your strength here!

passages.title: Building for Professions
passages.text: I see that you have acquired the blueprints for a profession building! Use the Architect Table to build in a small plot.

passages.title: Building for Professions
passages.text: How is it coming along?

passages.title: Building for Professions
passages.text: Congratulations!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Wasp Stinger
passages.text:
This stinger is proof of your strength at slaying ancients and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the stinger back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Wasp Stinger
passages.text: As you can see, the venom Gorgrond wasps have is extremely powerful. To face one is to possibly face your own death. I would refrain from harvesting more of these, one enough to prove your strength here!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Basilisk Scale
passages.text:
This scale is proof of your strength at slaying basilisks and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the scale back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Basilisk Scale
passages.text: A gruesome trophy from a gruesome beast. To be frozen and eaten slowly is not a death I would choose. The world is better with less of these basilisks in it!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Basilisk Scale
passages.text:
This scale is proof of your strength at slaying basilisks and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the scale back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Basilisk Scale
passages.text: A gruesome trophy from a gruesome beast. To be frozen and eaten slowly is not a death I would choose. The world is better with less of these basilisks in it!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
passages.text:
This crystal is proof of your strength at slaying elementals and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the crystal back to Jonaa and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
passages.text: I have seen no elementals elsewhere in Draenor that compare in ferocity to those in Gorgrond. I wonder what caused them to be so angry. That crystal was hard-won I am sure!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
passages.text:
This crystal is proof of your strength at slaying elementals and your gladiator friend has born witness!

Take the crystal back to Limbflayer and claim your accolades!

passages.title: Proof of Strength: Elemental Crystal
passages.text: I have seen no elementals elsewhere in Draenor that compare in ferocity to those in Gorgrond. I wonder what caused them to be so angry. That crystal was hard-won I am sure!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
passages.text:
Hey there! You're the commander of this keep, right? I represent the Steamwheedle Preservation Society.

We've been trying to get a very important excavation up and running in Nagrand. Unfortunately, we've had trouble with ogres in the area.

In fact, one of our best preservationists recently went missing while surveying the area. He's the third society member we've lost up there this week!

We aren't really equipped for a rescue mission... so whad'ya say? We could really use the help.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Broken Precipice
passages.text: You're looking for what now? I mean, yeah sure... whatever. Just get me down alright?

passages.title: Welcome to Ashran
passages.text:
Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. 

Report to Commander Anne Dunworthy in Stormshield for your briefing.

passages.title: Welcome to Ashran
passages.text: You've just now showed up? Well, better late than never.

passages.title: Reporting For Duty
passages.text: Front and center, <name>! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.

passages.title: Reporting For Duty
passages.text: Yes yes, it's the real Harrison Jones. Why is he such a celebrity all of a sudden?

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
passages.text: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the icespine stingers you brought me. Use it to catch the Zangar eels in these coastal waters.

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
passages.text: Catch those eels?

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
passages.text: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.

passages.title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
passages.text: You have proven your worth, traveler. Now take this frostwolf fishing journal back to your garrison and study up. You will be catching all you can eat in no time.

passages.title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
passages.text: We can use that as bait?!

passages.title: Anglin' In Our Garrison
passages.text: Look at all the bait ideas in this thing! Great job <name>!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
passages.text:
We've tracked Warlord Bladefury and the stolen artifact to the salt fields of western Gorgrond.

Thisalee Crow will meet you there with an advance scouting team.

The entire garrison is on high alert. We must be ready to intercept the enemy if necessary.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
passages.text: This isn't looking good.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
passages.text: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, <name>.

passages.title: Rosa is bad
passages.text: Text

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
passages.text:
We've tracked Warlord Bladefury an' da stolen artifact ta northern Gorgrond.

Choluna be dere wit a scouting team.

I got dey entire garrison on high alert. Go, meet wit her, and intercept da enemy if necessary.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Awakening
passages.text: I've never seen a magnaron of that size before. This is bad, <name>.

passages.title: Icespine Stingers
passages.text:
I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior.

The canyon north of us is full of icespine stingers. Slaughter them and bring their stingers back to me. They should work well as bait in these local waters.

passages.title: Icespine Stingers
passages.text: Have those stingers for me?

passages.title: Icespine Stingers
passages.text: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.

passages.title: [PH] Lumber Mill Rank 01 Alliance
passages.text: [PH] FIND TIMBER

passages.title: [PH] Lumber Mill Rank 02 Alliance
passages.text: [PH] FIND TIMBER

passages.title: [PH] Lumber Mill Rank 03 Alliance
passages.text: [PH] FIND TIMBER

passages.title: Spires of the Betrayer
passages.text:
I have much to ask of you, <name>, but before we begin I must ensure that you develop yourself to your full potential. I can help.

I'd like to create a link between us, an artifact that will enhance your power and allow me to track your progress. How do you feel about amulets? No? A ring? I've got it.

My contacts among the arakkoa outcasts tell of a band of pure solium. Right now it's in the talons of High Sage Viryx high atop Skyreach. Bring me that ring, <name> - you and I have much better uses for it.

passages.title: Spires of the Betrayer
passages.text:
The arakkoa we see today are a shade of their former glory. They hide atop their spires and glower at the land below, smug and superior. The truth is that they were driven to their lofty perches by the very enemies they look down on today.

I wish the arakkoa were easier to deal with. Their manipulation of the sun's rays could've been an asset to us.

passages.title: Spires of the Betrayer
passages.text:
The ring! You've got it. Feel how it's still warm to the touch? The power of Draenor's sun is locked into the metal. This is perfect, <name>. It is exactly the base material we need to fashion into something amazing.

While I prepare your treasure, let's talk about our next steps...

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
passages.text:
These feelings are too strong. I can no longer hide my love away.

I need to tell Thorn the truth. I need to tell Thorn, I love her.

She mentioned her favorite flower is a rose. I've been so heads down with my work... I don't even know where I could find a rose on Draenor.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
passages.text: We are under attack!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
passages.text:
Commander! The Burning Blade attacked just a few moments ago, they are looking for the Heart of Gorgorek. 

Thankfully, Lieutenant Thorn was here to protect us.

What? You found a rose? Shh, hand it to me quickly. I'll hold onto this until the time to confess my love is right.

passages.title: Where There Is Smoke...
passages.text: Burning Blade assassins have infiltrated the garrison. We must not let them take the Heart of Gorgorek, commander.

passages.title: Where There Is Smoke...
passages.text:
The assassin appeared out of nowhere.

Baros took the blade that was meant for my heart. I ripped out the throat of our attacker... but I was too late.

Baros gave me this flower before he passed.

<Thorn holds up the rose. A tear rolls down her cheek.>

passages.title: A Stolen Heart
passages.text: Don't let Azuka take the heart, commander. Don't let her win.

passages.title: A Stolen Heart
passages.text: Today was not a good day.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Exarch's Call
passages.text:
Ahhh, just the <race> I were hopin' ta see, my dear.

Yrel stopped by the garrison earlier lookin' fer ya. Such a lovely lass, that one! Asked me all about ma family back home when I be feelin' homesick. Bless her. Anyway, what were I goin' on about ag'in?

Oh! She asked if ye'd meet her at Elodor to the east.

She's been invited by the draenei council ta face the Exarch trials, whatever those may be.

Anyway, ye'd better scooch!

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Exarch's Call
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>.

passages.title: The Trial of Courage
passages.text:
An Exarch must be a pillar of strength, and no greater strength is there than the courage to face danger.

Far to the northwest, among the snowy crags of Frostfire Ridge, lives a primal fury named Everburn.

Only when you face one of these creatures eye to eye, will you know the extent of your courage.

passages.title: The Trial of Courage
passages.text:
I see that you and Yrel have stared into the eyes of the most primal of the elementals, and not waivered from your path.

It pleases me to say that your courage is not lacking.

Well done.

passages.title: No Time to Waste
passages.text:
Commander, we're in luck. The antidote recipe is fairly simple.

I was able to make a small amount with what I had on me. You should take it to Lunzul before it's too late. It should keep her alive long enough for me to make more.

passages.title: No Time to Waste
passages.text: <Lunzul grumbles incoherently.>

passages.title: No Time to Waste
passages.text: By da spirits... me head be hurtin'...

passages.title: The Trial of Champions
passages.text:
The first three trials you have passed with flying colors.

For the final trial, you shall face the Exarch Council.

Speak to me when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: The Trial of Champions
passages.text: Well done, champion. Well done.

passages.title: [Deprecated] Put out the Fires
passages.text: (PH)I need a gift for thorn! A rose style gift.

passages.title: Unwanted Pests
passages.text:
Those creatures out in the shallows keep busting the turrets as fast as we can get them operational.

I'm supposed to go clear them out but my blaster is completely busted; the damn thing barely can light a candle like this!

Could you do me a favor and go kill a few of those pests while I get my blaster fixed at the shop?

Just let Gazwitz know you covered for me so I can get reimbursed for the repair.

passages.title: Unwanted Pests
passages.text:
Lemmy's gun broke down again I take it?

Good job covering for 'em out there. I could use more workers like you!

passages.title: Fair Trade
passages.text:
Alright. Here you go.

Be sure to deliver them to Garaal quickly. He has a heavy interest in detail and fine craftsmanship. He'll surely appreciate your work.

passages.title: Fair Trade
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

Fanara mentioned the competition was fierce this year.

My, my. These goods should keep me busy for an entire season!

As the victor of the competition one usually becomes my apprentice, however, your skills are surely in need of no apprenticeship.

Perhaps a trade is in order.

I'll keep your delivery and share the goods with our local craftsmen and in return, I'll share some of our knowledge with you.

passages.title: Moving On Up
passages.text:
A generous decision, <name>.

You have demonstrated your skills as a hunter, delivered a piece worthy of your name and proven your dedication to your craft. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

May the light guide your hand and passion, your heart.

passages.title: An Act of Kindness
passages.text:
I know that you and Vindicator Yrel are here on important matters, but I must ask you a favor.

A squad of rangari left on patrol just before the poisonous mist set in.

If they were caught out in the swamp, they are surely in trouble.

Harvest the Restorative Goldcaps growing among the reeds, and use them to restore any fallen rangari that you find.

If you find yourself in trouble, eat one to combat the poison.

passages.title: An Act of Kindness
passages.text: Were you able to find the others?

passages.title: An Act of Kindness
passages.text: Thank the Light! All of the rangari who were missing have returned accounted for. Thank you, hero.

passages.title: Welcome to Ashran
passages.text:
Greetings, and welcome to Ashran. 

Report to General Ushet Wolfbarger in Warspear for your orders.

passages.title: Welcome to Ashran
passages.text: You've just now showed up? Well, better late than never.

passages.title: Reporting For Duty
passages.text: Front and center, <name>! No time to waste, go speak with these fellows and they'll fill you in.

passages.title: Reporting For Duty
passages.text: Yea, that Zurge really is angry isn't he?

passages.title: Moonshell Claws
passages.text:
I will help you, but you are going to need to prove to me that you are not only a worthy fisherman, but also a fearless warrior.

The beach southeast of us is full of moonshell crawlers. Slaughter them and bring their claws back to me. They should work well as bait in these local waters.

passages.title: Moonshell Claws
passages.text: Have those claws for me?

passages.title: Moonshell Claws
passages.text: Not bad traveler, not bad at all.

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
