passages.text: Now that you have proven yourself as a warrior, let's see how your fishing skills hold up. I have fashioned a bait out of the moonshell claws you brought me. Use it to catch the shadow sturgeon in these coastal waters.

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
passages.text: Catch those sturgeon?

passages.title: Proving Your Worth
passages.text: I see you are both a fisherman and a warrior.  I will do what I can to help you.

passages.title: The Fractured Hammer
passages.text:
It is obvious that this elaborate smithing hammer has seen better days.

Now fractured and dirty, it is merely a shadow of its former self.

One thing is certain, its previous owner was neither ogre nor Iron Horde.

Perhaps someone at Stonefang Outpost would know who this belongs to.

passages.title: The Fractured Hammer
passages.text: What do you want, <race>?

passages.title: The Fractured Hammer
passages.text: My father's hammer, where did you find this!?

passages.title: The Dragon's Tale
passages.text:
Chromie thinks she's picked up the trail. We suspect that Garrosh traveled through here when he first arrived on Draenor. But what about Kairoz? He must be close.

Chromie will illuminate the clues. Look for a series of temporal anomalies. Follow the trail east of here and pick your way up to the top of the mountains until we've located Kairozdormu... or his body. Good luck!

passages.title: The Dragon's Tale
passages.text:
That solves one riddle. The moment they arrived in Draenor, Garrosh killed his savior.

He left the job unfinished; The dragon's spirit is still restless.

I hope you're ready for a fight.

passages.title: What's Under There?
passages.text:
It is done.

With this enchantment, not only can you roam amongst the goren freely, but you can move as they do.

Your travels through the canyon are now made easier. You have safe access to places otherwise impossible to reach.

Perhaps these tunnels will lead to more information that could be used against the Iron Horde.

passages.title: What's Under There?
passages.text: That goren disguise smells awful.

passages.title: What's Under There?
passages.text: Your search brought rewards?

passages.title: Hard Shell
passages.text:
I have already learned much from watching the Laughing Skull.

Traveling through goren tunnels was thought to be impossible due to the acid they leave behind, but the orcs found a way around it.

We will need some of the shells of goren within the canyon.

If you see any of their tunnel craters ready to burst, approach them and goren will come pouring out. This way, you can kill many at once and find the shells more quickly.

passages.title: Hard Shell
passages.text: Goren seem willing to eat anything in their path, alive or otherwise.

passages.title: Hard Shell
passages.text: Ah, yes, these shells will work perfectly.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text:
Hey Champ,

You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in?

Who am I kidding, who wouldn't be interested in fame, fortune, and brawlin'? I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.

passages.title: How Tough Are You?
passages.text:
Mogor's holding a special match over at the Ring of Blood to crown the new Blood Champion and I think you have what it takes!

Now, these ogres respect one thing and one thing only: badass...ness. They have a big fella at the front door making sure only the toughest gladiators enter the proving grounds.

If you're in, kill the grizzled gladiator Lug'dol at the tower just up the road and present his head to Kroggol the Wall. That oughta show 'em what you're made of.

passages.title: How Tough Are You?
passages.text: Nobody gets in da proving grounds unless I say so.

passages.title: How Tough Are You?
passages.text:
If you kill Lug'dol, you definitely belong in da proving grounds.

I don't even care that you tiny not ogre!

passages.title: Entry Fee
passages.text:
You looking for da Ring of Blood? HAH! That good one. Not just anybody able to compete in da ring. You gotta pay the entry fee: fifty blood marks.

How do you get them? Oh, tiny one, you killing me!

<Kroggol hands you a small stone caked in blood.>

Dat one is yours. You kill others in da proving grounds to get da rest. Take dem to Wodin da troll servant by Mogor when you done.

Don't talk to Mogor, though. Mogor da boss.

passages.title: Entry Fee
passages.text: Don't be wastin' my time, <race>. What business do you be havin' with Mogor?

passages.title: Entry Fee
passages.text: You? Fightin' ta be da Blood Champion? Hmm.

passages.title: The Champion of Blood
passages.text:
You have da blood stones required as proof of your worth. Hmm. Yes, you might be da champion Mogor be lookin' for.

You be one of only two to complete da blood stone trial. Da two of ya be fightin' for da glory of becoming Blood Champion.

Speak to Gurgthock and we be seein' if you be a champion... or just another stain on da arena floor.

passages.title: The Champion of Blood
passages.text: Only da very best be havin' a chance at bein' da Blood Champion, mon.

passages.title: The Champion of Blood
passages.text: You did it, mon! I never thought I'd be seein' such a fight!

passages.title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
passages.text:
The ogron possess something of value to the Iron Horde. I am sure they're unaware, likely just bored and in need of something to torture.

We could simply leave them to their fate, but we should follow up on this clue. With any luck, it will help us stop the Iron Horde from turning Gorgrond's most fearsome creatures into weapons.

Try to find Corporal Thukmar and his notes.

passages.title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
passages.text: Again you've done well, friend.

passages.title: Leave Every Soldier Behind
passages.text: We have the notes. Let us see what they reveal about our enemy's strategy.

passages.title: The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring
passages.text:
The different sections of the tome describe tailoring techniques that seem strange compared to traditional methods.

The author's name does not appear anywhere in the tome. Maybe someone in your garrison knows more about the book's origins.

passages.title: The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring
passages.text: What have you there, child?

passages.title: The Cryptic Tome of Tailoring
passages.text:
It seems that you have found a very special tailoring book.

It belongs to Ameeka, a tailor of great renown from Embaari Village.

passages.title: A Mysterious Satchel
passages.text:
An empty satchel with an old, magical aura.

It appears quite dilapidated, with remnants of herbs and mushrooms along the inner lining. Perhaps exploring Umbrafen will offer a clue.

passages.title: A Mysterious Satchel
passages.text:
Oh, my. One of my satchels! Where did you find this? I lost it weeks ago.

I've been so busy training I forgot to collect herbs for Master Ardule. I need your help <name>, if you are willing, but I must warn you - the herbs can be quite dangerous!

Hand me the satchel and I'll restore the protective inscription to guard you from harmful toxins.

passages.title: The Power of Preservation
passages.text:
The ink is very precious to our people. It has the ability to preserve ancient texts.

Master Ardule can explain further. He's just inside.

passages.title: The Power of Preservation
passages.text:
My, <name>. Your delivery...

I don't know how to thank you enough.

This is a substantial amount of ink. You've helped ensure our history for generations to come.

Perhaps I can repay you with a taste of the very knowledge you've helped preserve?

passages.title: Where There Is Smoke...
passages.text:
You garrison is under attack by the Burning Blade!

Kill the Burning Blade masters that are leading the assault and report back to Warmaster Zog.

passages.title: Where There Is Smoke...
passages.text: I knew it was only a matter of time before Azuka would make her move.

passages.title: A Stolen Heart
passages.text:
This invasion is clearly an attempt to seize the Heart of Gorgorek.

We need to fortify our guard before it's too late!

passages.title: A Stolen Heart
passages.text: Azuka's reign of terror continues... we need a new plan.

passages.title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
passages.text:
A powerful enchantment emanates from these ancient Highmaul bracers.

Maybe Yu'rina the Mystic, your garrison enchanting quartermaster, can tell you more about the bracer.

passages.title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
passages.text:
Interesting, an Arakkoa recently visited the garrison looking for an armor piece with a powerful enchantment like this. His name was Delath.

The enchantment on this bracer is beyond my skill, but perhaps this Delath can give you the necessary insight to replicate it.

passages.title: Failed Apprentice
passages.text:
Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his scepter to the field you see before us. 

As you can see, the scepter's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Torag Stonefury, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but he failed and became trapped in ice. 

Free Torag, take the ring, and complete his task, and I will consider a reward.

passages.title: Failed Apprentice
passages.text: Thank you. I thought I was going to be stuck here forever.

passages.title: Oru'kai's Scepter
passages.text:
If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Wor'gol. 

Here, take this ring. The bird man told me to use the ring on the scepter to nullify the enchantment.

Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.

passages.title: Oru'kai's Scepter
passages.text: Do you have it? Give it to me.

passages.title: Oru'kai's Scepter
passages.text:
Yes... This is it, after so many years. Soon, I will have all of the Armaments of Oru'kai.

Return my ring as well and I will fulfill the promise I made to that squeamish orc. 

Take this book. If you have any skill, you can use it to decipher and learn Draenor's enchantments. 

Of course, you will need a proper workplace as well. Here are plans; hopefully you can follow them.

Now, be gone, and steer clear of the other armaments, for they are mine.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: Missing Grunt
passages.text:
With the Heart of Gorgorek residing inside the garrison walls, we need to stay vigilant. The Burning Blade are known for attacking swiftly, and without warning.

I have a number of grunts patrolling the keep. Dul'zak, one of our newer recruits, should have reported back by now.

passages.title: A Strengthened Bond
passages.text:
This entire time... I have been so consumed with my own grief.

I never once stopped to consider how much my father was suffering at the hands of our enemies.

Thank you so much <class> for helping him to return to me. Please, allow me to repair his hammer.

In exchange for everything you have done for us, I will teach you whatever you wish to know.

passages.title: Hexcloth
passages.text:
I shall now impart to you the finer points of creating hexcloth.

The process is quite simple. It involves immersing carefully woven fur into the ichor drawn from Gorgrond Flytraps.

Normally, you would need to harvest it yourself, but I actually managed to liberate some from the Shadowmoon during their last raid.

You are welcome to use it.

passages.title: Hexcloth
passages.text: Were you successful, friend?

passages.title: Hexcloth
passages.text:
This is perfect! The cloth and magic are perfectly balanced and stable.

I am happy to say that you have learned the basics of my tailoring methods. I respect your skill and your eagerness to learn new techniques.

Let me give you some other patterns and materials that I hope you find useful during your journey.

passages.title: Whacking Weeds
passages.text:
Something needs to be done about the podling menace in Spiteleaf Thicket!

Alongside Hemet Nesingwary, I've hunted some of the largest and most terrifying beasts around. Never in my life have I encountered a creature as vile, depraved, nefarious or degenerate as a podling!

The vicious little monsters spread themselves like weeds and if something isn't done, they'll spread across the entire continent!

Make your way into Spiteleaf Thicket and slay as many podlings as you can find!

passages.title: Whacking Weeds
passages.text:
Great work, <name>.

I'm surprised we made it out of Spiteleaf Thicket alive! I can still hear the sound of their maniacal laughter as they swarmed us....

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text:
Hey Champ,

You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in?

You're the one that brought a new meaning to pain at the Ring of Trials not too long ago, right? This is the next step in your climb to fame! You've gotta get down here.

I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text:
Hey Champ,

You were out when I stopped by. I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in?

If you think the Stonemaul arena was a thrill, this is way, way bigger than that. It's going to be HUGE, I'm calling it now.

I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text:
Hey Champ,

You were out when I stopped by. You're the talk of the arena, friend! I mean, the Ring of Trials? Stonemaul? You're killing it out there!

I've got a sweet gig set up at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand. Lots of ogres looking for the next big fight. Big money. You in?

I'll meet you at my stash so we can talk a bit in private before your big debut.

<A map is included with a dollar sign scrawled on an abandoned ogre tower.>

passages.title: Garrison Campaign: The Ring of Blood
passages.text: I won't waste your time, champ. I've got a once in a lifetime opportunity for you.

passages.title: A Fascinating Fungus
passages.text:
The Zangar Shore is home to many peculiar strains of fungi, some of which are similar to those of our native Azeroth. However, one strain in particular is most fascinating!

I call it "Zangarium Draenormycota," due to its prevelance in Draenor's fungal ecosystem. This unique strain of fungus is highly adaptable and can be found on many of the living organisms throughout Zangar Shore.

Why does it exist? What properties does it hold?

To answer these questions, I will need additional spore samples.

passages.title: A Fascinating Fungus
passages.text: Have you collected the spore samples for my research?

passages.title: A Fascinating Fungus
passages.text:
You have the spore samples for my research! Excellent!

The Zangar Shore is a dangerous place... what with the risk of fungal mutation and all.

Oh... I didn't mention that part before? I was sure I did!

No matter! You look hardy enough, I'm sure your genes are impervious to foreign fungal strains that your body has never before encountered!

passages.title: Dirgemire
passages.text:
In order to fully understand the nature and properties of the Zangarium Draenormycota, I need to examine the strain within a complex fungal structure. The fungal brain of a spore giant would do nicely.

Not just any spore giant will serve though, it needs to be big... mean... primordial... the perfect specimen!

In a cavern deep below the surface is an ancient spore giant the locals fearfully refer to as Dirgemire. Slay the monster, but be sure to carefully preserve the fungal brain for our research!

passages.title: Dirgemire
passages.text: Without a fungal brain to examine, the mysteries of the Zangar ecosystem will remain unsolved!

passages.title: Dirgemire
passages.text:
I see you've retrieved Dirgemire's fungal brain!

Not only is the fungal structure perfectly intact, as a specimen it is exquisite! I will need only a moment to begin the examination...

passages.title: Transponder 047-B
passages.text:
The back of the transponder is etched in scribbled writing.

<URGENT: If found, please return to Goggles near Eledor. It is of the utmost importance!>

passages.title: Transponder 047-B
passages.text:
Oh my! What do we have here, commander?

<Inspecting the transponder.>

A little damaged, slightly bent and burnt to a crisp, but this is my lucky day!

We've been testing a new device and this transponder carries invaluable information! I'll have Bixx extract the coordinates for mapping.

Just a few more parts and I should be able to teleport anything across this entire valley! And I do mean anything!

That'll surely help our reinforcements stand against the Iron Horde!

passages.title: Out of the Shadows
passages.text:
Congratulations again, Blood Champion. You be fightin' like nobody I ever seen.

While you were in da ring, one ayour bruddas came by and asked for you ta return ta your base. He called himself Bodrick Grey.

passages.title: Out of the Shadows
passages.text: We'll need to keep an eye on this Azuka Bladefury character. Sounds dangerous.

passages.title: Out of the Shadows
passages.text:
Congratulations, Blood Champion. You be fightin' like nobody I ever seen.

While you were in da ring, one a your bruddas came by and asked for you ta return ta your base. He called himself a shadow hunter.

passages.title: Out of the Shadows
passages.text: We best be keepin' an eye on dis Azuka Bladefury. She be bad news.

passages.title: Investigating the Invasion
passages.text:
I'm going to lead a small squad behind enemy lines.

Meet me by Dreadmaul, <class>. From there we can decide our next course of action.

passages.title: Investigating the Invasion
passages.text: Glad you made it, <name>. It's time to start pushing back on this Iron Horde invasion.

passages.title: It's Gotta Work!
Phylarch the Evergreen
passages.text: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]

passages.title: Phylarch the Evergreen
passages.text:
For tens of thousands of years we Botani have clashed against the mightiest forces of this world, but none have had your unbridled ferocity and resilience.

I... I concede to your battle prowess. I will aid you in your campaign for dominance of my world.

If you will accept me.

passages.title: Trega's Tailoring Kit
passages.text:
The bag is filled with patterns and unfamiliar tailoring tools. You find the name "Trega" embroidered on the inside of the bag.

You seem to recall seeing her in Wor'gol. With any luck, she's still there.

passages.title: Trega's Tailoring Kit
passages.text: That's my sewing kit! I never thought I would see this again.

passages.title: Trega's Tailoring Kit
passages.text: I was chased by ogres and had to leave my bag behind. It looks like almost everything is here, except for... oh, no!

passages.title: Investigating the Invasion
passages.text:
I'm going to lead a small squad behind enemy lines.

Meet me by Dreadmaul, <class>. From there we can decide our next course of action.

passages.title: Investigating the Invasion
passages.text: Glad you made it, <name>. It's time to start pushing back on this Iron Horde invasion.

passages.title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
passages.text:
A powerful enchantment emanates from these ancient Highmaul bracers.

Maybe Eileese Shadowsong, your garrison enchanting quartermaster, can tell you more about the bracer.

passages.title: Enchanted Highmaul Bracer
passages.text:
Interesting, an Arakkoa recently visited the garrison looking for an armor piece with a powerful enchantment like this. His name was Delath.

The enchantment on this bracer is beyond my skill, but perhaps this Delath can give you the necessary insight to replicate it.

passages.title: The Strength of Iron
passages.text:
A stitched patch along the side of the satchel clearly identifies its owner.

You remember hearing stories of a great blacksmith just north of Embaari.

passages.title: The Strength of Iron
passages.text:
This... this is my satchel... but how?

Did you see a boy - a young boy near this? You must tell me where you found it!

I tried to fight them, but the looters... they were too strong! They almost killed me!

Please, please....

I'd give anything to have my only son back! I cannot fail him....

passages.title: Father and Son
passages.text:
Please find my boy!

Before the looters came we were on the hill just northeast of here.

There weren't many of them, but I'm a blacksmith, not a fighter!

Have I let my only son down?

passages.title: Father and Son
passages.text:
My boy!

<A tear falls down his cheek, clearing a path down to the skin where soot once rested.>

You... no words can explain how grateful I am.

I can only repay what I have to offer, which isn't much in terms of valued goods. Most of my work goes straight to our soldiers.  I do, however, carry the wisdom of my people and my craft.

It would be an honor if you allowed me to share some of this wisdom with you.

May the light guide you, <name>.

passages.title: Failed Apprentice
passages.text:
Oru'kai was the first ogre mage to master the art of enchanting on Draenor. Upon his death, his items were scattered across Draenor. I have tracked his staff to the shore you see before us. 

As you can see, the staff's enchantment is making it difficult to retrieve. A would-be apprentice, Deema, took one of Oru'kai's rings in to break the enchantment, but she failed and became trapped as well. 

Find and free Deema, take the ring, complete her task, and I will consider a reward.

passages.title: Failed Apprentice
passages.text: Thank you. I thought I was going to be stuck here forever.

passages.title: The Intricate Pendant
passages.text:
The crimson gem used in this pendant is unlike any you've seen before, and the filigree wrapped around it is masterfully crafted.

There's likely to be much you can learn from the person who made this. Perhaps someone at your garrison will recognize the work.

passages.title: The Intricate Pendant
passages.text: Why hello <name>, what do we have here?

passages.title: The Intricate Pendant
passages.text: Please, allow me to take a closer look.

passages.title: Oru'kai's Staff
passages.text:
If I had known being an enchanter was this dangerous, I would have stayed in Shattrath. 

Here, take this ring. The arakkoa told me to use the ring on the staff to nullify the enchantment.

Bring the scepter back to him and maybe he will teach you what he promised to teach me.

passages.title: Oru'kai's Staff
passages.text: The staff! Give it to me!

passages.title: Oru'kai's Staff
passages.text:
Yes... This is it, after so many years. Soon, I will have all of the Armaments of Oru'kai.

Return my ring as well and I will fulfill the promise I made to that squeamish draenei. 

Take this book. If you have any skill, you can use it to decipher and learn Draenor's enchantments. 

Of course, you will need a proper workplace as well. Here are plans; hopefully you can follow them.

Now, be gone, and steer clear of the other armaments, for they are mine.

passages.title: Primal Fury
passages.text:
It looks like this is it, commander.

We must stop the Iron Horde at all costs. I have sent stormcrows to your garrison, and called for Shadow Hunter Rokhan to deploy your troops to the Gates of Tanaan at once.

By the time you get to northern Talador, he should be waiting for you... with an entire army.

There is no time to delay.

passages.title: Primal Fury
passages.text:
Your feats seem to know no limits, <name>. Today, you and your garrison forces have struck a terrible blow to Warchief Hellscream and the Iron Horde.

However, he is not defeated so easily. If anything, his hunger for vengeance will grow.

We must destroy the root of his operations in Tanaan Jungle, but first, there is much preparation to be done.

Until then, bask in the glow of our momentous victory.

passages.title: Locating the Lapidarist
passages.text:
Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price!

Alright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol.

Rumor has it there is a master craftsman there who's skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones. Might be your guy.

passages.title: Locating the Lapidarist
passages.text: <race>, how can I repay you for returning this pendant to me?

passages.title: A Father and His Son
passages.text:
We must hurry before more orcs arrive! My father works just down this path!

We'll be safe at his shop.

passages.title: Lost Lumberjack
passages.text:
All o' them mole machines got mighty unreliable here in Gorgrond. I hear tell that one of 'em might've crashed here in Tangleheart.

See if you can find Frenna. She would've been on the one we tracked to this location. I'll go lookin' for the mole machine to see if it can be repaired.

passages.title: Lost Lumberjack
passages.text: Frenna didn't make it out of Tangleheart.

passages.title: Peeking into the Portal
passages.text:
I sent Scout Pazerp to get a better look at the portal. She should have reported back by now; what could be taking her so long?

She is one of my best scouts, I hope she is alright.

passages.title: Peeking into the Portal
passages.text: Poor Pazerp... this news is unsettling to say the least. The Iron Horde seems to have an unending supply of troops.

passages.title: Diamonds Are Forever
passages.text:
Please watch closely <name>. I shall craft this jewel into a fine pendant for you.

Hopefully you will learn a bit of true jewelcrafting in the process.

passages.title: Diamonds Are Forever
passages.text: It is finished, and even more beautiful than the last!

passages.title: Diamonds Are Forever
passages.text:
Thank you for your help <name>, please take this pendant along with a copy of my research.

I hope these will prove useful in helping you to better understand the secrets of Draenic gems.

Until we meet again, friend.

passages.title: Peeking into the Portal
passages.text:
I sent Scout Pazaztick to be gettin' a better look at da portal. He shoulda reported back by dis time; what be taking him so long?

Dis is what happens when you hire da goblins as help.

passages.title: Peeking into the Portal
passages.text: Dis not good. Them Iron Horde be causin' a lot of da trouble round here. We need ta find a way ta deal wit dim.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
Clearing the Garden
passages.text:
This clearing is the perfect spot to grow herbs for our Garrison, there is just one little problem. All these dang raccoons!

I need you to clear them out and we can get this garden growing.

passages.title: Clearing the Garden
passages.text: Did you get 'em?

passages.title: Clearing the Garden
passages.text: Great work, <name>! We will get started planting the garden right away.

passages.title: A Power Lost
passages.text:
<The fragment gleams in the light as its aura's final pulse fades.>

The power within the fragment appears to be drained.

You recall hearing travelers speak of a local in Embaari Village who specializes in imbuing gems with magic.

passages.title: A Power Lost
passages.text:
What have you got here...

Only a keen eye would be able to spot the potential of this drained crystal. You may not be familiar with draenei crystals yet, but your familiarity with gems certainly shows.

Tell you what... if you would assist me in the troubles we're having with our local defense crystals I'd gladly share some of my own expertise in jewelcrafting with you.

passages.title: Dyed in the Fur
passages.text:
I can't believe they tried to physically rip the magic out of the material!

It seems we were never in danger of my secrets falling into the wrong hands after all. Better safe than dead...

In return for your help, I will share with you my methods of fusing magic to cloth.

Flytrap Ichor is very rare in this region, but I do have a bit in reserve. Take this woven fur and dip it in the ichor here. You will see for yourself what all of the fuss is about.

passages.title: Dyed in the Fur
passages.text: Has the cloth been enchanted?

passages.title: Dyed in the Fur
passages.text:
There, you're on the path to becoming a true Hexweave tailor.

Do not share the secrets I've shown you here with anyone.

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text:
I've been trying to get this place ready for your pets, but we've uncovered some rude pests while building the garrison. I tried to take care of them myself, but they are too tough for my meager team.

There's an angry carrot in the garden, an enormous rat eating our food rations, and an ornery water creature harassing the fishermen. If you can take care of them, I'll be free to finish up my work on your menagerie.

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text: Thank you, <name>.  Let's see if your pets like their new space!

passages.title: Egg Punt
passages.text:
<A sweaty, pulsing egg - no doubt flush with ravager larvae.

A swift kick should take care of these.>

passages.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Alexi Barov
passages.text: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]

passages.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Alexi Barov
passages.text:
"The brothers united once more," he said.

"A world full of untold riches to plunder," he said.

"Wealth beyond imaging," he said!

And then he proceeded to drop a log on top of me.

"There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries," he said.

At least we can agree on that...

passages.title: Curing With Force
passages.text:
The infection is getting stronger so I made some adjustments and I'm pretty sure I have the right formula now.

It should now work but it needs to have less competition with the infected blood for it to have any effect.

This means you will need to weaken them before you apply the serum for it to function properly.

The infection is getting more advanced and will soon be untreatable so we have this one shot to save as many as we can.

passages.title: Curing With Force
passages.text: Any progress to report with that cure?

passages.title: Curing With Force
passages.text:
Yea! Great work, <name>!

I've already heard from the survivors and they're glad for this second chance at life.

You made a real difference today!

passages.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov
passages.text: [PHYLARCH ACQUISITION TEXT GOES HERE]

passages.title: The Rise and Fall of Barov Industries: Weldon Barov
passages.text:
"The brothers united once more," he said.

"A world full of untold riches to plunder," he said.

"Wealth beyond imaging," he said!

And then he proceeded to drop a log on top of me.

"There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries," he said.

At least we can agree on that...

passages.title: Seeking the Scout
passages.text:
We are still trying to locate all of our scouts out in the field. One of these, Altauur, enjoys handling the more dangerous missions.

He has not checked in and I feel we should check to make sure he has not taken on more than he can handle.

passages.title: Seeking the Scout
passages.text: D'kaan worried about me? He is more worried I will be chased back to the camp with one of those giant beasts in tow. Still I could use your help here...

passages.title: Penny From Heaven
passages.text:
<Durotan looks at you curiously.>

Those from your world are not much for subtlety, are they?

Go on ahead and greet our new companion. We will join you as soon as we can make ready.

passages.title: Penny From Heaven
passages.text:
Ahh, there y'are!

Penny Clobberbottom reportin' for duty, commander.

passages.title: Unintelligible Intelligence
passages.text:
The notes are unreadable, but based on previous experience, the text appears to be very similar to standard Orcish.

It is possible that the notes could contain strategic information. Perhaps it would be of great value to the Frostwolf Orcs.

Someone in Wor'gol might be able to help interpret the text.

passages.title: Unintelligible Intelligence
passages.text:
<Raleigh looks up from the scrolls.>

Commander <name>, what brings you to Wor'gol?!

passages.title: Unintelligible Intelligence
passages.text:
We have been studying these orcish texts feverishly since our arrival here. Allow me a moment to translate this for you.

Hmmm... The notes appear to contain a list of names.

passages.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
passages.text:
It appears that a genesaur was killed here not long ago and this growth has sprung up. It is stirring up the local monsters and I fear for our outpost.

There is a strange ancient that wallows in grief here and is not hostile. Perhaps you could "harvest" its story?

passages.title: Ambassador to the Ancient
passages.text:
So the normal ebb and flow of battle has been disrupted by the saberon. I do not think it wise to leave things as such.

We should see about infiltrating the saberon and setting things right.

passages.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
passages.text:
The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this.

One of their entrances is covered with a large boulder. Too large for you or I, but perhaps an ogre with a large enough hammer could break it. I think you know who I am talking about...

passages.title: Beatface vs. Boulder
passages.text: You have strong friends <name>. We must make haste before the plants realize the way is open.

passages.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
passages.text:
The saberon took their treasure up the rise and barricaded themselves in after Birchus attacked. It will be difficult to get in but I hear you have resources to handle this.

One of their entrances is covered with tough vegetation. I believe you have a mechanical solution to this problem in the form of a shredder. I think you know what to do...

passages.title: Shredder vs. Saberon
passages.text: Your machine is brutish but effective, well done <name>. We must make haste before the plants realize the way is open.

passages.title: Reclaiming Property
passages.text:
You are attracted by a low green glow to the container. Inside there is a glowing bundle of herbs that was most likely stolen from the overgrowth below.

It would be best to collect all of these so the saberon don't continue their dabbling in plant magic and irritating the nearby magnaron.

passages.title: Reclaiming Property
passages.text: The saberon should definitely NOT have any of the herbs you have found!

passages.title: Reclaiming Property
passages.text: A good catch discovering those herbs <name>. We cannot allow them to continue using these. Who knows what it might set off.

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text: Your work has born fruit. Inside the nearby cave a powerful saberon shaman is learning to channel the genesaur magic using the Death Bloom we seek. The solution is before us: kill the shaman, take the Death Bloom, return it to Birchus. That should improve the safety of our outpost.

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text: Do you have something for me little beast?

passages.title: Taking the Death Bloom
passages.text: You have... you have brought me the bloom. At last my purpose can be fulfilled!

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text:
I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had.

And now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?!

No, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me.

My peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Alexi, and serve him a notice of termination!

You will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text: Did you deliver the... notice of termination?

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text:
<Weldon holds Alexi's head up to his face and begins speaking.>

You no-good, backstabbing son-of-a-goat! Your greed is only surpassed by my own!

As for you my peasant friend, you have served me well. Here are your just rewards!

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text:
I was a fool to trust him after the fiasco over the Barov family fortune! What I should have done is killed him the first chance I had.

And now he thinks he's going to plumb this land for all that it's worth and cut me out?!

No, dear brother, not this time! There can only be one CEO of Barov Industries and it will be me.

My peasant friend, you must do me this service. Find my brother, Weldon, and serve him a notice of termination!

You will likely find him out in the wilds, near small timber.

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text: Has my brother been served the notice of termination yet?

passages.title: Reduction in Force
passages.text:
<Alexi holds Weldon's head up to his face and begins speaking.>

You no-good, backstabbing son-of-a-goat! Your greed is only surpassed by my own!

As for you my peasant friend, you have served me well. Here are your just rewards!

passages.title: Spawn Tracking & Spell Visuals: Do They Work?
passages.text: Here's some text.

passages.title: Bypassing Security
passages.text:
Oh, my goodness!

This is a list of captives, it appears they may be awaiting transfer... or possibly even execution.

There is one name on this list that I do recognize: my master!

I have been awaiting his return, but now it appears that he may have fallen into enemy hands.

This is a disaster! Please, <name>, we must rescue him.

According to the notes, he has been taken to Grom'gar, located far east of here.

One moment... I think I may have just the thing to help you break in undetected...

passages.title: Bypassing Security
passages.text: You know the trick to fooling a bunch of Orcs? Every once in a while you've got to be holding all the cards!

passages.title: Just Another Stick in the Wall
passages.text:
So, get this.

As I was flyin' in, I took the opportunity to scope out what might be a defensible position.

Just on the other side o' these boulders is an ideal clearing to hole up in. I even brought a set of blueprints to get us all settled in!

That's not too presumptuous, is it?

Anyway, whenever you're ready just hit this plunger!

passages.title: Just Another Stick in the Wall
passages.text: Perhaps this little creature will earn her keep after all.

passages.title: Locating the Lapidarist
passages.text:
Are you sure I can't take this off your hands? I'll give you a fair price!

Alright, alright... if you insist on finding the owner, you might want to try visiting Wor'gol.

Rumor has it, there is a master craftsman, skilled in manipulating precious metals and stones.

But, if you change your mind, you know where to find me....

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text:
I been tryin' ta get dis place ready for your pets, but we uncovered some rude pests while buildin' da garrison. I tried takin' care o' dem myself, but they be too tough for my little friends.

Beat da angry carrot in da garden, da rat eatin' our food, and da ornery water creature harassing da fishermen. If you can do it, I be free to finish up da work on your menagerie.

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text: How'd you fare, <name>?

passages.title: Pets Versus Pests
passages.text: Nice job, brudda.  I hope your pets be likin' dere new home.

passages.title: A New Darkmoon Challenger!
passages.text:
Look at me, now look at my horse, now look back at me, are I not the most impressive battler of pets that you have ever seen?

Look now at my compatriot over there. Is he on a horse? Of course not! Is his hat made of fireworks? Not in a million years! Everything about me is more impressive, from my coat color to my last name, which I made myself.

Dare you step up to the might of Christoph Willikens Dennis Ragnaros VonFeasel the First?

I can see you trembling!

passages.title: A New Darkmoon Challenger!
passages.text: Ready, eh? Put up your cat's tiny dukes!

passages.title: A New Darkmoon Challenger!
passages.text: Next time I won't go so easy on you!

passages.title: The Razorbloom
passages.text:
The Laughing Skull shaman Kaz ran off while we were coming here.

She claimed to be looking for more of her people in the jungles to the south.

Draka insisted on following her to safeguard us against betrayal.

Commander, if Kaz is telling the truth, then she and Draka are going to need all the help they can get.

Will you join them? They could not have gotten far.

This could prove to be the perfect test for your new shredder and lumber mill resources.

passages.title: The Razorbloom
passages.text:
My husband sent you, didn't he?

Normally I would laugh at that, but seeing these horrors, Kaz and I could use all the help we can get.

passages.title: Broken Promises
passages.text:
A heavily-scratched ring, faintly stained with blood.

Someone at the Darkmoon Faire might be able to provide more information about this item.

passages.title: Broken Promises
passages.text:
Ah, I see that you've found my lovelies. Beautiful, aren't they? It's a shame that the process drives them so... insane.

The ring is yours to keep, of course. Can you hear them whisper? Marvelous.

passages.title: Firebird's Challenge
passages.text:
You're ready to fly high and give the Firebird's challenge a shot? That's great!

Simply collect 15 rings to win! Speak to me when you're ready for takeoff!

passages.title: Firebird's Challenge
passages.text: How was the flight?

passages.title: Firebird's Challenge
passages.text: Wow, great flying out there, ace! Here's your prize!

passages.title: Battle Pet Roundup
passages.text: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight. Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles <himself/herself>?

passages.title: Battle Pet Roundup
passages.text: Those pets looked tough.  How'd you do?

passages.title: Battle Pet Roundup
passages.text: I knew you could do it, kid.

passages.title: Thieving Dwarves
passages.text:
Cutter is on the trail of the artifact the dwarves stole. He has the nose of a wolf when it comes to hunting in the jungle.

Follow the canyons south until you find him.

It would seem the wolf queen and I are going to do more damage here before we leave.

We will follow as quickly as we can.

passages.title: Thieving Dwarves
passages.text: Wow. Those... "dwarves"... sure do know how to make both botani AND goren mad.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
News from Talador
passages.text: Rokhan sends word that you are needed at Frostwall. The Iron Horde have landed on the shores of Talador.

passages.title: News from Talador
passages.text: Welcome back, mon.

passages.title: News from Talador
passages.text:
Bodrick Grey sends word from your garrison that they have spotted a fleet of Iron Horde at the shores of Talador.

We must not allow them to destroy Shattrath.

passages.title: News from Talador
passages.text: Welcome back, <name>.

passages.title: The Lumber Mill
passages.text:
The Rangari have been here for a tick, and they hear tell from the Laughing Skull o' a place called Tangleheart.

Seems some really bad ancients come from there, and botani use a kind o' sap to grow them quickly.

I think we could use that for yer outpost. Hey, wood is wood, right?

I'll meet ya there.

passages.title: Iron Horde Invasion
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in Blasted Lands.

Use the portal at the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind to head directly to the front line.

This new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Iron Horde Invasion
passages.text: The situation here is dire, <name>. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Iron Horde Invasion
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Thrall in Blasted Lands.

Use the portal at the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar to head directly to the front line.

This new threat is known only as the Iron Horde. They have taken over the Dark Portal and must be stopped

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Iron Horde Invasion
passages.text: The situation here is dire, <name>. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Iron Horde Invasion
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Vindicator Maraad at the Shattered Beachhead in the Blasted Lands.

You can reach the docks outside Northwatch Hold by taking a boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet and traveling south along the coast.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
passages.text:
Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of showing off at your outpost. 

Return this to Maraad to increase your glory!

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
passages.text: I've seen plant life mimic the vicious hydra before, but to improve on the design? Only in Gorgrond... excellent work <name>.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
passages.text:
Defeating Biolante has yielded you a trophy worthy of acclaim.

Take this to Durotan at Beastwatch.

passages.title: Trophy of Glory: Biolante
passages.text:
In this land even the plants turn into vicious monsters. Biolante was one of the worst, still as a plant until you were too close.

A fitting end to such a beast...

passages.title: A Warrior's Shroud
passages.text:
Although this cloak has seen better days, the workmanship is still quite impressive. Any normal cloak would have most certainly fallen apart by now.

Perhaps one of the Frostwolf orcs within Wor'gol would be willing to help you repair it.

passages.title: A Warrior's Shroud
passages.text: Greetings, <race>. do you require any repairs?

passages.title: A Warrior's Shroud
passages.text: This is a fine cloak! Sadly, we no longer have the resources to make them like this.

passages.title: Is This One of Yours?
passages.text:
I found this one skulking nearby. She claims to be an ally of yours.

Is this true? Or does she cook slowly over my fire?

passages.title: Is This One of Yours?
passages.text: Thank you for vouching for me, commander.

passages.title: Cut 'Em Out!
passages.text:
After all that you've done for us, I would love to help you. Regrettably, I don't have the materials I would need to repair this perfectly.

Use my knife to gather a few hides from the clefthoof that roam near the spire and find some sootweed pitch to properly cure them.

Unfortunately, those miserable ogres have taken up residence in the only place that I know of sootweed to grow. You may be in for a fight <name>.

Return to me if you can obtain these and I will gladly help you repair your cloak.

passages.title: Cut 'Em Out!
passages.text: Were you able to obtain the materials, <name>?

passages.title: Cut 'Em Out!
passages.text:
You are covered in soot from head to toe, <name>!

As promised, I will help you repair your cloak. I have a few other items here which you might find useful as well.

Come back and see me any time!

passages.title: Unruly Visitors
Unruly Visitors
passages.text: Looks like we've got some visitors in the battle pen today, and they're looking for a fight. Why don't you show 'em how a master of pet battles handles <himself/herself>?

passages.title: Tangleheart Return
passages.text:
Hey there, peach. We've got the lumber mill good and ready, but we gotta find a way of choppin' wood fast out here.

The Laughing Skull talked about Tangleheart, where the botani grow things quick as a quark.

I'm headin' there now.

passages.title: Heavy Arms
passages.text: The burned out shell of some sort of weapon of mass destruction. It might be worth asking around your garrison to see if anyone can help get it working again.

passages.title: Heavy Arms
passages.text: Yo, boss. Whatchya got for me?

passages.title: Heavy Arms
passages.text: I think we could get into some serious trouble with this beauty!

passages.title: He Drew Aggro...culture
passages.text:
What you saw was the wake of the genesaur, Iyu. It was chasing this mechanical monstrosity and the person who drove it.

I believe the pilot of this vessel is still alive and trapped within the ruins of the camp.

If you wish them to be recovered, I recommend doing so now.

passages.title: He Drew Aggro...culture
passages.text: Ah perfect. I'll get this up an' runnin' in no time.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
One of your soldiers stopped by asking for you while you were out. Something about a caravan heading out to Nagrand.

Whatever it was, it can't have gone well for them. That's Warsong territory.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Commander. Good to have you back.

We've got some movement in Nagrand. Let me fill you in on the details.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
One of your soldiers stopped by asking for you while you were out. Something about a caravan heading out to Nagrand.

Whatever it was, it can't have gone well for them. That's Warsong territory.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Boss-mon. Good to have ya back.
 
We been seein' some movement in Nagrand. Let me give ya the details.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Welcome back, <sir/mam>.

One of Bodrick's men delivered a message about a caravan being dispatched for Nagrand. He's awaiting your approval on a new outpost.

I've been hearing whispers around camp about Nagrand. They say it's Warsong territory. They might need your help <sir/mam>.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Commander. Good to have you back.

We've got some movement in Nagrand. Let me fill you in on the details.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Welcome back, <sir/mam>.

One of our shadow hunters delivered a message about a caravan being dispatched for Nagrand. Rokhan's awaiting your approval on a new outpost.

I've been hearing whispers around camp about Nagrand. They say it's Warsong territory. They might need your help <sir/mam>.

passages.title: News from Nagrand
passages.text:
Boss-mon. Good to have ya back.
 
We been seein' some movement in Nagrand. Let me give ya the details.

passages.title: Finding Nat Pagle
passages.text:
Now that you have proof, we might just have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

Last I heard, he was in fishing with the local Angler's faction out in Pandaria. Somewhere off the coast of Krasarang Wilds. Head out there, show him your catch and see if you can get him to come back with you!

passages.title: Finding Nat Pagle
passages.text: You came all this way for me? Well, I am pretty important.

passages.title: Finding Nat Pagle
passages.text: You came from Draenor? How does that even work?!

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text:
What's this species, a molten catfish you say? I have never even heard of a fish like this, much less seen one in person!

I have to find more fish like this, it's what I live for! And if the fishing is as good as you say it is, there is just no way I can pass this opportunity up. Take this page from my journal as proof that you found me and I will meet you back at your Garrison.

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text: You found Nat? The real Nat Pagle?!

passages.title: The Great Angler Returns
passages.text: We should really catch some big one's when Nat's gets here!

passages.title: A True Draenor Angler
passages.text:
If you want me to help you permanently, you have to show me a few of these big Draenor catches first. Head out into the wild and bring me back the biggest fish you can find from all the surrounding areas.

I made this custom lure for you to use, please take care of it, it's never let me down!

passages.title: A True Draenor Angler
passages.text: What did you catch?

passages.title: A True Draenor Angler
passages.text: These fish are exquisite, <name>. Great job!

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text:
Now that you are experienced enough with Draenor fishing, we might have a shot at convincing Nat Pagle to join us out here.

If we want Nat to actually come all the way out here, we are going to have to show him real proof of the incredible catches on Draenor. Head out to the lava lakes here in Frostfire and see what you can do. All that time you spend honing your skill here in Draenor should pay off now.

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text: Any luck near those lava pools?

passages.title: Luring Nat
passages.text: This will do nicely... A fish like this would be hard for anyone to deny, especially Nat!

passages.title: An Angler on Our Team
passages.text:
You truly are a master fisherman!

I would be delighted to join you here on Draenor and help you catch as many lunkers as you can. But first, let's grab a drink.

passages.title: An Angler on Our Team
passages.text:
You truly are a master fisherman!

I would be delighted to join you here on Draenor and help you catch as many lunkers as you can. But first, let's grab a drink.

passages.title: Strategic Choices
Ashran Appearance
passages.text:
Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander.

It would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area.

I can arrange a flight if you are interested.

passages.title: Ashran Appearance
passages.text:
Just a second, pal. Can't you see I'm busy here?

Commander! I didn't think you were actually going to show... I mean... welcome, commander.

passages.title: Host Howell
passages.text:
Lieutenant Howell said you might be showing up.

It's such an honor to meet you in person. The lieutenant is at the inn, I'll escort you over there.

passages.title: Host Howell
passages.text: Commander <name>, I'm so glad you could make it. It's a true honor, sir.

passages.title: Big Frostfire Gun
passages.text:
One of my finest works, <name>! Momma would be so proud of me right now... if she was still in one piece.

We gotta test this bad boy out though before I'm comfortable letting you run around with it all willy-nilly.

I heard there were some clefthooves out back causing a ruckus.

passages.title: Big Frostfire Gun
passages.text: Did you manage to subdue those rowdy clefthooves?

passages.title: Big Frostfire Gun
passages.text:
Hmmm... sounds like it still needs a bit more punch. Let me get back to work on it, boss, I'll see what I can do!

Good news is, we know a lot more about the Iron Horde tech now. I made a copy of my notes for ya.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text:
I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards.

This inn is run by Jaesia Rosecheer, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor.

We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact our latest recruit, Knewbie McGreen just came through the portal today.

If you are looking to trade for weapons or armor, Vindicator Nuurem will be happy to help.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: How did your walk go?

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.

passages.title: A Surly Dwarf
passages.text:
Before you go there is someone you might want to talk with.

He's opinionated, a bit gruff, and very overbearing, but he's the best damn warrior I've met in ages.

He belongs on the front lines with you, commander. And trust me, he knows it.

passages.title: A Surly Dwarf
passages.text: Look, I don't have time for any... Oh, it's you!

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: Ever since we built da menagerie, a lot o' "visitors" been showin' up. I know da look, and they be lookin' for a fight. <Brudda/Sista>, you show 'em you da real master 'round here.

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: Did you show 'em the mojo?

passages.title: Scrappin'
passages.text: You showed 'em, boss!

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
passages.text:
Welcome to Nagrand's one and only Ring of Blood, where hopefuls become gladiators and gladiators become discarded piles of meat on the arena floor!

Talk to me to start a fight, hop down into the ring, and fight for your life. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!

You'll face off against an ogron that has a hankering for freshly severed heads. You'll be fine... and I'll be rich!

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Skull Chewer!
passages.text: Nicely done, pal. Now how's about we kick things up a notch?

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Fracktus!
passages.text:
Have you ever fought a living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face? Well, today's your lucky day!

Fracktus is a... well... living, breathing mountain that wants to murder your face, actually. Got that one right the first time!

Just hop in the ring so we can get started, will ya?

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Fracktus!
passages.text: Incredible! You've got real moxy, kid.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Venoxis!
passages.text:
Alright, alright, how about this. A living, breathing... wait for it.... tree... that wants to murder your face. Genius, right?

Look, they don't pay me to come up with witty dialogue about these things, give me a break. They're ogres - they pay for blood. Hence the name.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Venoxis!
passages.text: You're the best I've ever seen in all my years as a promoter. I really mean that.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Dreshax!
passages.text:
You're going to love this one, champ.

That's right, it's the largest bone worm this side of Draenor. Dreshax lovingly disposes of all of the suckers... I mean... fallen gladiators for us.

Think you've got what it takes? Hop on in and wait. Dreshax's lair is just below the arena - he'll come to you.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Dreshax!
passages.text: What a battle. What a fight! Incredible!

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Horde try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Horde.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
Word of your glory in battle has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.

Well done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
passages.text:
The Blackrock forces based out of the Pit in Gorgrond make up the bulk of the Iron Horde army. If we crush them on their home soil, the rest of the Iron Horde will have little hope of standing against us.

If you choose the battle, bring friends. The Blackrock won't be defeated easily.

passages.title: Assault on the Pit
passages.text:
Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.

Well done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text: I hear you were a sight to see in the ring. I'm proud to serve by your side, commander.

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text:
We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.

Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text: Da assault be goin' well I hope?

passages.title: Assault on Skettis
passages.text:
News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.

Ya be a force to be reckonin' with.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
As we do battle all across Draenor, the cowardly Alliance try to seize our territory within Ashran.

Our men would be inspired to see you join the battlefield, striking terror into the hearts of the Alliance.

passages.title: Battle in Ashran
passages.text:
News about da fightin' beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils too.

Dem Alliance must a been none too happy to see ya on the field.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
A challenge has been issued at the Ring of Blood.

Bring friends and do battle to prove your right as champion.

passages.title: Challenge at the Ring of Blood
passages.text:
I been hearin' ya were a sight ya see in the ring.

We made some bets on ya. Easy money.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Mogor!
passages.text:
You've really done it this time, champ. Mogor has challenged you to uphold his title as lord of the ring!

I wish I could give you tips to help you make it out of there in one piece, but I've never seen Mogor fight. Nobody's ever gotten this far!

Good luck.

passages.title: The Ring of Blood: Mogor!
passages.text: You did it. You really did it! You're the new lord of the ring!

passages.title: Ashran Appearance
passages.text:
Our base on Ashran is almost complete, commander.

It would be a huge show of support if you could make a trip out there and put your stamp of approval on their staging area.

I can arrange a flight if you are interested.

passages.title: Ashran Appearance
passages.text: Commander! I am humbled to be able to serve you. The Lieutenant requests your presence.

passages.title: Warspear Welcome
passages.text:
Lieutenant Kragil said you might be showing up.

I've been ordered to take you to the inn.

passages.title: Warspear Welcome
passages.text: Throm-Ka, commander. I am pleased to finally meet you in person.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text:
I hope you will find our facilities to be up to your high standards.

This inn is run by Narnin Dawnglow, in my opinion this is the best place to hearth in Draenor.

We have new recruits coming through the portal daily. In fact one of out latest recruits, Zarjhin, just came through the portal today.

If you are looking for weapons or armor Beska Redtusk will be happy to help.

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: How did your walk go?

passages.title: Inspiring Ashran
passages.text: Thank you again for taking the time to visit, commander. You have no idea how much it means to us.

passages.title: Burning Beauty
passages.text:
Before you go, there is someone you should meet.

She might set some of your stuff on fire, but I believe she's the best mage this side of Draenor.

She belongs on the front lines with you, commander.

passages.title: Burning Beauty
passages.text: So, you are the commander? Sylvanas sent me to find you.

passages.title: Abu'gar
passages.text:
Ya brought my gear! Well it be lookin' like my luck might be turnin' around after all!

Abu'gar will be returnin' the favor, just ya wait and see!

Right after I hook myself a lunker, of course...
