Jinyu normally avoid our order, but every few years, we find one that subscribes to the way of the Crane. One such jinyu is Dextrous Izissha.

Izissha is your next challenger. He waits for you on the island's southwestern shore.

passages.title: Dextrous Izissha
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! You continue to gain favor in the eyes of Chi-Ji.

Your next battle will be one to remember. You will not be fighting a trainee. Instead, you will face one of your trainers.

passages.title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
passages.text:
Most of the duels within the Cradle take place between two trainees. Rarely, when a trainee exhibits a rare amount of skill, they will have an opportunity to duel their trainer.

Today, you duel against Kuo-Na. She will be waiting for you at the Pedestal of Hope.

passages.title: Kuo-Na Quillpaw
passages.text:
You continue to impress, <name>.

Come again soon. Your training is not over yet.

passages.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
passages.text:
Your "rival" has appeared again. Ellia Ravenmane has been avoiding her duties on the island, instead focusing on personal training, with the intent to defeat you in battle.

"I will destroy <name>," she said.

I have honored her request for a rematch, but I will be keeping a close eye on her. Her motives may be shifting in a dangerous direction.

passages.title: Ellia Ravenmane: Revenge
passages.text: I will consult directly with Chi-Ji about Ellia's behavior. She treads on thin ice.

passages.title: Tukka-Tuk
passages.text:
You are making a name for yourself, <name>. I received a challenge from one of our more skilled competitors. He believes you are not as strong as you seem.

His name is Tukka-Tuk, the hozen. If you've ever fought against hozen before, you know that their apparent juvenility belies their battle acumen. Good luck.

passages.title: Tukka-Tuk
passages.text:
Well done, as usual.

I trust I will see you again soon.

passages.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
passages.text:
Usually our trainees are adventurers like yourself, or monks from Tian Monastery, or occasionally retired Shado-Pan. Very rarely, though, we will greet trainees that have no fighting experience whatsoever.

Huck Wheelbarrow is one such trainee. He has requested a duel with you. Look for him on the island's western shore.

passages.title: Huck Wheelbarrow
passages.text:
There remains only one trainee ranked higher than you.

I have a feeling that you will be facing him when you return.

passages.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
passages.text:
Our highest-ranked trainee is an outsider like you. It is both strange and exciting to live in a time when so many foreigners have embraced the way of the Crane.

Your challenger's name is Mindel Sunspeaker, and he awaits you within Angkhal Pavilion.

passages.title: Mindel Sunspeaker
passages.text:
You are now our highest-ranked trainee. You are no longer obligated to participate in trainee duels. Congratulations!

Of course, there are still other ways to prove yourself. I have the feeling I will be seeing you again...

passages.title: Yan Quillpaw
passages.text:
You have already defeated Kuo-Na Quillpaw. You have not yet fought her brother, Yan.

He will meet you at the Pedestal of Hope, and he will not hold back. His reputation as a trainer is at stake.

passages.title: Yan Quillpaw
passages.text:
And with that victory, I suppose we've run out of challengers for you to fight! Other than me, of course.

But... I don't fight. I mean, you wouldn't want to fight me. It would... not go well for you.

passages.title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
passages.text:
Fat Long-Fat has requested another match with you. I find this strange. And concerning.

He will be waiting atop the Dome Belrissa.

passages.title: Fat Long-Fat: Rematch
passages.text:
I believe I understand why he wanted to fight you a second time, though I need to speak with Chi-Ji before I can be sure.

Come back soon, <name>. I think it is time you learned the true nature of Fat Long-Fat.

passages.title: Thelonius
passages.text:
When we last spoke, I promised to tell you the secret of Fat Long-Fat. I still plan to tell you that secret... after I determine your worth.

I will meet you on the western shore, and we will duel.

passages.title: Thelonius
passages.text:
You are truly worthy of the secret of Fat Long-Fat. Here it is:

Fat Long-Fat and Chi-Ji are one and the same. Fat Long-Fat is the Red Crane.

He believes that the Cradle is in great danger.

He believes there is one person that can save it.

He believes that you are that person, <name>.

Stay in touch.

passages.title: Champion of Chi-Ji
passages.text:
While you will always hold a place of honor among our order, you are still welcome to participate in our duels.

One of our current champions awaits you in the Dome Balrissa. I know that they would be honored to duel with you.

passages.title: Champion of Chi-Ji
passages.text:
Done masterfully, as always.

We hope to see you again soon, <name>.

passages.title: Shut it Down
passages.text:
I mussed up. Bad.

It's hard work cutting seeds out of kafa berries! But I noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so.

I fed everything I had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves.

Kota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

passages.title: Shut it Down
passages.text: Thank you, friend. Let this be a lesson to you: never feed the goots.

passages.title: Gourmet Kafa
passages.text:
It was genius: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out.

Kafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET.

But it's over now. Uncle is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again.

I won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so I can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

passages.title: Gourmet Kafa
passages.text:
Great, I'll get up there and... harvest them soon.

<Cousin Gootfur begins wrapping long strips of linen around his hands.>

Can't believe I thought this was a good idea.

passages.title: Jumping the Shark
passages.text:
There is only one way to kill sharks where I come from, with your bare hands!

I dumped a good amount of chum in the water just off the dock here, this place should be crawling with the local reef sharks in no time. Hop on the first one you see and take it out!

passages.title: Jumping the Shark
passages.text: Did you show that shark who's boss?

passages.title: Jumping the Shark
passages.text: That was a huge shark you took out <name>!  Color me impressed!

passages.title: Bright Bait
passages.text:
Certain fish are only attracted to bright lights. The forest north of here is home to a local pandaren firefly called a suncrawler.

You should be able to find them on the base of the tree trunks all around that area. Bring me back a handful of them and I can use them for bait!

passages.title: Bright Bait
passages.text: Any luck with those suncrawlers?

passages.title: Bright Bait
passages.text: These should do nicely <name>.  Thanks for the help!

passages.title: Sotelo's Quest
passages.text:
Push the plunger.

PUSH IT!

passages.title: Piranha!
passages.text:
Certain fish are very difficult to catch. The wolf piranha falls squarely into this category.

Lucky for me that you showed up! Put those fishing skills to the test and bring me back a few from the krasarang river due northwest of here.

passages.title: Piranha!
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Piranha!
passages.text: I see you still have all your fingers, nice work.

passages.title: Regaining Honor
passages.text:
<name>, the yaungol warchief, Humongous, killed Shado-Master Zhen. He has his banner.

You have to kill Humongous and regain Zhen's honor! If you don't, I will.

passages.title: Profiting off of the Past
passages.text:
<A relic drops off of the statue. Hmm, these could prove to be valuable to the right person.>

<There's a collector on the outskirts of the ruins. Perhaps he'd be interested in purchasing them from you?>

passages.title: Risking It All
passages.text:
Wait, what?! How could he be so reckless? Blowing the ship free is insane! They could kill Shen-zin Su, and all of us with it. 

I know we don't have much time, but we need to think of another way...

passages.title: Risking It All
passages.text: The first step is done, but now we must save Shen-zin Su!

passages.title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
passages.text:
My fate is sealed. The yaungol put this spear in my side. The wound will kill me.

The yaungol hold me in place with their twisted, corrupted magic. The indignity of it hurts worse than my spear-wound.

My death, I cannot stop. My imprisonment... you may be able to help me with this.

passages.title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
passages.text: I will not die before having my revenge.

passages.title: A Spear Through My Side, A Chain Through My Soul
passages.text:
I am freed.

The yaungol must be stopped.

passages.title: Emergency Care
passages.text:
I... am alive... but barely. They killed the rest. My friends... and family...

I must return to the village... But, I do not have long, and cannot move on my own... are you a healer? I... have a healing potion in my hut... search my belongings. You can use your magic, if you have it.

passages.title: Emergency Care
passages.text: Thank you. I suppose... I'll need to ask you to do a bit more before I can return to the village. I cannot leave the bodies of my friends and family here.

passages.title: Staying Connected
passages.text:
The Tongue of Ba-Shon should allow us to communicate from long distances, <name>.

If the relic works the way I think it will, I should be able to stay here and continue my meditations while you do some scouting in the Valley of Emperors.

Mishi will take you to the edge of the valley so that we can test my theory. I would hate for you to be in the tombs with no way to contact me. That would be horrible!

passages.title: Staying Connected
passages.text:
Very good! The relic works!

It appears there is more going on in the Valley of Emperors than I had anticipated. It is crucial we figure out why the Mogu are opening the tombs.

passages.title: An End to Everything
passages.text:
These spirits must have been released when the tombs were opened... 

Death was not final for the Mogu. Instead, death was merely a stop over on the path to a new body. Spiritbinders used a foul magic to transfer spirits from one shell to the next.

Years of being trapped in the tombs has left them confused. They need to be destroyed before their confusion turns to anger or worse, they find a new shell.

passages.title: An End to Everything
passages.text: Have you disposed of the spirits yet?

passages.title: An End to Everything
passages.text:
You have done them a great service, <name>.

It is a cruel fate to be stuck between the living world and the afterlife.

passages.title: Breaking the Emperor's Shield
passages.text:
The Mogu have been scattered and sparse in number for many years. Their purpose in the valley makes sense now.

With this many restless spirits they can build themselves an army using the guardians buried in each tomb. Combined with the Zandalari forces this would be devastating!

The Tomb of Secrets houses elite warriors called the Emperor's Shield. They must not be resurrected! You'll find the tomb on the highest rise to the southwest.

passages.title: Breaking the Emperor's Shield
passages.text: Have you gone to the Tomb of Secrets yet?

passages.title: Breaking the Emperor's Shield
passages.text:
The Mogu and the Zandalari intend to resurrect the Thunder King?!

We cannot let this happen, <name>! The Thunder King will rain destruction on this land with his return.

passages.title: Lessons from History
passages.text:
The Thunder King was a vicious Emperor and with the Zandalari at his side he was unstoppable. His return would surely return this land to turmoil and misery.

You must locate his remains and take them somewhere safe. The Tablet of Thunder should help you figure out how to access his tomb.

passages.title: Lessons from History
passages.text: Have you read the tablet?

passages.title: Lessons from History
passages.text: They will need to move the remains to a secure location. We must go after them!

passages.title: Justice
passages.text:
After the mercenaries robbed us, most left.

But one of them... after the others took all we had, he ran the rest of us through. For sport!

Get justice for the fallen. Perhaps news of their death will raise my spirits enough to go on.

You'll find them just west of here.

passages.title: Justice
passages.text: Ahh.. they are dead. Already, I can feel my spirits lifting. Soon I will have the strength to return to the village.

passages.title: By the Falls, For the Fallen
passages.text:
I do not wish to dishonor my friends and leave them in unmarked graves.

Yet, we have never needed to bury so many at once, and I am in no condition to gather materials.

Please, visit the lakes that hug the mountains edge along the road to the south. Underneath the waterfalls there, you will find stones that have been polished to a sheen by the falling water. They will make suitable headstones.

passages.title: By the Falls, For the Fallen
passages.text: The stones - have you brought them?

passages.title: By the Falls, For the Fallen
passages.text: Good. Thank you. After this, I cannot imagine leaving my fellows to less than a proper burial.

passages.title: Checking In
passages.text: When the trolls came, they brought their mercenary... friends with them. I saw them go past us, to the fishing camp in the northwest. My cousin, a healer, lives there - can you check in with him and make sure he and his village are well?

passages.title: Checking In
passages.text: Ahh... My cousin is wise to be worried... I am not well...

passages.title: Preparing the Remains
passages.text:
Thank you much, friend. After this tragedy, it is good that fortune has smiled on us and sent you.

You have gotten justice for my fallen friends, and gathered the necessary materials to honor them. I will gather their bodies, prepare the materials for their funerals, and meet you at the graveyard. 

In the meantime, however, please return to my cousin and ask him to gather the villagers for the funeral.

passages.title: Preparing the Remains
passages.text: I see... it is tragic what has happened there. We will meet you at the graveyard to honor them.

passages.title: Shut it Down
passages.text:
My cousin over at Kota Basecamp mussed up. He mussed up bad.

He was too lazy to cut seeds out of kafa berries by hand, but he noticed goots eat the berries up and give back the seeds... in a day or so.

He fed everything he had to the goots on Kota Peak and now they're nuts! Chargin' everything that moves.

Kota used to be safe for Grummles to gather kafa. Not anymore. Not with them goots. Will you help?

passages.title: Shut it Down
passages.text: Thank you for helping to correct my mistake, friend. Let this be a lesson to you: never feed the goots.

passages.title: Gourmet Kafa
passages.text:
It was a crazy idea: kafa berries go in the goot, seeds come out.

Kafa'kota is already rare and worth a fortune, but my cousin's invention--Kafa'goot--is GOURMET.

But it's over now. Uncle Keenbean is upset and peak is a muss. All that's left is to collect the rest of the Kafa'goot and never make it again.

I won't ask you to gather it--kind of a mussy task, not fit for hero-- just mark it so we can find it easily when the mountain is safe again.

passages.title: Gourmet Kafa
passages.text:
I'd heard an adventurer was up there marking the deposits. Mussy work for someone with your skills, but I appreciate it.

I'll get up there and... harvest them soon.

<Cousin Gootfur begins wrapping long strips of linen around his hands.>

Can't believe I thought this was a good idea.

passages.title: Trouble Brewing
passages.text:
Lots of yetis in Kota, yup. Usually not too dangerous. Usually just eat goots.

Then stupid Cousin Gootfur over at Kota Basecamp fed kafa to the goots, and the yeti ate them goots.

Now they're moody, cranky, sleep a lot but never seem rested. Typical kafa addicts.

Gonna come outta those caves soon, I'm sure. Come lookin' for more kafa.

Then we all in trouble.

passages.title: Trouble Brewing
passages.text:
Ah, hello there! Tallmug sent a messenger yak over explaining that you would be helping us with our yeti problems.

And you weren't torn to shreds! Yeti's are tough enough on their own - can't imagine what a cranky kafa-addict yeti must be like. You're brave. Or lucky. Or dumb.

Maybe all three.

passages.title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
passages.text:
Thank you for coming, adventurer. I am sorry to have been so cryptic, but I could not risk alerting the mogu to my work here.

They are seeking something in the valley. Plundering the tombs of their old kings for relics of power.

I could not observe them long before having to flee, but I did manage to recover a relic of my own.

The Tongue of Ba-Shon will let us communicate securely over long distances, but only after I have bound it to myself.

I think I'm ready to begin, if you are.

passages.title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
passages.text: I'll need to bind my essence to the Tongue, then you can use it to speak with me from anywhere.

passages.title: The Tongue of Ba-Shon
passages.text:
This must be a very powerful relic for Zuan to want it back so badly.

It frightens me to think of what else they may find in the tombs...

passages.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
passages.text:
Welcome, Challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.

Your first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.

Fight with strength, fight with honor.

passages.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
passages.text:
Without conflict, there can be no growth.

The need to change, to persevere, to improve, these are the traits that bring champions to my doorstep.

passages.title: Round 1: Brewmaster Chani
passages.text: Well done, challenger.

passages.title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
passages.text:
Welcome, challenger, to my tournament of champions! Today we test the strengths of Pandaria's most dedicated heroes.

Your first opponent awaits you under the eastern gazebo. Defeat her, and you may proceed to the next round.

Fight with strength, fight with honor.

passages.title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
passages.text:
Without conflict, there can be no growth.

The need to change, to persevere, to improve, these are the traits that bring champions to my doorstep.

passages.title: Round 1: The Streetfighter
passages.text: Well done, challenger.

passages.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
passages.text:
You may know your next challengers. They were arguing fiercely when they arrived, so I have charged them with fighting side by side.

This will teach them the strength of friendship, and possibly entertain me in the process.

Go to the north eastern arena and face this jinyu and hozen.

Do not be gentle, they need to learn to work together.

passages.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
passages.text: Strength can come from an ally as much as from one's self.

passages.title: Round 2: Clever Ashyo & Ken-Ken
passages.text:
Pity that those two did not learn their lesson yet. No matter. In time I am sure they will come to see wisdom.

In the meantime, congratulations on your victory.

passages.title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
passages.text:
Your next challenger is a Bramblestaff. Strength is in their blood. I remember a full century of only Bramblestaff champions.

No pressure, little <race>.

Go to the eastern arena north of here and face this young challenger. See first hand if strength is earned or inherited.

passages.title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
passages.text: I was once defeated in a match by a Bramblestaff. In my defense, he distracted me with a ball of yarn.

passages.title: Round 2: Kang Bramblestaff
passages.text: Ah. The Bramblestaff family have long held the championship generation after generation. I am sure this one will take the title sooner or later as well.

passages.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
passages.text:
Your next challenger is a favorite of mine. He draws strength from raw force and determination.

Plus he has a mask.

Face him in the western arena when you are ready, and good luck.

passages.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
passages.text: Sometimes strength can come from the outside.

passages.title: Round 3: The Wrestler
passages.text: Well fought, challenger. That was a fierce opponent.

passages.title: Round 3: Master Boom Boom
passages.text:
Your next challenger found his strength on a beach. Particularly in a box labeled "dynamite."

He proves however that found strength can be as deadly as personal strength.

When you are ready, face this Master Boom Boom in the Western Arena.

passages.title: Round 3: Master Boom Boom
passages.text: Well fought, challenger. That was a fierce opponent.

passages.title: Round 4: Master Windfur
passages.text:
Well done, challenger. You have reached the final round.

Your last opponent is a powerful master of the winds. He has defended his people for many years and stood as champion on more than one occasion.

Face this Master Windfur in the main arena when you are ready.

And challenger... good luck.

passages.title: Round 4: Master Windfur
passages.text: Congratulations, champion! The day is yours.

passages.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
passages.text:
And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct?

Go to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power!

Good luck, Challenger!

passages.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
passages.text: Some find strength in numbers. I respect this idea, when it is properly executed.

passages.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
passages.text:
Superb! What a battle!

You have proven yourself champion of this day's tournament. Well done!

You must return and put on such a show of strength in the future.

passages.title: Greenstone Village
Hui's Vengeance
A Trail of Fear
passages.text:
You now know Niuzao's secret. We are not only the wardens of this temple... we were the wardens of the Sha of Fear that was buried beneath it.

The Sha itself may have escaped... but it left traces behind. If you're truly going down into the catacombs, you should eliminate those traces, before they escape and cause greater problems than those we already face.

passages.title: A Trail of Fear
passages.text:
Even among our own order, only a few chosen elders knew of our sacred duty to contain the Sha of Fear.

Why they chose to tell the yak-keeper, I may never know.

passages.title: A Trail of Fear
passages.text: We already have mantid, mogu, and yaungol to worry about. This sha problem needs to be nipped in the bud before even we are overrun.

passages.title: Bad Yak
passages.text:
Is this the place where they replace defective yaks?

Can anybody help me out, here?

passages.title: Bad Yak
passages.text: This yak is not a good yak. Not at all.

passages.title: Bad Yak
passages.text: I think we made a pretty convincing argument. They'll HAVE to replace my yak now.

passages.title: Seeking Father
passages.text:
I've searched everywhere... but I haven't found my father. I KNOW he's alive still. He just needs his crossbow... then he'll be OK.

I've heard that you Shado-Pan guys sometimes fight the mantid on Sra'vess. I don't have any way of getting there. If you ever go over there, can you look for my dad?

passages.title: Seeking Father
passages.text: I know he's OK.

passages.title: Seeking Father
passages.text: <Ku-Mo doesn't seem to notice you.>

passages.title: Preparing Zouchin Village
passages.text:
The village elders seem to think the Thunder King's remains are being kept nearby. They have also expressed some concern with our presence here. They fear this will provoke another attack on their village.

While our priority is in getting the remains back we cannot leave the villagers defenseless. Speak with Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu and see what can be done to help.

passages.title: It Takes A Village
passages.text:
The villagers have been guarding Zouchin since the first attack. They are exhausted and many are injured.

If the Zandalari attack again the last thing we need is for the defenders to fall asleep on the job.

Relieve them of their posts so that they might have time to heal and see their families.

You'll find them stationed around the village.

passages.title: It Takes A Village
passages.text: Are the villagers recovering?

passages.title: It Takes A Village
passages.text: Very good, <class>! With the villagers rested we may yet stand a chance against the Zandalari.

passages.title: Revelations
passages.text:
The prisoner is being kept upstairs, <name>. It will be difficult to get information from him, but even the slightest detail about their location will help.

The elders have begun questioning him already. With their help we should be able to figure out our next move.

Go speak with him and see if he has any useful information.

passages.title: Revelations
passages.text: What did the prisoner have to say?

passages.title: Revelations
passages.text:
We cannot dwell on this setback, <name>. Prophet Khar'zul must be dealt with.

Every member of the Thunder King's forces we are able to destroy brings us one step closer to victory.

passages.title: A Blade is a Blade
passages.text:
This is no time to hold to tradition. Our masons' calloused hands bleed and tremble. Our blacksmiths cannot forge weapons as quickly as our sentinels can break them.

It is time to fight smart.

Many of the mantid come bearing weapons, and when they die, they simply leave them on the battlefield. It would be a shame to see them go to waste.

passages.title: A Blade is a Blade
passages.text: Our men are accustomed to fighting with maces and clubs. Unfortunatly, we have little time for customs.

passages.title: A Blade is a Blade
passages.text: I will see to it that these are properly distributed. What's more - I'll make sure our blacksmiths get a rest. Niuzao knows they deserve it.

passages.title: The Overwhelming Swarm
passages.text:
I command the sentinels of Niuzao. Every defender out there can hold his own against the mantid swarm.

The kunchong, however, are something different.

They are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to my sentinels' lives. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them. Niuzao... and perhaps you.

passages.title: The Overwhelming Swarm
passages.text:
Put on our armor, and you'd be indistinguishable from any of the other sentinels out there.

Good fighting, <race>.

passages.title: The Big Guns
passages.text:
The mantid now surround the Temple with their infernal war wagons. The sooner we are rid of those things, the better. You could destroy them with your own weapons and spells, but this will work much faster.

<Ogo hands you a few small casks of hastily-packed explosives.>

Beware of retaliation from mantid that remain be inside the war wagon when it explodes. In fact, I'd stay as far away from those things as possible.

passages.title: The Big Guns
passages.text: We can push these mantid back. We can outlast them.

passages.title: The Big Guns
passages.text:
Good, you're back in one piece.

We hope to be seeing more of you in the future, <race>.

passages.title: Herding Cats
passages.text:
Xuen trusted me to watch kittens. I like kittens. They are small things and funny.

But I lost kittens. They are strong and many.

Xuen sure to say I can no longer watch kittens. I must find kittens. Will you help?

Take my special cage and it will put them in a safe place.

passages.title: Free the Dissenters
passages.text:
Not all of my fellow villagers from Inkgill are corrupted. Many heeded my warnings and did not drink of the sha-tainted waters.

They are in hiding, terrified, and intimidated by the guards.

Please, tell them there is hope! Go into the village to the north. Speak with them and send them to me.

passages.title: Free the Dissenters
passages.text: Though we may not seem like much, from these inauspicious beginnings I know we will rebuild. Thank you, friend.

passages.title: Animal Control
passages.text:
The chasm is overrun with flame hounds and lava worms, and they will be entrenched indefinitely with such a large supply of trogg flesh for food.

This infestation needs to be taken care of now, before they endanger the city. You look like you can handle yourself, <name>.

I want you to clear a path through the beasts and make certain to take out the largest threats, Adjules and Magnaw.

passages.title: Animal Control
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Who knows what kind of destruction those beasts would have caused.

passages.title: The Dark Shaman
passages.text:
These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals.

I don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Horde. That's where you come in, <name>.

Fight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.

passages.title: The Dark Shaman
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The Dark Shaman
passages.text:
It would seem that the dark shaman experiments drove Gordoth insane.

Hopefully we've seen the last of this, <name>.

passages.title: No Orc Left Behind
passages.text:
This was supposed to be a routine sweep, <name>. Clean up a few troggs, make sure there is no threat to the city and then be in the tavern by midday.

Instead I've a group of scouts missing, flame hounds pouring out of the chasm and Xorenth going on about "the next twilight's hammer."

<Commander Bagran spits>

Go in there and get my scouts back so we can figure out what is going on down here.

passages.title: No Orc Left Behind
passages.text: Have you found the scouts?

passages.title: No Orc Left Behind
passages.text:
That's all that survived?

I don't know who these Dark Shaman are working for, but they are going to pay for this.

passages.title: Ancient Mogu Crypt
Joining the Alliance
passages.text:
We have a duty, <name>.

It is our responsibility to spread the Tushui philosophy beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle... and there is no better place to start doing that than here: Stormwind City, heart of the Alliance.

Let's find out who their leader is. We need allies.

passages.title: Joining the Alliance
passages.text:
<race>... you're here.

Good.

passages.title: The Alliance Way
passages.text:
I only recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I'd be glad to call you an ally, if you're willing to join our cause.

Walk with me, <name>.

passages.title: The Alliance Way
passages.text: Before you go, <name> - I have one more thing to discuss with you.

passages.title: An Old Pit Fighter
passages.text:
I need to know if you can fight. There may come a time where you will be called upon for military matters, and I need to know that you can protect my kingdom.

I've heard stories about pandaren fighting techniques, but I've never seen them in person.

Shall we?

passages.title: An Old Pit Fighter
passages.text:
You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Alliance. Fewer still would be willing to face the King of Stormwind in combat.

You, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Alliance, <name>.

passages.title: Open the Golden Doors
No Man Left Behind
passages.text:
I sent recon out over an hour ago and none of them have reported back. And now these damned hounds are pouring out of the chasm.

I don't know what's going on down there, but I'm not going anywhere till I get my men back.

I want you to head in there and find them, <name>, preferably while they are still alive.

passages.title: No Man Left Behind
passages.text: Have you found all the rangers?

passages.title: No Man Left Behind
passages.text:
That's all that survived?

The Horde is going to pay for this in blood.

passages.title: The Dark Shaman
passages.text:
These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals.

I don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Alliance. And I need your help stopping them, <name>. 

Fight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.

passages.title: The Dark Shaman
passages.text:
It would seem that the dark shaman experiments drove Gordoth insane.

Hopefully we've seen the last of this, <name>.

passages.title: Animal Control
passages.text:
I'm glad you're here, <name>. The horde is amassing an army and I'm not going to wait to find out why.

We need to strike fast and take down some of the larger beasts they have down here.

I want you to head in there and take care of Adarogg and Slagmaw before the horde can use them as weapons against us.

passages.title: Animal Control
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Who knows what kind of destruction those beasts would have caused.

passages.title: Path Less Traveled
passages.text:
The toughest roads often have the most to teach us, <class>. I will no doubt learn a great deal from following the path of Shaohao.

Many years ago Shaohao traveled to the highest peak in Kun-Lai to seek the guidance of the Jade Serpent. I too will travel to Seeker's Point in search of wisdom.

Perhaps you would be interested in a journey such as this? If so speak with Uncle Cloverleaf. He will help you prepare.

passages.title: Path Less Traveled
passages.text: Travel to Seeker's Point will require much good fortune, <class>. Hopefully you have many lucky trinkets!

passages.title: Dread Space
passages.text:
Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled <class> such as yourself.

Take a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.

passages.title: Dread Space
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Joining the Horde
passages.text:
Here we are, <name>... Orgrimmar, heart of the Horde.

We can be helpful beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle. There are innumerable problems out there, just waiting for us to solve them. This is what Master Shang Xi would have wanted.

There's no better place to start doing that than here, with the aid of the Horde. Let's find out who their leader is. We need allies.

passages.title: Joining the Horde
passages.text:
<race>... you're here.

Good.

passages.title: The Horde Way
passages.text:
I recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way.

I've recently been trying to bolster the strength of the Horde. A few pandaren might do us good.

Walk with me, <name>.

passages.title: The Horde Way
passages.text:
Ji. <name>. You're here, good.

Let's keep this moving.

passages.title: Hellscream's Gift
passages.text:
I need to know if you can fight... that you can kill, and live. Eventually, each of you will be called upon for war, and I need to know that you can be counted on.

I mentioned a gift earlier. It lies here, within the Ring of Valor. Step into the arena, right through this door behind me. I will test your skills.

passages.title: Hellscream's Gift
passages.text:
You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Horde. Fewer still would be willing to face a charging magnataur in combat.

You, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Horde, <name>.

passages.title: Your Private Collection
passages.text:
Pandaria is rich with history, legends, stories, and lore of every sort. While you are traveling throughout the world I would ask that you keep an eye open for artifacts and pieces of information that you feel would be pertinent to our work here.

When you accumulate enough knowledge, we will compile it in to a volume for your personal collection here.

You can, of course, return whenever you like to review the volumes we are making for you.

passages.title: Your Private Collection
passages.text: So much to learn.

passages.title: Your Private Collection
passages.text: Ah! Now that that is done we can start to place your collected research here. I look forward to seeing what you find.

passages.title: Sweet Tooth
passages.text:
We cannot summon a god without a worthy offering.

I have noticed a rare flower growing among the fields to the north.

The Starshade is a potent flower whose bloom holds a powerfully sweet, intoxicating liquor.

A single taste of this heady substance invigorates and strengthens the body.

Surely, this god will appreciate its worth.

passages.title: Defeat the Abomination
passages.text: Now that the pool of life is cleansed, the way to the crypt's interior is open. Make your way down there and defeat the abomination.

passages.title: Paragon 5
passages.text:
The emanations are growing stronger, <class>.

I feel them coming from the cave below us.

I wish to study the beast that you have slain, so I will grant you the honor of awakening the next paragon.

After all, the danger should be past.

Go now, wallstrider, before I change my mind.

passages.title: Into the Monastery
passages.text:
This... is unspeakable. If the monastery has truly been taken over by the Sha, we will need a great effort to purge the monks inside of corruption.

Gather a group of your allies, and meet me inside the Monastery.

passages.title: Into the Monastery
passages.text: You have come. Good. This is a calamitous situation.

passages.title: Into the Monastery
passages.text:
This... is unspeakable. If the monastery has truly been taken over by the Sha, we will need a great effort to purge the monks inside of corruption.

Gather a group of your allies, and meet me inside the Monastery.

passages.title: Into the Monastery
passages.text: You have come. Good. This is a calamitous situation.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text:
There are enemies of the Horde beneath this very city, <class>.

The Searing Blade plots to take Orgrimmar for their own, and have already taken Ragefire Chasm! We need to storm their forces and retake what is ours!

Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside Ragefire Chasm. He will have further orders for you.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text: I've been expecting your arrival, <name>.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text:
Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. <name>, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.

Go speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text:
Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. <name>, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.

Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text: I've been expecting your arrival, <name>.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text:
Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. <name>, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Undercity.

Go speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

passages.title: Enemies Below
passages.text: I've been expecting your arrival, <name>.

passages.title: The Challenger's Ring: Snow Blossom
passages.text:
News of your feats has been traveling around the camp, <name>.

In fact, Snow Blossom would like to test your skill in battle.

You had best prepare yourself, <class>. She is not easily defeated.

If you can prove your worth to her, you will win a valuable friend.

passages.title: The Challenger's Ring: Snow Blossom
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: The Challenger's Ring: Snow Blossom
passages.text:
Ahhhh, so you bested Snow Blossom in battle, did you?

She will be stinging from that loss for a while, I'd wager.

However, you have done well to win her to your side.

She does not warm to strangers quickly, but through time, she will prove to be a loyal and dependable companion.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text:
Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest.

The island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news.

Even more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island.

I need a capable <class> to check out the situation.

The Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, <name>, but we must continue to monitor their actions.

passages.title: Spiteful Sprites
passages.text:
The Darkwoods sprites on Shan'ze Dao have fallen to the mogu's domination.

The once sly tricksters are now the full servants of the Shan'ze. They grow bolder each day, stealing and killing to satisfy their masters.

They must be eliminated, but be careful. They may look harmless, but they are actually quite vicious.

passages.title: Spiteful Sprites
passages.text: Good work, <class>. Left unchecked, the sprites would soon outnumber our entire army.

passages.title: Illusions Of The Past
passages.text:
<class>, I need your strength to eliminate the Shan'ze Illusionists on Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest.

It wearies me to ask of you this difficult task.

The illusionists are among the strongest of the Shan'ze's elite sorcerors.

They will not be easy to defeat, but I know no <class> who is better suited to the task.

passages.title: Illusions Of The Past
passages.text: Do not be fooled by their illusions.

passages.title: Illusions Of The Past
passages.text:
I knew you could do this, <name>!

With fewer Shan'ze Illusionists to stand against us, our task here will be much easier.

passages.title: Little Hatchlings
passages.text:
I have seen the cruel experiments that the Shan'ze are performing on their island to the northwest.

The Shan'ze raise baby serpents from the egg. They keep the young in tiny cages, surrounded by squalor and filth.

The cruelest gaolers starve and torture them.

We must save as many hatchlings as we can. You have my full permission to punish any mogu that gets in your way!

passages.title: Little Hatchlings
passages.text:
Those creatures will remember you as their savior.

You have done well, <name>.

passages.title: Born Free
passages.text:
Do you know the story of the great cloud serpents of Pandaria, <name>?

Someday you must hear it. Unfortunately, there is no time to tell it now.

What you must know is that the wild cloudrunner serpents of Townlong are in trouble.

The mogu are capturing wild serpents and corrupting their minds, bending them to their sinister will.

Go to Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest. Free the adult serpents from their chains. Save them!

passages.title: Born Free
passages.text: Good work, <race>. It gladdens me to see that the wild serpents are free once again.

passages.title: In Sprite Of Everything
passages.text:
The sprites of Shan'ze Dao have always been capricious tricksters, but now they have fallen under the mogu's influence.

Even as we speak, they gather under a new leader.

We cannot allow this to happen.

Their mischievous pranks were one thing, but united, their dark magic is too powerful and too dangerous to comprehend.

Take out their leader before it is too late.

passages.title: In Sprite Of Everything
passages.text: The sprites are easily manipulated, and too dangerous to ignore.

passages.title: In Sprite Of Everything
passages.text:
Good work, <name>.

The wood sprites may look harmless, but that's what makes them so dangerous.

passages.title: The Funky Monkey Brew
passages.text:
Pirates! Our shores have been scoured by the most ill-tempered, ill-mannered, ill-hygienic, and ill-good hozen that ever was found in Pandaria. And to make matters worse, they claim to serve the legendary Captain Ook!

We see them every night partying and brewing punch on their island Unga Ingoo.

 I say we take their brew for a change! I think I can even improve their mix.

Gather up some friends and meet me on the southern side of Unga Ingoo. It is time for a Brew Run!

passages.title: The Funky Monkey Brew
passages.text: These hozen pack some mean toys and some meaner brews.

passages.title: The Funky Monkey Brew
passages.text: A fine punch! A fine punch indeed! The sort of punch that punches back. Well done, <class>!

passages.title: When The Dead Speak
passages.text:
The Shan'ze's experiments are overseen by a powerful necromancer known as a Shan'ze Deathspeaker.

If we are to put an end to their operations, we must eliminate their leader.

passages.title: When The Dead Speak
passages.text: What would possess the mogu to perform such hideous experiments?

passages.title: When The Dead Speak
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>.

I expected nothing less.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text:
Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest.

The island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news.

Even more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island.

I need a capable <class> to check out the situation.

The Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, <name>, but we must continue to monitor their actions.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text:
Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest.

The island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news.

Even more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island.

I need a capable <class> to check out the situation.

The Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.

passages.title: The Mogu Menace
passages.text: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, <name>, but we must continue to monitor their actions.

passages.title: Assault Fire Camp Gai-Cho
passages.text:
The Yaungol are a constant nuisance, but the group at Fire Camp Gai-Cho, to the northeast, conspired with the Osul yaungol in their recent incursion into Kun-Lai.

We cannot allow such an incursion to go unpunished.

Go, attack Fire Camp Gai-Cho. We need to make sure they remain occupied, so that they cannot rise up and threaten The Ox Gate again.

passages.title: Assault Fire Camp Gai-Cho
passages.text: Is your raid on Gai-Cho complete?

passages.title: Assault Fire Camp Gai-Cho
passages.text: Well - that should certainly deter any attack for a while. Good work, <name>.

passages.title: Uruk!
passages.text: Uruk is the Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol. Your mission will not be truly complete until you defeat him. Go to it!

passages.title: Uruk!
passages.text: How goes the mission?

passages.title: Uruk!
passages.text: Uruk is dead! This threat has subsided, at least for today. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Cheng Bo!
passages.text:
Cheng Bo is the Warbringer of Fire Camp Gai-Cho. While you've made a dent in their operations, you now have an opportunity to strike a major blow. 

Slay the Warbringer!

passages.title: Cheng Bo!
passages.text: How goes the assualt?

passages.title: Cheng Bo!
passages.text: With Cheng Bo subdued, we can refocus our efforts on our other enemies. Your efforts earn you much respect, <name>.

passages.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
passages.text:
It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. <class>s like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.

Xi, Friend of the Small has visited us from a faraway land and will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She's waiting for you on the small practice field across the road.

passages.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
passages.text:
Why, you look great! I've heard bad things about what happens down there.

Well, are you ready to start your training in the ways of the <class>?

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text:
I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin and the other gnomes have mentioned that memory loss is pretty common for you survivors.

Anyways, High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text: It's good to meet you, <name>. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text:
So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...

<McBride looks through some papers.>

<name>. It is <name>, right?

You've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.

Head northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: Have you beaten back the Blackrock worgs?

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: You've bought us a little time, <name>, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text:
The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.

In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!

Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text: Kill the spies!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!

passages.title: Calligraphed Letter
passages.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, <name>. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

passages.title: Calligraphed Letter
passages.text:
Ah, you got my letter, <name>... good.
I've come from afar to teach your people the ways of the <class>.

passages.title: Calligraphed Letter
passages.text: I  have come from very far to train you in the ways of our people. Do not hesitate to come to me for training whenever you like.

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text:
I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, <name>!

Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text:
Have you ever seen a goblin, <name>? They're wretched little monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.

The Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.

I need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text: Kill the goblin assassins!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.

passages.title: Scribbled Scroll
passages.text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. The pandaren visitor, Ting, sent it for you. Maybe you monks can read this garbage, but I can't. You should go talk to her. She's in the Inn across the way.

passages.title: Scribbled Scroll
passages.text: Oh, yes, I sent that for you. I hope to prove that Forsaken can learn the arts of the <class> - perhaps you can help?

passages.title: Scribbled Scroll
passages.text: Yes, you can come to me to learn more about our people and our ways, especially when it comes to the arts of the <class>.

passages.title: Tiger Palm
passages.text: As you overcome great challenges in your journey to master struggles both internal and external, you will begin to uncover new abilities hidden inside yourself. Go, now, and develop a mastery of yourself, such that you uncover the Tiger Palm technique. Then, go practice it on a training dummy.

passages.title: Tiger Palm
passages.text: Ah, it's my favorite pupil! I'm going to go ahead to Undercity and try to teach the way of the <class> to some of the Deathguards. You should meet up with me there.

passages.title: Novice Elreth
passages.text:
Actually, before I go - you should speak with Novice Elreth. She had some work for you, and you would do well to help others and improve your skills.

The next time you see me, I will be in Undercity.

passages.title: Elegant Rune
passages.text: <name>, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from our visitor from afar, Lo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

passages.title: Elegant Rune
passages.text: I like it here, <name>. Your people have quite an appreciation for the finer things!

passages.title: Elegant Rune
passages.text: Well, it is good to see you. I must say, as much as you learn from me, I think I will learn from your people. Your brews are quite different than mine!

passages.title: Calligraphed Parchment
passages.text:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from our Pandaren friend, Gato. He visits from afar to grant us the honor of his wisdom, and to teach the ways of the monk. Do not shame your people by failing at his lessons!

passages.title: Calligraphed Parchment
passages.text: Ahh, you have come.

passages.title: Calligraphed Parchment
passages.text: We will honor our respective peoples by learning from each other. You will become a great <class>, if I have anything to say about it. And I will learn the ways of your people.

passages.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
passages.text:
Alright, mon. We start with da basics. I need ta know dat you know how ta swing dat weapon you're totin' around.

Go thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch ya fighting form and we'll go from dere.

passages.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
passages.text:
Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya punches - you may have a talent for dis.

Some rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.

passages.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
passages.text:
Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.

Vol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.

No, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.

It's time to begin ya trainin', <name>. Speak with Zabrax to the east.

passages.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
passages.text:
Anotha newblood, eh?

Ya actually look ta be in shape though. Steady hands. Fierce eyes. I may be able ta turn ya into a real <class>.

Lets not waste anymore time 'den.

passages.title: A Rough Start
passages.text:
Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.

There be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.

Dey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.

passages.title: A Rough Start
passages.text: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.

passages.title: A Rough Start
passages.text: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.

passages.title: More Than Expected
passages.text:
Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.

Head down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.

passages.title: More Than Expected
passages.text: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

passages.title: Calligraphed Note
passages.text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, <name>. I believe she was sent by our Pandaren visitor, Shoyu. You should read it.

passages.title: Calligraphed Note
passages.text: Ah, I am pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Calligraphed Note
passages.text: I am honored that Chief Hawkwind would allow me to train you and grant you your rite of passage. While I am a master in the ways of the <class>, I am but a child in the ways of your people.

passages.title: Calligraphed Sigil
passages.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our Pandaren visitor, Laoxi. It seems he would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.

passages.title: Calligraphed Sigil
passages.text:
Ah, you have come. Good.

I am learning so much - your people have a wealth of knowledge unmatched anywhere I have seen. As much as I am humbled by that fact, I hope that I may teach you of our ways, as well.

passages.title: Calligraphed Sigil
passages.text:
I was warned that not all of your people would be welcoming, but I have found quite the opposite - not only have I been welcomed, but I have learned so much from you.

You seem quite promising as a young <class>, and I hope I can teach you much of our ways, as your people have taught me of yours.

passages.title: Slitherscale Suppression
passages.text:
The Slitherscale take orders from their leader, the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord. He can be found celebrating his victories on the southeastern corner of Windward Isle.

If we can destroy this leader, we can deal their tribe a great blow.

Without their lord, the Slitherscale will think twice before attacking the gentle cloud serpents of the east.

passages.title: Slitherscale Suppression
passages.text: A snake without a head cannot strike.

passages.title: Slitherscale Suppression
passages.text: Wonderful! I knew you could triumph against the Slitherscale lord.

passages.title: Sra'vess Wetwork
passages.text:
The mantid outnumber us quite badly. Hundreds of them for each of us.

And, they surround us on two sides - at Gao-Ran in the south we're holding them off, but to the west, on the island they call Sra'vess, they continue to mass unabated.

We're not stupid. We're not going to launch a full scale attack on them. We can't sustain an intense battle on multiple fronts.

Instead, we're going to send you, and one of our Wu Kao, to do some dirty work. Sounds fun, doesn't it?

passages.title: Sra'vess Wetwork
passages.text: The mission isn't complete, <name>.

passages.title: Sra'vess Wetwork
passages.text: Good work. I think it's always best to strike while they're unprepared.

passages.title: The Bigger They Come...
passages.text:
Killing the smaller mantid works mostly as a distraction. It forces them to replenish their numbers before they consider any serious offensive.

The big ones, though - we kill a few of those, and we really disrupt operations on the island. That buys ourselves a substantial amount of time. With mantid, it's like their size is directly proportional to their importance in the empire.

So kill some of the big ones for me, while you're out there.

passages.title: The Bigger They Come...
passages.text: I don't think you're done yet.

passages.title: The Bigger They Come...
passages.text: Well done, well done. That should keep us safe for a few days, at least.

passages.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Hivelord
passages.text:
Near the ocean, on the eastern side of Sra'vess, there is a cavern that leads to a network of caves.

From there, the Sra'thik Hivelord maintains Sra'vess and plots against us. If we manage to take him out, we'll disrupt their operations for days.

Let's go to it.

passages.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Hivelord
passages.text: We've got to kill the Hivelord.

passages.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Hivelord
passages.text:
Well done, <name>! Because you took on that extra work, you've bought us some respite from the mantid.

I'm sure I'll have more work for you in the future, though. Come back later.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
passages.text:
I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.

You're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.

If you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

passages.title: Venomous Intent
passages.text:
If we are to strike against the Empress, we must arm ourselves with weapons. My own choice of weapon is of a particularly toxic design.

The scorpions wandering the ledge produce a deadly venom that they store in their tails.

Bring me their stingers, and I will show you how I earned the title of paragon.

passages.title: Venomous Intent
passages.text: Did you feel the venomtail's sting? Such lovely pain.

passages.title: Venomous Intent
passages.text:
Well done, Wakener. I hope you handled these stingers carefully.

The natural poison from these scorpions is deadly, but slow.

passages.title: Dark Wings, Dark Things
passages.text:
I require another ingredient to create my first poison, Wakener.

This ingredient you can easily find on the scarabs nearby.

Kill them and bring me their wings.

passages.title: Dark Wings, Dark Things
passages.text: Scarab wings can be crushed to produce a very fine white, deadly powder.

passages.title: Dark Wings, Dark Things
passages.text:
Yes, excellent, Wakener! These are perfect.

Have you ever considered learning the poisoner's craft?

passages.title: A Shade of Dread
passages.text:
The last ingredient is perhaps the deadliest.

The dreadshade flower grows all along these hills.

It is by eating these poisonous plants that the local wildlife has become so venomous.

A single drop of dreadshade nectar can stop a kunchong's heart.

Go and bring me some of these flowers. Do not be tempted to taste them.

passages.title: A Shade of Dread
passages.text: Sometimes, the most beautiful things are also the most dangerous.

passages.title: A Shade of Dread
passages.text:
Many would not know the value of what you hold.

You have done well, Wakener.

passages.title: An Ancient Empire
passages.text:
My brothers speak of an ancient mogu empire that once dwelled in the ruins to the east.

Once, this tribe knew untold secrets of sorcery and subjugation.

I have a curious mind, Wakener, and I wish to learn of the empires that ruled after my time.

Knowledge of the past will determine our future.

Go search the ruins for their ancient tablets. I will study their secrets and make them our own.

passages.title: An Ancient Empire
passages.text: What knowledge do you bring?

passages.title: An Ancient Empire
passages.text: Good, Wakener. It will take me time to decipher these tablets, but all knowledge is worthy.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Ah! Greetings friend of Lorewalker Cho. I have a message for you.

<The strange little creature hands you a battered scroll case.>

The Lorewalker waits for you in Kun-Lai. Very dangerous to travel there, yes, very dangerous.

Look for guides along the road to help you find your way.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text: More strangers? This day is testing my limits.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Oh, you are a friend of Cho's? Welcome! Welcome!

I would serve you a banquet but as you can see we are in dire straights at the moment.

Say, would you be willing to lend us a hand?

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Ah! Greetings friend of Lorewalker Cho. I have a message for you.

<The strange little creature hands you a battered scroll case.>

The Lorewalker waits for you in Kun-Lai. Very dangerous to travel there, yes, very dangerous.

Look for guides along the road to help you find your way.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text: More strangers? This day is testing my limits.

passages.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
passages.text:
Oh, you are a friend of Cho's? Welcome! Welcome!

I would serve you a banquet, but as you can see, we are in dire straights at the moment.

Say, would you be willing to lend us a hand?

passages.title: Captain Jack's Dead
passages.text:
Gore from Captain Jack's head drips and mysteriously seeps into the ground as you examine your hard-won trophy.

Strange, but no time to investigate that now. There's too much work to be done.

The chieftain of your newfound friends will doubtlessly be impressed with this proof of your grookin' skills.

passages.title: Captain Jack's Dead
passages.text: Ookin' grookin, wikket!

passages.title: Mogu Incursions
passages.text:
We've heard reports of a group of Mogu infiltrating the coast here in Townlong. I have no idea what they are doing. Frankly, I don't care. 

You've proven yourself, so we've decided to give this mission to you.

What's going to happen is this - you're going to go, find them, and kill them.

Our scouts reported the first group landed to the north, between here and Deadtalker's Plateau. Go there and wipe them out.

passages.title: Mogu Incursions
passages.text: Why aren't they dead already?

passages.title: Mogu Incursions
passages.text: It was just a decoy! They've moved to attack Niuzao Temple!

passages.title: Mistblade Destruction
passages.text:
Korven has told me of his findings. There is an enormous amber deposit sitting at the bottom of the Lake of Stars.

Unfortunately, a hostile saurok tribe lives at the edge of the lake, and revere the amber as their own.

They will not allow us to enter their territory easily.

Go south to the lake. Kill the Mistblade saurok, so that we can more easily harvest the nearby amber.

passages.title: Mistblade Destruction
passages.text: Well done. With access to this amber, we shall be able to craft weapons to our cause.

passages.title: The Scale-Lord
passages.text:
The saurok at the Lake of Stars take their orders from their Scale-Lord, a vicious, merciless leader who guards his territory fiercely.

If we can eliminate this leader, then we can gain access to the enormous amber lode beneath the lake.

Go. Their leader gives his orders from his underground dwelling, at the southern edge of the lake.

passages.title: The Scale-Lord
passages.text: Good. I am glad to hear that he is dead.

passages.title: The Fight Against Fear
passages.text:
When we discovered the sha influence at Kypari Zar, I had hoped the corruption could still be cleansed.

Unfortunately, the Klaxxi Council has confirmed that the sha of fear's corruption is deep-seated, and continues to spread.

To the south, I have observed some of the local wildlife consumed by an unnamed terror.

The sha can warp and twist its victims into unimaginable horrors.

We must stop the corruption before it becomes worse. Seek out the sha-infected Horrorscale Scorpids. Eliminate them.

passages.title: The Fight Against Fear
passages.text:
You have purged the hills of the infected creatures? Good.

The sha is a merciless enemy. Thus must we be merciless in return.

passages.title: Bad Genes
passages.text:
Far to the south, Wakener, the Empress's genemancers set about their dark experiments. (Dark yes, but not as dark as mine!)

They dissect and mutate the nearby wildlife, breeding creatures of their own design. (Their design, which will become my design!)

We must not let them succeed! (No, no! Only I am allowed such power!)

Their mutations are already being unleashed for war. Go! Destroy them at any cost!

passages.title: Bad Genes
passages.text: Is it done? Are my competitio - I mean, our enemies - dead?

passages.title: Bad Genes
passages.text:
Yes, yes! They are dead!

Thank you, Wakener. Well done.

passages.title: Relics of the Swarm
So You Want to Be a Chef...
passages.text:
You wish to be a chef? If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are.

If you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn how to slice peaches and show me what you've learned. I have fresh pandaren peaches which I will sell to you at a token price.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Chef...
passages.text: Show me that you can follow instructions.

passages.title: So You Want to Be a Chef...
passages.text: Very well.  You are capable of learning.  There is much I can teach you, and I have most of the ingredients you need to learn. Train with me.

passages.title: The Spring Drifter
passages.text:
Nobody really travels up the Ancient Passage on foot. That is just asking for a faceful of saurok if you are not careful.

Tell you what, Egg Shell and I were just about to set off upriver to Binan Village. Want a lift?

passages.title: The Spring Drifter
passages.text: It is always good luck to have a grummle aboard when traveling through a saurok infested cave.

passages.title: The Spring Drifter
passages.text: Wheh, we made it. Welcome to Binan Village.

passages.title: Educating Saurok
passages.text:
The Spring Road is under the protection of her ladyship, the esteemed Madam Goya.

The saurok of Hatescale Burrow northeast of here require "education" in this fact. We have warned them before but sadly they seem to have a very short memory.

Travel northeast to this burrow and find their shaman leader. Eliminate him and you will have the gratitude of her ladyship. As well as an appropriate bounty.

passages.title: Educating Saurok
passages.text: The deed is done and a debt must be paid. Here is your reward. You have our gratitude.

passages.title: Research Project: The Mogu Dynasties
passages.text:
Ah, an explorer. Just what I could use. I am on the verge of discovering the dark secrets of the mogu.

Not all of the secrets, mind you. They kept a lot of dark secrets. But I am on the verge of discovering "a" secret at least.

If, in your travels, you come across some fragments of the mogu past, bring them to me and I will happily reimburse you for them.

passages.title: Research Project: The Mogu Dynasties
passages.text: It is dangerous to forget our past.

passages.title: Research Project: The Mogu Dynasties
passages.text: Ah! Some fine pieces here. Very fine pieces indeed. My thanks, adventurer.

passages.title: Uncovering the Past
passages.text:
Interested in being a Lorewalker? There is lots of digging and reading and digging and more reading.

I have entire days where I stare at a broken vase trying to figure out how it goes back together.

Should give it a try. Go solve one artifact of Pandaria and we will appreciate you sharing the knowledge of how you did it.

passages.title: Uncovering the Past
passages.text: I am beginning to wonder if I'll ever get the hang of this stuff.

passages.title: Uncovering the Past
passages.text:
Wow! You got the pieces to meld together so well. The quality of this restoration is amazing.

How did you do it?

passages.title: Ready for Greatness
passages.text: You seem to know your way around the kitchen. Demonstrate to me your skills and make me 5 bowls of rice pudding.

passages.title: Ready for Greatness
passages.text: I believe you have the potential to be a great chef, but the proof is in the pudding, so to speak.

passages.title: Ready for Greatness
passages.text: You are ready. You are now a zen master cook.

passages.title: Learning the Ropes
passages.text:
Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills!

Head out into the forest and pick a fight with a battle pet. Make sure to use your Track Pets skill so you can see pets you can fight on the minimap. Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!

passages.title: Learning the Ropes
passages.text: Nice work, <name>!  You're better with those pets than I thought!

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day! Visit Erma, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Are your pets feeling better?

passages.title: On The Mend
passages.text: Now those look like some healthy pets, <name>.  Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text:
I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, <name>. I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.

Julia Stevens can be found at the Maclure Vineyards south of Stormwind. She is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced her in battle!

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: How is your team coming along? I have two snakes so far!

passages.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
passages.text: You're better with those pets than I thought!

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: I'm excited to start my training. We start with sliced peaches, right?

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: I really want to be a chef, but the other kids already started a couple of months ago. There's no way I can catch up without your help.

passages.title: Lesson 1: Sliced Peaches
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: Instant noodles aren't that hard to cook, right?

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: It's so easy to overcook the noodles!

passages.title: Lesson 2: Instant Noodles
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: Cooking is harder than I thought. It's so easy to burn things.

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: I hope I don't burn myself.  Eep.

passages.title: Lesson 3: Toasted Fish Jerky
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: I'm not very fond of mushrooms... but I'll do my best to learn.

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: Ick.

passages.title: Lesson 4: Dried Needle Mushrooms
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: I love rice cakes. I'll do my best to make good ones!

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: I can't wait to see how they turn out!

passages.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
passages.text: Here it is!  How did I do?

passages.title: A Token of Appreciation
passages.text: Thanks for checking to make sure I'm doing well! I've been able to help out the Ironpaws today, and they said I could give this to you.

passages.title: A Token of Appreciation
passages.text: You're my favorite teacher ever.

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text:
Sigh... you guessed it... Sheepie is gone... AGAIN.

Stupid sheep! Gives me so much trouble!

I hate to ask you again, but I promise this will be the last time.

Can you find him for me?

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text: Where's Sheepie?

passages.title: Oh Sheepie...
passages.text:
What? Sheepie is... gone?

<Chee Chee's lip begins to quiver.>

passages.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
passages.text:
You have proven yourself in battle.

Still, if you would aid us further, I must ask something else of you.

The Sha of Violence awaits beyond within the Sealed Chambers. Destroy it if you would earn my respect.

passages.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
passages.text:
You have defeated the Sha of Violence and saved the monastery. You have my respect.

Perhaps we were wrong about your people, <name>.

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text:
We need reinforcements! Someone has to fight through and light the signal flame.

It's all up to you, <class>. No pressure or anything.

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text: <name>, you need to get out there and signal the reinforcements!

passages.title: Lighting the Way
passages.text: Outstanding, <name>. Your timing couldn't have been better!

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text:
I sent a dozen of my best men ahead to infiltrate the mantid siege.

None have returned.

Since you are taking the fight directly to the mantid, you will be in a position to free any who had the misfortune to be captured.

You will do this?

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text: My men are being held somewhere amongst the mantid siege.

passages.title: Somewhere Inside
passages.text:
Thirteen thanks I give to you; twelve for those you rescued and my own as well.

Here's something else I give to you in gratitude.

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text:
If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.

I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text: You ready to catch some FISH?

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text:
If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.

I'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

passages.title: The Anglers
passages.text: You ready to catch some FISH?

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text:
The Tillers do their business at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

If you're interested in getting started, I hear there's a new farmer in town by the name of Farmer Yoon.

I betcha he'll be looking for help.

passages.title: The Tillers
passages.text: You arrived just in time!

passages.title: The Order of the Cloud Serpent
passages.text:
The Order of the Cloud Serpent is always searching for talented riders.
