passages.title: Saur Loser
passages.text:
Inside the Beast Pens you will encounter some of the most skilled beast tamers in the Zandalari military. They are trained to kill with axe, beast, and claw. This is where they build their cavalry.

We need you to kill any Zandalari you find in the Beast Pens before they can get their mounted monstrosities out into the open battlefield.

passages.title: Saur Loser
passages.text: These trolls have been using dark magics to achieve their goals. No patience, no honor. You have done the world a good service in reducing their numbers today.

passages.title: Loa-saur
passages.text:
The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.

We need to put a stop to this.

Search the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.

We must not allow these atrocities to continue.

passages.title: Loa-saur
passages.text: I always believed the loa to be a simple troll superstition. These Zandalari are full of surprises.

passages.title: Loa-saur
passages.text: Well done, champion. These beasts are strong enough. We don't need them infused with an angry spirit now do we?

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text:
One of my scryers has identified a Zandalari leader near the central tower. He needs to be removed.

Would you be willing to do this for me, <class>?

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text: You're dependable, <name>. I like that.

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text:
One of my scouts has returned with word of a mogu leader under the central tower. He needs to be removed.

Would you be willing to do this for me, <class>?

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text: I appreciate what you've done for us this day, <name>.

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari war party down on the beach just outside these walls. We need to eliminate them before returning to camp.

Are you up for the task?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. That's a worry off my mind.

passages.title: Zandalari on the Rise
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Can you handle this one?

passages.title: Zandalari on the Rise
passages.text: Yet again you prove yourself. We would be fortunate if all amongst us could aspire to your talents.

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari war party up the beach. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Would you be willing to handle this one?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: Your skills are impressive. You have our gratitude.

passages.title: The Beast Pens
passages.text:
I do not want to see another Zandalari beast rider breach our defenses!

I have dispatched Scout Captain Daelin and some war mages to the Beast Pens northwest of here. Their mission is to infiltrate and harass the Zandalari siege and cavalry units. I want you to join them and lend your expertise.

Keep an eye out for the tell tale shimmer of their magical cloaking spell.

passages.title: The Beast Pens
passages.text: Today, we hunt the hunters!

passages.title: No Time To Rest
passages.text:
We have accomplished much since arriving here, but now is not the time to rest. Your efforts have helped us breach the upper level of the Thunder King's stronghold.

Now, I call on you to continue our campaign. Report to Scout Captain Daelin within Conqueror's Terrace. He will have further orders for you.

passages.title: No Time To Rest
passages.text:
The Zandalari here are not to be under-estimated, <class>. Powerful magic overwhelms this space.

We must be diligent in our efforts.

passages.title: Trailing Light in the Dark
passages.text:
There is some dark magic in the Diremoor that extinguishes even our magical illuminations, and so our scouts struggle to find their way.

As you pass through the swamp, relight any torches you find that our men might find their way. Perhaps they will help you find your way back as well.

passages.title: A Wing to Fly On
passages.text:
I've just received a report that another young pterrorwing has been spotted in the Diremoor.

We need to recover as many of these as we can find. They may be the key to flying on this island.

passages.title: A Wing to Fly On
passages.text: A great gloom looms over this island...

passages.title: A Wing to Fly On
passages.text: Wonderful! I'll pass him off to our caretaker. Thank you.

passages.title: The Sleepless Legion
passages.text: The Shan'ze are animating an army from the statues in the center of the isle, an army that batters our defenses day and night. Destroy any of the walking statues you see. Our defenders will greatly appreciate it.

passages.title: The Sleepless Legion
passages.text: You are not done just yet, <class>.

passages.title: The Sleepless Legion
passages.text: Your efforts are appreciated, <class>.

passages.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
passages.text: There are mogu in the Diremoor animating the army of statues near the tower. Vereesa wants them dead. I think you're the one to do it.

passages.title: Enemies Beneath the Tower
passages.text: Well done, <class>. Thank you for the help.

passages.title: The Shuddering Moor
passages.text:
There is an immense beast in the swamp. It has not yet marched upon us, but I place no stock that we will continue to be so fortunate.

Strike it down before it grows hungry enough to brave our defenses.

passages.title: The Shuddering Moor
passages.text:
You are not one to be trifled with. I am sure to have further use of your services.

Come back to me in a day's time, <class>.

passages.title: The Zandalari Colossus
passages.text: The trolls have dispatched one of their immense constructs on the southern road, blocking our passage around the island. See to it that the road is cleared, <class>.

passages.title: The Zandalari Colossus
passages.text:
When I give you a task, it gets handled.

Well done, <class>.

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text:
One of the scryers has identified a Zandalari leader near the central tower. He needs to be removed.

Would you be willing to handle this?

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text: You're dependable, <name>. I like that.

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text:
One of Vereesa's scouts has returned with word of a mogu leader under the central tower. He needs to be removed.

Would you be willing to handle this?

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text: I appreciate what you've done for us this day, <name>.

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: The scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari among the bones west of Ihgaluk Crag. We need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Among the Bones
passages.text: It's good to have a man I can trust close at hand.

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text: The scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari just this side of Za'Tual. We need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?

passages.title: Competing Magic
passages.text: Your skills are impressive indeed. Thank you for doing this for me, <name>.

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text:
We've received word of a Zandalari war party up the beach, north of our foothold. We need them hunted down and killed.

Are you willing to do this thing for us, <class>?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: You have our gratitude, <name>.

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text:
The scryers have spotted a mogu leader at the central tower. He needs to be killed before he can mount an offensive on our position.

Can you take care of this for us?

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Imposing Threat
passages.text: One less threat at our doorstep. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Raining Bones
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Would you be willing to do the deed?

passages.title: Raining Bones
passages.text: You're a good <class> to have around, that's for certain. Thank you.

passages.title: Zandalari on the Rise
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Can you handle this one?

passages.title: Zandalari on the Rise
passages.text: Yet again you prove yourself. We would be fortunate if all amongst us could aspire to your talents.

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari war party down on the beach just outside these walls. We need to eliminate them before returning to camp.

Are you up for the task?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. That's a worry off my mind.

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text:
We've spotted a Zandalari war party up the beach. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.

Would you be willing to handle this one?

passages.title: Encroaching Force
passages.text: Your skills are impressive. You have our gratitude.

passages.title: The Zandalari Prophecy
passages.text:
Dear adventurer,

I have read your reports on the Zandalari and believe I have some clues as to their most recent aggression.

If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.

Thank you for your diligence!

Sincerely,

Lorewalker Cho

passages.title: The Zandalari Prophecy
passages.text:
No wonder the Zandalari have come. They are in need of a new home, and I am sure their mogu allies have promised them much.

We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.

passages.title: Rumbles of Thunder
passages.text:
Dear adventurer,

The foreboding sound of thunder has haunted my people for generations. And as you have discovered in your own research, Lei Shen is at the heart of that fear.

If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.

Thank you for your diligence!

Sincerely,

Lorewalker Cho

passages.title: Rumbles of Thunder
passages.text:
What we know of Lei Shen are dark legends that have been remembered over the vast span of time. I often wondered if these legends had exaggerated the power of Lei Shen. But your research would suggest they may have greatly underestimated the Thunder King. These are dark days indeed.

We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.

passages.title: Gods and Monsters
passages.text:
Dear adventurer,

Is it true that the mogu are really connected to the titans? I find this very hard to believe. But looking over your research, some of the truth about the mogu begins to take shape.

If you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.

Thank you for your diligence!

Sincerely,

Lorewalker Cho

passages.title: Gods and Monsters
passages.text:
Your research is most distressing. But it sheds light on a truth we have long sought: "Where did the mogu come from? And why were they such tyrants?"

We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.

passages.title: Beasts of Fable
passages.text: Have you ever read the great Pandaren book of fables? Pandaren pass these stories on to their cubs - stories of the cricket and the hawk, or the slow-moving turtle - to teach them lessons that they will find useful in life. What few cubs know is that these creatures exist, here, in Pandaria! Though the stories of their travels are made up, they are powerful denizens of this world. Should you happen upon them in your travels, you may test the might of your pets against their storied statures.

passages.title: Beasts of Fable
passages.text: You found them all? Amazing! So the stories ARE true! Perhaps you will write the next great Pandaren fable based on your own incredible journey!

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book I
passages.text: The stories of Ka'wi the Gorger, Nitun, Kafi, and Dos-Ryga will exist in this land, always. Do you wish to meet them in battle once more?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book I
passages.text: Do you return victorious?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book I
passages.text: I bow to you who continues to walk in the footfalls of the great Pandaren fables.

passages.title: Giant Dinosaur Bone
passages.text: <Ku'ma shrugs.>

passages.title: More Giant Dinosaur Bones
passages.text: Bones bones bones bones bones...

passages.title: Many More Giant Dinosaur Bones
passages.text: Too many, not enough, no no...give them to Ku'ma...

passages.title: Learn To Ride
passages.text: It's time for you to learn how to ride! Seek out Randal Hunter at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. Don't forget to buy your mount while you are there!

passages.title: Learn To Ride
passages.text: Don't forget to buy your mount while you are here!  Katie Hunter can be found here in camp.

passages.title: Made for War
passages.text:
Some things are built with multiple purposes in mind. Some things are built with the sole purpose of destruction.

A massive construct called the Pyrestar Demolisher sits guarding Dawnseeker Promontory. Its purpose is solely to destroy. It must be dismantled.

passages.title: Made for War
passages.text:
Excellent work, <race>. The problem with constructs is they can always be rebuilt.

I imagine it will not take the Sunreavers long to build a new death machine.

passages.title: Mana Scavengers
passages.text:
Sometimes, even the smallest creatures can be the biggest threat.

The Sunreavers brought mana wyrms with them. Though small in size they have the ability to cripple our casters in combat. Many have learned the hard way not to underestimate them.

They must be dealt with and quickly.

passages.title: Mana Scavengers
passages.text: You've made excellent progress today, <class>. Rest assured however, our work here is nowhere close to done.

passages.title: Work Order: Dominance Offensive I
passages.text:
<Yoon's writing decorates the page though his feelings seem conflicted.>

I normally try to stay out of conflict, but an order is an order. Since you are of the Horde I decided to pass this order your way.

The Dominance Offensive has requested an order of red blossom leeks.

The troops down there just can't seem to get enough of them! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32642))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32642))");

passages.title: Work Order: Operation: Shieldwall I
passages.text:
<Yoon's writing decorates the page though his feelings seem conflicted.>

I normally try to stay out of conflict, but an order is an order. Since you are of the Alliance I decided to pass this order your way.

Operation: Shieldwall has requested a whole heap of witchberries.

I can't be sure, but I think they have an idea to use them in some sort of weapon. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

passages.title: Work Order: Golden Lotus I
passages.text:
<Yoon kept this order request short.>

The Golden Lotus have requested a large number of white turnips.

Their request mentioned something about trouble-making sprites wreaking havoc on Mistfall Village. Apparently the sprites don't like turnips! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32647))

passages.title: Work Order: Shado-Pan I
passages.text:
<Yoon's writing seems rushed. He must have been excited.>

The Shado-Pan want crops from you! What an honor indeed!

A request came in this morning for green cabbages. Apparently, they make a rather tasty cabbage soup with them.

Only the finest will do for the Shado-Pan! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32649))

passages.title: Work Order: The August Celestials I
passages.text:
<Yoon's familiar writing scrolls across the tattered paper.>

The trainees out at the Cradle of Chi-Ji are in need of striped melons. Apparently, they use them in their training exercises.

A representative will be by tomorrow to collect whatever striped melons you can spare. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32653))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32653))");

passages.title: Work Order: The Klaxxi I
passages.text:
<Though Yoon's writing leaves something to be desired, it's nice to still have a little piece of him on the farm.>

An order came in this morning from the Klaxxi. Strangely enough they are requesting mogu pumpkins for some kind of research.

I find it's best not to ask them too many questions...

Best get started on their order. I'd hate to see what a bug of that size could do to your crops if you don't!

passages.title: Inherit the Earth
passages.text:
As you know, <name>, I'm getting along in my years. One can't stay a spry young pandaren forever, you know.

I'm looking for someone to take over my duties here at the Tillers Union, and I can't think of a better person than Farmer Yoon.

He's got a good deal to learn, but he's got a good head on his shoulders and most importantly, a generous heart.

Do you think he'd be interested?

passages.title: Inherit the Earth
passages.text: Why I just knew you could convince him, <name>. You've set my heart at ease, knowing the Tillers will be in good hands.

passages.title: You Want Fish?
passages.text: Are you looking for golden carp? or some other Pandaren fish? I'm no fisherman myself, but there is a fellow by the river who has been teaching the folks traveling through here. If you go speak with him, he will likely give you some fish, as well as teach you how to fish.

passages.title: You Want Fish?
passages.text: Ah!  Have you come to learn how to fish? You're talking to the right person. First, here - have some fish!

Taming the Tempest

Eyes of the Thunder King
Mogu Runes of Fate
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. I am privileged to offer you an excellent opportunity. Through the centuries, we've honed a method by which the very laws of chance themselves can be bent. With a Mogu Rune of Fate, valuable artifacts will find their way into your hands more frequently inside the palace of the Thunder King.

passages.title: Mogu Runes of Fate
passages.text: May these charms bring you great luck, <name>.

passages.title: Mogu Runes of Fate
passages.text: May the stars smile upon you, <name>.

passages.title: The Court of Bones
passages.text:
The mogu within the nearby Court of Bones pose a constant threat to our foothold on this island. Grand Magister Rommath has been entrusted with halting their efforts, but I am certain he could use a capable <class> to see this task through.

Go to him. Aid in whatever ways that you are able.

passages.title: The Court of Bones
passages.text: Yes, good, come... there is work to be done.

passages.title: Za'Tual
passages.text:
The Zandalari have been a constant nuisance since we arrived on this island. I've assigned Halduron Brightwing to take charge of dismantling their presence at Za'Tual, in the south.

Report to Halduron when you are best able. He will have work for you.

passages.title: Za'Tual
passages.text: One more to join the Zandalari hunt?  Good.  Very good.

passages.title: Ihgaluk Crag
passages.text:
Aethas has taken over at Ihgaluk Crag, to the southeast, continuing his effort to turn the Saurok against the Zandalari and mogu.

Go to him, and help in any way that you can.

passages.title: Ihgaluk Crag
passages.text: You have good timing. I am quite in need of your assistance.

passages.title: The Court of Bones
passages.text:
The mogu within the nearby Court of Bones comprise one of the greatest threats to our presence on this island. Narasi Snowdawn has been entrusted with halting their efforts, but I am certain she could use a capable <class> to see this task through.

Go to her. Aid in whatever ways that you are able.

passages.title: The Court of Bones
passages.text: Yes, good, come... there is work to be done.

passages.title: Ihgaluk Crag
passages.text:
Archmage Modera has taken over at Ihgaluk Crag, to the southeast, continuing her efforts to turn the Saurok against the Zandalari and mogu.

Go to her, and help in any way that you can.

passages.title: Ihgaluk Crag
passages.text: You have good timing. I am quite in need of your assistance.

passages.title: Za'Tual
passages.text:
The Zandalari have been a constant nuisance since we arrived on this island. I've assigned Archmage Lan'dalock to take charge of dismantling their presence at Za'Tual, in the south.

Report to him when you are best able. He will have work for you.

passages.title: Za'Tual
passages.text: One more to join the Zandalari hunt?  Good.  Very good.

passages.title: Reader for the Dead Tongue
passages.text: Return to your capital city and seek out a warlock trainer who may know more about the codex.

passages.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
passages.text:
The trolls are in open rebellion. This could work to our advantage! If they open up a second front, Garrosh cannot possibly defend the city from us both.

I have a very risky assignment for you. I need you to be the Alliance representative, and open up talks with Vol'jin of the Darkspear tribe.

Try finding the troll prisoner that we freed from Kor'kron clutches. Zen'tabra, wasn't it?

It may be our only chance to bring Garrosh to his knees...

passages.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
passages.text:
<Zen'tabra narrows her eyes at you.>

Why de Alliance seek de Darkspear? We fightin' de "Warchief," sure, but dat don't mean we friends. I never trust de Alliance, an' I ain't 'bout ta start now.

Still, dat funny mechanical cat ya have saved me life... so I give you dis. I let ya speak wit' Vol'jin.

Let him decide if ya words be venom or honey.

Don't be tryin' nothin', <class>. Ya lift a finger against Vol'jin, ya life be forfeit.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
Ya want we work together on dis, ya gotta earn me trust.

In Northern Barrens, de Kor'kron be massin' for war. Hellscream's goons be stockpilin' lumber, oil, stone, an' meat. Supplies de Darkspear want ta use against' 'im.

Go to de Barrens. Kill de Kor'kron. Bring me dem supplies! Fight dem wherever dey spring up, escort supply caravans, group up ta take down de dangerous ones. Whatever ya gotta do.

Prove ta me da Alliance wants dis! I be watchin'.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text: I need dem Kor'kron supplies ta fuel de Darkspear Rebellion.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
<Vol'jin motions to his guards to allow you to come forward and speak.>

De Barrens be splattered wit' blood, <race>. Ya done right by me.

Tell de Alliance ta rally its fleet. When de time comes, de Darkspear an' de other rebels will try ta hold de harbor for ya. Hellscream made too many enemies ta fight 'em all off at once, hah!

Ya have me thanks, <race>. Dis rebellion only gonna get so far wit'out ya.

passages.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
passages.text:
My dream brew can only tell me so much. Its visions are scattered in time and space. But it is clear that a showdown is brewing amongst the Horde.

In my dream brew I see that the troll Vol'jin of the Darkspear has already travelled to Durotar to defend his people. He is accompanied by Chen Stormstout, the brewmaster from the Wandering Isle.

If I have learned anything about Chen, it won't be long before he brews up some trouble... You should hurry!

passages.title: The Darkspear Rebellion
passages.text:
<Ki'ta Arrowtusk beckons you over.>

I been waiting for ya, hero. Dis be a time of reckoning.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
Ta take down de warchief, I be needin' an army an' supplies. I got me an army. No shortage of hate for what Hellscream done to de Horde. But supplies! Lumber, stone, meat, oil. Dis be what we need.

Hellscream's Kor'kron be stockpilin' supplies in Northern Barrens, to de west. Kill de Kor'kron! Fight dem wherever dey spring up. Help our tauren bruddahs by escortin' their caravans, an' group up to take down Kor'kron leaders. Whatever it takes. Get me dem supplies!

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text: Da Horde be splinterin' under Hellscream's leadership.

passages.title: Battlefield: Barrens
passages.text:
<Sen'jin is buzzing with activity. Vol'jin motions for you to approach, a dark sadistic grin spreading across his tired face.>

Ya done good, <name>. Blood in de Barrens. Hellscream got to be feelin' that.

No doubt he gonna come for us, but we gonna be ready...

passages.title: A Knockoff Grumplefloot
passages.text:
The "grumplefloot" has been hastily carved out of a tree root, with holes unevenly spaced along its length.

A close inspection of its backside, however, reveals words carved into the wood:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: A Knockoff Grumplefloot
passages.text: What's that you have there, <class>?

passages.title: A Knockoff Grumplefloot
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: A Tale of Romance and Chivalry
passages.text:
A small book, written for children. It's well-bound and in fairly good condition.

On the back cover of the book, near the spine, you find a few words written in flowing script:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: A Tale of Romance and Chivalry
passages.text: My, my. What's this you've brought me?

passages.title: A Tale of Romance and Chivalry
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Boom Boom's Fuse
passages.text:
Amidst the gibbets of hozen meat and fur flying aimlessly around Kota Kon's sphere of destruction, you seem to have grabbed hold of a small fuse.

The fuse is created entirely from woven, matted hozen tail hair. It has a strong smell.

Near one of the ends of the fuse, however, is a small paper tag, embossed with the words:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Boom Boom's Fuse
passages.text: What's that scent I detect?

passages.title: Boom Boom's Fuse
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Teeth Like Swords
passages.text:
The tooth comes to a singular edge, almost as if it were sharpened by stone. It clearly belonged to a ferocious beast.

Handling it gingerly, you notice a few tiny words, expertly carved into the enamel:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Teeth Like Swords
passages.text: You have something for me - I can see it in your eyes. What is it, <class>?

passages.title: Teeth Like Swords
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Secret of the Ooze
passages.text:
The contents of the vial swirl and froth violently, causing the vessel to tremble in your hand. As you look into the container, you think you catch a fleeting image of a living, angry face.

The vial's stopper fits snugly. Around its edge, some small words have been carved with an expert hand:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Secret of the Ooze
passages.text: Greetings, <class>.

passages.title: Secret of the Ooze
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
passages.text:
You might not have recognized this as a modified chomping apparatus if it didn't have the words "modified chomping apparatus" messily painted onto it.

Right beneath the sloppy label, you see a smaller message, written much more neatly in bright red ink:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
passages.text: Can I help you with something?

passages.title: Modified Chomping Apparatus
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
passages.text:
A piece of an eggshell, presumably penguin. Its edges are covered with rime, and based on its curvature, this egg was quite large when it was intact.

Strangely, the inside of the eggshell has a message written on it, in jade-green ink:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
passages.text: You have the look of a messenger about you. What do you have for me, <race>?

passages.title: Frost-Tipped Eggshell
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Last Year's Model
passages.text:
The robot is in bad shape. It was built with several sockets which, like the Blingtron 4000, presumably once carried gems, but are now empty.

The robot's otherwise dust-covered posterior region contains a small, shiny metal plaque, embossed with the words:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Last Year's Model
passages.text: What's that you have there, <class>?

passages.title: Last Year's Model
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: The Digmaster's Earthblade
passages.text:
An entirely ordinary-looking shovel. The handle is carved with an ornate script: "The Digmaster's Earthblade".

On the flipside of the handle, however, is a smaller label, written in simpler text:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: The Digmaster's Earthblade
passages.text: What are you carrying, <class>? Something of mine?

passages.title: The Digmaster's Earthblade
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Well-Worn Blindfold
passages.text:
A piece of cloth, shaped for a human-sized head. The cloth is unadorned and simple, except for a small tag on the end, which reads:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Well-Worn Blindfold
passages.text: You carry something of mine, I believe.

passages.title: Well-Worn Blindfold
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Paper-Covered Rock
passages.text:
It's a strange combination of items. The paper envelops the rock completely, dwarfing it like a smothering blanket of wood pulp. Compared to the paper, the rock is barely a pebble.

When held up to the light, the paper reveals a distinct watermark, along with the text:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Paper-Covered Rock
passages.text: Good day, <race>. Have you brought something for me?

passages.title: Paper-Covered Rock
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: Raptorhide Boxing Gloves
passages.text:
The gloves are stitched together roughly, and by the smell of it, they've been treated with crawler mucus. Nevertheless, they appear sturdy and functional.

Somewhat unsurprisingly, the inner seam bears the following words:

RETURN TO BRAWLER'S GUILD

passages.title: Raptorhide Boxing Gloves
passages.text: What's that you have there, <class>?

passages.title: Raptorhide Boxing Gloves
passages.text:
Ah, you've found one of my treasures. Well done, adventurer.

In return, I will allow you to purchase one of my rare challenge cards.

passages.title: What We've Been Training For
passages.text: Are you ready to put your pets to the test? The battle pet arena is no place for low-level rabbits, you'd better have a rocketbot in your pocket and be ready for action. If you've got three fully-experienced pets, find battles against trainers of similar skill and show the world what you've got. You can find the instructions in your Pet Journal.

passages.title: What We've Been Training For
passages.text: Well, you're back, did your pets make it out in one piece?

passages.title: What We've Been Training For
passages.text: I've heard stories about some of your matches circulating around, apparently they were quite a sight to behold! I think you've earned this reward. Congratulations, trainer, and keep up the good work.

passages.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
passages.text:
Welcome ta Sen'jin Village, mon. I know you traveled far ta see Vol'jin, leader a' da Darkspear.

But I must ask ya ta wait a little longer. Let us speak.

passages.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
passages.text:
<Vol'jin nods at you.>

<class>. Looks like ya just chose a side.

I hope ya ready ta fight.

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book II
passages.text: The stories of Lucky Yi, Greyhoof, and Skitterer Xi'a will exist in this land, always. Do you wish to meet them in battle once more?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book II
passages.text: Do you return victorious?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book II
passages.text: I bow to you who continues to walk in the footfalls of the great Pandaren fables.

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book III
passages.text: The stories of No-No, Ti'un the Wanderer, and Gorespine will exist in this land, always. Do you wish to meet them in battle once more?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book III
passages.text: Do you return victorious?

passages.title: Beasts of Fable Book III
passages.text: I bow to you who continues to walk in the footfalls of the great Pandaren fables.

passages.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
passages.text: I take ya to Vol'jin.

passages.title: Vol'jin of the Darkspear
passages.text:
<The troll does not have a strong grasp of the common tongue, and his throat is still bandaged from a knife wound. But the meaning of his words is clear.>

What de Alliance want wit' ol' Vol'jin, hmm? Zen'tabra says we got a common enemy. That don't make us friends.

But... Maybe we can work together dis once. You want to strangle de Warchief, hm? Shut 'im out?

<Vol'jin smiles disarmingly, his grin slow and savage.>

passages.title: War is Coming
passages.text: As you enter the vale, you see a rotund pandaren trying to flag you down from the balcony above Mogu'shan Palace. It looks like Lorewalker Cho is trying to get your attention. You should investigate!

passages.title: War is Coming
passages.text: Ah! Welcome my friend. I am very glad that I was able to get your attention. Great deeds are at work that require a hero such as yourself.

passages.title: The Road to War
passages.text:
Hey! I just received word from our agents in Durotar.

The Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.

I hear you've already got an in with the trolls. Why don't you zip over to Durotar and see what's happening?

passages.title: The Road to War
passages.text: It be good to see dat some Alliance have a sense of loyalty.

passages.title: The Road to War
passages.text:
I have received word from Baine. The Darkspear Rebellion needs your help.

Go to Razor Hill and seek out Ki'ta Arrowtusk.

Breathe word of this to no one!

passages.title: The Road to War
passages.text: Ah, it be good to see your face again, <name>.

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text:
My mind is spinning with boredom - I never get to leave this place!

You look like you've seen some adventures. If you can bring me a truly heroic story, I've got something special I'm sure you'll be interested in.

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text: Anything to tell me, <name>?

passages.title: Heroic Deeds
passages.text:
Congratulations, <name>, you did it!  Before I forget, here's the special surprise I promised -- I hope you like it.

Now tell me all about the adventure.  Did you face certain death?  Meet any friends?  I wish I had more friends like you.

passages.title: Work Order: Sunreaver Onslaught I
passages.text:
<Yoon keeps the details of this order short, but detailed.>

Another request has come through for the Horde. The Sunreaver Onslaught, located out on the Isle of Thunder, has requested a bushel of scallions.

Though this Horde and Alliance conflict still gets my fur in a bristle, I won't turn away a hungry stomach. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32942))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32942))");

passages.title: Work Order: Kirin Tor Offensive I
passages.text:
<Yoon keeps the details of this order short, but detailed.>

Another request has come through for the Alliance. The Kirin Tor Offensive, located out on the Isle of Thunder, has requested a bushel of juicycrunch carrots.

Though this Horde and Alliance conflict still gets my fur in a bristle, I won't turn away a hungry stomach. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32944))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(32944))");

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text:
<The leather vellum is very old. Stained by age, it bears the following letters:>

On the isle of time are tall men four
Round and strong and nothing more
Of these brothers the shortest be
Where the trail leads to me.

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text: <The dirt here looks overturned. Perhaps something is buried beneath.>

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text:
<Another dirty scrap of parchment is buried beneath the soil.>

Somewhere hope stands, wings held forth
From its feet turn to the north
Pass beyond an ancient gate
Behind a stone pair, I await.

passages.title: Rolo's Riddle
passages.text: <Another pile of dirt! Could there be something buried here?>

passages.title: Noodle Secrets Long Forgotten
passages.text:
Searching amidst the rubble, you find the fragment of an old sign. Wiping away the dust, you can make out the well-weathered pandaren characters for "Noodles" and "Lin."

Looking above, you suspect that the establishment this sign belonged to was situated on the bridge, which now lies in rubble about you. An eatery placed on a bridge sounds very temporary, so its owner would likely live nearby.

Perhaps there is a clue to be found in the village here on the island?

passages.title: Noodle Secrets Long Forgotten
passages.text:
Well, hello there. I am Lin Chao-Wei.

Have you come here to try my family's famous noodle soup?

passages.title: The Lost Secret of the Secret Ingredient
passages.text:
If you've come here to try my family's famous noodle soup, I'm afraid you're out of luck.

My father passed away before he could teach me the secret ingredient. He did mention writing down the recipe for a friend of his that studied at the Temple of the Jade Serpent.

Perhaps you can find it there?

passages.title: The Lost Secret of the Secret Ingredient
passages.text:
You recognize the name, Lin, on the scroll. A few characters down you see the character for "Recipe."

This must be it!

Your only worry is that the sha energies that manifested themselves in the tales of the pandaren may have corrupted the scroll as well.

There is only one way to find out....

passages.title: Secrets Lost, Forever?
passages.text:
<With the ancient Lin family noodle soup recipe in hand, you decide to set out for the Halfhill Market.>

<If anyone in Pandaria knows how to decipher this scroll, it's Sungshin Ironpaw.>

passages.title: Secrets Lost, Forever?
passages.text: Hello, <name>. What is it you have there?

passages.title: Bad Feeling, Worse Result
passages.text:
<As you open the scroll, you realize your worst fears have come true: the sha energies have corrupted the Lin recipe.>

<Your only choice is to defeat the released energies in the hope that the scroll can be saved.>

passages.title: DEPRECATED The Celestial Tournament
passages.text: Description.

passages.title: DEPRECATED Great Job, You Won
passages.text: Description.

passages.title: Why Do We Fight?
passages.text:
Oh my friend, today you and your companions have put an end to the sha that has plagued Pandaria since before time was recorded. You have accomplished that which even the titans and their mogu servants could not: destroying the last breaths of Y'Shaarj.

Come, will you join me in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms? There is something I would like you to bear witness to.

passages.title: Why Do We Fight?
passages.text: Our precious Vale of Eternal Blossoms. So much destruction and violence. But... I sense a glimmer of hope.

passages.title: Secrets Lost, Forever?
passages.text:
<With the ancient Lin family noodle soup recipe in hand, you decide to set out for the Halfhill Market.>

<If anyone in Pandaria knows how to decipher this scroll, it's Sungshin Ironpaw.>

passages.title: Noodle Time
passages.text:
Hello, <name>. Care to work the noodle stand again?

Just let me know when you're ready to work another shift and I'll get everything set up.

passages.title: Noodle Time
passages.text: Keep up the good work, <name>!

passages.title: Noodle Time
passages.text: Great work <name>! Everyone always loves it when they hear that you'll be making noodle soup. People come from all over Pandaria just to try a taste.

passages.title: The Last Gasp of Y'Shaarj
passages.text: A dark, vaporous substance stains the floor of the room. This is all that remains of the Old God Y'Shaarj.

passages.title: The Last Gasp of Y'Shaarj
passages.text: Do you see? Even now it fades from being.

passages.title: Little Tommy Newcomer
passages.text: I've got a battle pet, too! Want to battle? It'll be fun, I promise!

passages.title: Little Tommy Newcomer
passages.text: I'm ready to battle!

passages.title: Little Tommy Newcomer
passages.text: You cheated! I know it!

passages.title: Proving Grounds
passages.text:
You there! It's <name>, right? Greetings. I'm Taijing.

<Taijing sizes you up.>

You look strong. I've seen you a few times here in the Vale, but I've never seen you fight before. I wonder... are you as strong as you seem?

If you're interested in proving yourself, speak with Trial Master Rotun at the Temple of the White Tiger, in Kun-Lai. He will put you to the test.

passages.title: Proving Grounds
passages.text:
Welcome to the Proving Grounds, <class>. I am Trial Master Rotun.

Here, you may test your skill at performing several different combat roles: dealing damage, absorbing damage, and healing. I shall administer and judge these trials.

Are you ready to begin?

passages.title: Proving Grounds
passages.text:
You there! It's <name>, right? Greetings. I'm Jinho.

<Jinho sizes you up.>

You look strong. I've seen you a few times here in the Vale, but I've never seen you fight before. I wonder... are you as strong as you seem?

If you're interested in proving yourself, speak with Trial Master Rotun at the Temple of the White Tiger, in Kun-Lai. He will put you to the test.

passages.title: Proving Grounds
passages.text:
Welcome to the Proving Grounds, <class>. I am Trial Master Rotun.

Here, you may test your skill at performing several different combat roles: dealing damage, absorbing damage, and healing. I shall administer and judge these trials.

Are you ready to begin?

passages.title: Refining The Vision
passages.text:
I have finished grinding the stones, and have attuned the hourglass to a new series of timeways. Will you return to the Siege of Orgrimmar and turn the hourglass once more?

Return quickly, I am most curious.

passages.title: Refining The Vision
passages.text: Did you use the Vision of Time? What was the result?

passages.title: Refining The Vision
passages.text:
A tale of true heroism, and a powerful moment in history. But not quite what we are after, I am afraid.

Not much time remains - I shall double my efforts.

passages.title: Seeking Fate
passages.text:
I have not been completely forthright with you, despite all that you have done to aid the Timewalkers. I cannot tell you everything, not yet, but know this - there is a traitor amongst us. Tell no one of your mission today, and take caution around any of my flight while you hold the Vision of Time.

Quickly now, return to the Siege of Orgrimmar once more and use the hourglass.

And be safe.

passages.title: Seeking Fate
passages.text: Did you use the Vision of Time? What was the result?

passages.title: Seeking Fate
passages.text:
Was that... me? How very interesting.

Now we are beginning to see the shadows between worlds. Was this the future of our world, or simply one possibility? Regardless, our newfound ability to see more deeply into the timeways will allow us to push forward towards the answers we seek.

Allow me some time to continue my research. And be vigilant, hero, for the timeways are as infinite as our enemies.

passages.title: Hidden Threads
passages.text:
You have kept our mission a secret, and for that I thank you. Knowledge of the timeways, when in the wrong hands, can cause catastrophic devastation. My flight has little power to repair it, now. We must be careful.

The hourglass grows in power. I believe it can now be used to see much further than before. I wish you to push it to its limits.

Return to the Siege of Orgrimmar, and focus the hourglass on the most devastating timeway you can find.

passages.title: Hidden Threads
passages.text:
Stormwind... destroyed?

I realize that this vision may come as a shock to you. I know little more than you at this time. I will do my best to search for answers, you have my word.

passages.title: One Final Turn
passages.text:
I do not wish to ask this of you again, but I do not know who I can trust any longer. I have been using the Vision of Time to gather information, and in my searches, I believe I have found another crux in time. It is in the Caverns of Time itself.

I did not want to believe it when the vision first came to me, but I cannot sit idly by and let this information pass. The Caverns of Time - you must go there, now, and use the Vision of Time.

Move quickly!

passages.title: One Final Turn
passages.text:
Soridormi, the prime consort of Nozdormu, dead? And I was there as well?

We cannot know what this means, or what will come to pass, or even if this vision takes place in our timeway. You must speak of this vision to no one, lest we alter the course of time and cause great danger to us all. All we can do now is complete the Vision of Time - it will show us what the future truly holds.

passages.title: Shatterspear Laborers
passages.text:
There are a large number of Shatterspear trolls picking through the ruins to the north and northeast. I suspect that they're looking for magical artifacts, but none of our scouts have reported the discovery of anything of significance turning up from their digs. They may well just be fueling their war.

One thing is fairly certain though: less laborers would slow down their offensive, so less laborers is what they're going to get. You in?

passages.title: Shatterspear Laborers
passages.text: Good work. Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Remnants of the Highborne
passages.text:
There are several ruins similar to these spread through Darkshore, many of them inhabited by the troubled spirits of the Highborne. Out of mild courtesy for their cursed souls, we haven't been overly proactive about stripping the ruins of artifacts, but those hesitancies vanish in light of this new troll threat.

While you're aiding the Sentinels in their goals within the ruins, please collect any artifacts that you stumble upon and bring them back to me. I would like to preserve what little I can.

passages.title: Remnants of the Highborne
passages.text: Were you able to recover any artifacts?

passages.title: Remnants of the Highborne
passages.text: Perfect! Thank you so much. I would hate to lose more records of our culture to war - far too much has been sacrificed already.

passages.title: Denying Manpower
passages.text:
To the north, the Shatterspear have a war camp where they are constructing their catapults. The camp is guarded by some of their mystics, but I've started receiving reports that there are sightings of orcs and tauren there as well.

I don't want to make any assumptions as to what that suggests, but I do want you to go in and kill them before they can make any further strikes on our Sentinels.

passages.title: Denying Manpower
passages.text: Excellent work. One more threat we can worry a bit less about. We'll continue the offensive while they are still off-guard.

passages.title: Swift Response
passages.text:
I have a scout that we lost contact with a couple days ago. I assumed her dead, but it appears that she's been captured. The trolls indicate that they have at least two captives though... the only other person that comes to mind is Alanndarian Nightsong, a civilian that was in the area against my advisement early yesterday.

The Shatterspear have established a war camp to the north - it is almost certainly where any of their prisoners are being taken. Find them and free them if you're able.

passages.title: Swift Response
passages.text:
<Alanndarian looks very pale, though shallow breaths betray the life that remains in her.>

You're here...  to save me? A bit later... than I hoped.

passages.title: War Supplies
passages.text:
The trolls are building their forces and supplies at the war camp to the north. When they feel they are ready, they will almost certainly launch their attack on Lor'danel from that location. It shouldn't take us long to rout this rabble, but I'm not one for taking unnecessary risks.

I want you to fight your way into the war camp and set fire to any stockpiles of supplies that you see. The setback should buy us quite a bit of time before they can muster a counterattack.

passages.title: War Supplies
passages.text: Excellent work. That should slow them down a bit.

passages.title: Timely Arrival
passages.text:
It's good to see you. I wasn't looking forward to enduring what Alanndarian did, so the rescue is somewhat welcome.

I saw the troll leader before I was captured, and thought I had the perfect opportunity to kill him, but he's protected by some sort of magic shield. Morra needs to know before she mounts her assault, but first, we need to get out of here.

Help me to the dock - I'll make my way to Lor'danel via water, and you can go back to Morra with the intel.

passages.title: Timely Arrival
passages.text: Some sort of shield you say? We might have a way around that. Balthule had an idea for breaking whatever protective enchantments their shaman had, so it might work on this too. Thank you for saving Aynasha and bringing me this information - it may well make the difference in our battle.

passages.title: One Bitter Wish
passages.text:
Morra sent you? I should have listened to her - it's just hard to take trolls seriously I guess.

<Alanndarian lets out a weak chuckle.>

It's way too late for that anyway. We're mortal now... this is the fate we have to face, one way or another. I've had time to accept that.

I have one request though... kill the torturer that did this to me. They call him Rit'ko... you can find him just ahead with the other prisoner.

<Alanndarian offers a small smile, then winces and slumps back over in pain.>

passages.title: One Bitter Wish
passages.text: Alanndarian is dead then. That saddens me greatly, but it is not entirely unexpected. I expect no mercy from these savages, and will show them none.

passages.title: Strategic Strikes
passages.text:
Striking at the head of the beast doesn't work if there's another head to replace it. Before we can kill their leader, we need to kill the subleaders that may try to step up. Right now, they are not as well defended, and you should be able to best them without much support.

Take this dryad spear and hunt them down. The poison on its tip should slow their incantations. My scouts reported one inside the water chamber in the ruins to the east and the other past the remains of the tower to the southwest.

passages.title: Strategic Strikes
passages.text: You've shown a great deal of talent for one so young. Good work. It seems the final battle is before us.

passages.title: On the Brink
passages.text:
I've already been working on something for breaking down their protective wards. With a focus based in their power and a bit of druidic magic, we should be able to breach their shields.

Find their shaman to the east and southeast and recover several of their amulets. I will prepare them and imbue an arrow that you can deliver to Sandrya Moonfall for the attack.

passages.title: On the Brink
passages.text: Did you recover the amulets?

passages.title: On the Brink
passages.text: These will do perfectly. I will prepare them for Sandrya - you are sure to be dispatched to meet with her shortly.

passages.title: The Last Wave of Survivors
passages.text:
It's too late for Laird, he didn't make it in time.

The last wave of night elves from Auberdine attempted to escape a couple of hours ago. They stayed in their old home, clinging to the hope that it could be salvaged, but it seems they were finally forced out. I fear many of them won't make it, like Laird did not.

Quickly, go down the coast to the west and find any survivors that you can. We're sending Sentinels and Hippogryphs down, but every moment counts - we need to know which ones might make it.

passages.title: The Last Wave of Survivors
passages.text:
Thank you, <class>. Some of them surely would not have made it without you.

We'll be taking the wounded to the main building once we have them all safely back in town. Perhaps you can meet us there later?

passages.title: The Boon of the Seas
passages.text:
It is good to see you. You were key in ensuring that our loved ones made it home, and I hold some hope that you may yet help us further.

Like Laird, their wounds will be grave - every one of them battered by the coast and assaulted by the elementals. I am doing what I can, but it seems that those elementals hosted a toxin that is weakening their ability to heal. I believe I can concoct a salve, but I will need secretion from the muscles of the clams that inhabit this coast. Can you help me?

passages.title: The Boon of the Seas
passages.text: Did you bring muscles from the clams? I worry that our time grows very short.

passages.title: The Boon of the Seas
passages.text:
This will do perfectly. Thank you so much!

I suspect they will want to thank you personally should they recover, so perhaps you can stop by later on.

passages.title: Threat from the Water
passages.text:
Some of the survivors of this last Auberdine attack are still trying to make it up the coast to safety. We only caught word that they were coming within the last hour. I wish that we had more warning...

The coastline west of us is swarming with vile spray, vicious little water elementals. We need to clear them out if any of the survivors are to have a chance of making it to Lor'danel. Depart immediately and kill every elemental you see.

passages.title: Threat from the Water
passages.text: Your efforts are very much appreciated. Since the Cataclysm, the elementals have been out of control. We have little hope of taking back Auberdine without extinguishing their presence first.

passages.title: What's Happening to the Blackwood Furbolg?
passages.text:
Our ancestors lived alongside the Blackwood furbolgs for generations. But recently, we have lost contact with their settlements deeper in the forest. One of their larger villages, Blackwood Hold, can be found to the south.

Travel there and find Elder Brolg. Ask him why his people have withdrawn from us and offer your help, if necessary.

passages.title: What's Happening to the Blackwood Furbolg?
passages.text:
Why have you come here, outsider?

<You tell the elder that you were sent by Foriel Broadleaf at the Grove of the Ancients. He seems to relax slightly.>

The elf is right. The forces of Felwood have seeped into Darkshore and sickened my people.

passages.title: The Bear's Paw
passages.text:
The foul satyr of Felwood have started to introduce their poison into Darkshore, into our lands. Their corruption kills the land and twists the creatures who live in it. My people are no exception.

Our magic alone is not enough to bring them back to their senses. There is an herb, called bear's paw, that we use to break fevers and fortify the weak. With its help, we may be able to break the influence of the satyr. The herb grows in the wilds around the village.

passages.title: The Bear's Paw
passages.text: Have you gathered the bear's paw?

passages.title: The Bear's Paw
passages.text: These are poor, weak stalks, but they are all we have. The corruption spreads quickly, even among the plants of the forest.

passages.title: No Accounting for Taste
passages.text:
<The machine buzzes for a few moments before Wizbang's voice breaks through.>

Interesting! The source of this corruption definitely came from something external--no surprises there--but it appears that in this case they've been eating something foul. A large mammal probably. Most likely a bear.

Search the beach for a bear carcass for me. Slightly east of there would make the most sense, on the inland side of the beach. Bring me the sample back at town.

passages.title: No Accounting for Taste
passages.text: Welcome back! Did you find that bear sample that I was looking for?

passages.title: No Accounting for Taste
passages.text: This definitely looks like the stuff they were eating. Let me take a closer peek...

passages.title: The Corruption's Source
passages.text:
I rushed here as soon as I heard the news from Wizbang. I know who's behind this mess now. Zenn Foulhoof.

He came over from Teldrassil after he was chased out for performing perverse magics. The kinds of corruption he employs are not welcome among my people, and it seems he's taken it a step further this time, perhaps as some form of revenge.

Zenn's been given too many chances, it's time we remove this threat to all that is natural. Kill Zenn and his minions, and then find me back in Lor'danel.

passages.title: The Corruption's Source
passages.text: It is done then. Thank you. I only hope that the wildlife here will see more peace with his passing.

passages.title: A Taste for Grouper
passages.text:
Between boat rides and building, I'm exhausted... and hungry. You know what sounds tasty? Fish. Fish sound delicious.

Darkshore is known for its grouper. If you fish me up some, I'll make it worth your time.

passages.title: A Taste for Grouper
passages.text:
<Johnathan's belly grumbles as you approach.>

Couldn't have said it better with words.

passages.title: A Taste for Grouper
passages.text:
It looks like fishing's your thing. My belly appreciates the gift.

I'm thinking you would get more use out of this pole than I would. Have at it.

passages.title: Three Hammers to Break
passages.text:
I've flown through the ruins of Auberdine on a scouting mission. There are three Twilight's Hammer cultists that are responsible for the elementals that have overrun the destroyed town.

Head west into the ruins. Seek out and slay Cloudtamer Wildmane, Windmaster Tzu-Tzu, and Skylord Braax.

Only then will Sentinel Selarin and her forces stand a chance of taking back their home.

passages.title: Three Hammers to Break
passages.text:
Without those three coaxing them, perhaps the flow of elementals into the Ruins of Auberdine will be stemmed.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Bear's Blessing
passages.text:
Before the bear's paw can be used to cleanse the afflicted, it must be completed and blessed. To the north of the village roams a tallstrider named Fleetfoot. You'll need its tailfeathers to complete the herb bundle.

Bring the tailfeathers and the bear's paw bundle to the ancient bear statue in the ruins around the Grove of the Ancient, further north of where you'll find Fleetfoot.

While at the shrine, combine the tailfeathers with the bear's paw and receive the bear spirit's blessing.

passages.title: The Bear's Blessing
passages.text: Have you visited the old bear statue?

passages.title: The Bear's Blessing
passages.text:
<Elder Brolg accepts the blessed bundle from you and looks over it.>

This is exactly what we needed. The bear's spirit favors us and there may be hope for my brothers after all.

passages.title: Call Down the Thunder
passages.text:
Aetherion is almost in our world, but he can still be dealt with!

At the end of the dock floats a ritual orb. I want you to use it to complete the ritual, beckoning the elemental lord down from his vortex.

Trust me, <name>, I and the other spirits that you have freed will greatly weaken Aetherion. However, it will be up to you to finish him off for good and save the Kaldorei people of Darkshore from utter destruction.

Deliver his essence to Corvine Moonrise at the refugee camp so he will know.

passages.title: Call Down the Thunder
passages.text: You have returned. What news do you bring?

passages.title: Call Down the Thunder
passages.text:
Yalda? The spirits of others from the Ruins of Auberdine?

<The druid ponders what you've conveyed about your adventure in the ruins.>

I remember them all. They will be dearly missed, but they have moved on into the Goddess's embrace and that is for the best.

Ande'thoras-ethil, may your troubles be diminished, <name>!

passages.title: Solace for the Highborne
passages.text: I have come to Bashal'Aran to grant peace to the troubled spirits of the Highborne, but I find my hand hesitates with each blow. If you would like to aid me, you would have my gratitude.

passages.title: Solace for the Highborne
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Solace for the Highborne
passages.text:
You have my thanks. Though they may not be able to show it, you have the thanks of the Highborne spirits as well.

Fare safely, traveler.

passages.title: The Final Flame of Bashal'Aran
passages.text:
It is in times like these that we are forced to stop and examine our way of life. We are mortal now, and no matter how much we desire otherwise, we are deserving of our new place in this world.

Bashal'Aran, down the road to the south, once a city of our ancestors, it now is home to their cursed ghosts. We held hope of salvation for them as with ourselves, but we have left them in torment for too long. It is time to extinguish the Final Flame of Bashal'Aran.

passages.title: The Final Flame of Bashal'Aran
passages.text: You have our thanks. It is time that we leave the past behind us, and start looking to our future.

passages.title: A Love Eternal
passages.text:
I would like to extend my gratitude for saving us. I would call myself fortunate, but my beloved, Anaya, lays long dead. I am alone and deeply troubled, and sadly, I require your aid yet again.

Wandering the woods of Darkshore after my rescue, I found myself in the ruins of Bashal'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.

passages.title: A Love Eternal
passages.text:
I somehow avoided being inflicted with the same toxin that the other survivors now endure. I cannot help but be envious of them to a degree though... living an eternity alone seems not worth living at all.

I miss you so much, Anaya.

passages.title: A Love Eternal
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.

Please, I would be alone with my grief...

passages.title: A Lost Companion
passages.text:
Please help... I can barely sit up.

My friend, a bear named Grimclaw, he's not here. I sent him ahead to let the Sentinels know we were coming before we left Auberdine, but he never arrived. I sensed something might be amiss as we were leaving, but with the evacuation, I never had a chance to act on it.

If he's injured, there's only one place that he would go - the Withering Thicket, north of Auberdine, down the road to the south from here. Bring him back to me safely... he's my only family.

passages.title: A Lost Companion
passages.text:
Greetings, traveler. You seem to have an interest in my friend here. You're here on behalf of his friend Volcor then I imagine? If Volcor didn't come himself, he must be injured as well. I hope he recovers quickly.

Gimclaw is too injured to be moved far and he's going to need some immediate treatment. I'm afraid I can't let you take him back just yet, but perhaps you can help me while I tend to him.

passages.title: Spirit of the Stag
passages.text:
In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.

If you wish to align yourself with the Great Stag Spirit, take this incense to the woods just north of Bashal'Aran. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.

passages.title: Spirit of the Stag
passages.text:
I am the caretaker for my kind, leading not through force, but through wisdom and swift action. Wisdom is what carries us into the deeper forest when danger beckons and swiftness is what leaves our enemies basking in our absence.

In this wisdom, I see through to your true intentions, and I know that you are deserving of my blessing, the blessing of my swiftness. It can be yours, but know that the other spirits will not welcome you once you proceed - consider this carefully before accepting my boon.

passages.title: Spirit of the Moonstalker
passages.text:
In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.

If you wish to align yourself with the Great Moonstalker Spirit, take this incense to the land just south of the Ruins of Lornesta. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.

passages.title: Spirit of the Moonstalker
passages.text:
I share these forests willingly, accepting night elf kind into my home, and on occasion calling them friend. Though they have been tainted greatly in recent memory, I can see in you the same strength, honor, and spirit that first endeared them to me.

If you place value in the ferocity necessary to overcome all odds, then I am willing to call you my champion. Know now that if you side with my kind, the other spirits will not accept you, so consider your choice carefully.

passages.title: Peering Into the Vortex (DEPRECATED)
passages.text:
There is no time to waste, <race>! It is taking every ounce of my power to keep Darkshore's entire landmass from being shattered and swept into the ocean... you must listen to me very carefully.

On that hippogryph there is an orb. Take the hippogryph to the top of the vortex and use the orb to sample the energy surrounding it. Hurry, <name>. I don't know how much longer I can hold!

passages.title: The Land Is in Their Blood
passages.text:
If we're to stabilize the forces of nature, we'll need every little bit of help we can get. The furbolg of the Blackwood tribe have long inhabited the area and have strong ties to the land.

Their elder Shaman, Elder Brownpaw, wields great power over the elements -- his assistance would be invaluable. See if you can obtain their aid.

passages.title: The Land Is in Their Blood
passages.text: I have much respect for the great Malfurion Stormrage.  I cannot, however, leave my people in their time of need.  Maybe there is a way we can both help each other.

passages.title: The Last Wildkin
passages.text:
The wildkin were once numerous in Darkshore. Such are their ties to the land that the Cataclysm that shattered Darkshore also decimated their numbers.

The wildkin Aroom is the last of his tribe and is a powerful elder with a strong connection to Elune. His help will be most necessary in healing the land -- you will find him north of here at the Moontouched Den.

passages.title: The Last Wildkin
passages.text: A terrible sadness surrounds the creature.  Its eyes stare beyond you as you approach it.

passages.title: Aroom's Farewell
passages.text:
<The creature hoots sadly as it addresses you.>

Aroom is last of tribe...

Others won't rest... need funeral pyre. Bring Aroom the feathers of others.... let them rest.

Then Aroom help you.

passages.title: Aroom's Farewell
passages.text: You bring others' feathers?

passages.title: Aroom's Farewell
passages.text: I thank you, <race>.  Soon my kin will rest.

passages.title: Protector of Ameth'Aran
passages.text:
Nothing will repair the land quicker than the strength of those who inhabit it. We night elves are fortunate that some of our best allies just happen to be both the land and its inhabitants at once.

The Ancient of War known as Selenn was charged with guarding the ruins of Ameth'Aran, to the south. Go there and seek his help.

passages.title: Protector of Ameth'Aran
passages.text:
If the great Malfurion requires my presence, it is my duty to heed his call.  It is also my duty to protect these ruins, however.

Perhaps you'll help me fulfill both my obligations, <name>?

passages.title: The Blackwood Pledge
passages.text:
It won't be immediate, but the elementals' anger will soon die down and my people will live to fight another day.

I will go help you and Malfurion in any way that I can.

passages.title: The Blackwood Pledge
passages.text: This is fortunate news, <name>.  The furbolg may seem little more than a savage race, but their ties to the land are ancient and their shamans are second to none.

passages.title: Elune's Fire
passages.text:
We need special flame for ritual. We need Elune's fire.

Horoo's spirit wanders east of here. Horoo carries torch of Elune. Bring here so spirits rest.

Aroom thanks you.

passages.title: Elune's Fire
passages.text: You have torch?

passages.title: Elune's Fire
passages.text:
<Aroom lets out a long low-pitched hoot.>

Finally kin may rest.

passages.title: The Wildkin's Oath
passages.text:
Wildkin with Elune. Aroom in your debt now.

Aroom help you now. Return to Malfurion, I join you soon.

passages.title: The Wildkin's Oath
passages.text: The wildkin were once the guardians of the land.  It is good to hear they haven't all forgotten their old ways.

passages.title: Calming the Earth
passages.text:
I would be neglecting my responsibility if I abandoned my post just now, with so many elementals out of control in the ruins.

Let us deal with them first, before we see how we can aid Malfurion. What do you say, small one?

passages.title: Calming the Earth
passages.text: The land is deeply unsettled, <name>.  It'll be years before calm returns to these parts.

passages.title: Calming the Earth
passages.text: It's become clear, <name>.  The elements won't be calm until Malfurion succeeds in returning balance to the land.  Aiding him is, in a way, also fulfilling my task.

passages.title: Sworn to Protect
passages.text:
My duty here has been fulfilled as best it can. Send word to Malfurion that I'll be joining him soon.

Good luck to you, <name>. Good luck to all of us.

passages.title: Sworn to Protect
passages.text: Excellent job, <name>!  Selenn's help in holding back the vortex will be invaluable.

passages.title: The Emerald Dream
passages.text:
Our efforts in containing the destruction don't appear to be quite enough. I fear we're going to need aid from beyond the waking world.

Twilight cultists inside the Earthshatter Cavern to the east have opened a gateway to a nightmare-infested section of the Emerald Dream. They hold a green dragon prisoner named Thessera there.

Go through the nightmare portal and free her. She will be a powerful ally.

passages.title: The Emerald Dream
passages.text: Malfurion calls?  Yes... I can hear his voice through the dream...

passages.title: The Shatterspear Invaders
passages.text:
If we didn't have enough on our hands with the land and the elements turning against us, it seems something has riled up the trolls to the northeast, and they've started on a war path. I'm not sure what their aims are, but they've already attacked several of our scouts and have besieged the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.

We've sent a contingent of our best Sentinels to counter their attacks. If you would travel northeast to the ruins and join them, I'm certain that they could use the extra hand.

passages.title: The Shatterspear Invaders
passages.text:
Glynda sent you to lend a hand, did she? I'm glad she did - I could certainly use the help.

I'm working on our initial plans to start whittling away at their ranks. Please feel free to help Tysha and Balthule in the meantime.

passages.title: The Front Line
passages.text:
Their forces are weakened, their supplies destroyed, and their subleaders are dead. It is time for us to take this fight to their home, and their leader. I'm admittedly still in the dark as to what spurred their sudden aggression, but perhaps we will find some answers on their doorstep.

Take this arrow that Balthule prepared and report to Sandrya Moonfall deep in Shatterspear Vale to join the attack. It would be best to secure a ride on one of our nightsabers - going on foot would be dangerous.

passages.title: The Front Line
passages.text: Greetings, <class>. Did you bring the arrow?

passages.title: The Front Line
passages.text: It is good to meet you. Word has been sent to me of the efforts you have made to aid us against the trolls, and I must admit I am a bit impressed. The final fight is upon us now, I hope you are prepared.

passages.title: Disturbing Connections
passages.text:
The letter from Garrosh Hellscream makes clear the suspicions that were raised during the offensive on the Shatterspear. The presence of forsaken at the tower ruins and horde supplies and enforcers at the Shatterspear War Camp were only the start. Garrosh himself contacted the Shatterspear to spur their offensive towards Lor'danel, and it seems clear that he fully intends to push from the south as well.

Glynda Nal'Shea will need this information if the night elves are to be prepared.

passages.title: Disturbing Connections
passages.text: You're back! I hear the battle went well.

passages.title: Disturbing Connections
passages.text:
Well, this news is disturbing indeed. I will start dispatching messengers to Ashenvale immediately and see if we can't get some reinforcements prepared for them.

I cannot thank you enough for all the help you've lent us in these trying times. Such heroic deeds deserve reward. I think I might have something that will serve you perfectly.

passages.title: Don't Forget the Horde
passages.text:
Evenar and the other apprentices may not be much use in a battle, but you look like you can more than hold your own. The Horde scum across the road to the east at Bathran's Haunt need to be taught a lesson.

Their new warlord, Garrosh Hellscream, has them up to no good. Feel like teaching them a thing or two?

I'd come with you, but my assignment is to stay here and protect Orendil's apprentices, and that's exactly what I'm going to do.

passages.title: Don't Forget the Horde
passages.text:
<The sentinel eyes you appreciatively for a moment.>

A job well done, <class>. If you're any indication of the quality of the <race> adventurers we're going to be seeing more of, we should have this war against the orcs and their Horde taken care of faster than expected.

passages.title: Twilight Plans
passages.text:
We're not fully aware of the intentions of the Twilight's Hammer cultists to the southwest. We fear an attack on Lor'danel, however their motives might go well beyond that.

I need you to go to the Twilight Encampment and get your hands on their plans. Hurry, <name>. We might not have much time.

passages.title: Twilight Plans
passages.text: Have you obtained the plans yet, <name>?

passages.title: Twilight Plans
passages.text: Excellent job, <name>.  Now give me a moment to examine the plans you've brought me.

passages.title: Spirit of the Thistle Bear
passages.text:
In these woods reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker. These spirits make powerful allies, but you can only align yourself with one of them.

If you wish to align yourself with the Great Thistle Bear Spirit, take this incense to a cave just east of the great whirlpool. Meditate before the great spirit while burning the incense on the ground between you, and face his trial to earn his blessing. Should you succeed, return to me.

passages.title: Spirit of the Thistle Bear
passages.text:
For countless ages I have walked these forests and lived in these mountains. Through snow and fire, I have watched civilizations crumble and nature press on. Now, the very earth turns against us, and it becomes very apparent that we must fight if our legacy is to continue.

Your heart is true, and I would choose you as our champion. If you value the thick hide and resilience of my kind, then accept my boon. Know that the other spirits will not accept you once this choice is made, so choose wisely.

passages.title: Unsavory Remedies
passages.text:
I have no doubts that Grimclaw will recover with the help of my healing magics, though I can't say the same for the poachers that attacked him. Still, I could use some salve to close his wounds and lessen his pain while he heals.

To the east you will find the Ruins of Lornesta. Among the crumbled stones, there is a variety of fuming toadstool that flourishes in the damp environment. Bring me some of the toadstools so that I can mix a salve for our friend here.

passages.title: Unsavory Remedies
passages.text: Grimclaw is quite the fierce combatant. I feel somewhat sorry for those poachers, despite their aims.

passages.title: Unsavory Remedies
passages.text: You have my thanks, young one. We should be able to speed Grimclaw's recovery dramatically with this salve.

passages.title: Grimclaw's Return
passages.text:
With the binding complete, the blessing has taken hold. It will most certainly make your travels in these lands easier.

Grimclaw made a full recovery. Before I could do anything to stop him, he bolted off towards Lor'danel. I suppose that means it's time for your departure.

It was a great pleasure to have met you. For now, farewell - send my best wishes to Volcor and Grimclaw.

passages.title: Grimclaw's Return
passages.text:
You've returned! It is good to see you again. I suppose we have you to thank for Grimclaw's return?

I'm afraid... I have some bad news. I've been unable to purge the toxin... their conditions worsen. Gershalla died shortly after you left, and Volcor... Volcor passed just before you came back.
