Ancient texts tell us that Uldum is home to untold riches and treasures beyond compare. Go forth and claim these in the name of the Horde!

You can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the southwestern part of Tanaris and looking for her in Thistleshrub Valley.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Uldum!
passages.text: You could be one of the very first mortals to set foot in Uldum in millenia. Just think of the treasures that await us!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Uldum!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Adarrah at Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris.

Be one of the first to enter glorious Uldum and claim its treasures in honor of the Alliance!

You can reach Adarrah's caravan by traveling to the western reaches of Tanaris.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Uldum!
passages.text: There are wonders just waiting to be discovered beyond this valley. And they will be ours!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Ghostlands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.

Your help is needed to turn back the numberless Scourge invaders and secure the help of the Forsaken in fighting our common enemy.

To reach Tranquillien, follow the road south from Fairbreeze Square and into the Ghostlands.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Ghostlands!
passages.text: Your arrival here is fortuitous, <class>. We cannot fight the Scourge without help.

passages.title: Nahom Must Hold
passages.text:
As soon as we make our move west in order to attack Neferset City, the enemy will strike us from the east, where we'll be weak.

Nahom will be the first to fall, and if it does, Ramkahen will soon follow.

A small detachment is there already.

Get a briefing from them. I want you to make sure that they hold Nahom until I can send more troops there.

passages.title: Nahom Must Hold
passages.text:
<name>!  It's you!  My regiment was ambushed on our way here.

Our captain was slain, leaving me in command... until you got here, that is... sir!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead.

Westfall has been overrun by beggars and transients, leading to a massive increase in criminal activity. Your help is needed to restore order to the populace. You can reach the Jansen Stead in Westfall by traveling west from Elwynn Forest.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
passages.text: Murder, rookie. That's what you're looking at on the ground in front of us.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

The commander's watchmen are stretched thin defending against marauding wolves and bands of wild worgen. They cannot hold out for long without your help. You can reach Darkshire in Duskwood by following the road south at the border between Elwynn Forest and the Redridge Mountains.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
passages.text:
You are the help that we requested?

<Althea sighs.>

I suppose you will have to do.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Wetlands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Mountaineer Rharen at Dun Algaz.

In the wake of the cataclysm's destruction, Wetlands has become overrun with wild beasts, orcish raiders, and savage gnolls! To reach the Wetlands, you must travel north from Loch Modan through the dwarven hold of Dun Algaz.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Wetlands!
passages.text: We haven't gotten much in the way of reinforcements lately. We can use every pair of hands we can get.

passages.title: Decimation
passages.text:
<Melisara's image appears before you.>

The Stormpike forward camp sits atop Corrahn's Dagger, west of Sofera's Naze. You must enter the camp and slaughter every dwarf that you see. They must be taught what it means to fear and there is no finer lesson than absolute decimation.

No survivors, <name>. Even their captain - especially their captain - must die.

I will be in contact.

passages.title: Decimation
passages.text:
<Melisara's voice pervades your thoughts.>

They will see the bloodshed and they will hesitate. Hesitation will make them think twice about ever attacking us again.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Loch Modan!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Pilot Hammerfoot at South Gate Outpost.

The destruction of the Stonewrought Dam and the resurgence of the kobolds and troggs has the mountaineers stretched thin. Reinforcements are desperately needed! Travel east through South Gate Pass from eastern Dun Morogh to reach South Gate Outpost.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Loch Modan!
passages.text: Have our leaders finally heard my pleas? We're down to just a handful of pilots and mountaineers to defend Loch Modan.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers.

To reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

Ancient Stromgarde's honor must be redeemed! Too long have ogres and criminals sullied its streets. Travel north from the Wetlands and cross the Thandol Span to reach Arathi. Follow the road to Refuge Pointe and present yourself to the captain.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text: Would that you were a company, but we'll have to make do with with what we have.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: The Hinterlands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village.

Now that the Wildhammer dwarves have officially thrown in their lot with the Alliance, they have made themselves our enemies. They must be defeated!

To reach Revanktusk Village, cross into the Hinterlands from the mountain pass in eastern Hillsbrad Foothills and make your way to the eastern coast.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: The Hinterlands!
passages.text: Have you come to help us against the Wildhammers? The Warchief knows that what happens here will be important to the Horde's future.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Western Plaguelands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Thassarian at Andorhal.

On the heels of our early victories in Andorhal, the Forsaken have decided to launch a counterattack. Your help is needed to beat back the Scourge and Horde and reclaim lost Andorhal.

To reach Andorhal, travel north through the Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road beyond Chillwind Camp.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Western Plaguelands!
passages.text: There is much to be done here. Both of our enemies are relentless and would slaughter us without mercy the moment we sheathe our blades.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Badlands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Your help is needed to survey the damage done by Deathwing, and the disposition of Horde forces in the Badlands.

Gek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands via rocket, in exchange for your help. Look for him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Badlands!
passages.text: You must be here to help Fuselight! Let's get you to the Badlands right away.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Badlands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Gek Nozzlerocket at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

The Alliance is desperate to gain a foothold in the Badlands. Your duty will be to keep them at bay and learn about the destruction wrought by Deathwing.

Gek has agreed to provide transportation to the Badlands by rocket. Meet with him at Light's Hope Chapel.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Badlands!
passages.text: Sure, I can get you to the Badlands, but when you get there, I want you to agree to help my comrades.

passages.title: Quality Construction
passages.text:
Look here, chief, if it weren't for this bumbly idiot across from me, the Krazzworks would be holding up just fine.

Unfortunately for everyone involved, "Fancypants" Rothman here decided to deploy the place on top of a mountain! I mean really, who does that?

So, we got leaks all over the place due to faulty valves. Think you could take this blast tape and seal 'em up for me?

passages.title: Quality Construction
passages.text: Look, I'm just a simple cartographer, but according to my estimates, not to mention what my eyes are telling me, there are a few more faulty valves that need to be sealed.

passages.title: Quality Construction
passages.text: There you go. Now hows about we use this blast tape on Rothman's mouth?

passages.title: Wildhammer Infestation
passages.text:
While these two idiots argue about who royally messed up here, we've got a full-scale invasion of the Krazzworks taking place!

Those no-good Wildhammer are all over the place. Get out there and clear the Krazzworks of those smelly ale-guzzling pests.

passages.title: Wildhammer Infestation
passages.text:
You got the chops for killing dwarves, that's for sure, <name>. This is a good thing.

Next up, more dwarf slayage!

passages.title: Everything But the Kitchen Sink
passages.text:
You gotta do something about them Wildhammer Stormtalons. They're tearing us up!

Problem is, we're out of ammo, so we had to improvise. We loaded up my Krazz Cannons with all kinds of stuff: pool ponies, Kaja'Cola cans, food containers, fuelcells, tires... you get the picture.

Basically, everything but the kitchen sink.

Think you're in the mood for some target practice?

passages.title: Everything But the Kitchen Sink
passages.text: That's the spirit! Must be pretty humiliating being shot down by junk.

passages.title: Of Utmost Importance
passages.text:
When Garrosh's zeppelin went down, so did the induction samophlange that you recovered for us in Azshara. The Alliance have it somewhere in that keep, and Krazz wants it back.

The basement of the keep would be my best guess, so start there. When you get your hands on it, bring it back to me near the eastern tower.

passages.title: Of Utmost Importance
passages.text: Krazz is waitin'. Keep it moving.

passages.title: Of Utmost Importance
passages.text: Brilliant! Krazz will love you something mighty for bringing this one home. Good on you.

passages.title: Highbank, Crybank
passages.text:
Get down there and make a mess of those Alliance rabble. Any of'm will do. I just want'm scattered while you're in there after the real target.

Find us near the eastern tower when you're done.

passages.title: Highbank, Crybank
passages.text: And that's how it's done. Scattered to the wind. Not quite the fighting force they boast themselves to be, eh?

passages.title: Welcome to Highbank!
passages.text:
Welcome to the highlands, soldier. You're here just in time.

Horde troops just launched an assault from the air. Step up and do something about it. Clear them out!

passages.title: Welcome to Highbank!
passages.text: You'll have to kill a few more than that, soldier.

passages.title: Welcome to Highbank!
passages.text: That's more like it. We should be able to mop this up from here.

passages.title: Burnin' at Both Ends
passages.text:
Har! We get to jump right inta the action, <name>. Looks like Highbank has whatcha call a zeppelin problem: that airship is poundin' the crap outta the walls.

Listen, I've got me an idear so stupid it's genius. I just need some cannon powder.

Collect as much as you can find around Highbank an' meet me by the trade area!

passages.title: Burnin' at Both Ends
passages.text: I need more powder! Get me more powder! More more more!

passages.title: Burnin' at Both Ends
passages.text:
Aye, that'll do 'er.

<Flintlocke stuffs some of the powder in his mouth.>

Ohhh, fresh. Heady. Redridge fine grain with a hint of Westfall sulphur and a mild aftertaste. Highbank gets the good stuff.

passages.title: Matters of Loyalty
passages.text: I have no authority over such matters. You must speak to our leader, Drek'Thar. I have already sent word of your arrival to Frostwolf Keep. Drek'Thar will be out to speak with you personally.

passages.title: Matters of Loyalty
passages.text:
<High Warlord Cromush's face turns white.>

THEY HAVE FORSAKEN US? THEY HAVE FORSAKEN THE HORDE? This cannot be!

I...

<Cromush falls to one knee.>

I... I WILL BE FINE. We will do this without their aid. To hell with the Frostwolf!

passages.title: Be Prepared
passages.text:
Every adventurer worth their salt knows never to step foot in a cave, dungeon, crypt or tomb without an ample supply of rope... right?

Well, mine was in that wagon full of explosives that you set off.

How about searching around here and seeing if you can't find some.

passages.title: Be Prepared
passages.text: How goes the search?

passages.title: Be Prepared
passages.text: Something tells me I'm going to need this.

passages.title: Deception and Trickery
passages.text:
As long as I am by your side the enemy will think of you as one of their own. Your newfound humanity, however, will not allow you to be reckless. If you draw attention to yourself the dwarves will grow suspicious and likely attack!

With that said, I have a plan. Take this barrel of poisoned water and use it to sate the thirst of the tired Stormpike trainees. Once they drink from it they will become deathly ill, eventually succumbing to the poison.

passages.title: Deception and Trickery
passages.text: Deception and trickery - these are your tools!

passages.title: Deception and Trickery
passages.text: They won't die immediately, but they WILL die! When they finally piece together who was responsible for the deaths of their soldiers, you will be long gone - a phantom of death!

passages.title: Domination
passages.text:
<Melisara's thoughts intermingle with your thoughts.>

The last task will be an assault against the siege technicians of Gavin's Naze, located west of the Headland. Venture to the final finger and lay waste to the dwarf and gnome engineers that build and fortify the Stormpike machines of war. Be sure to plant Cromush's final pocket-nuke as well.

passages.title: Domination
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Domination
passages.text: With the Stormpike forces maimed, the time has come for detonation!

passages.title: Hammer Time
passages.text:
The three of us have been arguing for weeks over whose weapons are superior.

I won't let anyone tell me my maces are second best. Kilram's axes and Seril's swords could never match the pure strength of my craft.

I'm tired of arguing. It's time to show those two I'm right with a demonstration. If you would, dear, head outside and tell Deez Rocksnitch that I need the biggest boulder he can find!

passages.title: Hammer Time
passages.text: Lilith wants a boulder moved inside the observatory, eh? That's my business: consolidated materials. I usually don't get individual buyers, but hey, I won't ask questions.

passages.title: Rubble Trouble
passages.text:
If you want to get a boulder in there, you can use my own patented Boulder-in-a-Box! Normally I'd just sell you one up front, but I'm fresh out of materials.

Earth elementals have been popping up on the peak directly south of town. They're a good source of rubble. If you bring me back a good amount, I'll pay you for the restock, and I'll throw in a Boulder-in-a-Box absolutely free!

passages.title: Rubble Trouble
passages.text: You got that rubble?

passages.title: Rubble Trouble
passages.text: Looks like a good amount! Here's your pay, as promised...

passages.title: The Defilers' Ritual
passages.text:
Ah, I can already see more clearly, <name>.

We are right to be wary of the evil Neferset. I can already sense that they're behind the forces that corrupt the river.

Go underwater once more and find the Murkdeep Cavern. You will find the Neferset are performing a foul ritual of corruption.

Stop them so the river is cleansed once again.

passages.title: The Defilers' Ritual
passages.text: Is it done, <name>?

passages.title: The Defilers' Ritual
passages.text: The waters of the river are nearly cleansed.  Our prophetic visions will soon return.

passages.title: See You on the Other Side!
passages.text:
Alright, <name>. We've bought ourselves a little breathing room, but there's no time to lose.

Follow me!

passages.title: See You on the Other Side!
passages.text: So far, so good...

passages.title: Bearzerker
passages.text:
High Chieftain Winterfall's absence has done little to quell the rage of the Winterfall. In his absence, their greatest warrior has rose to a position of terrible power.

Grolnar the Berserk lurks in the cave at the top of Winterfall Village, gorged on enough corrupt firewater to kill ten lesser furbolgs.

He has become a bloated and horrible beast! Our warriors have been unable to face him... do you have the strength to defeat him, <class>?

passages.title: Bearzerker
passages.text: Has Grolnar fallen?

passages.title: Bearzerker
passages.text:
Your actions prove yourself a mighty warrior to me and all the Timbermaw!

Let us hope the Winterfall will be defeated for good now...

passages.title: Flower Power
passages.text:
You know how to use the spitters, but did you know that if you use a sunflower you can grow things faster? We'll grow some sunflowers and then we'll plant some spitters to push back Warden Stillwater's crazed monstrosities.

Let's go!

passages.title: Flower Power
passages.text: I think that was just the start of it, bud! MORE INCOMING!

passages.title: Boulder Delivery
passages.text:
Here you go, as promised! One Boulder-in-a-Box.

Lilith was asking for this, wasn't she? She's my only customer!

passages.title: Boulder Delivery
passages.text: Oh, it's you again. Where's that boulder?

passages.title: Boulder Delivery
passages.text:
Ah, you actually brought the boulder! I'm a bit surprised.

Stand back and witness the pinnacle of craftsmanship.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall. The Dark Lady's forces need your help to expand the dominions of the Horde and drive back the Alliance interlopers.

To reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
passages.text: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived. The Dark Lady has plans for you, as she does for us.

passages.title: Put That Baby in the Cradle!
passages.text:
Och!

You an' junior took yer sweet time gettin' 'ere, din't ya!?

<Drinkin' ale/Holdin' hands>, takin' in the sights, I'll wager.

Don't go breakin' yer arm pattin' yerself on the back now, the real work's just beginnin'!

There be more ta this ancient artifact than ye know, but in order ta reveal its secrets, we need ta get it to the Cradle of the Ancients!

Now howdya spose we do that?

Maybe junior over there has some bright ideas, eh?

passages.title: Put That Baby in the Cradle!
passages.text:
Of course I have a plan for moving the coffer.

Someday, maybe the old coot will learn to trust me.

passages.title: Three if by Air
passages.text:
I had planned on bringing the coffer back to my lab for study, but it seems Brann here has different ideas.

He thinks he knows how to put a stop to Deathwing's plans here in Uldum.

My buddy, Jock, is standing by with the transport, just waiting for our signal.

Take these flares and plant them around the perimeter to let him know that we're ready.

passages.title: Three if by Air
passages.text:
Nice work, lad.

Looks as tho everything made the trip in one piece.

I'm beginnin' ta see why junior keeps ye around.

passages.title: The Push Westward
passages.text:
Our work is done here, <name>. Against all odds, we stopped the Neferset advance on Nahom.

Let us join the forces pushing west, lest they take all the glory for themselves.

They must've reached the outskirts of Neferset City by now.

passages.title: The Push Westward
passages.text: You've arrived just in time, <name>.

passages.title: Kilram's Boast
passages.text:
Pah! Crude and clumsy is all I see!

You need more than just strength. My axes are just as strong as Lilith's maces, but so sharp, I can cut through a tree in one chop!

You heard me, one chop! I'll prove it, too, here in front of everyone. Go ask Deez if he can get a tree in here!

passages.title: Kilram's Boast
passages.text: They want a tree now? Let's see what I got.

passages.title: Tree Delivery
passages.text:
Here you go, one instant Super-Gro Insta-Tree made with 80% natural ingredients!

No roots, no muss, no fuss. Just give it to Kilram and make sure he stands the heck back when he uses it.

passages.title: Tree Delivery
passages.text: Chop chop!

passages.title: Tree Delivery
passages.text: Alright! Stand back now and watch what a true quality weapon can do!

passages.title: Seril's Boast
passages.text:
Brutes and amateurs.

It doesn't matter how sharp or heavy your weapon is if all it's good for is hacking like an ogre. I could go on and on about finesse and speed and balance and control... but it's easier to one-up these fools.

Tell Deez we've got one more order for him. I need a block of ice.

passages.title: Seril's Boast
passages.text: Oh, it's you again! I'm so surprised!

passages.title: Are We There, Yeti?
passages.text:
My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret... 

I'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!

I need thick yeti fur from the Ice Thistle yeti. There's plenty of them in the Ice Thistle Hills to the southeast.

passages.title: Are We There, Yeti?
passages.text: I've got lots to get started on here. Please get me those furs as soon as you can!

passages.title: Are We There, Yeti?
passages.text: These furs are perfect, <name>. We're off to a great start here!

passages.title: Echo Three
passages.text:
A lot of goblins have been going missing out there in Ice Thistle Hills. I was almost one of them!

I had the idea to set up a sensor to tell us when the yeti were getting close to Everlook. Of course, it's not working either. There's yeti all over the hills and I haven't heard a peep from it.

Would you mind checking on it for me? It might still be fixable. Echo Three's set up to the southeast on the edge of Ice Thistle Hills. Don't ask what happened to Echo One and Two.

passages.title: Echo Three
passages.text:
Part of this machine is still moving, but on closer inspection it's been severely manhandled. The metal is dented and cracked, and there's huge footprints in the snow all around it.

In fact, it sounds like something's approaching right now...

passages.title: The Perfect Horns
passages.text:
I can't make a yeti without horns!

I've been looking for what seems like forever for the perfect set of horns... and no horn I find is good enough! But just the other day I saw the biggest yeti in Winterspring.

I named him Icewhomp. His horns are the ones I've been looking for! He lurks all the way in the back of the cave along the eastern ridge of Ice Thistle Hills.

Bring me his horns... but be sure to check on Echo Three along the way!

passages.title: The Perfect Horns
passages.text: Are they perfect? They better be perfect!

passages.title: The Perfect Horns
passages.text:
I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...

Perfect!

passages.title: Fresh From The Hills
passages.text:
Ice this time? Hoo boy, sure. I've got good news and bad news for you.

The good news is there's a bunch of pure solid ice over in the Ice Thistle Hills cavern, straight east from Everlook. The bad news is there's also a bunch of vicious yetis in there.

But if you can handle the yeti, hey, piece of cake! Just walk right up to the bigger chunks and crack 'em open with your weapon. Bring it all back to me and I'll do my thing.

passages.title: Fresh From The Hills
passages.text: Oh, you're back! How were the yetis?

passages.title: Fresh From The Hills
passages.text: Not bad! Let's hope they don't ask for lava or something next, right?

passages.title: The Coffer of Promise
passages.text:
I'm not quite certain what ta expect 'ere, so stay on yer toes, eh?

These codes should reveal the coffer's true purpose, and present us with the tools to thwart Deathwing's efforts in Uldum fer good!

Stand back!

passages.title: The Coffer of Promise
passages.text:
Well, now.

Would ya look at that!?

passages.title: The Coffer of Promise
passages.text:
Of course! I had a hunch this is what we'd find.

Had no idea about the organic transformations, though, I must admit.

There's more to this old relic than I'd dared to hope.

passages.title: Extinction
passages.text:
Owlbeasts... Soulless, feathered monstrosities sent from the darkest depths of the Twisting Nether to prey upon the weak.

<Nils points to the woods surrounding Eastpoint Tower.>

They surround us on all sides and they are planning an attack - I can sense it. You must stop them before they can organize.

I want you to head into the forest and kill every owlbeast that you see. NONE SHOULD SURVIVE!

passages.title: Extinction
passages.text:
The itching has stopped - for now - but they will return.

Oh yes, they will return...

passages.title: A Haunting in Hillsbrad
passages.text:
The battle over Dun Garok was the bloodiest of all the Hillsbrad battles. The dwarves, outnumbered ten-to-one, fought until the bitter end. Every last one of 'em died in defense of that piece of land.

Now I hear claims that the place is haunted. Nobody wants to go near it! Unfortunately I have orders to prepare Dun Garok for habitation.

Could you do me a favor and go to Dun Garok and search for evidence of a haunting? It's far to the southeast.

passages.title: A Haunting in Hillsbrad
passages.text: OoooooOooooo...

passages.title: A Haunting in Hillsbrad
passages.text: Haunted? Ye could say that!

passages.title: Silence of the Dwarves
passages.text:
The spirits of my soldiers haunt this fort now, <lad/lass>. Their souls are now bound to this place. Even in death they continue to fight for it. 'Tis sad.

Put 'em out o' their misery and perhaps ye shall have the spoils of yer people's victory.

passages.title: Silence of the Dwarves
passages.text: They fight for their land even after death - much like the Forsaken. I will report back to high command that Dun Garok is uninhabitable. Let them keep what they hold so dear.

passages.title: A Taste for Bear
passages.text:
Have you ever had the luxury of trying bear meat? I never had the chance to try it in Gilneas, but the bears here are simply exquisite.

The shardtooth bears that roam just to the south are well-marbled with fat from the cold here. I've been hunting them myself, and it's quite a lark, but I much prefer eating them!

I recommend you try your hand at the hunt. Stick to the white-pelted shardtooth bears, and the Captain will go to field to bring back any you kill.

passages.title: A Taste for Bear
passages.text:
Simply splendid! I've been watching the Captain bring bear after bear back to camp and I can't wait to see them thrown on the smoker.

Perhaps I'll have a taste of them raw...

passages.title: The Owls Have It
passages.text:
I've been eatin' owls my whole life. Owls is good eatin', and my friend Jez agrees. I was the first one that told him to sell owl!

Mister fancy-pants worgen here says bears taste better, but don't pay him no mind. You should go hunt yourself some owl. There's plenty of 'em wandering just south of here. Stick to the gray ones for now, an' buzz me on the little talky-thing Jez gave you when you've racked up a few.

passages.title: Fresh Frostsabers
passages.text:
Doesn't that smell great? My smoked meats get top dollar, and nobody else provides the exotic flavors I've got out here in the hills. And it's efficient; you just do the hunting for a small fee, and my other fine friends drag the beasts back here for skinnin' and smokin'!

I've got the market cornered on Frostsaber meat right now. Absolutely delicious stuff, makes great sausages. Head out and hunt those cats just west of here, and we'll call that a start!

passages.title: Fresh Frostsabers
passages.text: Alright! Don't stop now, we're after the big ones next!

passages.title: Pride of the Dinner Table
passages.text:
Alright kid, time to head out further into the field!

This haul's nice and good, but further to the west you'll find much bigger kitties. The pride watchers and huntresses have a lot more muscle on them, and it makes AMAZING burger patties. They sell like crazy!

Gimme a ping when you've cleared house and we'll see about you going after the main course.

passages.title: Pride of the Dinner Table
passages.text:
Beautiful! I'm watching the Captain drag this all back right now and it's a gorgeous sight.

And the next course...

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Zephyrus
passages.text:
Durnholde Keep has always been a place of strife. For years the humans used it as an internment camp and prison for the orcs. After that it was taken over by the Syndicate. Now? The Dark Lady captured and placed powerful elementals within its walls. She charged me with administering "The Durnholde Challenge." Any that can defeat all of the elementals will earn a grand prize! Take this guide and face your first challenge: Zephyrus!

Durnholde is located just northeast of us.

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Zephyrus
passages.text:
Zephyrus was a mighty adversary. Surely the remaining elementals will challenge you further!

<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Teracula
passages.text: According to the guide, Teracula is your next challenge. It roams the path just outside of Zephyrus' lair.

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Teracula
passages.text:
Teracula was an even mightier adversary than Zephyrus.

<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Bloodvenom
passages.text: According to the guide, Bloodvenom is your next challenge. The fearsome elemental can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the western prisons.

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Bloodvenom
passages.text:
Now you know why the monster was called Bloodvenom. What challenges remain?

<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Infernus
passages.text: According to the guide, Infernus is your next challenge. This being, made of molten lava and raging fire, can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the eastern prisons.

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Infernus
passages.text:
Though you have defeated the four elements, one final challenge awaits. What could it be?

<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: D-1000
passages.text: Imprisoned in the old Durnholde Keep arena is a being comprised of pure mercury. The Forsaken have dubbed it the D-1000. Kill the D-1000 and claim your prize!

passages.title: The Durnholde Challenge: D-1000
passages.text: This is the first time anyone has actually completed the challenge. You truly are a powerful <class>, <name>. As promised, choose your reward.

passages.title: Novice Elreth
passages.text: Why don't you go speak with my novice, Elreth? She serves me, and will have some tasks to which you can apply your new abilities.

passages.title: Novice Elreth
passages.text: May the Dark Lady watch over you, <name>.

passages.title: Caretaker Caice
passages.text:
I am done with you. There are, however, others who can use your aid.

Caretaker Caice, standing on that stump behind me, can probably give you another assignment. You should speak with him now.

passages.title: Caretaker Caice
passages.text: Yes?  And who might you be?

passages.title: Shadow Priest Sarvis
passages.text:
Are you still here, <name>? You know, I'm only a deathguard. I don't have many tasks I can hand out to passers-by like you.

I'd recommend that you talk to Shadow Priest Sarvis. I remember, he helped me get on my feet after I was plucked out of that tomb. I'm sure he'll do the same for you.

You'll find him just inside the chapel, here on the west side of town.

passages.title: Shadow Priest Sarvis
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

I see you wield a weapon.  Can you fight?

passages.title: The Heart of the Matter
passages.text:
Well, <laddie/little lady>, half of me wishes I could stick around a while and take in the sights with ye.

I've seen some mighty amazin' things in my day, but this here takes the cake.

Sadly, I have a fair bit o' research ta do on these discs before I make my way into the Halls of Origination.

You seem ta be worth your salt, perhaps ye'd like ta tag along and see how a REAL archaeologist works, eh?

passages.title: The Heart of the Matter
passages.text:
Bout time ye showed up, lad.

Now let's get goin'! There be work ta do!

passages.title: Strange Life Forces
passages.text:
When this creature died, some sort of energy was released from its body. The energy was passed on to you, and now you feel somewhat stronger.

According to Winterspring locals, Witch Doctor Mau'ari at the Snowden Chalet is an expert in the wildlife of the area. She might know something about this mysterious energy.

passages.title: Strange Life Forces
passages.text:
What's dis? You got de smell of de E'ko on ya! Let Mau'ari tell ya a little bit about de E'ko and what it do.

You're lucky, <race>. De E'ko searched you out. A troll like me's gotta go find de E'ko herself.

All de creatures of Winterspring have E'ko. De furbolg, de chillwind, de shardtooth... even de Ice Thistle yeti! You kill dese creatures, and sometimes, a bit of E'ko comes out. Different creatures... different E'ko.

Go on now. Go find de other E'ko!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Burning Steppes!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Ariok at Flamestar Post.

Honored Eitrigg's son, Ariok, needs your assistance to halt the blind aggression of the Blackrock orcs before they invade the neighboring lands.

You can reach the Burning Steppes by traveling south from the Searing Gorge through Blackrock Mountain. Flamestar Post will be south of the mountain.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Burning Steppes!
passages.text: We must stop the Blackrock orcs before they can expand their influence.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Blasted Lands!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold.

Okrilla, commander of the Horde forces at Dreadmaul Hold, requires your help to secure the outpost against rebellious ogres and the forces of the Alliance.

Travel to Dreadmaul Hold by taking the road south from the Swamp of Sorrows.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Blasted Lands!
passages.text: Our enemies are numerous, <class>. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

passages.title: The Executor In the Field
passages.text:
I can keep you busy here in town all week... but you seem to be more the fighting type.

<Elreth looks you over and nods.>

Yes, you'll do just fine. I'd like you to go talk to Executor Arren. Follow the path north, out of Deathknell. You'll find him not far past the barricades.

passages.title: The Executor In the Field
passages.text: What do we have here?  A new <class>, ready for battle, eh?

passages.title: Hero's Call: Blasted Lands!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.

Nethergarde's garrison urgently needs your help to stem the Horde advance into the Blasted Lands! Travel south from the Swamp of Sorrows and follow the road east to reach Nethergarde Keep.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Blasted Lands!
passages.text: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

passages.title: Starfall Village
passages.text:
You've been pretty busy around here. If you're still eager to do good deeds, or just get paid, I've got something you might be interested in.

Starfall Village is just northwest of Everlook. The night elves there recently suffered a pretty nasty bug infestation, and they're asking for any help they can get.

A few goblins from here already went there to start exterminating, but I'm sure there's room for more. Talk to Wynd Nightchaser, he'll fill you in.

passages.title: Starfall Village
passages.text: Welcome to Starfall, <class>. We have opened our doors to all travelers in our time of need.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Swamp of Sorrows!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle.

The Alliance forces urgently needs the munitions provided by the baron! You must do whatever is necessary to convince the baron to keep selling our forces supplies at reasonable prices.

To get to the swamp, follow the road from the southeastern Burning Steppes through the Redridge Mountains.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Swamp of Sorrows!
passages.text: Welcome to Bogpaddle, <class>. I fully expect you will enjoy all our facility has to offer.

passages.title: Exterminators at Work
passages.text:
The infestation of our barrow den occured nearly overnight. Vicious creatures never before seen in these lands swarmed the tunnels, hatching from unseen eggs.

With the few of us here, it was all we could do to keep them from spreading outside the den. We were forced to hire goblins from Everlook that claimed expertise in extermination, but they have not yet been successful.

If you wish to assist them, enter the barrow den to the west of this lodge and speak with Rinno Curtainfire.

passages.title: Exterminators at Work
passages.text:
Oh good, another warm body!

I hope that elf up there didn't bore you to death. We've got a lot of bugs to kill here.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Swamp of Sorrows!
passages.text:
All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle.

Persuade the trade baron to continue supplying our warriors with the weapons and munitions they require, no matter what it takes!

Travel to the Swamp of Sorrows by following the road from the southeastern Burning Steppes through the Redridge Mountains and meet the trade baron at his seaside resort.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Swamp of Sorrows!
passages.text: Welcome to beautiful Bogpaddle!

passages.title: Bombs Away!
passages.text:
The Wellson Shipyard is constantly receiving supplies from offshore and we need to put a stop to it. They have setup cannons along the docks for defense but if you can make it to them, we can use them to destroy their supply ships.

Head down there and see what you can do. Report back to me on your progress.

passages.title: Bombs Away!
passages.text: Great work on those supply ships, <name>!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.

passages.title: Out of Harm's Way
passages.text:
Luckily, when the infestation occured, no druids were slumbering in the western barrow den. It is still a sacred site to us, however, and its depths hold blessed relics kept there undisturbed for ages.

While I am somewhat trusting of the goblin exterminators, I am also... familiar with the habits of their race. Please retrieve any relics you can find in the barrow den and bring them back to me so they are not damaged. They are within urns, nestled in the small alcoves throughout the den.

passages.title: Out of Harm's Way
passages.text: I hope you found them intact...

passages.title: Out of Harm's Way
passages.text: They may not look like much to you, but these relics hold great value to the people of Starfall.  You are kind, <name>.

passages.title: Step Into My Barrow
passages.text:
I've still got no clue where all these bugs came from. My best guess is the cataclysm stirred up some underground nests we never knew about.

No use getting distracted with that when they need killing, though!

passages.title: Step Into My Barrow
passages.text:
I figured a talented <class> like you would have no problem taking care of a few bugs.

I GUESS I FIGURED WRONG.

passages.title: Step Into My Barrow
passages.text:
Hey, nice work!

If you ever want to come back and kill some more bugs for absolutely no additional reward, please, feel free!

passages.title: Enter the Dragon Queen
passages.text:
Hello, <race>. I wish we could meet in more favorable circumstances. The world hangs by a thread, and all that the Titans have wrought may be in jeopardy.

It saddens me greatly, but my judgment is final. Deathwing - the horrific creature that was once the Earth Warder and once my friend - must be destroyed.

I have prepared a site atop the Highlands, to the west of the Vermillion Redoubt, where I can bring about his end. Seek out the Circle of Life and speak with Lirastrasza within. I will join you there.

passages.title: Enter the Dragon Queen
passages.text:
Hello again, <race>. I hear you were instrumental in our push toward Grim Batol - thank you!

Alexstrasza has sanctified this ground in the hopes of luring Deathwing here. She'll perform a ceremony to lure him out... and then destroy him within this sacred circle.

Let's hope her plan works.

passages.title: The Balance of Nature
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I am Ilthalaine. My purpose in Shadowglen is to train young <class>s like you and to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered. Unfortunately, the nightsaber numbers grew too large, and they will devastate the other populations if they are not culled.

Journey forth, young <class>, and thin saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.

passages.title: The Balance of Nature
passages.text: There is still work to be done, <name>. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber population.

passages.title: The Balance of Nature
passages.text: You performed your duties well, <name>.

passages.title: Fel Moss Corruption
passages.text:
You seem to know what you're doing. Perhaps I can task you with something a little more important.

As you may well know, the corruption in Teldrassil was supposedly wiped away. Yet something lingers. The creatures have not calmed and all manner of problems still plague us.

I need you to deal with the grellkin that have gathered to the west, and while you're there, I want you to search them for fel moss. This will help me determine from where this continuing corruption stems.

passages.title: Fel Moss Corruption
passages.text: Satisfy my suspicions, <name>. Bring to me fel moss from the grellkin.

passages.title: Fel Moss Corruption
passages.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, <name>.

You confirmed my fears, however. The grellkin are still tainted by fel moss, despite Teldrassil's blessing. Something sinister remains within the tree. I can only hope that the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs are free of the corruption, or we are still in grave danger.

I will look into this further and contact those who might be of aid. Thank you, <class>.

passages.title: Demonic Thieves
passages.text:
Vicious little grell! They've been stealing from our foodstores again.

If you wouldn't mind lending a hand, they are sure to have my stolen bags within their camps to the west. I would be glad to reward you if you can bring them back to me.

passages.title: Demonic Thieves
passages.text: I don't have any spare supplies for my customers until my stolen goods are recovered. Have you had any luck?

passages.title: Demonic Thieves
passages.text:
Elune be praised! And you as well, young <class>.

There are many young night elves in need of these, but I'd be more than happy to give you one of the bags as a reward. I'm sure it will come in handy.

Safe travels to you.

passages.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Delicious Meat
passages.text:
Say there, <class>... do you like meat? Even better, do you like money?

I got a second cousin who's making a killing in the frozen meats business. He's set up a smoking pit up north, and he's looking for help hunting all the dangerous beasties that always tend to taste so good.

Carnivores pay well, friend. I'm too heavily invested here in this barrow den - what was I thinking? - so I might as well pass the tip on to a helpful <race> like yourself.

His name's Jez. Head northeast, and look for the smoke!

passages.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Delicious Meat
passages.text: Look around you; you're looking at the largest goblin-owned hunting reserve in Kalimdor! I've got the licenses to shoot and eat everything that walks on the snow from here to Everlook... and lemme tell you, they're good eatin'!

passages.title: A Little Gamy
passages.text:
Many find the meat of the Shardtooth bears to be too gamy for their taste. I disagree, though I'm not one to judge the tastes of others.

The Shardtooth Maulers, however - their brown-furred cousins, to the south - have much more tender flesh, particularly in their paws. And I've heard that the snout is also considered a delicacy.

Continue your hunt, <name>. Let's see if you can bag those maulers for ol' Francis.

passages.title: A Little Gamy
passages.text:
<Francis smacks his lips.>

You've got to try some of this, <name>.  These maulers are perfectly tenderized... possibly because of the pummeling you delivered.

passages.title: Yetiphobia
passages.text:
It's all ready, <name>!

Now, I told my friend Legacki that I have a surprise for her. This is where you come in!

I'm going to give you my mechanical yeti, and you'll get the honor of using it to surprise her. She's just on the other side of Everlook, near the inn.

Go up to her and turn the yeti on... I'll be watching from here!

passages.title: Yetiphobia
passages.text: She'll never expect it!

passages.title: Yetiphobia
passages.text:
Hah! She'll think twice before making fun of my ideas again!

Thanks for your help, <name>. I couldn't have had so much fun without you!

passages.title: Iverron's Antidote
passages.text:
Our friend Iverron has fallen to poison from the nearby webwood spiders. I can tend to him to keep his state from deteriorating, but I need someone to gather an ingredient to prepare him an antidote.

All around the ponds you should find Moonpetal Lilies. These flowers have great healing properties, and I can use them with the ingredients I already have to restore Iverron to better health.

Would you gather them for me? There should be many just in sight of here, near the water's edge.

passages.title: Iverron's Antidote
passages.text: Our dear friend is not doing well, even with my mending. Have you brought the supplies I require?

passages.title: Iverron's Antidote
passages.text: These will do perfectly. Thank you, <name>. Your swiftness is appreciated.

passages.title: Webwood Corruption
passages.text:
I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely. Something foul lingers.

These spiders suffer much more deeply from the corruption than the other nearby wildlife. They are becoming a danger to your people and a danger to the forest. We must thin their numbers, but more importantly, we need to find the source of the corruption that plagues them.

I will come with you and aid you in this.

passages.title: Webwood Corruption
passages.text: This is grim work. It pains me to have to inflict such violence on creature of the forest, corrupt or not.

passages.title: Webwood Corruption
passages.text:
This corruption these spiders suffer from is not simply surface deep. It cannot be magic or subtle malintent. It is bred into them.

It seems our next task is clear.

passages.title: Vile Touch
passages.text:
If these spiders are born with corruption in their veins, then their broodmother must be at the root of this evil.

Let us make our way to the far north end of the cave and seek out Githyiss the Vile. The answers we seek lie with her.

passages.title: Vile Touch
passages.text: I adore these forests. I want to see the corruption purged from them completely. When next I return, I want to do so with a lighter heart.

passages.title: Vile Touch
passages.text:
Githyiss and her brood were being corrupted by this totem. This is a furbolg totem.

This is very troubling indeed. This means the Gnarlpine are still a danger to these forests. We let our guard down too soon.

passages.title: Signs of Things to Come
passages.text:
I will pursue the trail of the Gnarlpine and track this corruption to its source. If you ever encounter Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar, he knows intimately of the problems that plague this forest, and he can direct you on how to help further.

I'm sure we will meet again with time. Perhaps you can aid me in dealing with the source of this corruption once I locate it. For now, I will take you back to Dentaria so that you may finish your training. Thank you for all that you have done, <name>.

passages.title: Signs of Things to Come
passages.text:
You've returned! It's good to see you. It seems you've dealt with the source of much of the corruption in Shadowglen.

Teldrassil still suffers and will need attention, be we can afford a moment or two for you to finish your training here in Shadowglen.

passages.title: Teldrassil: Crown of Azeroth
passages.text:
As part of a ritual to complete your training here in Shadowglen, you must learn about our recent history.

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell to our northeast and retrieve a phial of its water. While there, you will witness a glimpse of our magics and learn of our past.

When you are done there, bring the water back to me, and I will direct you further.

passages.title: Teldrassil: Crown of Azeroth
passages.text: Our recent history is fraught with strife and violence. There is still much with which we must come to terms.

passages.title: Teldrassil: Crown of Azeroth
passages.text: Well done, <name>. You have one task left for you before you depart Shadowglen for the open wilds of Teldrassil.

passages.title: Teldrassil: Passing Awareness
passages.text:
While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, <name>. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.

passages.title: Teldrassil: Passing Awareness
passages.text: Greetings, <class>. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?

passages.title: Teldrassil: Passing Awareness
passages.text:
Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do.

Before we get to the task at hand, you should take in the lesson of this moonwell.

passages.title: This Can Only Mean One Thing...
passages.text:
Raz and I were enlisted by the Guardians of Hyjal to investigate the re-emergence of Ragnaros into our world. Let me go ahead and confirm that he is back and he is angry! We also have evidence that these Twilight's Hammer cultists are moving elementals from here to Blackrock Caverns, over in the Eastern Kingdoms.

Raz and I were about to head over there to investigate. We've got room for another in the mole machine if you're interested. Just meet us on the inside and we'll begin our journey.

passages.title: This Can Only Mean One Thing...
passages.text: Oh dear, Raz has been captured! As soon as we entered a dozen cultists and some big fat ogre jumped us. I ran while I Raz tried to fight them off. We need to save him, <name>!

passages.title: Basic Botany
passages.text: HELP! HELP! Crazed undead are attacking my farm! That psycho warden over at the Sludge Fields is probably responsible for this mess. Help me fight off the zombies!

passages.title: Basic Botany
passages.text:
PHEW! That was close! You're a real natural with these plants, <class>. You know, I brought the seeds here with me from Lost Isles. I figure once I get them all figured out I'll make a fortune in the deadly flower business!

Wha... LOOK! MORE ARE COMING!

passages.title: A Favor for Melithar
passages.text:
You should speak with Melithar. I believe he had some troubles with the grell already.

I expect he can offer you a well needed place to store more of your goods should you aid him.

passages.title: A Favor for Melithar
passages.text: Ilthalaine sent you? He was wise to do so. I am indeed in need of help.

passages.title: To the Chamber of Incineration!
passages.text:
It was an ambush, <name>! As soon as we walked in a super-fat ogre named Rom'ogg Bonecrusher attacked us! Raz bravely defended me while I ran off to hide. I watched as they beat him unconscious and then dragged him to a place the fat one called the "Chamber of Incineration." I think it's just down the hall across the bridge.

I'm too scared to go any further. Take my all-purpose diving helm and search for Raz. I'll communicate with you through the helm.

And if you find that ogre, kill him!

passages.title: To the Chamber of Incineration!
passages.text: <Pip's helm crackles with static.>

passages.title: To the Chamber of Incineration!
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm crackles with static.>

RAZ! What have they done to him!? FOLLOW HIM!

passages.title: What Is This Place?
passages.text:
<Pip's helm gives you a slight jolt.>

What is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!

Kill Corla to get past this hall!

passages.title: What Is This Place?
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm crackles with static.>

We haven't got much time. Raz looked injured. If we get to him in time there might be a chance that I can turn him back into a regular orc!

<You feel a sharp pain in the back of your head and hear the jingling of coins.>

Sorry about that. I figured I'd send through some gold - for your troubles and all that...

passages.title: The Twilight Forge
passages.text:
<Pip's helm hums with energy.>

Damn it! Raz won't stop! It's as if he were possessed with a burning vengeance for all things Twilight! It looks like if we're going to get past this room and catch up with Raz we'll need to take out the Twilight armorer, Karsh Steelbender. Kill him quick, <name>.

passages.title: The Twilight Forge
passages.text: <Pip's helm crackles with static.>

passages.title: The Twilight Forge
passages.text:
<Finkle's helm crackles with static.>

That should put a stop to their armory - at least for now.

Raz ran off across the ramp on the other side of the forge. GO GO GO!

passages.title: Ghouls Hate My Grains
passages.text:
You're a pro at this, <name>! A regular junior botanist! Listen, I've got a new seed to try called the rocknut. Use it to block the undead. Just drop it down and they'll stop dead in their tracks. Undead are so stupid!

Let's give it a try!

passages.title: Ghouls Hate My Grains
passages.text: I think that made Stillwater angry. He's sending the heavy-hitters after us now. No time to lose, friend, let's go!

passages.title: Screechy Keen
passages.text:
Them smaller owls are sure tasty, but Goodgrub says there's even bigger ones further south. Screechers, the folk around here call 'em... they make a heck of a noise when you tussle with them!

But he says they're the best owls he's ever tasted or sold, and I believe him. Why don't you go rustle up some of those for us while I keep arguin' with Francis here?

passages.title: Someone Setup the Pumpkin Bomb
passages.text:
You ever seen one of these?

<Brazie pulls out a pumpkin.>

This ain't no ordinary pumpkin, friend. See, once you plant it they'll lay in wait until a zombie shows up and then KABLOOEY! Zombie guts all over the place. Let's go!

passages.title: Someone Setup the Pumpkin Bomb
passages.text: D... Do you hear that rumblin'? I think Stillwater is comin'! HOLY MOLY LOOK OUT!

passages.title: Tending the Garden
passages.text: Even though we beat Warden Stillwater, his zombies still roam the countryside. Look there, another wave is approaching! Help me fight them off, old buddy! Let's go!

passages.title: Tending the Garden
passages.text: That'll keep 'em out for today, but I know they'll be back tomorrow. Hopefully you'll be around to help me.

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text:
So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...

<McBride looks through some papers.>

<name>. It is <name>, right?

You've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.

Head northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: Have you beaten back the Blackrock worgs?

passages.title: Beating Them Back!
passages.text: You've bought us a little time, <name>, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text:
The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.

In the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!

Kill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text: Kill the spies!

passages.title: Lions for Lambs
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!

passages.title: Vengeance for Orsis
passages.text:
The great city of Orsis was attacked by the armies of air.

We were taken prisoner. We were the lucky ones.

Most died, trapped beneath the choking desert sands.

Asaad, Al'Akir's caliph, ordered the attack... and he must pay with his life.

passages.title: Vengeance for Orsis
passages.text: Blessings upon you.  Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

passages.text: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner. However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text:
I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, <name>!

Find Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!

passages.title: Join the Battle!
passages.text: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!

passages.title: Targets of Opportunity
passages.text:
We were part of a clandestine operation put together by Prince Nadun of Ramkahen. We lost most of our unit during an ambush and we're now unable to finish our mission.

Should you be up for it, I can arrange for a sizable reward for you.

We were instructed to take out any targets of opportunity that would damage the enemy's military infrastructure.

We've spotted General Husam and two of his captains up ahead. Slaying them for us will be a great favor for Ramkahen.

passages.title: Targets of Opportunity
passages.text: Is it done, <name>?

passages.title: Targets of Opportunity
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>.  Your reputation is well-deserved.

passages.title: The Source of Their Power
passages.text:
We managed to do extensive scouting before our crew was ambushed.

We discovered that Deathwing's envoy, Siamat, is giving the Neferset their newfound power.

They claim it has restored them to the greatness of old, but something else has happened. Their very souls have been corrupted.

As one of the four winds, Siamat is incredibly powerful. But that power has been drained considerably by this process.

Strike now, while it is possible for you to slay him and bring an end to this madness.

passages.title: The Source of Their Power
passages.text:
It is true, then?  The great blight upon our race will soon end now that the Neferset have lost the ability to corrupt any more of our people.

Name your reward, <class>.  It is the least we can do for you.

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text:
Have you ever seen a goblin, <name>? They're wretched little monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.

The Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.

I need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!

passages.title: They Sent Assassins
passages.text: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

Yes, you are known to the Earthen Ring by name.

Your exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes.

I am but a messenger. A familiar presence seeks audience with you.

Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of our world.

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text: Yes, <class>?

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text:
Have you embraced the Holy Light yet, <brother/sister>? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers!

Take this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text: Rescue our soldiers!

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text: I think you now understand the power of the Light. The Light giveth hope, brother and the Light taketh from the darkness! BLESSED BE THE LIGHT!

passages.title: To the Depths
passages.text:
The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies.

It is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there. Any information you could gather would be of great value.

The Horde is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, speak to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay.

May the spirits guide you, <name>.

passages.title: To the Depths
passages.text: Lok'tar, brother! You have arrived just in time.

passages.title: Wayward Child
passages.text:
One of my children is not with me, <name>.

He stayed behind with the Twilight's Hammer at the Stonecore deep within the Temple of Earth.

I sent my other children to free him from the dark magic that was surely keeping him from returning here, but... no such magic was placed upon him.

Go into the Stonecore and destroy Ozruk. He must be reclaimed by the earth.

passages.title: Wayward Child
passages.text: Is it done, <race>?

passages.title: Wayward Child
passages.text:
<Therazane's eyes appear slightly more crystalline than you recall.>

Ozruk has been reclaimed by the earth.

Take your reward and leave me be, <name>.  I wish to be left alone.

passages.title: A Personal Summons
passages.text:
<An unfamiliar feeling wells up from deep within you, flooding your mind with thoughts and images.>

Hear my words, <name>.

Our world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis.

I call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour.

I am Naraat.

Seek me out at once, and your calling shall be revealed.

I await you at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.

passages.title: A Personal Summons
passages.text: May your sense of honor and duty serve Azeroth well, <class>.

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text:
Greetings, hero of Azeroth.

We of the Earthen Ring know you by name, <name>.

Your exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes.

I am but a messenger. A powerful presence seeks audience with you.

Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the dilemma of our world.

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text: Yes, <class>?

passages.title: The Eye of the Storm
passages.text: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

passages.title: To the Depths
passages.text:
The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies.

It is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there, so any information you could gather would be of great value.

The Alliance is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, travel northwest of Stormwind and speak to Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor.

May the spirits guide you, <name>.

passages.title: To the Depths
passages.text: All of our war ships are off fighting the Horde. You'll have to take the mercenary ship.

passages.title: Razor Beak and Antlers Pointy
passages.text:
What happened to me, you ask? Listen, <class>, and listen well, for my tale is one of tragedy...

I was sent here to Owl Wing Thicket to find some relics. I only made it this far before I was overwhelmed by a flurry of wings and talons.

How they roared and pecked, <class>!

I now lay here, a broken orc, with nothing but vengeance on my mind. Please, <class>, if you have any sense of honor, you will go into Owl Wing Thicket and help me regain mine.

passages.title: Razor Beak and Antlers Pointy
passages.text: They came at me two at a time, <class>.  I stood no chance.

passages.title: Razor Beak and Antlers Pointy
passages.text:
My honor is restored.

Partially.

My tale continues, <class>, for I have left portions of my honor elsewhere in this forest.

It has not been a very easy journey for me.

passages.title: Chips off the Old Block
passages.text:
My mysterious benefactors gave me more than one task. The second task took me farther south, to the Frostwhisper Gorge. I was surprised to learn that the gorge's bridge had been broken in two, preventing land travel from one side to the other.

In addition, the juvenile Frostmaul tumblers were separated from their stronger adult parents. I thought that I could defeat them in battle.

I was incorrect. I was forced to run away in shame.

Teach these tumblers a lesson, <name>. Fight them, and win.

passages.title: Chips off the Old Block
passages.text:
Be glad that the adult giants are trapped on the other side of that gorge. They are far hardier than these tumblers you fight.

I feel rejuvenated by your courage, <class>. Perhaps all hope is not lost after all...

passages.title: Necessary Refreshment (Backup Groundspawn Quest)
passages.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, <name>. If you bring me 6 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.

passages.title: Altered Beasts
passages.text:
We, the blue dragons, have been forced out of our home, Mazthoril. An impostor by the name of Umbranse has taken advantage of us in our weakest hour, and now occupies the cave.

Mazthoril is a place of extremely potent magic, and he does not know how to wield it. Even the wildlife suffers.

The beasts nearby have been altered. Please, <race>, I must ask you a favor. Gather their brains, so I can see if I can undo this Umbranse's wild magic.

passages.title: Altered Beasts
passages.text: Mazthoril belongs to the blue dragonflight. This is not right.

passages.title: Altered Beasts
passages.text: Let's see what I can do with these...

passages.title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
passages.text:
What a shame. Whatever Umbranse has done, he has prevented me from undoing his magic.

He is wiser than I had anticipated.

I do have a backup plan, however. I have seen owlbeasts enter and leave Mazthoril, even after Umbranse took control. Their ancient druidic magic must be capable of disabling Umbranse's. Luckily, I happen to be somewhat of an expert in their methods.

Travel south, to Dun Mandarr. You will find a chest with a dreamcatcher in it.

That will be your first step.

passages.title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
passages.text: The owlbeasts' magic will be the key to our retaking of Mazthoril.

passages.title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
passages.text: Good. It is just as Jaron described it.

passages.title: The Arcane Storm Within
passages.text:
Mazthoril's innate magic can wreak unimaginable havoc if mishandled. Umbranse's wanton casting within the cavern has opened up a number of tesseracts - in other words, portals - connecting to other worlds. If I am to return to Mazthoril, these tesseracts must be closed.

The dreamcatcher will close the portals, buying you safe entrance into Umbranse's lair. First defeat whatever comes out of the tesseracts, then use the dreamcatcher to quickly close them, before anything else spills into this world.

passages.title: The Arcane Storm Within
passages.text:
It will take some time for Mazthoril to recover... but she will.

The Blue Dragonflight is far from dead.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Hyena Harvest
passages.text:
Look, <name>!

I have taken your bait and fashioned traps that will be most useful in your next task.

Far to the southeast of here run a dangerous pack of Bloodsnarl Hyenas.

I am confident that they can be tamed and used to great effect in our performance.

Lay one of these next to them and they won't be able to resist it.

Then, once they're trapped, you just have to collect them and bring them back.

It works almost every time!

passages.title: The Vortex Pinnacle
passages.text:
One of our civilian leaders was taken prisoner by the air elementals.

They are probably torturing him for information as we speak.

Go to the Vortex Pinnacle, where these foul creatures came from, and look for Itesh.

You will find the entrance to the Vortex Pinnacle hovering off of the southeastern coast of Uldum.

passages.title: The Vortex Pinnacle
passages.text: You actually came here looking for me?

passages.title: The Pursuit of Umbranse
passages.text:
We have isolated Umbranse's position here in Winterspring. It is as I suspected.

Umbranse is at Mazthoril, the cavern that once belonged to the blue dragonflight, in the southwest. My mother, Haleh, will greet you there. She is stationed outside of the cave in a small camp with a few other survivors.

Look for her campfire.

passages.title: The Pursuit of Umbranse
passages.text:
You are <name>, yes?

Good, you will serve well. I require the aid of a <class> such as yourself.

passages.title: Trailing the Spiritspeaker
passages.text:
I have heard tales of Umbranse, though I have not ever met him in person. Rumor has it that he's been collecting magical artifacts, though for what purpose, I couldn't say.

Best pass this information on to a trusted ally. Nymn, the high elf, can be found within Everlook, the large goblin town to the northeast. Tell him all that we learned today.

passages.title: Trailing the Spiritspeaker
passages.text:
Umbranse... I see. I will carry this information onto my people.

You will be contacted if you are needed again.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED] Sullah's Sideshow
passages.text:
Welcome, my friend!

The fruits of our labor have paid off abundantly! The time has come for us to give a dress rehearsal.

Oh, before we begin, I have a favor to ask.

There was a small snafu with a stubborn pygmy, so I have to ask that you take his place for the performance.

I'm sure you'll be able to pick it right up. You're a natural!

Break a leg, my friend!

passages.title: The Sands of Silithus
passages.text:
Let's see... oh, here's a good one! Silithus!

So, apparently the Cenarion Circle needs assistance with an insect infestation of some sort.

<Vizzie shivers.>

Ugh! No thanks, not for me. I'm perfectly happy freezing to death here in Everlook if the alternative is bugs.

Hmm... it says here that visitors should speak with Windcaller Proudhorn, and the easiest way to get there is via the path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs.

You interested?

passages.title: The Sands of Silithus
passages.text:
Welcome to Cenarion Hold.

<Windcaller Proudhorn brushes some snow off of your shoulder.>

You've certainly come from far off.

passages.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
passages.text:
Now here's an interesting one. It says to report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands. That's just about as far as you can get from here!

It says they're having trouble with Horde attacks. Hmph! I didn't know the Horde even had an outpost in the Blasted Lands! They tend to worry more about demons and less about rivalries down there, as I understand it.

You'll have to cross the Great Sea, then travel south from the Swamp of Sorrows.

You interested?

passages.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
passages.text: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

passages.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
passages.text:
Now here's an interesting one. It says that members of the Horde should talk to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold.

Hmph! I didn't even know that the Horde held Dreadmaul Hold!

I guess this Okrilla requires help fighting some ogres and the Alliance. You'd think she'd already have her hands full with all the demons down there!

The best way to Dreadmaul Hold is to cross the Great Sea, then to take the road south from the Swamp of Sorrows.

You interested?

passages.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
passages.text: Our enemies are numerous, <class>. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

passages.title: The Dunes of Silithus
passages.text:
Cenarion Hold, in Silithus, is one of the biggest druid settlements in Kalimdor. Almost as big as Moonglade, mon.

Someday, maybe Zen'Aliri be headin' on over to Cenarion Hold... fightin' some Twilight's Hammer, healin' the land where the silithid tear it... but Zen'Aliri's master tells him to wait.

So Zen'Aliri waits.

The easiest way to get there is that path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs.

If you got no master... there's nothing keepin' you from movin' on.

passages.title: The Dunes of Silithus
passages.text: Welcome to Cenarion Hold, traveler.

passages.title: Warlord Halthar is Back
passages.text:
He's at it again, <name>. Warlord Halthar... terror of the shire. He and his drake were spotted causing trouble to the south, among the Thundermar Ruins.

Kill Halthar, <name>! We'll send in some warbrands to help out once you engage.

passages.title: Warlord Halthar is Back
passages.text: Grim business, but well done all the same. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Call of the Warmatron
passages.text: Our venerable warmatron, Okrilla, has sent me to the far reaches of the world in search of suitable heroes that would join our cause. Are you interested in strengthening the Horde's grasp over the Eastern Kingdoms? Then take this portal to the Blasted Lands and report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold!

passages.title: Call of the Warmatron
passages.text: Silithus, such a worthless piece of land. It is a wonder that the great cataclysm did not sunder it fully!

passages.title: Into the Stonecore
passages.text:
You say that this Millhouse Manastorm and High Priestess Azil were to meet inside the Stonecore?

Sounds big. We'd best get on their trail. We don't want the Twilight's Hammer pulling off something big right under our noses.

Speak to Earthwarden Yrsa inside the Stonecore. She's been stationed there to make sure the Twilight's Hammer doesn't try to retake the Temple of Earth.

passages.title: Into the Stonecore
passages.text:
It's about time they sent someone to help.

Millhouse Manastorm?  It sounds like we're both after the same person.

passages.title: Bring Down the High Shaman
passages.text:
Our scouts in the field report that High Shaman MacKilligan has moved out of Thundermar and is fighting amidst the Thundermar Ruins northwest of here, across the river.

He's a dangerous one, <name>, responsible for the deaths of many a Dragonmaw. He WILL be destroyed, that is not the question.

The question is: will you be the one to earn the glory of the kill?

passages.title: Bring Down the High Shaman
passages.text: The High Shaman has been brought down! Thundermar will no doubt try to send others, but on this day, the Dragonmaw are triumphant.

passages.title: They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies.
passages.text:
There's an orc who lives in the west. At the frayed edge of the cataclysm's swath of destruction.

They call him Swiftdagger, <name>. They call him that because ... his ... actually I think that's just his name.

<Nozzlepot shrugs.>
