passages.title: Spirit of the Loch
passages.text:
I have no knowledge of any artifact that Cho'gall is crafting, but I think I know one that can help.

Countess Verrall is the ancient spirit of Loch Verrall to the north. She has no love for the Twilight's Hammer, who have polluted her waters.

Seek her for the wisdom that you seek.

passages.title: Spirit of the Loch
passages.text:
I know why you are here, <name>. Your reasons sing within your fluids.

I know about the dead dwarf forgesmith polluting my lake. If you want to find out what his corpse remembers, you must earn it.

passages.title: Unbinding
passages.text:
Look, if there's one thing I know, it's elementals. I've been able to really gain an appreciation for how they feel. Let me tell you, they don't appreciate being enslaved one bit!

So, what I'm saying here is that if you were to free the enslaved elementals, I'm sure that not only would they show their gratitude, they'd also likely turn on their masters.

Sounds like a win-win to me, <name>.

passages.title: Unbinding
passages.text: What'd I tell you? Elementals aren't so bad after all, eh?

passages.title: Pay Attention!
passages.text:
Listen, <race>. It's not that I don't appreciate the rescue and all, but this is a dire situation.

You have to pay better attention out there!

I was watching, and you passed right over a busted alliance crate.

There's bound to be something in there that could help me and my boys.

How about you get out there and take a look-see, hrm?

passages.title: Pay Attention!
passages.text:
Sure enough...

This looks to be something that Nazgrim will take quite an interest in.

passages.title: Do the Honors
passages.text:
It looks like all that's left to do is to place the orbs on the pedestals at each corner of this mechanism.

We appear to have stumbled upon what may be the most important find in modern history.

<Harrison looks at you for a moment, then hands you the orbs.>

Well, go ahead, <name>.

We'd have never made this discovery without you.

passages.title: Do the Honors
passages.text:
Well, now. Would ya look at that!

As amazing as this is, I am confident that there's more to our discovery than meets the eye...

Much more.

passages.title: To the Surface
passages.text:
Nevin has just sent word that he and his men are making their way to the surface. He'll be waiting for you in the building that S.A.F.E. has established as its headquarters.

See Torben Zapblast over there? Talk to him when you're ready to head to the surface and he'll arrange to have you transported up there. It's been a pleasure meeting you, <name>, and I'm honored to have played a small role in helping you escape from Gnomeregan to start your life on the surface.

passages.title: To the Surface
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>.

passages.title: To the Surface
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to get so many survivors out of Gnomeregan this time. Everyone is going to be thrilled to meet you and hear your story.

passages.title: The Platinum Discs
passages.text:
The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin. Touching them makes your hand tingle. Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.

"Salutations. I am a keeper of knowledge. The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."

You have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!

passages.title: Narkrall, the Drake-Tamer
passages.text:
<name>, the stronghold at Bloodgulch is the heart of the Dragonmaw empire in the Highlands. It is just up the river. Narkrall Rakeclaw is using his considerable power to amass a wing of drake-riders there.

For the Dragonmaw to succeed, Bloodgulch must succeed. Go to Narkrall and make sure it is so.

passages.title: Narkrall, the Drake-Tamer
passages.text:
<Narkrall sizes you up.>

Another mewling Horde whelp? Zaela saps our strength by diluting our forces with the weak. Very well, <class>. Prove yourself to me, and show me what your Horde is made of.

passages.title: Princess Theradras
passages.text:
Do not be alarmed, young <race>. I am Zaetar, son of Cenarius, and I come to you for your assistance.

Long ago, I made the mistake of mating with Princess Theradras, a powerful earth elemental aligned with the Old Gods. Our children, the centuar Kahns, turned on me upon birth and slew me mercilessly. Now, Theradras' taint runs deep and threatens far more than just Maraudon.

Come slay her and free my spirit so that we may restore Desolace to a place of verdant life and promise, as Cenarius would want.

passages.title: Princess Theradras
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. As you can see, my mere presence here has resulted in a bloom of glorious life despite my mate's presence. Names aside, perhaps one day you will again venture into Desolace and find it a verdant oasis free of any traces of the Old Gods.

passages.title: Pool of Tears
passages.text:
The trolls that lurk within this temple have done grievous harm to my kind, <name>. We were sent here to guard this place, and were instead used to unleash the terrible powers within.

I must beg you for the help only a mortal can give. You can be my hand within the temple; should I enter by myself, I risk being turned against my brothers as well.

We shall make a pact. If you wish to help, first gather Atal'ai artifacts from the waters around the temple, and return them to me.

passages.title: Pool of Tears
passages.text: Your gathering of these artifacts will be a sign of faith. Once rendered, I will perform the ritual.

passages.title: Pool of Tears
passages.text:
The essence of the green dragonflight wafts from these artifacts; the vestiges of my corrupted kin. In purifying them, I form a bond between us.

Step forward, <name>, and receive the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight.

passages.title: Dragon, Unchained
passages.text:
Lirastrasza is the last and greatest of the red dragons that the Twilight's Hammer captured. They're about to kill her.

I need you to take the Elementium Axe and free her from her bonds.

passages.title: Dragon, Unchained
passages.text: Use the axe to break Lirastrasza's chains.

passages.title: Dragon, Unchained
passages.text:
Isn't she a beauty?

Let's see what she does now that she's free.

passages.title: Dragon, Unchained
passages.text:
Lirastrasza is the last and greatest of the red dragons that the Twilight's Hammer captured. They're about to kill her, <class>.

You need to take the Elementium Axe and free her from her bonds before they do.

passages.title: Dragon, Unchained
passages.text:
Isn't she beautiful? So graceful.

I hope she gets her fill of revenge and then some.

passages.title: The Warden's Time
passages.text:
<Erunak's image penetrates your mind.>

You have done well, <name>, but more remains to be done.

Before moving on from this place, let us be sure that we leave it in disarray.

Find the one who leads these naga and repay him for his misdeeds.

passages.title: The Warden's Time
passages.text:
It is good that this operation has been undone.

Soon, I must move on...

passages.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
passages.text:
The Earthcaller's initiate, Goldmine, has need of you.

I think that they're ready for you to help them with whatever's down in that mine.

passages.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
passages.text: <name>, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

passages.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
passages.text:
The Earthcaller has a goblin initiate? Goldmine is his name? He has need of you.

I think that they're ready for you to do their dirty work with whatever's down in that mine.

passages.title: Back to the Elementium Depths
passages.text: <name>, glad you're back! Have I got something fun for us to do!

passages.title: The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened
passages.text:
These two have no idea how to tell a story. Theldurin's story was too short, and Lucien's tale was a little too tall, if you catch my drift.

Also, neither of their stories had action and fans admiring my awesomeness in them.

Sit back, <name>. I'll tell you what really happened that day.

passages.title: The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened
passages.text: I seem to have lost my place... let's see... where was I...

passages.title: The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened
passages.text:
I can't believe those guys would interrupt me like that.  My story was going so well, too...

Anyhow, thanks for sticking around so long.  It's nice to have someone new to share tall tales with.  I'm sure Lucien and Theldurin feel the same way.

You have any you'd like to share with us?

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
<An ancient, slightly cracked slab of stone with an immense number of inscriptions etched on all sides of it. You're unable to decipher the language, but the sheer amount of text and the semi-ornate nature of the stone suggest that this might carry significant value.>

<Levia Dreamwaker, back with the Nespirah survivors, was looking for something exactly like this.>

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
Hah! Did you see the admiral giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offer us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole mess.

I'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. Wait... what's that you have there?

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
Brilliant! It will take me a while to translate, but this is precisely the kind of find I was hoping for.

There's no knowing if we will make it out of this place, but if it comes down to it, I will find a way to float this to the surface in hopes that it will one day be found.

Thank you again, <name>. Here... perhaps I have something that may be of use to you.

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
<An ancient, slightly cracked slab of stone with an immense number of inscriptions etched on all sides of it. You're unable to decipher the language, but the sheer amount of text and the semi-ornate nature of the stone suggest that this might carry significant value.>

<Elendri Goldenbrow, back with the Nespirah survivors, was looking for something exactly like this.>

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
Hah! Did you see the captain giving me dirty looks and decide to throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offer us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole mess.

I'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. Wait... what's that you have there?

passages.title: Piece of the Past
passages.text:
Brilliant! I can't have expected much more with the tools I gave you.

I should be able to fill in the blanks and get this all written out shortly. There's no knowing if we will make it out of this place, but if it comes down to it, I will find a way to float this to the surface in hopes that it will one day be found.

Thank you again, <name>. You're not bad.

passages.title: Water of Life
passages.text:
Take my Water of Life and pass it into the corpse of the drowned dwarf.

He was a worker of metals in life, and though his body now feeds my loch, the Water will allow him to tell you what you want to know.

Then, take your information and be gone from my demesne.

passages.title: Water of Life
passages.text:
The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf?

You're kidding, right?

passages.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
passages.text:
Okay, <name>, we need to get to the earth portal at the back of the cave.

I've "procured" a ride for us. Why walk when we can ride in style? I hope you don't mind mine carts.

Let me know when you're ready.

passages.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
passages.text:
Oh no! My weapons and totems!

They're destroyed!!!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Mount Hyjal!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

Our brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!

Speak with Cenarion Emissary Blackhoof to gain entry into Moonglade. Blackhoof is located at the tauren district in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

Onward, <brother/sister>! Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Mount Hyjal!
passages.text: We knew the Horde would send help and not a moment too soon!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

Our brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!

Speak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, <brother/sister>!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
passages.text: Help us!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
passages.text: We knew the Alliance would send help and not a moment too soon!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Deepholm!
passages.text:
By order of his royal highness, King Anduin Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Naraat the Earthspeaker at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.

The Earthen Ring requires our aid! They report that the elemental plane of Deepholm threatens to overtake our world and destroy all life on Azeroth!

The Eastern Earthshrine can be found directly northwest of Stormwind Keep.

For the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, <brother/sister>!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Deepholm!
passages.text: Our world is in danger, <name>! We need the help of great heroes, like you, to save it!

passages.title: The Gnoll King
passages.text:
<name>, I'm afraid I must ask of you the impossible.

I received my eyepatch because he willed it so. Countless thousands have perished to his wrath. It was only by sheer miracle that we were able to imprison him here.

Doing so was a grave mistake. We held out as long as we could, but then they came. From the shadows and darkness, gnolls in service of Hogger ripped my best men to pieces.

You must defeat the Gnoll King, lest he mounts another attack and slaughters us all in cold, bloodthirsty rage.

passages.title: The Gnoll King
passages.text: Have you defeated Hogger?

passages.title: The Gnoll King
passages.text:
You have performed a deed this day unlike any I have seen in my long career. Hogger's death will plague the Riverpaw for years to come, and hopefully put an end to their attacks on our people.

Greatest of heroes, please take this as a sign of my eternal gratitude.

passages.title: Show Me Your Papers
passages.text:
After your work in dealing with the Twilight's Hammer cult, Captain Anton recommended you for a delicate assignment.

My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into the Stormwind has come to a halt. The king has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

passages.title: Show Me Your Papers
passages.text: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, <name>. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.

passages.title: While We're Here
passages.text:
You know, while we're here, we might as well take care of the Twilight's Hammer intruders. This place used to be ours, after all!

I'd help, but with my totems and weapons broken, I'm pretty helpless.

passages.title: While We're Here
passages.text: They had it coming to them.

passages.title: Rune Ruination
passages.text:
Examining the Twilight Rune of Earth, you can almost feel its power extending further into the Elementium Depths.

It's probably connected to other runes. Initiate Goldmine thinks that you should destroy all of them.

passages.title: Rune Ruination
passages.text: We still have some runes to destroy, <name>.

passages.title: Rune Ruination
passages.text:
That'll teach 'em to move in on our territory!

What's that over across the way?

passages.title: A Fiery Reunion
passages.text:
That's Magmatooth, my estranged fire elemental. <name>, you gotta kill him or he's gonna kill me!

It was all just a big misunderstanding. How was I to know he'd be mad about me "borrowing" his heart down in Deepholm? He can't die... not permanently anyway!

He's got the controller to the portal on him for sure. You gotta get the controller and then use it in the Fire portal to take us back to the entrance.

passages.title: A Fiery Reunion
passages.text: <name>!

passages.title: A Fiery Reunion
passages.text:
We survived and all of the portals are now shutdown!

You don't think Magmatooth is going to hold a grudge, do you?

passages.title: Empire of Dirt
passages.text:
This war has taken its toll on us as a people. We have lost much to secure our place as the rightful rulers of Lordaeron. And though the moment is won, the battle continues to rage in other parts of the Eastern Kingdoms.

I must return to the Undercity to recuperate. I want you to go to Hillsbrad Foothills in my stead, <name>. As my most trusted soldier, you will lead our forces to absolute domination against our enemies in Hillsbrad.

Report to High Executor Darthalia at Southpoint Blockade, to the east.

passages.title: Empire of Dirt
passages.text: News of your conquest in Silverpine emboldens us, <name>. We are prepared to fight at your command and beat back the last remaining vestiges of humanity in Hillsbrad.

passages.title: Total War
passages.text:
Many of the Wildhammer have already fled their homes. It is time to wipe them from the map.

Up on the ridge to the north you will find abandoned houses in the Thundermar Ruins. Kegs of potent Thundermar ale have been left behind.

Thundermar ale is 220 proof; I don't know how that's possible.

Smash open the kegs and set their content aflame. Burn them out! Leave the dwarves nothing to return to!

passages.title: Total War
passages.text:
Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes...

Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Fortune and Glory
passages.text:
We have to keep moving, <name>. It's just a matter of time before those troops get their act together.

The coffer should be just beyond these ruins.

Stay on your toes. Something tells me this isn't over yet...

passages.title: Fortune and Glory
passages.text: Good to see you're still in one piece, <name>.

passages.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
passages.text:
You were right to bring this note to me, <name>. The king's proclamation came too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.

This note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all the infiltrators, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to restrain any agents you find, bring them to the entrance of the Stockade, and report to me when you're finished.

passages.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. The note you captured makes sense in light of this ritual the infiltrators mentioned. This city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers. We must act before their plans can come to fruition.

passages.title: War Forage
passages.text:
<Griff's stomach growls.>

Whenever we Dragonmaw go on the warpath, everyone stops hunting.

The best tasting food is stolen from the mouths of the enemy. Up on the ridge north of the river there's a bunch of wrecked Wildhammer houses. I bet they're loaded with food.

Bring some to my mouth.

passages.title: War Forage
passages.text: Hungry.

passages.title: War Forage
passages.text:
<Griff greedily snatches the heap of food, enough to feed dozens of men.>

Great! Did you get any for yourself?

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text:
Since my people first claimed the Highlands, the Wildhammer dwarves have been our persistent foe. We fought them in Grim Batol, we fought them in the Wetlands, and even now open warfare rages to our north, across the river, amidst the Thundermar Ruins.

Prove your valor to me. Seek out and crush Wildhammer Warbrands. The best among them carry insignias - my warriors collect them by the dozen.

Can you?

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text: Show me the insignias you've collected, <class>.

passages.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
passages.text:
<Narkrall clenches the insignias in his weathered hand.>

So, <class>. There's more to you than meets the eye.

Maybe your Horde can stand with the best of my warriors. Let's try you out...

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text:
S'not a boast to say that we Thundermars brew the finest ale in the Eastern Kingdoms. It's 220 proof. Yeah, you heard me!

As folks fled from the south to the town center, they were forced to leave behind their ale.

<Blundy pauses, allowing the gravity of the situation to soak in.>

GET IT BACK! That stuff'll turn even the stringiest of warriors into a whirlin' dervish of mouth-foaming destruction. Get them kegs! S'our only hope!

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text:
Get me that ale, <name>.

Hey, you haven't been skimmin' off the top, have you?

passages.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
passages.text: Oh aye ... we get a few of these kegs out to the boys on the front and we're gonna see some fireworks. Thank you, <name>!

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text:
Supplies are short, <name>. We've got refugees coming into Thundermar from up and down the ridge - that's a lot of mouths to feed.

Plenty of food stores were left behind as people pulled their families to safety. We need that food!

Scour the Thundermar ruins south, east, and southwest of here for food stores.

Careful, <class>! The fighting around the ruins is pretty intense.

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text: Got some eats?

passages.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
passages.text:
It's good - hardly a worm or weevil to be found!

This is a lifesaver to the folk who fled here for survival.

passages.title: Dragonmaw Takedown
passages.text:
The Dragonmaw!

<Colin spits.>

Monsters, all of them. We've fought them up and down these highlands since the last war. And now they're joining forces with the Horde?

If you're going to convince us Wildhammers to unite under the Alliance banner, you'd best prove yourself against the Dragonmaw. Wade into the battle that's raging in the Thundermar ruins to the south and southwest. Kill Dragonmaw marauders and collect the insignias that their greatest warriors wear. Then we'll talk.

passages.title: Dragonmaw Takedown
passages.text: How goes the fight, <class>?

passages.title: Dragonmaw Takedown
passages.text:
Look at that! That's quite a collection of trophies you have there.

I'll spread the word. If a single Alliance <class> can do this, imagine what the rest of your lot can accomplish!

passages.title: The Darkest Depths
passages.text:
I've been seeing sea creatures acting oddly through the whole swamp. The murlocs, yes, but before that the gilblins, and the makrura... I even saw some naga wander ashore the other day.

Something's calling them here, and working them into a frenzy to boot. Many of the creatures have been drawn to Stagalbog Cavern to the west. Something's down there, and if it gets any stronger we'll all start wandering in there too...

You should put a stop to whatever it is before that happens.

passages.title: The Darkest Depths
passages.text: Oh my. It sounds like you ran across quite a sinister being. I wonder what one of those was doing all the way out here...

passages.title: A Disarming Distraction
passages.text:
The curse has taken over the expedition members' higher brain functions, but my calculations reveal their suppressed adolescent subconscious can still be stimulated by realistic imagery.

Utilize this holo-projector to distract them.

They are currently setting up explosives at the tomb to the east to attempt to gain access to secret passages in Uldum.

They seek dangerous re-origination technology beneath Uldum and must be stopped.

passages.title: A Disarming Distraction
passages.text: Greetings, user <name>.  I am happy to see you are still unaffected by the effects of the expedition curse.

passages.title: A Disarming Distraction
passages.text:
Well done, <name>.  The expedition has already doomed itself.

There is no need for it to endanger the rest of the world as well.

passages.title: To Fuselight Proper
passages.text:
This, <race>, is paradise. I've always wanted to live in a nice quiet town by the sea so I can focus on my explosions without any distractions.

Quiet's not for everybody, though... 'specially the adventuring hero-type, like yourself.

We've installed a teleporter in the backside of town that'll take you up to the top of the cliffs. From there, you can take the quick ride west into Fuselight proper, within the Badlands.

There should be more for you to do up there. Tell 'em that Flo sent you.

passages.title: To Fuselight Proper
passages.text: Welcome to Fuselight!

passages.title: A Strange Request
passages.text:
On to other matters. I have a package that I need delivered.

A young lady came by our town not long ago, looking for compressed blasting powder, a tempered mithril bomb casing, and some safety goggles. Naturally, we had plenty of blasting powder and bomb casings to sell her, but the safety goggles were a little harder to find.

Long story short, I've got the goggles, but she's already returned to her studies down in Lethlor Ravine. Will you bring these down to her?

passages.title: A Strange Request
passages.text: Ahh... you've found me.  Good.

passages.title: A Strange Request
passages.text: Thank you, <race>.  You may keep the goggles, as they have already served their purpose: they brought you to me.

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text:
The cultists seem assured of their victory, even as we detain more and more of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.

These rituals seem to be the core of the cult's plan to attack Stormwind. I'm going to give you one of the robes taken from the arrested cultists. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest and see if you can get the cultists there to let you in on the plan.

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. We were worried that the tyrant Wrynn's guards had thrown you into the Stockade.

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text: You need to familiarize yourself with the portal ritual quickly. We need to send as many teams into Stormwind as we can. They're discovering and arresting more of our brothers each day.

passages.title: Third Sample: Implanted Eggs
passages.text:
Nyxondra is being held against her will. She is hidden from her brood, right in the middle of their breeding grounds. She lays eggs, but they will be taken away before she can see them hatch.

Cruel? Perhaps... but not nearly as cruel as the treatment that their dragonflight showed my mistress.

Show me that I can trust you, <name>. Take Nyxondra's eggs, and bring them here. You will need to beat Nyxondra into submission before you can take them.

passages.title: Third Sample: Implanted Eggs
passages.text: Remember, <name>... this is for the good of the black dragonflight.  We are here to redeem them, not to hurt them.  This is but a step in their recovery.

passages.title: Third Sample: Implanted Eggs
passages.text:
You have done everything that I have asked you, without question.  Our job here in Lethlor Ravine is done.

It is now time that I revealed everything to you.

passages.title: When the Going Gets Tough, Cheat
passages.text:
I just can't get my invention to work! Gah!

That's it, I've decided. I'm going to cheat and use magic.

What my invention really needs is a solid piston that's thin enough to fit through a narrow copper tube, but strong enough to withstand repeated impact without breaking. The magical rods carried by those ogre magi to the north should work perfectly.

From what I can tell, only the instructors carry the strong staves.

passages.title: When the Going Gets Tough, Cheat
passages.text: I don't like to stoop to using magic on my inventions, but this is somewhat of an emergency.

passages.title: When the Going Gets Tough, Cheat
passages.text: A perfect fit!  My goat puncher is finally finished!

passages.title: Gnomebliteration
passages.text:
I have downloaded my program to the fusion core and have complete control over it.

I've created a small pocket of air inside to avoid vaporizing user <name>.

I will yield control of all movement functions so I can dedicate my cycles to keeping the core stable.

Go down the hill and neutralize as many of the expedition members as possible.

My analysis reveals you might feel... "guilt" as a result of such high fatality numbers.

User <name>, you must be assured that expedition members are without hope.

passages.title: Gnomebliteration
passages.text: It is done, user <name>.  I thank you for your assistance with this unfortunate task.

passages.title: I Said the Words...
passages.text:
Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already infiltrated the city and made their way to the ritual sites.

I want you to visit the portal ritual sites in Stormwind's Dwarven District, Park district, and Cathedral Square. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to is read the last part of the incantation from the book.

Very soon, <name>, Stormwind will find itself awash in wind and water.

passages.title: I Said the Words...
passages.text: You've done an excellent job tracking down and combating the cultists, but I fear they are right about one thing. We will never know if we've gotten them all.

passages.title: Skullcrusher the Mountain
passages.text:
It was a trap! Cho'gall lured you in with the Hammer of Twilight so that his gronn could finish you off.

Survive and slay Skullcrusher the Mountain!

passages.title: Skullcrusher the Mountain
passages.text:
You did it, lad! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion.

Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!

passages.title: Skullcrusher the Mountain
passages.text:
It was a trap! Cho'gall lured you in with the Hammer of Twilight so that his gronn could finish you off.

Survive and slay Skullcrusher the Mountain!

passages.title: Skullcrusher the Mountain
passages.text:
You did it, <name>! You beat that damned gronn and sent Cho'gall packing into the Twilight Bastion.

Don't you worry. With your help and that of your friends, we'll get in there and we'll kill Cho'gall once and for all!

passages.title: Troggish Troubles
passages.text:
I'll need some time to analyze these samples, as well as a break from this trogg-shooting duty. Go man one of my turrets and take out as many troggs as you can. I'll be here studying.

The turrets have two abilities: a regular shot, as well as an electrical overload, for when too many enemies get close! Heh, heh. Good luck.

Oh, and look out for the big, slow troggs. You probably don't want to let them anywhere near you.

passages.title: Troggish Troubles
passages.text: Not quite done yet.  Need some more time.

passages.title: Troggish Troubles
passages.text: The results are in.  I've identified traces of corruption in all three samples you brought me.  Rhea will be quite disappointed.

passages.title: All's Fair in Love, War, and Archaeology
passages.text:
First things first, though. I'm not just going to sit here and tell you everything we've discovered down in those ruins. We've got problems to take care of!

Most pressing is those upstart Reliquary hooligans, just on the other side of the tomb. They're makin' off with all of our loot! Don't they know that diggin's dwarf work?

Hunt down a few of their "excavators" - more like bandits, if you ask me - and bring some of these precious artifacts back to me.

THEN we'll talk titans.

passages.title: All's Fair in Love, War, and Archaeology
passages.text: Your bags look heavy.  Heavy with liberated artifacts, I presume?

passages.title: All's Fair in Love, War, and Archaeology
passages.text:
Chalice... worthless.

Vase... counterfeit.

Hieroglyph... interesting, but rather common.

What's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, <name>.

Alright, fine.  Let's talk titans, shall we?

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text:
Inside the chest, you find a small, circular device, resting upon a cushion.

If there are any titan artifacts to be found here in the tomb, this is it. You resolve to bring it back to Dr. Blam.

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text:
Just one tiny little device?

I never did understand those titans.

Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.

passages.title: Water of Life
passages.text:
Take my Water of Life and pass it into the corpse of the drowned dwarf.

He was a worker of metals in life, and though his body now feeds my loch, the Water will allow him to tell you what you want to know.

Then take your information and be gone from my demesne.

passages.title: Water of Life
passages.text:
The Hammer of Twilight? And you say you got this information out of a drowned Wildhammer dwarf?

You're kidding, right?

passages.title: I Said the Words...
passages.text:
Now that you're familiar with the ritual, it's time for you to perform it in the city. Dozens of our brethren have already made their way to the ritual sites.

I want you to visit the portal ritual sites on the second level of the Drag, in the Valley of Honor near the Hall of the Brave, and near Orgrimmar's west gate. The teams there will have made most of the preparations and all you need to do is read the last part of the incantation from the book.

Very soon the city will be consumed in flame.

passages.title: I Said the Words...
passages.text: You've brought many of these traitors to justice, <name>, and yet their numbers keep growing. I fear we won't be able to stomp out all these rituals in time...

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text:
The cultists seem assured of their victory, although we have captured many of them. We must find out more about the ritual mentioned by the cultist you questioned.

These rituals must be the core of their plans to attack Orgrimmar.

Take one of the robes from the arrested cultists; it's not like they're going to need them anymore. Put it on and go back to the cultist outpost at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar and see what you can learn about these rituals and their place in the cult's plans.

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text: It's good to see you again, <name>. We thought the Warchief might have gotten his hands on you.

passages.title: Back Under Cover
passages.text: You need to familiarize yourself with the portal ritual quickly. We've sent dozens of brothers into the city, but only so many can evade capture. We're relying on you, <name>.

passages.title: Show Me Your Papers
passages.text: My men recently discovered a group of cultists attempting to sneak into the city. The flow of traffic into Orgrimmar has come to a halt. The Warchief has decreed that all visitors must be searched before they can enter the gates. Take this copy of his proclamation and read it to the people assembled at the front gates, then assist the guards there in searching those who wish to enter.

passages.title: Show Me Your Papers
passages.text: So there were more cultists waiting to be admitted to the city? It's a good thing that you caught them, <name>. Reading over the note that you found, it seems they're planning something big.

passages.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
passages.text:
The note you found can only mean one thing. The warchief's proclamation was too late; they already have infiltrators at work in the city.

This note contains instructions and locations for cultists to meet, but it doesn't say what they're doing. Our enemies have grown smarter. It's going to be tough to track down all of them, but we have to get as many as we can. Use these cuffs to arrest the infiltrators and then deliver them to Warden Gartok Ragefist at the Ring of Valor in the Valley of Honor.

passages.title: Arrest the Infiltrators
passages.text: So they're preparing some kind of ritual all over the city? Orgrimmar city is infested with cultists and their sympathizers and the warchief is at wit's end. We must do something!

passages.title: Small Comforts
passages.text:
You're the new face that's meant to be helping Keegan out I take it? Pleasure to meet you. Maybe you can lend a favor or two more to the troubled Wildhammer that have made refuge here.

We were all forced to retreat to this building quickly, and some of us left behind things of great value in our destroyed homes nearby. Would you mind bringing them back after you go out there? You would bring happiness to some very troubled souls.

passages.title: Small Comforts
passages.text: Were you able to find their valuables. I know it seems so minor, but little things make a big difference to some people in times like these.

passages.title: Small Comforts
passages.text:
You are very generous. Thank you.

There's a lot of darkness in our world these days. We appreciate the light that you've brought here.

passages.title: The Scent of Battle
passages.text:
Don't let Duglas fool you, the Mullans have been itchin' to take wing again, and if there's anyone we'd do it for, it's Firebeard.

We left our gryphons in the Highland Forest to the south to hunt and to get away from the sounds of battle for a bit. They deserved a rest.

If you want us back in the air soon, you'd do well to help us bring our gryphons back in.

Take this piece of charred highland birch. We use it during training - as soon as they smell it, they'll come straight back to us.

passages.title: The Scent of Battle
passages.text: We're not going to be much use to you without our birds.

passages.title: The Scent of Battle
passages.text: Good on you. I always feel like a part of me is missing when my gryphon isn't nearby. I can't speak for Duglas or the rest of the clan, but I'll be ready to ride at Firebeard's call.

passages.title: The Loyalty of Clan Mullan
passages.text:
Your point's made. Keegan can count on us. We'll meet'm back at town as soon as all the boys are rallied up.

You're tough for not bein' a Wildhammer. Guess they breed'm good where you come from too.

Still, haven't seen ya drink yet. That'll be the real test.

passages.title: The Loyalty of Clan Mullan
passages.text: Ya got the Mullans. Good news! They're worth more than their weight in a fight, and they ain't exactly skinny.

passages.title: Anything We Can Get
passages.text: Stay back and forge more weapons? Pah! A Forgehammer has ne'er been afraid of battle! Who needs the safety of home to make weapons? Besides - there is oodles of raw material out here. Those Dragonmaw weapons are worthless, but they can be smelted down to make actual weapons. Bring me 8 Dragonmaw weapons so me daughter and I can forge real weapons out of them.

passages.title: Anything We Can Get
passages.text: How many have you got so far?

passages.title: Anything We Can Get
passages.text: Yer a good lad.  Have me thanks and a little gold for yer troubles.

passages.title: Somethin' for the Boys
passages.text: Cleaned up the camp and ran errands for Forgehammer? Not bad for a wee <class>. Take these to Iain at Firebeard Cemetery, and he should reward you for a job well done.

passages.title: Somethin' for the Boys
passages.text: What have we here?

passages.title: Somethin' for the Boys
passages.text: Hah! Looks like their raid went mighty well then. I'll have to buy ol' Forgehammer a round once we finish with this mess.

passages.title: Dropping the Hammer
passages.text:
Thanks to you and Iain, we've got enough riders together that we can take the fight back to the Twilight.

We're trained to fight while ridin', but a second rider to handle the Stormhammer tends to be more efficient. I thought you might enjoy the honor.

Pick your gryphon and join the fight. Best be quick about it though - we're aimin' to clear every last one of those Twilight off of those floatin' rocks before the hour's out.

passages.title: Dropping the Hammer
passages.text: Today is the day that the tables turn.

passages.title: Dropping the Hammer
passages.text:
Now that's how it's done, lad!

With a real gryphon wing back together, we can take the fight to the rest of the Twilight. You're welcome to fly with us anytime.

passages.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
passages.text:
I'd say we have a dragon problem, but it seems like they're a little more interested in New Kargath than they are in our small encampment. Nevertheless, I've got top men focused on keeping the dragons at bay.

One problem that has gone unchecked, however, is the ogre camp to our southwest. A small army of combatants seems to have appeared outside of their hovel.

We can't sit and wait for them to flank us, soldier. Thin their ranks before they thin ours.

passages.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
passages.text:
Thank you, <race>.  However, I'm afraid I don't have much to give you, other than this passionate round of applause.

Oh, I do have these.  Here, take your pick.

passages.title: The Root of the Corruption
passages.text:
You might have dealt with the symptoms of our problem, <name>. But I've been studying these foul beasts and the eggs are not laid here by them.

The stream from the current carries their eggs to the dam, but whatever is laying them will be found upstream.

Go northeast, to the river's main source, and deal with the root of the corruption.

passages.title: The Root of the Corruption
passages.text: Is it done yet, <name>.

passages.title: The Root of the Corruption
passages.text:
Yes.  The waters are clearing up.

I am certain I will be visited by a vision before the High Council meets.

Be warned, <race>.  My vote will only be swayed by what I see.

You might have helped us greatly here today, but if the vision sways me to make a case against war then that is the way my vote will be cast.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!

Might I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...

Chapman there sells the recipe, I think.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you!

Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.

passages.title: Marking the Fallen
passages.text:
We've taken more than we've lost, but we've still lost too much. Too many brave have given their lives for the Alliance out there. I want to make sure they're given proper honors no matter how fierce this battle gets.

Take these flags out with you and place one on any fallen soldier you see. The protective wards on them won't offer much protection against any defilement, but it's better than nothing. I'll be able to better judge how many we've lost from a distance, as well.

passages.title: Marking the Fallen
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Those soldiers deserve better than to be left face down in the mud.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!

Might I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...

Chapman there sells the recipe, I think.

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?

passages.title: The Grateful Dead
passages.text:
Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you!

Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: Calder's Creation!
passages.text:
Grim and gory, this next match is sure to have the crowd groanin' one way or another. Calder Gray has been gathering the bodyparts of defeated challengers and building the perfect champion.

This thing is the ultimate cobbled collaboration of corpsified combatants. A magnificent mashup of mangled monstrosities. Are you ready to get messy?! Cause I am! Let me know when you're ready so we can get this thing started!

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: Calder's Creation!
passages.text: No payout until the fight's over, man.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: Calder's Creation!
passages.text:
Wow! When I saw that... thing stumble into the arena, I thought you didn't stand a chance. But you proved me wrong. You tore it apart!

Grizzly business.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Earl of Evisceration!
passages.text:
You're going to have your hands full with this one, pal. We've got a seasoned gentleman warrior here! He hails from Gilneas, and he's out to prove that he's the best warrior this side of Azeroth.

You better pull up those boots and zip up those pants, because it's going to get downright feral up in here. Give me the word when you're down for some punishment.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Earl of Evisceration!
passages.text: You really pulled that one out. I thought you were done for sure when he wolfed and started tearing up the arena. I guess I should know by now that you don't go down easy.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Twilight Terror!
passages.text:
We've got someone you'll really love to hate this time around. I wasn't sure at first if I should let him into the pit, but a fight's a fight! And who am I to turn down some guaranteed cash?!

This guy hails from the Twilight Citadel itself, and comes toting a toasty punch. Better move fast and watch your back! Just give me the word when you're ready for some action.

passages.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Twilight Terror!
passages.text:
Looks like this title is yours! You really pulled that one out of the fire. 

Congratulations. I hope the coin serves you well.

passages.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
passages.text:
My grunts have got this dragon problem under control. Besides, I can't have an upstart <class> like you barging in and ruining our battle plans.

You want work? Fine, I'll give you work. Investigate the ogre camp to our southwest. From what I've heard, a small army of combatants seems to have appeared outside of their hovel.

We can't sit and wait for them to flank us, soldier... especially while we're already embroiled with black dragons. Thin their ranks before they thin ours.

passages.title: Half-Ton Holdouts
passages.text:
You've got the hint of a hero in you, <race>.

Now get out of my battlefield.

passages.title: Bloodwatcher Point
passages.text:
I've got an idea, but it's a bit of a long shot. Thankfully, long shots happen to be a specialty of mine.

North of here, the Reliquary has uncovered a new set of titan ruins beneath the sands. If there's anything older and wiser than dragons, it's titans. Heck, I've heard rumors that the titans CREATED the dragons.

Talk to High Examiner Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher at their camp to the northeast. He'll have more information than I do about these titans.

What did I tell you? It's a long shot.

passages.title: Bloodwatcher Point
passages.text:
Titans?  You come to me, asking about titans?

You've come to the right place, as we're on the brink of discovering something big.  You will, however, need to earn your keep first.

passages.title: It's Not About History, It's About Power
passages.text:
The Explorers' League may have a yeoman's knowledge of the actual act of digging. What they lack, however, is the good sense to USE the artifacts that they dig up. They stow their treasures in stagnant museums instead of using these items of power for their true purpose.

The dwarves are fools. Fortunately, they die easily.

You'll find them digging into canyon walls north of here. Take whatever you can out of their stubby-fingered hands, then return it to me.

passages.title: It's Not About History, It's About Power
passages.text: You've returned with liberated artifacts, I presume?

passages.title: It's Not About History, It's About Power
passages.text:
Chalice... worthless.

Vase... counterfeit.

Hieroglyph... interesting, but rather common.

What's this?  I've never seen trogg craftsmanship of this caliber!  You've stumbled upon something rare indeed, <name>.

We must not be so hasty as to overlook the troggs.  They may be simple, but they know things about the deep, hidden places of this world.

You've performed well enough.  Let's talk titans, shall we?

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text:
Inside the chest, you find a small, circular device, resting upon a cushion.

If there are any titan artifacts to be found here in the tomb, this is it. You resolve to bring it back to Dr. Blam.

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text: Well?  Has our long shot paid off?

passages.title: Return to Blam
passages.text:
Just one tiny little device?

I never did understand those titans.

Very well!  Let's see what this peeper can do.

passages.title: Tailgunner!
passages.text:
Okay, I've softened this guy up, how about you help me finish him off?

I've got a plan for our escape, but it'll require a lot of guts and a little luck.

You up for it, <name>?

Just follow my lead...

passages.title: Tailgunner!
passages.text:
Good work back there, <name>.

Looks like we've lost them, for now at least.

passages.title: A Favor for the Furrier
passages.text:
The commander can be most generous to those who demonstrate their loyalty, and I know of something that you can do to curry favor with him.

Before building up his... ehh... workforce, he dealt in the furs of animals.

He is quite skilled in the art of leatherworking. The furrier can do wonders with even the most tattered pelts.

The dried oasis to the east is said to be home to a rare breed of coyote.

Their furs would make a very thoughtful gift.

passages.title: A Favor for the Furrier
passages.text: Were you successful in your hunt?

passages.title: A Favor for the Furrier
passages.text:
Oh, these are exquisite!

The commander will be able to make a winter uniform with these.

passages.title: Drag 'em Down
passages.text:
A single Dragonmaw drake is worth a dozen Wildhammer gryphon-riders. Take them off of their lice-ridden birds and they're nothing.

Even you can slay them easily, Horde-<class>.

Hunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Finish them! Kill a few Thundermar gryphon riders and I'll believe your Horde is as mighty as you say.

passages.title: Drag 'em Down
passages.text:
You look a little battered. Those dwarves didn't give you any challenge, did they?

Still, that was an impressive show.

passages.title: The Hero Returns
passages.text:
The Stonefather is waiting for you back south at Stonehearth.

Make yourself presentable. You've earned a hero's welcome!

passages.title: The Hero Returns
passages.text:
Our hero returns!

You have saved my people, <name>. You have earned that which you seek.

passages.title: Fashionism
passages.text:
We have a strict policy among our ranks, one that we take most seriously.

Our troops are to dress in official uniform at all times. This helps with organization, friendly fire incidents are reduced, and it keeps the troops looking wonderful!

We call it, Fashionism.

We've been running low on uniforms lately. I must ask that you recover them from the troopers that have fallen in the line of duty.

You should find plenty of the poor fellows east of here, at the Ruins of Ammon.

passages.title: Fashionism
passages.text: Were you able to recover the uniforms we need?

passages.title: Fashionism
passages.text:
Most efficient work, <class>.

You should rise rapidly through the ranks.

passages.title: Thinning the Brood
passages.text:
We have been trying to get a foothold in The Darkwood for weeks now but that forest is infested with spiders. Do me a favor and see if you can thin them out enough for us to set up an attack.

Careful out there, I have heard reports of Horde troops nearby earlier in the week.

passages.title: Thinning the Brood
passages.text: Nice work on those spiders <name>.  At this rate, we will be taking that forest in no time.

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text:
Finding supplies on the island has been difficult, to say the least.

Fortunately, we have found a good supply of silk in The Darkwood, just west of here. The bad part of this story is that the silk comes from the glands on Broodmother spiders. I need you to gather 4 of these for me.

That should be just enough to finish up this last set of shirts.

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?

passages.title: A Sticky Task
passages.text: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, <name>.

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text:
Many soldiers died on this island <name>. It is only fair that we pay our respects to them in any way that we can.

I need you to travel to Forgotten Hill, due west of here and release our brothers in arms' tortured souls away from this place. Do be careful over there, reports of undead have been ongoing in the area.

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text: Were you able to release our forgotten brothers in arms?

passages.title: The Forgotten
passages.text: May their souls rest in peace.

passages.title: A New Master... But Who?
passages.text:
You've arrived just in time.

Here's the skinny: the Dark Iron dwarves in the gorge have been acting strangely, and the Thorium Brotherhood intends to find out why. Overseer Oilfist doesn't like surprises.

We suspect that they're following orders from some new leader. I have reason to believe that Gravius Grimesilt, just south of here, knows who it is.

Even here in Searing Gorge, we've begun to hear tales of your exploits, <name>. You should have no problem with Grimesilt.

passages.title: A New Master... But Who?
passages.text: Any news?

passages.title: A New Master... But Who?
passages.text:
Let's see... Overseer Maltorius... we're quite familiar with him and his work.

What's this?  The "archduke"?  That sounds promising.

passages.title: Dig-Boss Dinwhisker
passages.text:
Grimesilt wasn't as high up on the chain as I thought. We'll have to take out his superior and find out what he knows.

Dig-Boss Dinwhisker's his name, and he runs the Dark Iron digging operations within the Cauldron, just northwest of here. His excavators and footmen patrol the eastern side of the Cauldron, digging downward, day and night.

He's not known to show his face out in the field very often, but if you slay enough of his men, he'll be forced to come out and deal with you.

passages.title: Dig-Boss Dinwhisker
passages.text: If Dinwhisker doesn't have what we seek, I'm not sure what we'll do next.

passages.title: Dig-Boss Dinwhisker
passages.text: A... an ember?  What is this thing?

passages.title: Thorium Point: The Seat of the Brotherhood
passages.text:
Did... did you see that? This is the missing piece we've been looking for! We have to take this information back to someone at Thorium Point.

The Dark Irons have been known to consort with the firelord in the past, but never before have they brought their kind this far out into Searing Gorge.

Thorium Point is west and north of here. You will find it nestled in the cliffs that overlook Pyrox Flats. Take this information straight to Overseer Oilfist.

passages.title: Thorium Point: The Seat of the Brotherhood
passages.text:
Do I know you, <race>?

Sounds like another one of Ragnaros' minions.  I don't like the sound of that.

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text:
Forgotten Hill has been overrun with zombies and ghouls ever since we reclaimed this wretched isle. We have tried to clear them out many times but they always seem to come back.

One of our lieutenants recommended taking the ghouls' bones when we kill them in hopes that they can't reincarnate overnight. Think you can help us out with this one?

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.

passages.title: Salvaging the Remains
passages.text: I didn't think you would be able to do it, <name>.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?

passages.title: First Lieutenant Connor
passages.text:
The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in the Stormwind stockades. None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad. Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale.

I need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.

passages.title: First Lieutenant Connor
passages.text: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.

passages.title: Make Yourself Useful
passages.text:
Gobbles vill be sorely missed, but zhe mission must not suffer.

Perhaps zhere is somezhink you can do to redeem yourself.

Take vone of zhe uniforms you recovered. Vhile vearink it, my vorkers vill not behave so... aggressively.

Lately, zheir morale has been a bit lackink. Some of zhe vorkers are refusing to perform zheir labors.

Auch, zhe audacity!

Find zhese lazy imbeciles and convince zhem zhat zhey must get to vork... or else!

passages.title: Make Yourself Useful
passages.text:
Vell done, <class>.

Zhere may be hope for you yet.

passages.title: Captain P. Harris
passages.text:
The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad. Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there.

To make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors. We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back. Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to. You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline.

Oh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.

passages.title: Captain P. Harris
passages.text: You did it!  Maybe we can finally get some ships into port now.  Thank you <name>.

passages.title: Rattling Their Cages
passages.text:
We have been having issues with the undead down at the Cape of Lost Hope for a while now. Every time a new ship wrecks, they end up getting more undead to join their ranks.

Can you do us a favor and thin out the ranks up there? I know you won't be able to kill them all, but anything you can do will help at this point.

Keep an eye out for horde, we have been getting reports of them ambushing the beach lately.

passages.title: Rattling Their Cages
passages.text: Nice work on the undead up there <name>.  We really appreciate the help.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text:
Morale is low these days, <name>. We make every effort we can to keep the troops in high spirits but we are running low on our main supply of morale booster... rum.

I have been getting reports from our infantry to the south that the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope still have a good supply of southsea rum in their wrecked hulls. Can you head up there and investigate?

Bring back any rum you can find.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.

passages.title: Boosting Morale
passages.text: This rum will really help us out, <name>.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text:
Have you been over to the Wellson Shipyard yet, <name>? Best to stay away from there unless you have a good reason to venture in. Unfortunately, that is exactly what I need you to do.

You see, we have been short on supplies ever since we recaptured the island. That ghost ridden shipyard is overflowing with lumber but every time we send an escort to recover the lumber, they never make it back.

Can you help us out?

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text: Did the ghosts scare you off?

passages.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
passages.text: I didn't think you would be able to do it, <name>.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?

passages.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
passages.text:
Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here. His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them.

He keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard. I need you to take out Wellson for good this time. Be careful <name>, we have been receiving reports of filthy Horde all around the area.

passages.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
passages.text: Great work <name>.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.

passages.title: Recon Essentials
passages.text:
We used to have more stuff around here. I think there was a spyglass somewhere nearby, along with a smithing tuyere.

I'm pretty certain that they've been stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. Yes, I know that I'm a Dark Iron dwarf! I'm talking about the bad ones that live down in that gorge.

You'd best check the steamsmiths that work just south of here. They'd be most likely to use tools like these.

passages.title: Recon Essentials
passages.text: If you're here for the reward, you're gonna have to give me the stolen goods.

passages.title: Recon Essentials
passages.text: Fantastic work!

passages.title: Ghostbuster
passages.text:
See that hill just beyond our base camp? That's Largo's Overlook and it's not a fun place to setup camp next to. We have been dealing with those spirits and spectres ever since we setup base camp.

Can you head up there and let them know we don't plan on leaving anytime soon? A few good kills on their ranks should put them in line.

Thanks for your help on this, <name>.

passages.title: Ghostbuster
passages.text: Who's afraid of ghosts?  Not me.  Well, maybe in the dark.

passages.title: Ghostbuster
passages.text: Great work, <name>!  We should not hear from the ghosts again anytime soon.

passages.title: Dark Ministry
passages.text:
I got one more assignment for ye. This one comes straight down from the Overseer himself. Seems he was pretty shook up once he heard about that "Archduke" ye discovered.

He's asked for us to hunt down three Twilight ministers that work over in Firewatch Ridge, to the west. Kiyuubi, Letherio, and Finister are their names, and they each carry some sort o' special rock. Combine all three and bring 'em back here.

Listen, when the Overseer gives orders, ye don't ask questions. Ye just do it.

passages.title: Dark Ministry
passages.text: Ye got the thing?

passages.title: Dark Ministry
passages.text:
<Hansel weighs the stone in his hands.>

This thing is strange, <name>.  I don't know what to make of it.  It ain't natural, that's for sure.

passages.title: Heat That Just Don't Quit
passages.text:
We smith, we smelt, we roast up whatever spider meat we can get. Bush chicken if we're lucky. Point is, all o' this work means we need lots and lots of fire.

Good thing we're smack dab in the middle of firetown.

O' course, the best fire comes from the elementals. You'll find 'em all over Searing Gorge, but always near lava. Here, take these flasks and use 'em on the elementals.

Oh, did I mention the elementals gotta be alive when you gather your sample?

passages.title: Heat That Just Don't Quit
passages.text: Oilfist says he's gonna have us makin' firebombs soon.  All the more need for those flasks.

passages.title: Heat That Just Don't Quit
passages.text:
Yeeeeeeowch!  Don't just go puttin' this stuff into a dwarf's open hand.  This stuff is burnin' up!

Now me hands are gonna get even more swollen...

passages.title: In the Hall of the Mountain-Lord
passages.text:
The Thorium Brotherhood doesn't maintain a militia - just a few guards, and me, and that's it. If we're to successfully strike against the Dark Irons of the gorge, we're gonna need help.

Mountain-Lord Rendan sits atop that tower across the gorge, to our south. He doesn't consort with Twilight folks or fire elementals, but he hasn't joined the brotherhood either. Maybe it's time we paid him a visit. With his help, we might just stand a chance.

passages.title: In the Hall of the Mountain-Lord
passages.text:
And who might you be?

Ah, an emissary from the Thorium Brotherhood.  They're looking for my support?  Fine, I might be willin' to help out...

...for a price.

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text:
Largo and his minions have been stealing our supplies ever since we setup camp here. It's frustrating to say the least.

We have heard reports that he is stockpiling cannonballs in the towers overlooking the water up on his overlook. Can you head up there and try to recover some of them for us?

<name>, don't forget to keep a watch out for horde too.

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text: Did you find the cannonballs?

passages.title: Cannonball!
passages.text: Good job on the recovery effort <name>. These cannonballs should last us a while.

passages.title: Ruumbo Demands Honey
passages.text:
Ruumbo hungers!

The Deadwood jerks have stolen all their honey from the Timbermaw tribe! We saw...er, Ruumbo saw them do it! Now Ruumbo must have that honey!

Take this... this stick! Yes, this stick. Take this stick and use it to steal the honey from their beehives in Deadwood Village.

Ruumbo must have as much honey as possible. This is vital.

passages.title: Ruumbo Demands Honey
passages.text: Ruumbo can smell whether you have honey or not!

passages.title: Ruumbo Demands Honey
passages.text:
Honey! Delicious honey!

Well done, ugly creature! You may put the honey...put the honey down right there. No, to the left. Yes, there. Just leave it there.

passages.title: Battlezone
passages.text:
It vould appear zhat anozher opportunity has arisen for you to redeem yourself, <race>.

Zhis little emergency has set me back a few tank gunnahs.

You zhink you have vhat it takes to fill in for vone of zhem?

My tanks are just vest of zhe camp. Get out zhere and put an end to zhis silliness!

passages.title: Battlezone
passages.text:
Auch!

If I vere an inch or two taller, I'd be dead!

passages.title: Taking the Overlook Back
passages.text:
There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back.

I think you know what we need to do <name>. Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.

passages.title: Taking the Overlook Back
passages.text: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, <name>.

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text:
Getting useful machine parts out here on the island has been difficult, <name>. We have been trying to repair the broken siege engines here in camp but we keep running out of useful parts.

Our second regiment reported some wrecked out siege engines in a old battlefield to the west. Maybe we could find some parts over there?

You are going to have trouble finding anything in that old battlefield so take this magnetized scrap collector and put it to some good use.

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text: Did that magnet contraptaion actually work?

passages.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
passages.text: These parts will really help us out, <name>!  Who would have thought you can find stuff this useful in all that old junk?

passages.title: They Build a Better Bullet
passages.text:
Those gorge-digging dwarves do at least one thing right: they make very high-quality bullets. I've been unable to reproduce their results, so I've taken to stealing whatever bullets of theirs that I can find.

Ye want my help? Get me a couple hundred bullets from those marksmen below.

I'm sure they'll be happy to give ye their bullets one at a time, but you might find it faster just to look for the crates filled with them.

passages.title: They Build a Better Bullet
passages.text: A real <class> woulda caught the bullets with his teeth.

passages.title: They Build a Better Bullet
passages.text: I'll just divvy these up amongst the guards.  Ye have my thanks.

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text:
I have a new business partner, my best buddy, Brivelthwerp. Even as we speak, he's building up the infrastructure for our new ice cream empire!

He took our coolant tug, inventory, and employees southwest to the Sunken Dig Site. Unfortunately, I don't currently have a way to deliver something to him... something extremely important: our super-secret I-Scream Cryocannon!

You don't mind taking it to him, do you, <name>?

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text:
That must be the new I-Scream Cryocannon! Ain't she a beauty?!

<Brivelthwerp eyes you shrewdly.>

I'm going to let you in on a secret, my good friend: the groundwork for a vast mercantile empire is being laid right here!

Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

passages.title: The Mysteries of the Fire-Gizzard
passages.text:
There's so much we don't know about the incendosaurs. Where did they come from? How do they survive out here on the flats? And why do they taste so bad?

The key to understanding these prehistoric beasts, I believe, starts with the fire-gizzard. Every incendosaur has one. I'd like a few of them to study.

You'll find incendosaurs circling the foot of Iron Summit, mostly to the west.

passages.title: The Mysteries of the Fire-Gizzard
passages.text: I'm finally getting my hands on those lizard gizzards!

passages.title: The Mysteries of the Fire-Gizzard
passages.text:
Ooh, these are nice.  Now, leave me alone with my gizzards.  I've got studying to do!

<Agnes starts to poke the gizzards with a stick.>

Yes, very interesting.  Very interesting indeed...

passages.title: The Mountain-Lord's Support
passages.text:
Alright, alright! If I knew ye could dance like that, I wouldn't'a asked ye to do all that stuff earlier.

Tell Overseer Oilfist that I'll be joinin' ye. I'll meet ye in the slag pit, <lad/lass>! With the combined forces of Thorium Point and Iron Summit, those gorge-dwarves won't know what hit 'em!

passages.title: The Mountain-Lord's Support
passages.text:
So, Rendan's on our side?  About time that oaf came around.

Let's get moving, then.

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text:
I recently came into possession of something that needs to be delivered to a gnome that goes by the name, Brivelthwerp. It's more like Briveltwerp if you ask me.

I want you to take it to him in the southwest, down at the Sunken Dig Site. He's up to something and there's moolah involved... I can smell it!

Keep an eye on what he's doing, <name>, and see if you can't get a cut of his profits. A big cut!

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text: That's not what I think it is? Is it?!

passages.title: Special Delivery for Brivelthwerp
passages.text:
<Brivelthwerp eyes you up and down, but becomes overjoyed at the site of the special delivery.>

Welcome, friend, welcome! I'm going to give you the chance to get involved at the ground level of a once-in-a-lifetime opportuntity.

The entrepreneurial spirit knows nothing of the differences between the Alliance and the Horde!

Tell me... how do you feel about ice cream?

passages.title: How to Maim Your Dragon
passages.text:
<You sling the gore-spattered gryphon corpse over your shoulder, its wings dragging to the ground.>

<Highland Black Drakes roost just southwest of the Crucible of Carnage, along a ring of low mountain peaks.>

<If you drop the gryphon corpse there, a drake is sure to start feeding. With its guard down, you should be able to attack it until it is weak enough to mount and fly.>

passages.title: How to Maim Your Dragon
passages.text:
That was an impressive aerial display, <name>, but I wish it had come at a better time.

Narkrall is a great warrior, but he's also an impatient fool. He's about to get himself killed ... and we're about to lose one of our most important weapons in the battle for the Highlands!

passages.title: Touch the Untouchable
passages.text:
I've added a drop of my very own essence to the ooze. Look for a glowing sigil to the west, at the edge of Shadowlurk Ridge. Stand on it, concentrate, and pour this stuff all over yourself. It should be enough to shift you into the nether and let you see what's REALLY there.

You won't be alone... the satyr's treasure is being guarded by the biggest voidstalker they could summon. Defeat him, and the treasure is yours.

And come back in one piece, or this crazy broad's gonna fry me!

passages.title: Touch the Untouchable
passages.text: Can you hear me in there, <name>? Do you have the claw?

passages.title: Touch the Untouchable
passages.text:
The Claw of Tichondrius...

You hold a piece of the very demon that led the Legion to these woods, <name>. Better for it to be in our hands than with the satyr.

Hold still. I'm going to pull you back to our plane and make sure you and the claw arrive here safely...

passages.title: Finish The Job
passages.text: We have been trying to collect useful scraps from the front all week. Every time we gather a batch to bring back to camp, we get assaulted by the restless infantry in the area. Can you head over there and clear them out?

passages.title: Finish The Job
passages.text: It's about time someone took those guys out.

passages.title: That Smart One's Gotta Go
passages.text:
There's some kind of smart brain bug in the back of the cave. It's in charge of all of the silithid down there.

My ice cream is melting! How am I supposed to launch my ice cream empire, and save my inventory, if that thing's in there?!

passages.title: That Smart One's Gotta Go
passages.text: Outstanding! Nothing can stop us from being the greatest purveyors of ice cream in all of Azeroth!

passages.title: See the Invisible
passages.text:
Yeah, yeah, your stuck-up mage friend there hit it on the nose. The imps over at Shadowlurk Ridge are hiding the key to the satyr's barrier in the nether. It's right there, but you can't see it or touch it unless you're shifted.

I guess you're out of luck though, because only imps can phase shift! So you should just close your eyes, turn around, and let me go...

It was just a joke! Don't hurt me! I'll need slime from the cursed oozes around these ruins. Bring me enough to cover you from head to toe!

passages.title: See the Invisible
passages.text: You got that slime?

passages.title: See the Invisible
passages.text:
Oh good, you're back! Don't leave me alone with her! She's crazy!

Gimme that, I'll have you seeing the invisible in no time!

passages.title: Shark Tank
passages.text:
I hate sharks. All of my troops hate sharks too. This is where you come in, <name>.

I need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank. Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.

passages.title: Shark Tank
passages.text: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!

passages.title: We All Scream for Ice Cream... and then Die!
passages.text:
Don't get me wrong... I'm cheerful on the outside, but inside I'm just terribly torn to pieces. All of my friends and employees are dead.

Could you do me a favor? Would you swim down there and attach the tug's tow hook to my dead employees? I'll reel them in.

passages.title: We All Scream for Ice Cream... and then Die!
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. They gave their lives for ice cream.

passages.title: Operation: Stir the Cauldron
passages.text:
I'm putting you on a flying machine, <name>.

You'll be responsible for softening our landing into the slag pit. Speak with your flight master here in Thorium Point, then fly down to the gorge.

Once you near your landing point, there will undoubtedly be hordes of Dark Iron dwarves waiting for you. Use our flying machine's guns to take out as many of them as you can, then land at the cavern's entrance. Rendan should be waiting for you by the time you arrive.

passages.title: Operation: Stir the Cauldron
passages.text:
Well, here we are.

I hope you're ready, <name>.

passages.title: Rise, Obsidion
passages.text:
Overseer Maltorius is in charge here, but he's not the only dwarf of power within the Slag Pit. Lathoric the Black and his horrifying golem, Obsidion, loom just down this corridor.

Interfering with Lathoric's altar should summon both of them. Find it, then summon Lathoric and kill him. Report to Evonice Sootsmoker when you're finished.

passages.title: Rise, Obsidion
passages.text:
A fight well-fought, <name>!  I'm beginning to feel the tide turn.

Now, when you're ready, let's hit these Dark Irons where it really hurts!

passages.title: Look at the Size of It!
passages.text: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Pillamaster had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.

passages.title: Look at the Size of It!
passages.text: That is one huge pillow! Where'd you get it from?

passages.title: Look at the Size of It!
passages.text: This is better than even I could have thought possible! The Chambermaid's magical pillow is mine! You better believe you're going to get a nice reward for this accomplishment, <name>!

passages.title: Claiming The Keep
passages.text:
Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island, <name>? That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from.

Farson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here. We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep.

Can you finish him off for us?

passages.title: Claiming The Keep
passages.text: You killed him?  We have been trying to take that guy out for weeks!  We thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Twisted Twilight Ties
passages.text:
Hansel and I came here on a secret mission: kill Overseer Maltorius. While our main goal still remains the same - defeating Archduke Calcinder - it can't hurt to take out the infamous overseer of the Slag Pit while we're here.
