Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?

Without your help, this village will surely fall to the combined forces of the Sashj'tar and the sea giants.

<Toryl stands there quietly for a moment.>

Meet me in an underground cave out in Azuregale Bay.

I want to show you something that may turn the tide in this battle.

passages.title: Jandvik's Last Hope
passages.text: I do not know who you are, but I must thank you.

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Come with me to the edge of Elune'ara. Its crystal waters can wash away even the darkest shroud to reveal the truth within.

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Yes, <race>?

passages.title: Dark Waters
passages.text: Malfurion departed in a great hurry, but he bade me give you this before you left. Thank you for all you have done for Azeroth, and for all that you will do in time to come.

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text:
We should have seen this coming. My sister is dead, my friends are wounded and we will likely die here.

I want revenge.

<Lyrea hands you a vial full of growing green liquid.>

We cannot beat them, but we can turn the Stronghold against them.

Wild hippogryphs are attracted to the scent in this bottle. Wild hippogryphs are also notoriously violent when the object of their attraction is not a hippogryph.

Use it to clear a path deeper into the stronghold.

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text: I thought I was alone here. Are you here to continue the fight?

passages.title: Take Them in Claw
passages.text: I heard screams, and I was gratified that they belonged to the Nightborne. Well done.

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text:
They ransacked my library, <name>.

If they want our knowledge, we will give it to them. 

This piece of rune work will allow you to cast an ensnaring spell on the ground. When the Nightborne cross the threshold they will see the true might of the Moon Guard.

Teach them well!

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text: How fares the education?

passages.title: Lay Waste, Lay Mines
passages.text: A lesson we all must one day learn. Never assume your enemy dead until you see their corpse. <Lothrius grins.>

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text:
I have not been able to leave the safety of my guardians to search, but there are three tomes of great importance to me and mine. 

They contain secrets and cantrips that the Nightborne must NOT obtain. 

<Lothrius raises his hand to your forehead, cementing the names of three tomes into your mind> 

If we cannot best them, we must preserve all we can. Hurry, <name>.

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text: Did you locate them?

passages.title: Precious Little Left
passages.text: Thank the Mother Moon... They survived!

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text:
Conjurer Thalerian must be stopped.

He immediately sought out my father's private study when he arrived and he has not yet emerged. I worry that he may have found a very dangerous item.

It is called the Astromancer's Keystone. It is used to manipulate the stronghold's defenses.

Such magic was meant to protect the Moon Guard- used for any other purpose and it becomes unspeakably destructive.

Retrieve the Keystone. Slay Conjurer Thalerian to get it, if you must.

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: The Orchestrator of Our Demise
passages.text: They had no right to this power. Thank you.

passages.title: Overwhelming Distraction
passages.text:
Do you see the Nightborne outside this room?

They hold us here, like mice in a cage. It is more convenient for them that we are pinned down while they search the Sanctum for my father's relics.

My companions and I can escape to higher ground with some help.

Take this crystal. While standing on a mana focusing rune, use it to overcharge a Conjurer.

Their summons will turn on them and create an opening.

Use it well, and we will meet you atop the stronghold when the way is clear.

passages.title: Overwhelming Distraction
passages.text: We were able to make it here safely, thanks to you.

passages.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
passages.text:
This is all that remains of the Moon Guard.

Take a good look.

We are but a shadow of our former selves, and we have the Nightborne to thank for our demise.

For now there is nothing more we can do. If we want to live, we must leave immediately.

Retribution can wait.

passages.title: Last Stand of the Moon Guard
passages.text: I called them here. I will see that they are taken care of after the horrors my people put them through.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text:
It is just as we suspected, <name>! The demons thought they could take us by surprise.

Quickly, to arms! Protect the Banshee Queen!

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text: This is what we were born for.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text:
Your warning just saved us from what might have been a catastrophic loss. Now we can unleash our vengeance upon this Legion filth.

You now have my attention, <class>... and perhaps a bit of appreciation as well.

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text:
I've tried adventuring, and it isn't for me. Cooking is my one true passion: the heat of the stove, the sizzle of bacon... nothing beats it.

Let me help you, Master <name>. If you can bring me some recipes, I can work on improving them, here in Dalaran.

We'll make a great team. What do you say?

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text: We need more recipes before we can do any meaningful work in this kitchen.

passages.title: A Good Recipe List
passages.text:
You are truly amazing, Master <name>.

Now, let's get to work, shall we?

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text:
Power, eh? You bet! I got just the thing!

We've managed to get our hands on a rare venom from an uncharted island deep in the south seas. We captured as much of it as we could.

I had my boys build a device that can inject the venom into weapons, but just in small quantities for now until we've got a better handle on its effects.

Anywho, we got it locked up in a secure area just over there. You're free to use it, Shadow <name>... for a price, of course!

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text: It's like my momma used to say - if you've got the coin, we've got a deal.

passages.title: Injection of Power
passages.text:
Hey, don't even mention it, pal. I'm here for ya any time you need anything!

Seriously though, don't mention it. There are some folks that would do anything to get their hands on this stuff.

passages.title: For the People
Testing the Waters
passages.text:
There is no place that the Sashj'tar can hide from you now, <name>.

They will not be expecting a direct attack in their waters. This is a perfect opportunity to cut down their commanders.

Meet me in Jandvik after you have slaughtered them.

passages.title: Testing the Waters
passages.text:
There are sea giants in the bay!?

You must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

passages.title: The Forge of Guardians
passages.text:
First and foremost, the Forge of the Guardian must be protected. With Kathra'natir's knowledge, it will no longer be safe in Violet Hold.

Together, we should be able to transport it to a safer place. From there, our true challenge can begin.

passages.title: Hatchlings of the Talon
passages.text:
Greetings, hatchling. Do you wish to soar amongst the clouds as my children do?

<Aviana chuckles - a clicking, crow-like noise.>

Very well, receive my blessing and we shall see how developed your wings are.

passages.title: Fall of the King
passages.text:
All that remains is the Sea Giant King.

Place our banner upon his beach and draw him out of the sea. Once he has revealed himself, use the trident to wound him.

There is a derelict boat that washed up on the shore. Use that to quickly get to the king's island.

Gird your loins, <name>. This fight will not be easy.

passages.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
passages.text:
Mlrg...mglrmlr...

Gmlrgmlr mglrml gmlrg! Mlrgrlgr!

<Mrgrglilgrl points at the trail of spiderwebs leading out of the ruin.>

passages.title: Mglrgrs Of Our Grmlgrlr
passages.text: Mlrgmlr rmlgml! Mrlmgrlg gmlrmlrg, grmlgmlr lmrglgr mlgmrlr. Mlgrmlgr grmlmgl, Mrgrlilgrl...

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text:
Amateur merchants complain about supply and demand. Masters create their own.

You have done well retrieving the last two pieces I requested, but they are baubles compared to this.

Your target is the Lady Anastae, and she has something very valuable of mine: A design for a masterwork gem cut. 

Go and get it from her by any means necessary, but take care. She is a master manipulator and will tell you all manner of lies.

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text: What do you want?

passages.title: Elegant Design
passages.text: Lespin shall pay for his crimes!

passages.title: The Other City of Mages
passages.text:
Akazamzarak should be back from Dalaran with a new recruit to the Tirisgarde.

They await your return at the Hall of the Guardian.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text:
Stormheim is steeped with artifacts from tha War of the Ancients. Demon artifacts ta be exact.

I think these artifacts can clue us into some knowledge about their leader, Sargeras. I've already found some fragments to a titan disc, but need ta find the rest of 'em.

I need ya ta dig around Stormheim and see if ye can find any more fragments so we can reassemble the disc.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text: With so many demon artifacts buried here, it's a wonder this place is as vibrant as it is.

passages.title: Corrupted Studies
passages.text:
<Brann takes the fragments and begins reassembling them.>

Well, ye definitely found more o' the Titan Disc, but ye found something else too.

Here, take a look at that!

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text:
From the earth comes strength, and such strength can be imbued into weapons of power.

You have the look of one who seeks to know how to create such weapons.

There are creatures that still inhabit this dying planet who bear such strength. Bring me their cores and I shall trade you the knowledge you seek.

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text: There are also those who use such cores for more than mere forging. Be weary of such beings.

passages.title: Earth to Earth
passages.text:
It would appear the earth trembled at YOUR power instead. Well done, champion.

As we agreed, here are your prizes in exchange for the cores.

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text:
I found something, <name>. Well, a couple of things actually.

First I found an ancient text talking about a demon who harnessed the power of the titan disc I've been searching for.

Then I found a device which supposedly is used to summon 'im! Only, it's missin' some pieces from what I can make out.

I'm sure if we survey around Azsuna some more, those missin' pieces are sure ta turn up.

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text: From what I can make out, I think there's only seven or eight parts we need...

passages.title: And Into the Fel Fire
passages.text: Aye, that's all of 'em, lad. I'll just fix this up and we'll see what happens...

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text:
I fixed the key and am ready to open the chamber.

Meet me there when you have a chance and we'll discover what waits inside together!

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text: I always love a good adventure!

passages.title: Dark Secrets
passages.text:
A piece of the titan disc and a jar of blood. Well it's no wonder the elves locked this place up nice'n tight.

I'll take me disc piece and you can do whatever ye want with that blood.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text:
Now that we're re-supplied, we can get back ta work.

I found something here that I think ye'll be interested in. It's a page of a book talking about the world of Argus. But before the demons destroyed it.

Anyway, it's been me experience that if ye find one of something, there's sure ta be more of it around.

Keep lookin' around Val'sharah for more of these pages and bring what ye find back ta me. And take the page I found with ya so ye know what yer lookin' fer.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text: I can't wait to read the rest of that story.

passages.title: The Purple Hills of Eredath
passages.text:
<Brann skims over the book you've compiled.>

So where's the last chapter?

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text: Very good, very good! Now that we have all the pieces, it's time to put this disc back together!

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text: Jes a moment, lad...

passages.title: The Relic Renewed
passages.text:
After all that time, and we're still missing one piece!

I swear the gods are workin' against me on me quest, <name>.

Oh well, back ta work! And here's a little somethin' for all the hard work ye've done fer me.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text:
I've marked the location of the artifact on your map. It's in a rather hostile location, so I'd like you to go there and find it.

When you've recovered it, bring it back to me so I can discern its power.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text: Perhaps we can use this artifact to turn the tide of this war in our favor.

passages.title: A Beacon of Hope
passages.text:
Let's see what you've found.

<Tae'thelan studies the artifact for some time and lets out a sigh.>

Useless. It's nothing more than a star field generator. Probably from some academy before the war.

You can have it back, <name>. I have no use for it.

passages.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
passages.text:
The nightborne have dropped their shield allowing us to penetrate their city and learn their secrets.

One such secret I've discovered is a crown of immeasurable power.

I'd like you to find this crown and report back to me on what it does.

passages.title: Fit for an Elven Queen
passages.text:
You found it?

<Tae'thelan listens as you explain about the missing jewels.>

I see. So the crown was just a vessel and the jewels are the true source of power.

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text:
Then I believe it's clear what we must do next. Find the jewels.

They're bound to be here somewhere in Suramar, so we better start looking.

I'll coordinate the search from here, while you and my assistants look for the jewels.

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text: What's the status on the search for the jewels?

passages.title: Sifting Through the Rubble
passages.text:
<Tae'thelan takes the jewels from you and looks them over closely.>

There may have been power in them once, but it's been all but drained. These are just pretty jewels now.

Here, take them. Consider them payment for your services here.

passages.title: What Once Was Lost
passages.text:
That reminds me, I found a map to a chamber that may or may not hold something of value.

It doesn't seem to have any power associated with it, which is why I'm handing it over to you.

Here, take some more explosives. They may help speed up the process of finding it.

passages.title: What Once Was Lost
passages.text: <In the small chest, you find a chest with a raven's head etched into the lid.>

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text:
We'll need to hurry before the nightborne realize what we're after.

I'm bringing the goblins along in case we run into any obstacles along the way.

I've marked the location of the entrance to the chamber the Orb resides in on your map.

Meet me there as soon as you're ready and we'll claim this artifact for our own.

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax
passages.text:
NO! How did we fail? We were so close.

The explosives were too powerful. Those damned goblins ruined everything!

Now only a handful of shards of what was once an object of unimaginable power remain.

Take whichever one you want, <name>. I'd like to keep the rest to study.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text:
I'd like you to take the mold to the blacksmith in Dalaran. Alard, I believe his name is.

Have him help you forge a new set of keys.

I found some writing on the back of the mold that may hold the answer to what these keys unlock. I'll stay here and try to translate the text.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text: The key is clearly tied to something here in Azsuna.

passages.title: The Keys to Success
passages.text:
This is not a true key, but rather a device to provide access to the Nar'thalas Academy.

The academy was once a great location of knowledge for night elves to learn the arcane magics, but has long since long been destroyed.

The key is useless junk. You can keep it.

passages.title: Crystal Eyes
passages.text:
I've delved into the caves here and have discovered many ancient writings.

The most interesting I've found are resonating crystals, where the drogbar have resided. Unfortunately, they aren't on very good terms with the tauren here and this has hindered my research.

I thought, should there be any trouble with the drogbar, that you'd be able to handle them.

I'd like you to continue my research and discover what you can about Huln.

passages.title: Crystal Eyes
passages.text:
<Lessah listens to your recounting of the stories you discovered.>

If what you've said is true then that means that the piece I'm looking for is the necklace that Huln once wore.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text:
If I was able to find a bone fragment in what appeared to be a random location, then that means Eche'ro's bones must be scattered around Highmountain.

We must find his remains and give him the proper burial he deserved.

Oh, I'm sorry, in case you weren't aware, Eche'ro was Huln Highmountain's mount and companion.

He deserves to be honored as Huln once was.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text: We must see to it that his remains are given the respect they deserve.

passages.title: Laying to Rest
passages.text:
What an honor, <name>. To think that Eche'ro's spirit will come to your aid should you need it... that is a great reward indeed.

And for me, to witness the majesty of Huln himself! I shall continue to study him, and the glorious legacy he left behind.

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text:
While you were dealing with the stray Owlkitten, I took a look around.

It seems these curious creatures have a habit of escaping their parents' watchful eyes - some are trapped across the road by a wandering Ettin. 

He appears to have been... ahem... eating them.

We can earn Yowlon's blessing by bringing his children home.

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text: Have you managed to rescue any?

passages.title: You've Got to Be Kitten Me Right Meow
passages.text: They look so happy to be home. Excellent work.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone
passages.text: Many thanks, miner. This leystone shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text:
I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin tells me that memory loss is pretty common for a Gnomeregan survivor.

Mekkatorque, or more properly, the High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.

passages.title: Meet the High Tinker
passages.text: It's good to meet you, <name>. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text:
The felstalker pits?!

There's no time to waste, <name>!

 I canna' tell ye what the Burnin' Legion has planned for ol' Brambley, but it canna' be good!

Hurry! We've got to find him before the Burnin' Legion has their way with him!

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text: We've got to get to the felstalker pits an' save Brambley!

passages.title: Into The Pit!
passages.text:
It canna' be true!

Brambley... my dear ol' friend! Why did ye have to go an' die?

passages.title: Work Order: Foxflower
passages.text: Many thanks, herbalist. This foxflower shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text:
I have good news and bad news, <race>.

The bad news is that they somehow managed to capture and train a Devilsaur.

The good news is that it doesn't seem to have a collar and is tame. I imagine it must think that one of the Nightborne in there is its master. Find the pack leader and take him out, and we will set quite a beast upon them.

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text: Did you find the alpha?

passages.title: Apex Predator
passages.text: I saw everything from out here. That was... messy.

passages.title: Work Order: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: Many thanks, skinner. This leather shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Highmountain Salmon
passages.text: Many thanks, fisherman. This salmon shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Mangelrath
passages.text:
The demonic beast that stands before ye, must be the one that devoured ol' Brambley...

Just look at it, lying there with a full belly! I canna abide it any longer, <name>! We must slay the foul creature and avenge Brambley!

We've come this far already, <class>.

Are ye with me?!

passages.title: Mangelrath
passages.text: It's good to see a friendly face, I don't know how much longer I could have held out on my own!

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text:
An adventurer of another time has forgotten to loot something big... something that might cause them great emotional strain if not received quickly.

Your destination is Icecrown Citadel, your target the Lich King's corpse. Retrieve the missing item post-haste and deliver it to the stalwart adventurer - he should be somewhere at the Steam Pools in Feralas.

My assistant will open a portal to deliver you there. Just a moment!

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text: Hold, peasant. What business have you with the illustrious Johnny Awesome?

passages.title: Priority Delivery
passages.text: You'd best carry a reason of a higher caliber than that to dare interrupt my time with these buxom beauties.

passages.title: Timing Is Everything
passages.text:
Can you feel it, <name>? The waters churn with approaching Sashj'tar.

You must strike now...

Leave me... Find a way to bombard the naga... with the kegs...

Protect... Jandvik...

passages.title: Timing Is Everything
passages.text: Fjolrik died in honor of Jandvik. We will remember his bravery.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text:
<name>... I did not expect to see you down here.

The Sashj'tar are... rallying against Jandvik. I had a plan to... decimate them using these old powder kegs.

The naga proved more formidable to these old bones than I thought.

<Fjolrik coughs out some blood.>

We haven't much time... to prepare.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text: Move quickly, <name>.

passages.title: Dry Powder
passages.text:
<Fjolrik looks at you weakly.>

You made it back in time...

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text:
The Tidemistress... is filling her ranks with hulking naga... and sea giants.

Jandvik cannot withstand... their combined might.

Slaughter them... before they reach its shores...

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text: The Sashj'tar attacks are relentless.

passages.title: Sunken Foes
passages.text: The Sashj'tar forces are far greater than I imagined.

passages.title: Against Their Will
passages.text:
When the naga brought me down here, I saw many of my vrykul mining the sea floor. They had... squids... attached to their faces.

Whatever those things are, they must be controlling my kin and forcing them to work for the naga.

I do not know what will happen if you remove the squids, but I would rather my vrykul die than be slaves to the naga.

See me in Jandvik when the deed is done.

passages.title: Against Their Will
passages.text: I must express gratitude for the vrykul you have saved this day.

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text:
The first step to establishing a moonwell is to gain the blessings of the local wildlife. 

It is their good will that enables us to peacefully coexist, and a moonwell thrives on such energies. Combined with Elune's light, a moonwell can purify its surroundings for years.

To begin, we must find creatures willing to give their blessing. We can start with these owl-cat creatures.

They ran while you cleaned, but I saw one lingering just before the bridge. 

See if you can find where it lives!

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text: Did you bring the little one back with you?

passages.title: Homeward Bounding
passages.text: Well this is an interesting turn of events.

passages.title: Trouble Has Huge Feet
passages.text:
The Ettin's hide bears many shallow scratch marks and bite scars. It seems he had been terrorizing the local Owlcats for quite some time.

Mardranel Forestheart would be interested in this.

passages.title: Trouble Has Huge Feet
passages.text: Ahhhh... Well done, I am sure our furry friends here are very thankful for your efforts.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text:
I cannot, will not, accept what is happening here. My body resists me, but I will stop this.

<He looks at you.> You will stop this.

Here is a root of the corrupted World Tree Shaladrassil. It has somehow found its way out of the ground to this untouched place and already the Darkfiend satyrs are hard at work corrupting Suramar.

Stop them. Kill the satyrs, take their horns, drive their points through the totems.

Only then can we have any hope of reversing this.

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text: Have you stalled their efforts, <race>?

passages.title: Not Here, Not Now, Not Ever
passages.text: I am relieved, though there remains more we must do.

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text:
An amateur merchant looks back on their previous work as a learning experience. A master knows that some things are better left forgotten.

I was... vain, centuries ago. Desperate to prove myself, I took on a bold commission.

Find him and bring... it... back. You will know what I am talking about when you see it.

He resides near the villa south of this courtyard.

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text: He was so passionate, so driven. I saw his vision, created it to his exact specifications. Beautiful filigree and enamel put to a fearsome weapon...

passages.title: Estate Jewelry: Haute Claw-ture
passages.text: By the Magistrix, I had forgotten how ugly that thing is. Impeccable workmanship, obviously. Just... ugh. I should melt the whole thing down.

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text:
Now, <name>, do not mistake me- I am a druid. I understand that nature has a balance.

Predators must feed, and others will be hunted. I also understand that tampering with such balance has consequences.

That is why I have taken upon myself to walk this land and perform some... ah... calculations.

Slay only a small number of the wolves you find, and one alpha. That should reduce their number enough to allow the Sablehorn to thrive without disrupting the flow of things here.

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text: Are you being gentle with your pruning?

passages.title: Prongs and Fangs
passages.text: In the end, they will all thrive- for with more Sablehorn, the wolves will eat better in the years to come.

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text:
As a druid I understand that predation happens. Creatures that eat meat must acquire meat.

But this...

<Solendra gestures angrily toward a nearby petrified nightsaber.>

This is just sad. Free them, <race>. Take my blessing and free them from this needless torment.

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text: Have you freed them, <race>?

passages.title: Moonwhisper Rescue
passages.text: I am much relieved, <name>.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text:
You have done very well, <race>. 

All that is left is to combine their blessings into the ritual bundle and imbue the Moonwell. Once that is done, Mayruna will add a little water from a purified Moonwell and this land will be protected so long as we inhabit it.

This is a momentous occasion, my friend. You bear witness to a sacred rite not often performed in the company of strangers.

I will let you do the honors- simply place the ritual bundle into the sacred waters and we will do the rest.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text: You witness history, <race>.

passages.title: Eminent Grow-main
passages.text: Your assistance made this all possible. Thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Armguards
passages.text: Hail, blacksmith. I can take these armguards off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Boots
passages.text: Many thanks, blacksmith. These boots shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Gauntlets
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Warhide Mask
passages.text: Hail, leatherworker. I can take this mask off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Battlebound Armbands
passages.text: Many thanks, leatherworker. These armbands shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Warhide Gloves
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Robe
passages.text: Many thanks, tailor. This robe shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Hood
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Deep Amber Loop
passages.text: Hail, jewelcrafter. I can take this jewelry off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Skystone Pendant
passages.text: Many thanks, jewelcrafter. This jewelry shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Azsunite Loop
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Avalanche Elixirs
passages.text: Many thanks, alchemist. These elixirs shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Ancient Rejuvenation Potions
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Dragons of Nightmare
passages.text: Hail, scribe. I can take these supplies off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Ursoc
passages.text: Many thanks, scribe. These supplies shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Il'gynoth, The Heart of Corruption
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Strength
passages.text: Many thanks, enchanter. This enchantment shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Intellect
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Work Order: Pump-Action Bandage Gun
passages.text: Hail, engineer. I can take this device off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Auto-Hammer
passages.text: Many thanks, engineer. This auto-hammer shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Work Order: Failure Detection Pylon
passages.text: The Kirin Tor thank you.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text:
You did well against that sea witch, but not well enough.

Her power far surpasses any creature that I have ever fought. To defeat her, we will need something formidable. Something that she will not expect...

<Toryl grins wryly.>

Something of their own design... 

Salvage as many parts from their harpoon launchers as you can carry and meet me back in Jandvik.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text: The Tidemistress is a dangerous foe. We must be just as cunning to defeat her.

passages.title: Breaking Down the Big Guns
passages.text: You have all the parts that you will need... two in some cases.

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text:
You work for a murderer and a thief.

That design he wants? It is called the magistrix cut, and it was perfected by my husband. He was killed by Lespin for his secret.

I had him entombed in a small cave north of the city, for we could not make the trip to Tel'anor. Buried with him is a tome that contains the secrets of the design.

Retrieve the design and keep it out of his hands!

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text: Where is the master?

passages.title: The Master's Legacy
passages.text:
Well well, looks like that old fool finally met his match?

It looks like the Promenade is in need of a new jeweler, and I think I have learned all I could from my former master.

Here is something for your efforts.

passages.title: Cry More Thunder!
passages.text:
You have proven yourself an ally of the Thorignir and we will lend you our strength. I would ask one last favor of our new champion, though. 

The dragon who guided you to me awaits his vengeance against the vrykul. Together I wish for you to show these Drekirjar what it means to cross the Thorignir. Their toll must be paid in blood.

Speak to Vethir when you are ready.

passages.title: Highmountain Tribes
passages.text: Assist the Tauren of Highmountain by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Highmountain Tribes
passages.text: The Highmountain tribes thank you.

passages.title: Arkethrax
passages.text:
Within the Ingress is a demon who must die.

Arkethrax is a creature of cunning evil. If left unchecked he will be able to use the Ingress as a staging point for targeted assaults that will decimate our forces.

I, for one, have no intention of underestimating this opponent and shall join you on the battlefield when you are ready to fight him.

passages.title: Arkethrax
passages.text: With Arkethrax and his minions dealt with it should help prevent them from flanking Illidari Stand. Well done.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: It appears you & your weapon are both growing in strength. Return to me at the Heart of Azeroth. I have more to show you.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text:
Now that we have the necessary worm guts, I was able to fashion them into a special sort of rope.

It will allow you to descend from the bridge into the chasm below and recover some of my possessions that were stolen and thrown in by the Deeprock.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text: I have never been particularly fond of heights.

passages.title: Going Down, Going Up
passages.text:
I can't believe it! I hoped it would work, but I couldn't be sure.

You recovered heirlooms passed down by my family for many generations.

I thought them lost forever.

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text:
Is that Ebonchill you've got there? Alodi's old staff? My my my... <Cough>

In the days of the first guardian, all the members of the Council of Tirisfal granted their powers to the young mage in the hopes that he could overcome the Legion. <Wheeze> None of them are alive today... but that staff of yours remembers.

Search the streets of Dalaran below for reflections of the former council members. Their memories may empower you as they once did Alodi. Seek them out and speak with one!

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text: Seek out the memories of the former Council members. None are here in the upper floors of the tower, and none would be in the sewers. <Cough> Check the public squares, the inns, the lower floors of the tower, the streets... A sharp eye is your ally.

passages.title: Memories of Ebonchill
passages.text:
Ah, your eyes gleam with newfound knowledge, <name>.

That staff of yours has seen the passing of many mortal lifetimes.  It can teach you a great many things, if you're willing to listen.

As for its memories... they may be unreliable. You may find a different reflection haunts the streets of Dalaran each day. I leave it to you to find them all.

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text:
It looks like the ravenbears have started gathering materials for some sort of tribute, but the storm drakes are keeping them from finishing what they started. 

From the looks of it, they're gathering fully intact stag horns and long tail feathers from the greatstags and eagles nearby. 

It shouldn't take too long to gather the rest of what they need.

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text: Ca-caw?

passages.title: Nithogg's Tribute
passages.text:
Caw! Caw! 

<The ravenbear chieftain flaps his wings excitedly when he sees the reagents you've brought.>

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text:
All right, I've got one last beasty to send you after. He's a bit far out, but trust me, it'll be worth it. This one I put a huge wager on!

Along the eastern coast swims a great shark the locals call Steelscale. They say his hide is near impenetrable.

But you're gonna prove them wrong, aren't ya chum? Bring me his fin, and those tauren will have to fork over a princely sum.

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text: Hmm...

passages.title: Put It All on Red
passages.text:
<A note from the goblins is left behind, along with an old magnifying glass>

I wish I coulda been there to see the look on your face, but Raz and I got bigger fish to fry!

Thanks for the trophies and meat. I'm sure they'll fetch a nice sum on the black market, along with all the goodies we got from those stupid tauren! I'm sure they won't be needing them any more!

So long sucker!

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text:
Your research has granted you access to a very powerful ritual, one that will require the aid of a few friends if you wish to successfully summon a demon.

The ritual needs to be performed at the summoning platform above. 

Keep in mind, this sort of power always comes at a price. Not all who participate in the summoning will survive, so be prepared.

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text: You can begin the ritual on the summoning platform above.

passages.title: Ritual of Doom
passages.text:
So I take it things went well then?

A ritual of that magnitude requires a bit of recovery time. You cannot expect to perform it more than once a day.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text:
You will never know how thankful we are to you, <race>. Because of you, Moozy and my husband are safe. I won't let either of them out of my sight!

I am sorry to ask one last favor of you, but do you think you could find my mother and bring her here so she can see that her grandchild is safe?

Her name is Ethel, and her home is on the northern bluff of Thunder Totem.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text: Thank you for your kindness. Truly.

passages.title: Moozy's Reunion
passages.text: Your kindness will not be forgotten. You are a friend to my family, <name>.

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text:
Stranger! You are the one I have heard of?

When the kerfuffle with the drogbar happened, some of the young moose ran off!

I can't chase them down or the others might wander off as well.

Could you bring them back here?

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text: The moose are already broken. Just hop in the saddle and you can bring them here to me!

passages.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
passages.text: Thank you, friend to Highmountain.

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text:
Those foolish calves!

They've made off with our ceremonial drums again, treating them as toys... as... common drums!

Can you help me find them? They must be scattered to all corners of Thunder Totem by now, discarded as soon as the fun dries up.

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text: Can you feel the beat?

passages.title: Ceremonial Drums
passages.text: Nice! Got 'em! Feel free to play the drums, but leave them down here, will you? You're alright by me, <name>.

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text:
Well met, good chap!

I was on my way to study the local murlocs when I stumbled upon these most peculiar ruins. Those pirates over yonder arrived first, and it appears they've unleashed some ancient evil.

I would be remiss to let such an evil run rampant, but we should learn more of it before we proceed, lest we end up like those chaps.

I spied the crew bringing back some tablets from the ruins. If you can bring them to me, I may be able to decipher the nature of this evil.

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text: How goes the hunt for knowledge?

passages.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
passages.text:
Excellent! Luckily I brought a copy of the vrykul cipher that the League procured from Northrend.

I'll get to work on this straightforth! Let us hope the dialects are not too dissimilar.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text:
Unfortunately, we may have another problem. That mist seeping out of the ruins has affected the looting pirates. It's driven them quite mad.

Only one of them seems to be unaffected - a captainly fellow with a very fine hat. He wears a large ruby amulet, which I believe protects him from the mist. You'll need it if you are to enter the tomb.

He may not give it up willingly.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text: We will need the amulet's protection to proceed.

passages.title: A Stone of Blood
passages.text:
You have the amulet! Most excellent!

Of course, that probably won't help you with the pirates that are already mad as hatters, but small victories, eh chap?

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
I see you have grown in strength. With it, some of the untapped potential within your weapon is released.

Come back to the Hall of the Guardian when you are done with your adventures, and I will show you more.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text:
<Olothil sighs.>

My sister tries my patience sometimes.

No matter. I've identified a few locations that our parents might be. I shall search in this area with Kallistia. You've already helped us so much... would you help us look to the east?

You can use my scrying orb to see the locations that our ritual has uncovered.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text: Thank you for your aid, <class>.

passages.title: Back from the Dead
passages.text:
After over ten thousand years... to see mother and father again...

<The elven mage is at a loss for words.>

Thank you, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text:
Loramus has researched a way to make our warglaives even deadlier, especially against demons.

If he's to be trusted, he says that all he needs is an amount of Obliterum. Normally, the substance is used to improve the protection of armor, but Loramus insists he can use it for our warglaives.

I am certain we will all benefit from their increased deadliness on the battlefield.

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text: Have you obtained the Obliterum?

passages.title: Deadlier Warglaives
passages.text:
That stuff's hard to get and expensive. Impressive! I can't wait to see the results.

Ready for the next big task? No rest for the wicked.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
This is your vessel, <name>. She's a fine ship; been through many a campaign. Speak with the ship's captain when you're ready to depart.

Good luck out there. We've received few reports about what's happening at the Broken Shore, but I'd wager King Varian has matters well in hand.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...

Damn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

passages.title: Where the Wildkin Are
passages.text:
Owlbeasts are often charged with protecting places of importance to Elune. But if her influence over them wanes or is cut off, the creatures can become dangerous.

These wildkin, unfortunately, must be dealt with. The recent disturbances in Val'sharah have driven these creatures to madness.

Once an individual is lost, there is only one way to address the problem.

I cannot bring myself to kill one of Elune's creations, but I know what must be done.

passages.title: Where the Wildkin Are
passages.text: I wish it did not have to come to this, truly.

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
Allies from across Azeroth have come to Stormwind to support our efforts against the Burning Legion.

Before you ship out, you should pay them a visit. Every bit of preparation helps!

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text: The Light protects those who protect themselves!

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
It's good to see you've prepared yourself. You never know what you'll be facing out there.

We've commissioned these rings for high-ranking members of the Alliance. May this one protect you in the battle to come.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text:
When I arrived at my home, the front door was barred by magical roots.

I was able to remove them, but few of my tribe possess the necessary ability to do so themselves.

Take my staff. Its powers will easily disentangle the obstructing roots.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text: My old bones need more rest than I would care to admit.

passages.title: Grassroots Effort
passages.text: The grell trapped our young within the huts. They are no longer at risk, thanks to your generous efforts.

passages.title: The Diamond King
passages.text:
Me brother Magni, once King o' Ironforge, got changed into a diamond statue by a titan ritual. He's stood frozen in the belly o' the city fer years.

But I just got word that he's up and around... sayin' he knows somethin' 'bout how to beat the Legion!

Look, <name>, I dunno if Magni's crazy, or if that's even really him. But if there's even a chance he kin help us...

I'm told he muttered the name Ulduar. That's where I'm headed! I'd be obliged if you an' Khadgar were ta join me.

passages.title: The Diamond King
passages.text:
Magni's information was crucial to our efforts against the Legion. And it was good to see him again.

Now to find that tome about the Pillars of Creation...

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text:
Come closer, <race>.

Ragnaros in the Firelands, Al'Akir in his Throne of the Four Winds, and Neptulon in Throne of the Tides. They have been thorns in my hide since the world was new.

Prove to me your strength over the weaker elements, and I shall teach you how to display your power for all to see.

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text: Prove your mastery over magic and the elements, <race>.

passages.title: Controlling the Elements
passages.text: Now the other elements will truly fear you.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
My three sisters from that tree hung,
The crimes accused there was not one,
The youngest sister did escape,
As the noose looped around their nape,
Old Ravencrest is the one to blame,
This curse for you to lift our shame.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
Steel your heart and drink deep,

Return my sister back to sleep.

passages.title: Under the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
My dear sister laid to rest,
A tortured hero proves their best,
Today I do lift this curse,
And offer you a token, a small purse,
My other sisters are still gone,
There comes a day to right their wrong...

passages.title: The Kirin Tor of Dalaran
passages.text: Assist the Kirin Tor of Dalaran by completing 3 world quests.

passages.title: The Kirin Tor of Dalaran
passages.text: The kirin tor thank you.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: It appears ye and yer weapon are both growin' in strength. Return to me at Netherlight Temple. I have more to show ye.

passages.title: Time to Rumble!
passages.text: Welcome to the Black Rook Rumble! Many combatants have entered to prove their might in the Black Rook Arena, and now it is your time.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text:
An opportunity presents itself, <name>.

Ly'leth has arranged to grant you entry into a ball at the Court of Stars. I do not know what we may gain from this venture, but there is one task I must set for you.

Advisor Melandrus once called himself my ally. He and I planned Elisande's downfall, but when the moment came I found myself betrayed.

The wound his dagger inflicted still aches. I cannot enter Suramar to take my revenge, but you can.

Give him a traitor's death, and bring me his spellstone.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Court of Stars: Beware the Fury of a Patient Elf
passages.text:
<Thalyssra clutches the spellstone tightly for a moment.>

He brought this upon himself.

I cannot linger in the past. Elisande is weaker without him, and we are one step closer to righting the wrongs inflicted upon the shal'dorei.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text:
Hey there, pal. My sources around here say you had a run-in with the Sixtrigger brothers. I'd imagine you're not very happy with them?

Let's just say we're not exactly friends either.

So I'll tell you what. How about I let you in on some intel about their current location? Maybe they might have an unfortunate accident, you follow?

Oh, and bring some friends. They're not exactly the easiest of targets.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text: This seems to be where the Sixtrigger brothers keep their most prized spoils.

passages.title: Time to Collect
passages.text:
With the Sixtrigger brothers ended, you're finally able to collect your payment for services rendered.

You rummage through their most prized possessions and take your pick.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: There are a great number of factions here on the Broken Isles. We must unite them if we want to stand a chance against the Legion. Prove your worth to them and report back to me.

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: Any luck uniting the factions?

passages.title: Uniting the Isles
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. We still have a long road ahead of us to rid this world of the Legion, but this brings us one step closer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
Grand Master, you have saved our order from the brink of destruction.

Your deeds have shown us that with effort and determination we can overcome any challenge. In light of your example, we have doubled our efforts and developed a technique that will awaken your weapon to its true potential.

Please, stand before the Forge of the Roaring Mountain and raise your weapon high.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Grandmaster.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: I have been experimenting with technology that allows you to alter the structure of beasts, specifically with how they look.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: This is my most magnificent invention I have made. In the last 10 minutes.

passages.title: A New Invention
passages.text: Here you go, <name>. Take care of Hati and the Titanstrike and be safe in your adventures.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Soul Forge are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Suffer well, Deathlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Circle.

We are inspired by your determination and have developed a new technique that will bind the power of your weapon with the Emerald Dream itself!

Everything is prepared. When you are ready we shall begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Archdruid.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: With this new power, the Legion will fall!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to report that the improvements to the Forge are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Slayer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapons serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, our research into the Felblood Altar has proven useful. We've developed a ritual that should unleash the full powers of your artifact weapon!

Say the word, and we shall begin the ritual at once!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Netherlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: With this new power, nothing shall stop us!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much for our order.

Through your words and deeds we've been inspired to redouble our efforts and I'm proud to report that we've discovered a new technique that may be of use to you.

If you have a moment, <class>t, I would be pleased to show you the fruit of our research.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Archmage.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
Farseer, since you have joined us you have done much to aid the Earthen Ring.

Your efforts have not gone unnoticed. The spirits have watched all that you have done and are pleased. They also have shown me a technique that will unleash the true power of your weapon!

The ritual is ready. When you are prepared we can begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: We honor you, Farseer.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, in our short time together you have done much to aid the Conclave. Now, with the work upon the Altar of Light and Shadow complete, it is time that we aid you. We have discovered a method to awaken the full power of your weapon!

Please, step before the altar and raise your weapon high.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: All hail the, High <class>!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the crucible are complete!

When you are prepared, we shall use it to unlock the true potential of your weapons!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Shadowblade.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May your new weapons serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
I'm pleased to say that the improvements to the Altar of the Eternal Hunt are complete!

When you are ready, we shall use it to unlock the full potential of your weapon!

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Huntmaster.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May the new powers of your weapon serve you well.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text:
<class>t, you've brought together the Silver Hand like no <class>t has done before. You've shown us that with determination and faith in the holy light we can overcome any challenge.

Following in your example our workmen have toiled hard to improve the Altar of Ancient Kings, allowing it to unlock the true potential of your weapon.

Their work is now complete! Step forward when you are ready and we shall begin.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: Well done, Highlord.

passages.title: A Hero's Weapon
passages.text: May this blessed power aid you in the times ahead.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, <name>. Do you have a moment?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Do you have a moment, Conjurer?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

The ancient blue dragon in Azsuna known as Senegos lays dying and is key to our journey. You must aid him - I will meet you in his domain as soon as I am able.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text:
Once we have the proper implements we can use the Heart to infuse great power into your artifact. We need only a source.

Deep within the Darkheart Thicket lies the ancient Oakheart, once a great and mighty protector of Shaladrassil. He has regrettably fallen to the nightmare like so many of his kin.

As the darkness within him has taken root, an essence of the corruption has manifested. I ask that you recover the essence so that we may draw from its power, and put noble Oakheart to rest.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text: You have the essence?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Fallen Power
passages.text:
The ancient is at peace once more.

May his sacrifice not be in vain.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text:
We have everything we need, <name>.

Once you are ready, raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari to safely absorb the power stored within the nightmare essence.

I will use the blood you provided to make sure the ritual stays safely contained.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text: This is but the first step in unlocking the true potential hidden away deep within your artifact, but it is an exciting milestone nonetheless.

passages.title: Lucid Strength
passages.text: Well done! Everything went as planned.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text:
We must do what we can to ensure that the Nightmare never again festers within the Emerald Dream.

The aberration known as Il'gynoth lies at the heart of the corruption - a living, writhing manifestation of the horrors you will encounter at every turn of your journey.

I ask that you ensure its destruction, along with the Nightmare Lord himself... Xavius.

Once the deeds have been done, bring a small piece of each to me. We can study them to figure out just how the Nightmare grew so quickly.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text: Is the deed done?

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: In Nightmares
passages.text:
That is... far more than we needed.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text:
Now that we have a better understanding on the Heart's capabilities, it is time we tap into its true potential.

In the Emerald Nightmare you will find creatures that should not be; monsters that defy all that the Dream stands for.

All that the green flight itself stands for.

Each of these fiends carry within them corrupted essence, as Oakheart did, but far more potent. Gather all that you can, and we will turn their corruption against them.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text: The task before you is not simple, but I have faith in your abilities.

passages.title: The Emerald Nightmare: Essence of Power
passages.text:
Your bravery rivals that of my own kind.

Well done.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text:
As before, <name>, once you are ready raise your artifact and channel its energy upon the Heart of Zin-Azshari and we will unleash the power of the essence you gathered.

Do not worry - we still have enough of the blood you gathered to ensure the ritual remains stable.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text: After all you have done for my flight, this is but a small favor in return.

passages.title: Essential Consumption
passages.text: That is all I can do for you, little one. If you seek more power, you must look elsewhere.

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text:
Out of all the books, why that one?! Oh, Mother Moon, I am but a trusting fool.

I apologize, you have no idea what I'm going on about.

I lent my first edition copy of "Wards, Sigils, and the Nightborne Way" to a dear friend - well, former friend, I should say - just before the betrayal.

As fate would have it, there is an incantation in that book that I will need for my part of the ritual.

Please retrieve it if you can, but be careful - it is quite valuable!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text: Did you find it? Oh, please tell me you found it!

passages.title: Court of Stars: Literary Perfection
passages.text: That's the one! Oh, thank you, <name>. Thank you!

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text:
The elusive Wardens run an immense secret prison facility deep underneath the mountains of Azsuna housing all manner of terrible creatures.

Perhaps... 'used to run' is more accurate.

This presents us with a unique opportunity. The wardens used powerful containment crystals to encase each prisoner in their cell. If any of them still remain intact, we could use one to safely contain the Heart's power.

They certainly won't be needing them.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Borrowing Without Asking
passages.text: Excellent. This will work quite well.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text:
Vizuul's runebindings are more potent than I had anticipated. Not a bad thing - more power is certainly welcome - but there's certainly more potential for catastrophe if the spell matrix somehow becomes unstable.

We should be able to safely contain the fel energy within the containment field using the eon winder you recovered... but keep an eye open just in case.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text: I'm sure we'll be able to keep everything stable.

passages.title: A True Test
passages.text: I'm... so sorry, <name>. I was so sure that would work...

passages.title: Saving the Guard
passages.text:
The Moon Guard were once among the most powerful sorcerers on Azeroth. Most assumed their ranks demolished after the War of the Ancients, but it seems they have managed to survive in their ancient stronghold in Suramar!

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if they still oppose the Legion.

<name>, if you can save what remains of the Guard, I will work to convince the Council of Six to lend us additional aid.

passages.title: Saving the Guard
passages.text: It seems we have gained new allies. Let us figure out a plan of action.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text:
Grand Magistrix Elisande and her cohorts have lost their minds - they truly believe that allying themselves with the Legion will end in anything but their own demise!

They are too far gone to save, I'm afraid, but they still have powerful items that we can use to help us infuse the Heart of Zin-Azshari with their power.

In your assault on the Nighthold, ensure you recover the mad construct Trilliax's power core, as well as the spellbook of the Grand Magistrix herself.

Good luck.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text: I ask more of you than I wish, but there is no other way.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Delusions of Grandeur
passages.text:
<Thalrenus' eyes widen at the sight of the Millenia Tome.>

If Elisande has seen reason... perhaps there is still hope for the Guard after all.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text:
Our work is very nearly complete. Now that the Heart can safely absorb power from fel magic, we need the strongest sources of it that we can get our hands on.

Gul'dan has called the nightborne's elite back to the Nighthold to aid him. The storm of fel energy above the palace has seeped into the very fabric of their being, even making its way into the crystallized pieces of the Nightwell that many carry with them.

Those shards are exactly what we need, <name>. Save as many as you can in your assault.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text: How many Nightshards were you able to retrieve?

passages.title: The Nighthold: Into the Nighthold
passages.text:
<Kalec sifts through the pile of Nightshards.>

Yes, these are perfect! There's just one more thing we need.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text:
Before we perform the ritual there is one last thing I must ask of you, <name>.

You must finally bring Gul'dan to justice.

No more of his lies, his deceits, or his trickery. None of it can save him now.

Take one of his conjured eyes when you're done. Using his power for good will be a fitting end.

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text: Is the deed done?

passages.title: The Nighthold: Darkness Calls
passages.text: Let us not waste another moment.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text:
At long last, it is time to reap the fruits of your labors.

Lothrius tells of a place deep in the former Moonguard Stronghold used to infuse new Guards with immense power. It will be the perfect place to tap into and augment the power of the Nightshards you gathered.

Gather your effects and meet me there when you are ready, and we will use the Heart to finally reveal the great power within your artifact.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text: This is a truly momentous occasion.

passages.title: Balance of Power
passages.text:
Your artifact's new form is even more fantastic than I imagined.

Please, take what remains of the Heart as a token of my gratitude for such a marvelous adventure - there is still a fair bit of power left inside it.

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text:
<This leyline appears to be damaged and needs repair.

Several large chunks of the main column are missing and arcane energy is crackling in the gaps.

The elementals nearby seem to pick up debris and absorb it into their bodies as they move around. Maybe they have the missing pieces...>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text: <The leyline feed crackles as wild energy escapes the gaps in the column.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Ley Station Aethenar
passages.text: <As you insert the fragments back into the pillar the arcane energy begins repairing the cracks. You infuse the feed with ancient mana and the structure stirs to life.>

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text:
Souls are not the only plunder Helya craves, and the kvaldir are ever eager to please.

Among their spoils are the venerable blades of fallen heroes who dared stand against Helya's minions. These blades belong in a place of honor, not among their wretched kind.

Reclaim the blades, for the honor of the Tideskorn!

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text: Do you have the blades?

passages.title: To Honor the Fallen
passages.text:
I will see that these blades are returned where they belong.

The dead smile upon you, outsider.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text:
In a time before memory, the Naglfar was the prize of Helya's fleet. It would seem that it has lived on to serve her once more.

Now, the dread ship sails the sea of souls, and cuts through the mist unseen by the living. The kvaldir must have a way to summon her, and this is what you must seek.

Find her berth and board the Naglfar. Put an end to the dread ship, and the souls of the Tideskorn may be redeemed.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Piercing the Mists
passages.text:
With the dread ship sundered, the souls of the dead will know their judgement. 

Odyn will have his champions, and the Tideskorn will have their honor.

passages.title: Needs of the Many
passages.text:
[THIS IS A TEMPORARY QUEST TO GET YOU TO DALARAN IN THE BROKEN ISLES.]

Please take this portal to Dalaran in the Broken Isles and begin your artifact quest!

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text:
Battlelord, I have a request. Find me inspiration! An axe whose form has seen a truly astounding amount of battle, wielded by one of the world's most powerful warriors. Both weapon and owner forged together in the crucible of war.

Find this hero and their weapon, and convince them to come here.

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text: You've found them?

passages.title: Secrets of the Axes
passages.text:
Thank you, Battlelord. The Valarjar will be even better equipped once I've made my adjustments.

It has also inspired me to think of your weapon. The Blade Breaker. In my mind's eye the axe is called that.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text:
If we are to infuse the shard's power into the Ashbringer we will need help. We cannot wield such dark magic; however, I know who can...

The Knights of the Ebon Blade.

I will commission a flight for you to Acherus at once and meet you there - find Aludane Whitecloud in Dalaran when you are ready.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text: Darion owes us this much after all his kind have done.

passages.title: Walking in Shadows
passages.text: It is done. I hope you're right about this, Highlord.

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text:
The Exodar shook from the force of the Legion's arrival. Before we could react, demons were running rampant through the halls, slaughtering everything in their path. If it were not for the Prophet, we would have all perished in the initial assault.

I was charged with evacuating the Crystal Hall, which is when my Broken and I were separated from the main force.

We fell back into the collapsed hall to make our last stand.

With your aid, we may survive this invasion.

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text: The Legion must fall!

passages.title: Nobundo's Last Stand
passages.text:
You have my thanks, and the gratitude of the Broken, hero. Many would have considered us an acceptable loss, yet you have shown us great compassion and kindness. An act that I - we - will not soon forget.

Now we will return to the Vault of Lights and assist Velen as best we can.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
The third fleet has shipped out ahead of us, <name>. This gryphon will bring you to them.

Good luck out there. It's clear the Legion isn't going to make this easy, but let's hope King Varian has matters well in hand.

passages.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...

Damn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I will need more research material if I'm to keep improving on our current records.

If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
It may sound strange, but in order to do more research I will need, uh, more research material.

If I am to get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I will need to increase our overall knowledge levels before I can research the artifact further.

Before I can get started, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes. They may be hard to procure. I asked one of the scouts to seek them out, here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
We definitely have plans to improve our research methods. 

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I had one of the initiates attempt to find them. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I have some ideas on how we can improve our research methods.

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I put one of the researchers on digging up where they might be. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
More research? Absolutely!

Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
I think I can help you, I mean all of us, out.

Before I can get started though, I need some books. Some important ones. They may be hard to pinch. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text: I know of a few books that will give me the right place to start. They may be hard to get your hands on, but they'll be worth it. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text: Before I can get started though, I need a series of ancient tomes to begin my research. They may be hard to procure. I'll give you my notes to help you find them.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Your races use books to store their histories, and I will need some of these to piece together the legend of your steel. I asked one of your followers to look into their locations for me. Here are her notes.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Stashed Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Extraneous Order Resources
passages.text: Feeling safe, stranger?

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Piles of Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Sealing Fate: Immense Fortune of Gold
passages.text: A simple exchange with complex results.  That's the art of doing business.

passages.title: Focusing Our Efforts
passages.text:
The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.

Afterward, seek out the Moon Guard in the northern reaches of Suramar. They, too, could be valuable allies in our cause... if they still oppose the Legion as they once did many years ago.

passages.title: Focusing Our Efforts
passages.text: Let us speak with Thalrenus and discuss our plan of action.

passages.title: They Have A Pitlord
passages.text:
The Feltotem are not the first to embrace the temptations of the Burning Legion. And they will not be the last.

But in their arrogance, they have conjured a pit lord.

Will you join us in battle against this beast? The power of your artifact and skill could prove invaluable against such a creature.

passages.title: They Have A Pitlord
passages.text: The other demons we will contend with in time. But that pit lord, it was a creature of great evil and beyond our devices to defeat on our own. Your skills were appreciated.

passages.title: Permanent Hire
passages.text: You have not spoken to Saffrin yet, have you? Otherwise you would not be here.

passages.title: Supply the Effort
passages.text: Have you recovered the stolen items?

passages.title: Web of Manipulation
passages.text: Have you solved our spider problem?

passages.title: A Small Bag of Seeds
passages.text: <This small bag of seeds seems forgotten, perhaps Aliya Hillhelm could make use of them.>

passages.title: A Light of the Dark
passages.text:
The image of a purple candle, burning with glorious power springs unbidden to your mind as you contemplate the decaying filth before you, followed by a faint whisper echoing through your mind: "One candle to rule them all, and in its brightness bind them."

Bring Janky the candlesmith in Gundargaz enough Coagulated Black Blood to forge a most unfortunate candle.

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: Lily's Locket
passages.text: <This locket must be important to someone. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Lost Shoe
passages.text: <A shoe in the style worn by members of the Hillhelm family. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Clutch of Eggs
passages.text: <A clutch of chicken eggs, they must have come from a nearby farm. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text:
We placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

While highly effective, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They must be regularly fed with latent arcana lest they weaken.

As Magisters, it is our duty to maintain the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text: We must ensure the runestones are charged and defended.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text: Your strength is matched only by your acuity, my dear. I will ensure everyone knows how marvelously you have performed today.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
passages.text:
The Magisters placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

Naturally, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They can be fed with latent arcana, but that power draws enemies seeking to claim it.

As Blood Knights, it is our duty to defend the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
passages.text: Maintaining the safety of Eversong is of utmost importance.
